author: catherine-booth
fields.title: Okutya Katonda
fields.description: Okutya Katonda okw'amazima kufaanana kutya? Vumbula amaanyi agakyusa ag'okwenenya okw'amazima, okukkiriza okulamu, okusaba okw'obunyiikivu, okwagala okutukuvu, n'okwewaayo eri Katonda n'omutima gwonna. Vuganya Obukristaayo obw'obukuusa, kebera omutima gwo mu kitangaala ky'Ebyawandiikibwa, era yaniriza obulamu obujjudde obutukuvu, obuwulize, n'amaanyi ag'omwoyo.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Eby'okubuulira bya Mukyala Booth, ebyafulumizibwa edda nate wansi w'omutwe ogugamba nti “ Aggressive Christianity ,” byajjira Abakristaayo b'omu Amerika ng'eddagala eriwonya obunafu bwabwe, era ng'ekisikiriza ekigolokosa obugayaavu bwabwe.

Eby'okubuulira ebiri mu kitabo kino bye ddagala eriziyiza obulwadde, nga bwe byetaagisa nnyo, era nga bye bukuumi eri ensobi eziwera ez'omu ngeri gye tuyisaamu emyoyo gy'abantu; ensobi eziziletera okuyingira mu kizikiza eky'e Misiri, mu kifo ky'okuyingira mu kitangaala eky'ekitalo.

Ekyokubuulira ekikwata ku Kwenenya kiraga bulungi nnyo okwenenya okw'obukuusa, ekintu ekitaliimu makulu ekiteekebwa mu kifo ky'okuleka ddala buli ngeri ya kibi, n'okukyukira ddala eri Mukama. Olw'obwangu bwakyo n'obunnyonnyofu, kiba kyokulabirako eri okubuulira okw'okuzuukusa okunyiikivu,—oba okusinga, eri okubuulira kwonna eri emyoyo egitalokolebwa, wabweru w'ekkanisa oba munda mu yo. Emyoyo gino gyonna gijja kusangibwa nga geekwese mu bukuusa obumu, obuteekwa okumenyebwa awatali kusaasira, nga tebunnaba kulekebwa ne bagenda ku Lwazi olwayatika.

Ekyokubuulira ekikwata ku Kukkiriza okulokola kye kiddako. Ebizibu eby'akabi ebiva mu kintu—ekiyinza okuyitibwa okukkiriza okw'Antinomian, olw'obutafuna kigambo kirala kirungi okukinnyonnyola—kwe kukkiriza kw'amagezi awatali kwenenya, okukkiriza ebyafaayo eby'Enjiri, kwe bavangeeri bangi n'abayigiriza b'eddiini abalala kwe bayita okukkiriza okulokola, byanjuluzibwa bulungi ne bissibwako akabonero akalaga nti, BUTWA. Okwesiga Kristo okw'obukuusa okugoberera okwenenya okw'okungulu, okutaawulirangako bubi bw'ekibi n'okunakuwala okw'amazima okw'ekibi, kuleetedde amakanisa gaffe okuba n'ekibiina ky'abantu abangi, nnabbi Mikka be yannyonnyola bulungi bw'ati nti: “Ekibi kya Isiraeri kinene era tebakyenenyezza, kyokka bajja kwesigama ku Mukama, ne boogera nti, Mukama tali wakati mu ffe?” Tukakasizza nti omulimu omunene ogw'omubuulizi omwesigwa era omukambwe, abuulira ng'amaaso ge gasimbye ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka ennene enjeru ne ku Mulamuzi akka, gwe kuggya abeeyita Abakristaayo ku kwesiga kwabwe okw'obulimba mu Mulokozi atabalokola, n'okukebera ennyo emitima gyabwe egyavundira mu kibi, egyayanguyirizibwa okulangirirwa nti giwonye, “giwonyeewonye katono.”

Bangi ku ffe twagamba awatali kwegendereza emyoyo egyazuukusibwa nti, “Kkiriza kyokka,” nga tetunnayita mutima na kitala ky'amateeka ga Katonda okuguyita ku njuyi zombi. Tugobye omusomesa wa Katonda.

Amateeka, gali ng'omuddu eyalagirwa omulimu gw'okutwala omulenzi ku ssomero, n'okumukwasa omusomesa, twagalowoozaako nga gakambwe era nga ga bukambwe nnyo eri emirembe gyaffe egy'okulumirwa, ne tugagoba mu butamanya, ne tweyambisa obuvunaanyizibwa bwago obw'okutuusa eri Kristo, ne tubula ekkubo, ne tubuza omwoyo ogw'omuwendo omungi. Katonda atusaasire, era atuwe obuwombeefu, nga bwe yawa Apolo, tugololwe omukazi eyafukibwako amafuta!

Oluvannyuma lw'okugolola kwe okw'ekiseera ekituufu ku njigiriza enkyamu ku kukkiriza, Mukyala Booth ageenda mu maaso, ng'akutte akambe ak'okusalako, okusala okuggya ku muti gw'Obukristaayo obw'omulembe guno obukuku obw'obutwa obw'”okwagala okw'obukuusa.”

Eby'okubuulira bye ebina ebikwata ku kwagala bye ttaala nnya ezateekebwa ku njazi ez'okwagala okw'Ekikristaayo okw'obulimba. Ateekawo ebigezo ebiwera ebitalimba, ebisobozesa okwagala okw'amazima okwawulibwa okuva ku kukoppa okwa Setaani okw'ekivve. Ng'ebbaluwa za Yokaana Omutukuvu, eby'okubuulira bino bijjudde ebipimo eby'okugezesa okwagala, empisa eyo eya zaabu ey'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Kyandibadde kya mugaso nnyo eri bonna abeeyita nti balina okwagala okutuukiridde okugoba okutya kwonna okubonyaabonya, okwessaako ebipimo bino awatali kutya.

Bayinza okusanga ekigambo “okutuukirira” nga kifuna amakulu amawanvu, amagazi era amawaggulu okusinga bwe baali balowoozezza edda. Lwaki endowooza yaffe ku kutuukirira okw'Ekikristaayo terieyongera bulijjo okukula ng'okumanya kwaffe Katonda n'amateeka ge amatukuvu kweyongera?

Ekyokubuulira ekikwata ku Embeera z'Okusaba Okukwata, tukirumiriza Abakristaayo bonna n'abo bonna abanoonya Kristo, abakungubaga olw'okusaba kwabwe okutawangula wa Katonda. Mu kitangaala eky'ekyokubuulira kino ekitegeerekeka bulungi bajja kuzuula nti obuzibu buli mu butaba na mukwano gwa Yesu Kristo, oba mu butagondera biragiro bye, oba mu butabeerawo mu mitima gyabwe kw'Omwoyo asaba ku lw'abalala, oba mu kukkiriza okw'akamogo. Mu kunyonnyola ebiziyiza okusaba bino, omubuulizi asaanukulula omutima, era n'obukugu obw'okulongoosa omwoyo, agukebera okutuuka ku ntobo yaakwo ennyini. Engeri ye ey'obwogezi obukwata, obuvumu bwe n'engeri ye ey'obwangu gy'ayisaamu abamuwuliriza, ng'aggyako obukweke obw'ekibi n'obwefaananyi, engeri ez'enjawulo ebibi bino gye byeteesamu mu mitima gy'Abakristaayo bangi ne biziyiza okutuuka kwabwe ku ntebe ey'ekisa, kitujjukiza Ddokita Finney bwe yayolesa awatali kusaasira n'okubonereza abalabe bano ab'obutukuvu obw'Ekikristaayo, ne Yokaana Wesley bwe yasimbula n'emirandira “Ekibi mu Bakkiriza.”

Mu kyokubuulira kino, Mukyala Booth akyusa amaaso ge eri ekitundu ekirala eky'okukkiriza n'eky'ensobi ey'omu ngeri gye tuluŋŋamyamu emyoyo eri Kristo. Endowooza ye ku kibuuzo kino ekizibu si ya kusukkiridde wabula ya magezi era ey'omu byawandiikibwa. Ayigiriza nti Katonda yakola obulokozi okuweebwa mu kiseera kye kimu n'okukozesa okukkiriza, era nti “okugamba omuntu akkirize nti alokolebwa, nga tannalokolebwa, kwe kumugamba akkirize obulimba.” Naye anywerera ku nsonga nti ekikolwa ky'okukkiriza kikolebwa n'obuyambi obw'enjawulo obwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu awa obukakafu nti omukisa oguuŋŋanyibwa gujja kuweebwa. Obukakafu buno, oba akasigo, obuweebwa Omwoyo, bufuuka omusingi ekikolwa eky'enkomerero eky'okukkiriza kwe kwesigama, kwe kugamba nti, “Nzikiriza nti mfuna.” Kino kikwatagana n'ekya William Taylor ekya Katonda eky'”okukakasa ensonga ey'omwonoonyi okwewaayo eri Katonda, n'okwaniriza kwe Kristo,” nga okuweebwa obutuukirivu tekunnaba. [Footnote: Election of Grace, pp. 38-42.] Abayigiriza bombi bakkiriziganya n'okwekenneenya kwa Wesley okw'okukkiriza okuyigiriza nti omutendera ogw'okuna era ogw'enkomerero, “Ye akikola,” guyinza okutambulwa okwo kwokka olw'amaanyi ag'enjawulo agasoboza aga Mwoyo Omutukuvu, [Footnote: Sermons. Patience, Section 13; Scripture Way of Salvation, Section 17; and Whedon on Mark 11: 24.]

Bonna abasatu bateeka amaanyi aga Katonda okukolebwa nga tekunnaba kulangirira nti, “Nzikiriza nti mfuna,” oba “mmaze okufuna” (R. V.), ne bafuula okulangirira okwo okwesigama ku kutegeera enkyukakyuka eya Katonda mu mwoyo. Bonna banywerera nti okukkiriza okulokola si kikolwa kya mpisa buntu bwa muntu, wabula amaanyi ag'okukkiriza n'omutima gava eri Katonda, era nti kiteekwa okulindirirwa mu kusaba, era nti kifuuka mu mukkiriza olukalala lw'ebikolwa eby'ekitalo era eby'omwoyo, empisa ey'omwoyo, mu kiseera kye kimu ensigo n'ekibala eby'okusisimula obulamu obwa Katonda, nga byegatta mu byo empisa ez'obuwombeefu obw'okwenenya, okwefiiriza, okwesiga okwangu, n'obuwulize obutuufu obusibuka mu kwagala. Abayigiriza bano bakuza ekitundu kya Katonda mu kukkiriza. Tunoonya kyereere mu byawandiikibwa byabwe okusanga okulagirira kwonna eri oyo eyeenenya nga kuno nti, “Kkiriza nti olokolebwa, kubanga, Katonda bwe kigamba mu Kigambo kye,” wabula kkiriza nti olokolebwa bw'owulira Omwoyo we ng'akaaba nti, Aba, Kitaffe, mu mutima gwo.

Abayigiriza bangi ab'omulembe guno bagwa mu nsobi ey'okuyisa okukkiriza okulokola ng'ekikolwa ky'amagezi awatali buyambi, ekiyinza okukolebwa, nga bwe kyagalibwa, mu kiseera kyonna. Wabula kikolwa kya mwoyo ekiyinzika kwokka nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu asikirizza, atumiza okukkiriza kwokka bw'alaba okwenenya okw'amazima n'okwewaayo okw'omutima eri Katonda.

Olwo Omwoyo n'abikkulira Kristo era n'ayamba okumukwata. Mu kuwakanya enjigiriza ey'oku ntikko ey'okulondebwa edda egamba nti okukkiriza kwe kisa ekitaziyizika ekigabirwa n'obuyinza abalonde, waliwo akabi kanene ak'okugwa mu nsobi ey'okwawukana, eyitibwa Pelagianism, efuula okukkiriza okulokola ekikolwa omuntu ow'obuntu bw'ali kye asobola okukola awatali buyambi bwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Omusango omwennyini ogw'obutakkiriza guli mu butafaayo obw'okweyagalira eri Kristo, n'obutenenya bw'omutima, Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw'atasobolera kussaamu okukkiriza okulokola.

Mu nnyanjula yaffe eri “ Aggressive Christianity ,” twalanga, ku lw'amakanisa g'omu Amerika, ekyetaago ekya bonna—Obunyiikivu. Mu kwogera kwe okumpi okw'e Exeter-Hall, Mukyala Booth abikkula ensibuko y'ekiweebwa. Obutukuvu bwe nsulo y'obunyiikivu. N'olw'ekyo si mataba ga kiseera, wabula mugga oguyiwa amaanyi mu bonna ababulina, era, naddala mu Salvation Army, nga gwetisse ku kifuba kyagwo ebibinja by'e Bungereza ebitali mu kkanisa.

Obunyiikivu obutukuvu busaasaana era buwangula. Tetusobola kukwata bantu na luyompo lw'amagezi ag'okuwakana; naye tebalirema kuvuunama eri omuggo ogw'obwakabaka ogw'okwagala okwaka era okusanyusa. Abasajja abatono be basobola okuwakanya; bonna basobola okuwulira. Obunyiikivu n'obulokozi obujjuvu, ng'abalongo abeegatta, tebiyinza kwawukanyizibwa ne biba bulamu.

Ensobi ey'oku katebe k'okubuuliriza ak'omulembe guno eri ng'ey'omuweesi akuba ekyuma ekinnyogovu—akabonero akatono n'okukola okunene. Okubatizibwa okw'omuliro okugonza ebibiina byaffe kwandyangusizza omulimu omuzibu ogw'omubuulizi ne kwaza ebibala byagwo.

Emboozi ennya ku Butukuvu za kubuulirira okusinga okuwakana oba okunnyonnyola byawandiikibwa. Za mpewo ez'amaanyi ez'omwoyo. Kizibu okulaba Omukristaayo yenna bw'ayinza okugumira okwegayirira kuno okw'omuliro okukola ekyo Joseph Cook ky'ayita “okwewaayo eri Yesu Kristo okw'okwagala, okutuukiridde, okutakyusibwa, okw'emirembe n'emirembe, ng'Omulokozi era Mukama,” okusobola okutuuka ku “kufaanagana okutuukiridde okw'okuwulira ne Katonda,” okutuukirira okw'Enjiri mwe kuli.

Kimpa essanyu lingi okuba n'ekitundu ekitono eky'obuwombeefu mu kuwuluguma okuyita ku ssemazinga w'Amerika ebigambo bino ebyaka ebiva ku mimwa gya Debola ono ow'omulembe guno, nnabbi omukazi Omukristaayo eyayimusibwa Katonda okununula abantu be okuva mu buwambe obw'eby'ensi n'obunafu obw'eby'eddiini.

“Singa Katonda abantu ba Mukama bonna,” abasajja n'abakazi, “baali bannabbi, era nga Mukama ateeka Omwoyo we ku bo!”

“Tuziyize olugendo lw'Omwoyo, Oba tuzikize omuliro ogw'omu ggulu?

Katonda ateekewo ababaka be, Era oyo gw'anaayagala okussaamu Omwoyo!

Afuuwe nga bw'ayagala, Omwoyo bw'alonda Ebikozesebwa tubiwa omukisa: Tunaasanyuka, singa Kristo abuulirwa, Ne twagaliza ekigambo okukulaakulana.”

DANIEL STEELE.

Reading, Mass., Nov. 23, 1883.

Tunoonya kyereere mu byawandiikibwa byabwe okusanga okulagirira kwonna eri oyo eyeenenya nga kuno nti, "Kkiriza nti olokolebwa, kubanga, Katonda bwe kigamba mu Kigambo kye," wabula kkiriza nti olokolebwa bw'owulira Omwoyo we ng'akaaba nti, Aba, Kitaffe, mu mutima gwo. Abayigiriza bangi ab'omulembe guno bagwa mu nsobi ey'okuyisa okukkiriza okulokola ng'ekikolwa ky'amagezi awatali buyambi, ekiyinza okukolebwa, nga bwe kyagalibwa, mu kiseera kyonna. Wabula kikolwa kya mwoyo ekiyinzika kwokka nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu asikirizza, atumiza okukkiriza kwokka bw'alaba okwenenya okw'amazima n'okwewaayo okw'omutima eri Katonda. Olwo Omwoyo n'abikkulira Kristo era n'ayamba okumukwata. Mu kuwakanya enjigiriza ey'oku ntikko ey'okulondebwa edda egamba nti okukkiriza kwe kisa ekitaziyizika ekigabirwa n'obuyinza abalonde, waliwo akabi kanene ak'okugwa mu nsobi ey'okwawukana, eyitibwa Pelagianism, efuula okukkiriza okulokola ekikolwa omuntu ow'obuntu bw'ali kye asobola okukola awatali buyambi bwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Omusango omwennyini ogw'obutakkiriza guli mu butafaayo obw'okweyagalira eri Kristo, n'obutenenya bw'omutima, Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw'atasobolera kussaamu okukkiriza okulokola. Mu nnyanjula yaffe eri " Aggressive Christianity ," twalanga, ku lw'amakanisa g'omu Amerika, ekyetaago ekya bonna—Obunyiikivu. Mu kwogera kwe okumpi okw'e Exeter-Hall, Mukyala Booth abikkula ensibuko y'ekiweebwa. Obutukuvu bwe nsulo y'obunyiikivu. N'olw'ekyo si mataba ga kiseera, wabula mugga oguyiwa amaanyi mu bonna ababulina, era, naddala mu Salvation Army, nga gwetisse ku kifuba kyagwo ebibinja by'e Bungereza ebitali mu kkanisa. Obunyiikivu obutukuvu busaasaana era buwangula. Tetusobola kukwata bantu na luyompo lw'amagezi ag'okuwakana; naye tebalirema kuvuunama eri omuggo ogw'obwakabaka ogw'okwagala okwaka era okusanyusa. Abasajja abatono be basobola okuwakanya; bonna basobola okuwulira. Obunyiikivu n'obulokozi obujjuvu, ng'abalongo abeegatta, tebiyinza kwawukanyizibwa ne biba bulamu. Ensobi ey'oku katebe k'okubuuliriza ak'omulembe guno eri ng'ey'omuweesi akuba ekyuma ekinnyogovu—akabonero akatono n'okukola okunene. Okubatizibwa okw'omuliro okugonza ebibiina byaffe kwandyangusizza omulimu omuzibu ogw'omubuulizi ne kwaza ebibala byagwo. Emboozi ennya ku Butukuvu za kubuulirira okusinga okuwakana oba okunnyonnyola byawandiikibwa. Za mpewo ez'amaanyi ez'omwoyo. Kizibu okulaba Omukristaayo yenna bw'ayinza okugumira okwegayirira kuno okw'omuliro okukola ekyo Joseph Cook ky'ayita "okwewaayo eri Yesu Kristo okw'okwagala, okutuukiridde, okutakyusibwa, okw'emirembe n'emirembe, ng'Omulokozi era Mukama," okusobola okutuuka ku "kufaanagana okutuukiridde okw'okuwulira ne Katonda," okutuukirira okw'Enjiri mwe kuli. Kimpa essanyu lingi okuba n'ekitundu ekitono eky'obuwombeefu mu kuwuluguma okuyita ku ssemazinga w'Amerika ebigambo bino ebyaka ebiva ku mimwa gya Debola ono ow'omulembe guno, nnabbi omukazi Omukristaayo eyayimusibwa Katonda okununula abantu be okuva mu buwambe obw'eby'ensi n'obunafu obw'eby'eddiini. "Singa Katonda abantu ba Mukama bonna," abasajja n'abakazi, "baali bannabbi, era nga Mukama ateeka Omwoyo we ku bo!" "Tuziyize olugendo lw'Omwoyo, Oba tuzikize omuliro ogw'omu ggulu? Katonda ateekewo ababaka be, Era oyo gw'anaayagala okussaamu Omwoyo! Afuuwe nga bw'ayagala, Omwoyo bw'alonda Ebikozesebwa tubiwa omukisa: Tunaasanyuka, singa Kristo abuulirwa, Ne twagaliza ekigambo okukulaakulana." DANIEL STEELE. Reading, Mass., Nov. 23, 1883.

fields.title: Okwenenya
fields.body_html:
Matayo 3:2 “Mwenenye, kubanga obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu busembedde.” Matayo 4:17 “Okuva mu kiseera ekyo Yesu n’atandika okubuulira ng’agamba nti, ‘Mwenenye, kubanga obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu busembedde.’” “Kyennava, ai kabaka Agulipa, ne sijeemera kwolesebwa okw’omu ggulu: naye nnasooka okubuulira abo ab’e Damasiko, n’e Yerusaalemi, ne mu nsi yonna ey’e Buyudaaya, n’eri Abaamawanga, nti beenenye bakyukire Katonda, bakole ebikolwa ebisaanira okwenenya.”—EBIKOLWA 26. 19, 20.

Mu kamwa k’abajulizi basatu—Yokaana Omubatiza, Yesu Kristo, n’Omutume Pawulo—ekigambo kino kinywezebwa, kwe kugamba nti okwenenya kye kigobererwa ekitasoboka kwewalibwa nga oyagala okuyingira mu Bwakabaka bwa Katonda.

Abantu awamu batabuka nnyo ku nsonga eno, ng’abanywerera ku kigambo nti okwenenya nteekateeka Katonda gy’ateekawo mu bwetavu bwe yekka. Nzikiriza nti Katonda yakola obulokozi bw’omuntu okuba obwangu nnyo nga bwe kyali kisoboka eri amagezi ge Ayinzabyonna, agataliiko kkomo. Naye waliwo obwetaavu mu nsonga eno, nti kitugwanira “okwenenya n’okukyukira Katonda.” Kyetaagisa ddala nti enneewulira zange zikyusibwe era zireetebwe mu kwenenya eri Katonda, nga bwe kyetaagisa nti omulenzi omwonoonyi atawulira, enneewulira ze zizzibwe mu bumu ne kitaawe nga tannaba kusonyiyibwa. Amateeka ge gamu ag’omutima ge gakolebwa mu mbeera zombi, era obwetaavu bwe bumu mu byombi.

Bwe wabaawo kitaawe w’omwana yenna wano alina mutabani we omukirivu, mbuuza nti, Lwaki tommagana na mutabani wo? Omwagala—omwagala nnyo. Oboolyawo okwagala kwo gy’ali kw’omanyi okusinga eri abaana bo abalala bonna. Omutima gwo gumwegomba buli lunaku; omusabira emisana n’ekiro; omuloota ekiro; omutima gwo gwegomba mutabani wo, era ogamba, nga Dawudi bwe yagamba nti, “Abusaalomu, Abusaalomu, mutabani wange, mutabani wange.” Lwaki tommagana naye? Lwaki tomukuba ku mutwe, oba n’omusiimuula ku maaso, n’ogamba nti, “Mutabani wange omwagalwa, nsanyufu naawe nnyo. Nkwagala n’essanyu; nkusiima?” Lwaki bulijjo omunenya? Lwaki oteekwa okumuwanika ewala? Lwaki toyinza kubeera naye mu bulikwano? Lwaki toyinza kumuleka ng’ayingira n’afuluma, n’abeera naawe mu mbeera y’emu ng’omuwala ow’okwagala, omuwulize?

“Wangaana!” ogamba, “ensonga y’enjawulo; siyinza. Si nti, ‘Sandyagadde;’ wabula, ‘Siyinza.’

Ekyo nga tekinnaba kubaawo, enneewulira z’omulenzi zirina okukyuka gye ndi. Alwana nange; alina endowooza enkyamu ku nze; alowooza nti ndi muzibu, era wa ttima, era munyigiriza, era wa bukambwe. Nkoze byonna kitaawe w’omwana bye yandikoze, naye alaba ebintu mu ngeri endala eyawukana ku bye biri, era akutte enneewulira zino enzibu gye ndi okutuusa lw’ankyawa, era ajja kweyongerayo okujeemera by’enjagala. Ogamba nti, “Kyetaagisa nti, nga kitaawe w’omwana omugezi era omutuukirivu, nteekwa okunywerera ku nkyukakyuka mu ye. Siyinza kumusembeza nga mutabani wange, okutuusa lw’ajja ku bigere byange. Ateekwa okwatula ekibi kye, n’ansaba mmusonyiwe. Olwo, wangaana! okwagala kwange okw’obuzaale nga kulyanjaala n’essanyu lingi! Nga bwe nnandidduse okumusisinkana, ne mmubambira emikono ku bulago bwe! naye waliwo ‘siyinza’ mu nsonga.” Bwe kityo bwe kiri. Si nti takwagala, ggwe omwonoonyi; si nti omutima gwa Katonda omunene, ogw’ekisa, tegukukaabidde amaziga ag’omusaayi; si nti tandikubambidde emikono gye egy’okwagala kaakano kano, singa ojja ku bigere bye, n’oyatula nti wali mukyamu, n’onoonya okusonyiyibwa kwe; naye, obutali bwe kityo, tayinza—tasobola.

Amateeka g’obutonde bwe gamuziyiza okukola bw’atyo. Obulungi, oboolyawo, obw’obukadde n’obukadde bw’ebitonde ebitafa, mwe biri. Tawakanya, era tasobola, okutuusa nga mu ggwe mubaddemu enkyukakyuka mu ndowooza. Oteekwa okwenenya. Lukka 13:3: “Bwe mutalyenenya, mwenna mulizikirira bwe mutyo.” Kale, obanga okwenenya kye kigobererwa ekitasoboka kwewalibwa olw’obulokozi, katutunuulireko akaseera, tugezaako okuzuula okwenenya kye kiri ddala; era, wangaana! ensi n’ekkanisa nga bijjudde okutabuka ku nsonga eno!

Nkigamba, kubanga nkimanyi olw’okwogera n’abantu ebikumi. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyambe! Kale, okusooka, okwenenya si kukakasibwa kwokka nti oli mwonoonyi. Wangaana! singa kibadde kityo kyokka, ensi endala nga bwe twandibadde nayo leero, kubanga waliwo obukumi n’obukumi ku mitima gyabwe Omwoyo wa Katonda kw’akoledde omulimu gwe ng’abakakasa nti balina ekibi. Ntya nti twandyewuunyizza ddala, ne tutya, ne tusobezebwa, singa twategeeredde ekibiina ky’abantu Katonda b’akakasizza nti balina ekibi, nga bwe yakola Agulipa ne Fesuto. Wangaana! sandisobodde kubagamba muwendo gw’abantu, mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe ez’okweraliikirira, abankutte ku mukono, ne baŋŋamba nti, “Wangaana! nnandiwaddeyo ki okuwulira nga bwe nnali nawulira edda!

Waaliwo ekiseera, emyaka kkumi n’etaano, oba kkumi na musanvu, oba amakumi abiri egiyise,” n’ebirala, “lwe nnali nkakasibwa nnyo nti ndi mwonoonyi ne siyinza kwebaka wadde okulya—ne siyinza kufuna kuwummula; naye, mu kifo ky’okweyongerayo okutuusa lwe nnafuna emirembe, nnawugulwa, ne mpola, era kaakano, mpulira nga nkaluba ng’ejjinja.”

Ntya nti waliwo obukumi n’obukumi mu mbeera eno—abaakakasibwa edda nti balina ekibi. Waliwo abalala enkumi, abakakasibwa kaakano. Bagamba nti, “Yee, kya mazima omuweereza ky’agamba. Mmanyi nti nsaanira okussa wansi ebyokulwanyisa bye ndwanyisa Katonda; mmanyi nti nsaanira okutema omukono guno ogwa ddyo, n’okuggyamu eriiso lino erya ddyo.” Bakakasibwa nti balina ekibi, naye tebeeyongerayo. Ekyo si kwenenya. Bawuluma essabbiiti eno nga bwe baawuluma eyayita. Tewali kwanukula Mwoyo; bagaana Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ate era okwenenya si nnaku ya kibi yokka. Ndabye abantu nga bakaaba nnyo, ne beekulungujja, ne balwana, naye ate nga banywerera ku bakatonda baabwe, era mu bwereere ogezaako okubakunkumula okuva ku bo.

Wangaana! Singa Yesu Kristo yandibalokodde nga bali ne bakatonda abo, tebandibaddeko kigaana n’akatono.

Singa bandiyise mu mulyango omufunda nga bakyakutte akatonda kano akamu, bandiyiseemu dda; naye okwawukana ne kako—ekyo kintu kirala. Abantu ng’abo balikaaba ng’omwana wo omukakanyavu, bw’oba oyagala akole ekintu ky’atayagala kukola. Alikaaba, era bw’omuteera oluga alikaaba n’okusingawo, naye tajja kuwuliriza. Bw’awuliriza, afuuka eyeenenyezza; naye, okutuusa lw’akikola, aba mwonoonyi eyakakasibwa nti alina ekibi kyokka. Katonda bw’akozesa oluga olw’Omwoyo we, oluga olw’okulabirira kwe, oluga olw’Ekigambo kye, abonoonyi balikaaba, ne beekulungujja, ne bawuluma, ne bakukakasa nti basaba, era baagala okulokolebwa, naye ekiseera kyonna nga banywezezza ensingo zaabwe ng’ekyuma. Tebajja kwewaayo. Mu kaseera we beewaayo, bafuuka abeenenya ab’amazima, ne balokolebwa. Tewali nsobi esinga okubeera eya bulijjo okusinga abantu okulowooza nti beenenyezza so nga tebeenenyezza. Waliwo abamu ku mmwe mu mbeera eno, mmanyi. Ntya nti mukyamu ddala—temuli beenenya.

Katonda wa mazima newankubadde nti buli muntu mulimba; era, singa wanoonya, nga bw’ogamba nti wanoonya, era oboolyawo, olowooza nti wanoonya; singa wali wa mazima era wa bwesigwa eri Katonda, wandirokoddwa emyaka mingi egiyise. Wangaana! Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu, akuyambe ovaayo obeere WA MAZIMA. Ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala—nti obeere wa mazima. “Wangaana,” agamba, “lwaki mubikka ekyoto kyange n’amaziga, ne muleeta ebiweebwayo byammwe eby’obwereere? Beera wa mazima bwenkanidde, nange nnaba wa mazima gy’oli ne nkuwa omukisa; naye bwe mujja mu maaso gange ne mukaaba ne mwatula, ne muleeta ab’enkenyera, n’abaziruggwa, n’abazibe b’amaaso, ekikolimo kibeere ku mmwe.” Akutunuulira ng’ali walako. Beera wa mazima. Okwenenya si nnaku ya kibi yokka. Oyinza okuba omunakuwavu ennyo, naye okutuusa mu kufa ng’onywerera ku kintu ekimu ekigaaniddwa, nga bwe yali omufuzi omuvubuka. Ekyo si kwenenya. Ate era okwenenya si kusuubiza nti olireka ekibi mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Wangaana! Singa kibadde kityo, wandibaddewo abeenenya bangi wano ekiro kino.

Tewali n’omutamiivu omwavu atasuubiza, mu mutima gwe, oba eri mukazi we omwavu, oba omuntu omulala, nti alireka okutamiira. Tewali ngeri ya mwonoonyi yenna atasuubiza bulijjo nti alireka ekibi kye, n’aweereza Katonda, naye takikola. Kale okwenenya kye ki?

Okwenenya kwe kwegaana ekibi kyokka—okukyuka okuva mu kizikiza okudda mu kitangaala—okuva mu buyinza bwa Setaani okudda eri Katonda. Kuno kwe kuleka ekibi mu mutima gwo, mu kigendererwa, mu kuteesa, mu kwegomba, ng’omalirira nti olireka buli kintu ekibi, era KIKOLE KAAKANO. Mazima ddala, kino kizingiramu ennaku, kubanga omuntu omuteefu ayinza atya okwekyusa okuva mu kkubo eddala okudda mu lirala, bw’ateenenya olw’okuba nga yakwata ekkubo eryo? Era kitegeeza okukyawa ekibi. Akyawa ekkubo lye yakwata edda, n’alikyukira. Ali ng’omukirivu, bwe yatuula mu kiraalo ky’embizzi mu bikuta ne mu bucaafu, yamalirira ddala, era ku nkomerero n’akola. Yagenda, era ekyo kye kyali ekigezo ky’okwenenya kwe! Yandituuseeko ng’amalirira era ng’asuubiza okutuusa kaakano, singa yawangaala bwe kityo, so tandifunye kunywegera kwa kitaawe, okwanirizibwa kwa kitaawe, singa teyasituka; naye yagenda. Yaleka obucaafu, ekiraalo ky’embizzi, ebikuta—yabirinnyirira wansi w’ebigere bye; yaleka omutuuze w’ensi eyo, n’aleka ebyokwewolereza bye byonna n’ebyokwewogoma, n’agenda eri kitaawe mu mazima, n’agamba nti, “Nnyonoonye!” ekyategeeza ebisingako nnyo mu lulimi lwe olwo okusinga bwe kitegeeza mu lwaffe kaakano. “Nnyonoonye eri eggulu ne mu maaso go;” olwo ne wajja obukakafu bw’okwewaayo kwe, “era sikyasaanira kuyitibwa mutabani wo: mfuula ng’omu ku baweereza bo abapangise”—nteeke mu kiraalo ky’ente, oba onnkwase okulongoosa engatto, ndyoke mbeere mu maka go era mfune okumwenyera kwo. Okwo kwe kwenenya—ekyokulabirako kya Yesu Kristo yennyini ekirungi eky’okwenenya okw’amazima. Ekyo okikoze? Oledde ekintu ekikolimiddwa? Otemye ekintu ekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky’akubikkulidde?

“Naye” oyo ye kiziyiza ekikutwalira ebweru w’Obwakabaka? Okimanyi kye kiri, era tojja kulokolebwa okutuusa lw’okyegaana. Okwewaayo kye kigezo ky’okwenenya. Omwana wange ayinza okwagala okukola ebintu ebirala kikumi mu ataano, naye, bw’aba tayagala kwewaayo ku nsonga eyo emu ey’empaka, aba mujeemu, era abeera bw’atyo okutuusa lw’awuliriza. Kaakano, lino lye njawulo wakati w’okwenenya okw’obulimba n’okw’amazima. Ntya nti tulina enkumi mu makanisa gaffe abaalina okwenenya okw’obulimba: baakakasibwa nti balina ekibi—baali banakuwavu olw’ekyo; baayagala okubeera n’obulamu obulungi, okwagala Katonda mu ngeri ey’awamu; naye baabuuka ku nsonga entuufu ey’empaka ne Katonda; baagikweka omusumba waabwe, oboolyawo, n’abadiikoni, n’abantu abaayogera nabo.

Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, Ibulayimu yandyagadde okuleka buli kintu ekirala kye yalina; naye, singa teyayagala kuleka Isaaka, ebirala byonna byandibadde bya bwereere. Isaaka wo Katonda gw’ayagala. Olina Isaaka, nga bwe kityo n’omufuzi omuvubuka bwe yalina ebintu bye. Olina ekintu ky’onywereddeko, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky’agamba nti oteekwa okuleka, naawe n’ogamba nti, “Siyinza.” Kirungi nnyo; kale oteekwa okusigala ebweru w’obwakabaka. Mbeegayirira, temwerimba nga mulowooza nti mwenenyezza, kubanga temwenenyezza; naye, wangaana! Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ka mbeegayirire mwenenye.

Omutume agamba nti, “Kale nga tumanyi entiisa ya Mukama, tukakasa abantu;” era kino, nzikiriza, gwe mulimu ogusinga obukulu ogw’obuweereza. Okukola ki? Okukakasa abantu okwewaayo. Bulijjo twogera n’abantu enkumi abamanyi ddala Katonda ky’abaagalako. Tetusobola kubaleetera bangi ku bo kitangaala kiggya oba Njiri mpya. Bakimanyidde ddala byonna. Baali banjagulizaako emirundi mingi, ne njagala nnyo ekibiina ky’abakaafiiri, kye nfunye okuva olwo. N’olwekyo, bwe bawulira Enjiri, ng’abasolooza b’omusolo n’abonoonyi ab’edda, bayingira mu bwakabaka, so nga abamu ku mmwe abaana b’obwakabaka mu buzaale, muggalibwa ebweru, kubanga bwe bawulira bakkiriza, ne beewaayo, ne bagondera, so nga mmwe muyimirira ebweru ne munywerera ku bakatonda bammwe, ne muwakana, ne muteesateesa, ne mugaana! Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ka mbakakase okulinnyirira wansi w’ebigere akatonda ako, okumenya ekiddukiro ky’obulimba ekyo, n’okujja eri Katonda mu mazima, ne mugamba nti, “Mukama, nze nzuuno, okuba omuweereza, okuba atalina kintu, okukola ekintu kyonna, okubonaabona ekintu kyonna. Mmanyi nti nnaasanyuka n’okumwenyera kwo n’omukisa gwo okusinga ebintu bino byonna ebibi bwe binfuula kaakano awatali ggwe.”

Bw’ojja eri okwewaayo okutuufu, mikwano gyange, olifuna ky’obadde onoonya, abamu ku mmwe, okumala emyaka. Naye olwo ekizibu ekirala kijja, abantu ne bagamba nti, “Sirina maanyi ga kwenenya.” Wangaana! weewaawo, olina. Eyo nsobi nnene. Olina amaanyi, kubanga singa tebyali bwe kityo Katonda teyandikiragidde. Osobola okwenenya. Osobola kaakano kano okuyimusa amaaso go eri eggulu, n’ogamba, nga omukirivu bwe yagamba, nti, “Kitange, nnyonoonye, era neegaana ekibi kyange.” Oyinza obutasobola kukaaba—Katonda tewali w’ayagaliza oba kulagira ekyo; naye osobola, kaakano kano ddala, okwegaana ekibi, mu kigendererwa, mu kumalirira, mu kuteesa. Weegendereze, tojjaganya kwegaana kibi n’amaanyi ag’okwerokola okukivaamu. Bw’okyegaana, Yesu alijja akulokole okukivaamu. Ng’omusajja eyalina omukono ogwakala—Yesu yali agenderedde okuwonya omusajja oyo. Amaanyi ag’okumuwonya gandivudde wa? Okuva eri Yesu, mazima. Ekisa, okwagala, ekyaleeta okuwona okwo, byonna byava eri Yesu; naye Yesu yayagala ekigobererwa. Kye ki? Okwanukula kw’okwagala kw’omusajja; bw’atyo n’agamba nti, “Golola omukono gwo.” Singa yali ng’abamu ku mmwe, yandigambye nti, “Kiragiro kya ki ekitali kya magezi! Omanyi nti siyinza kukikola—siyinza.” Abamu ku mmwe mugamba bwe mutyo; naye nze ŋŋamba nti musobola, era mujja kwetaaga okukikola, oba mujja kuzikirira. Yesu yayagala ki? Yayagala ekyo, “Nnaakikola, Mukama,” munda mu musajja—okwanukula kw’okwagala kwe. Yayagala agambe nti, “Yee, Mukama;” era, mu kaseera we yagambira ekyo, Yesu yamuwa amaanyi, n’agugolola, era mumanyi ekyaliwo. Totunuulira mu maaso, n’ogamba nti, “Sijja kubaako maanyi;” ekyo si nsonga yo—eyo ya ye. Alikuwanirira;—asobola, bw’omala okwewaayo gy’ali. Kale nno, gamba nti, “Nnaakikola.” Toteganya ku ky’obonaabona—kirikolebwa. Alifuka amafuta n’eddagala. Okubeerawo kwe okw’ekitiibwa, okw’omukisa, kulikukolera ebisingawo mu ssaawa emu, okusinga okulwana kwo kwonna, n’okusaba, n’okwegalamira, bye bikoledde emyaka gino gyonna egy’okukoowa. Alikusitula okukuggya mu bunnya.

Kaakano oli mu bitosi, era gye weeyongera okulwana gye weeyongera okusaanawo; naye alikuggyamu, n’ateeka ebigere byo ku lwazi, olwo n’oyimirira nga winywevu. Golola omukono gwo ogwakala, gwe guba gwonna;—gamba nti, “Nnaakikola, Mukama.” Olina amaanyi, era weegendereze, olina obuvunaanyizibwa, obw’abantu bonna era obwa kaakano. Katonda “kaakano alagira abantu bonna buli wamu beenenye,” era bakkirize Enjiri. Wa ttima atya bw’aba nga alagira ekyo, ate ng’amanyi nti tolina maanyi! Kaakano, weenenya? Weegendereze omutego ogw’edda. Si nti, okaaba? Enneewulira erijja oluvannyuma lw’okwewaayo. Kaakano, togamba nti, “Sirina nneewulira emala.” Olina enneewulira emala okwagala okuleka ekibi kyo? eyo y’ensonga. Emmeeme yonna eteenenya kumala kuleka kibi kyayo, si yeenenyezza n’akatono! Bw’oyenenya okumala okuleka ekibi kyo, mu kaseera ako okwenenya kwo kuba kutuufu, era oyinza okukwata Yesu n’okunywerera. Olina obuyinza okwetwalira ekisuubizo, olwo kiba nti “tunula obeere mulamu.” “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu, olokolebwa.”

Onoojja ku nsonga eyo kaakano? Totandika kwewolereza. Kaakano—abantu bonna, buli wamu—kaakano! Wangaana, munnange, singa wakikoze emyaka kkumi egiyise? Okuva olwo, obadde otuuma ekibi, okusalirwa omusango, n’omusango. Emyaka gino gyonna, Katonda akuyise okwenenya n’okukkiriza Enjiri, ate nga okyali wano. Emmboozi emeka z’owulidde? Obuyita bumeka bwe wagaanye? Okukakasa okw’okwagala n’okukakasibwa okuva mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kumeka kw’ogaanye? Ekisa kya Katonda kimeka ky’ofunye mu bwereere?

Nkankana bwe ndowooza ku muzigo gw’emikisa egyayonoonebwa, enkizo ezaalagajjalirwa, n’obuyinza obwabula, abantu bye baliteekwa okuddamu olunaku olumu. Yogera ku ggeyeena—obuzito bw’ebintu bino butiisa bumala. Abantu bangi balabika ng’abatafaayo ku ngeri gye bayisaamu Katonda. Abantu bulijjo bamanyi nnyo ekibi kye bakola abalala. Bayinza okutegeera mangu ekibi eky’okukolako muliraanwa akabi okusinga ekibi eky’okunyiiza Katonda. Naye agamba nti: Malaki 3:8 “Omuntu anyaga Katonda? Naye mmwe munnyaga.”

Tolaba musango gw’okusalirwa omunene oguva mu kulwawo, okugaana, okuziyiza, okusookerera, n’okusagaasagana, Katonda ng’agamba nti, “Kaakano”?

Abadde n’obuyinza obutuufu ku buli mukka gw’ossizza, buli buyinza bw’obadde nabwo, na buli ssaawa eya buli lunaku mu bulamu bwo bwonna. Si kiseera kya kumaliriza mpaka zino?

Ayinza okukukolako nga bwe yakola abo abaamugaana emirundi mingi edda, abawandiikibwako nti: Abaebbulaniya 3:11 “Nga bwe nnalayira mu busungu bwange nti, ‘Tebaliyingira mu kuwummula kwange.’”

Tomunyiiza nga bo bwe baamunyiiza?

Wangaana, munnange, kakasibwa okwenenya leero. Leka ekibi kyo ojje ku bigere bya Yesu.

Ku lulwo ggwe, kakasibwa. Olw’emirembe, essanyu, amaanyi, ekitiibwa, n’okujaguza ebiva mu bulamu obweweereddeyo ddala eri Katonda era obumaliddwa mu kuweereza abalala, muwuliddemu. Naye okusinga byonna, weewaayo olw’okwagala kwe okunene gy’oli.

Omusajja omunene, omukambwe, eyali akakasibbwa nnyo yagamba baze wange wiiki ntono ezaayita, bwe yatunuulira ekifo abalala gye baali bafunira obulokozi, nti, “Mwami Booth, sandigenzeeyo wadde okuweebwa pawundi kikumi!”

Baze wange n’addamu mpola nti, “Onoogendayo olw’okwagala?”

Oluvannyuma lw’okusookerera akaseera, omusajja n’asangula amaziga ge, n’ayimirira, n’amugoberera.

Onoojja olw’okwagala—okwagala kwa Yesu? Onoojja olw’okwagala okunene kwe yakwagala nakwo n’yewaayo ku lulwo?

Onoojja olw’okwegomba okungi Kitaawo ali mu ggulu kw’akugobeddemu emyaka gino gyonna? Ku lw’okwagala kwe, onoojja?

Vuunama ku bigere bye owewaayo gy’ali.

Mukama akuyambe.

Amiina.
fields.body_text: Matayo 3:2 “Mwenenye, kubanga obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu busembedde.” Matayo 4:17 “Okuva mu kiseera ekyo Yesu n’atandika okubuulira ng’agamba nti, ‘Mwenenye, kubanga obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu busembedde.’” “Kyennava, ai kabaka Agulipa, ne sijeemera kwolesebwa okw’omu ggulu: naye nnasooka okubuulira abo ab’e Damasiko, n’e Yerusaalemi, ne mu nsi yonna ey’e Buyudaaya, n’eri Abaamawanga, nti beenenye bakyukire Katonda, bakole ebikolwa ebisaanira okwenenya.”—EBIKOLWA 26. 19, 20. Mu kamwa k’abajulizi basatu—Yokaana Omubatiza, Yesu Kristo, n’Omutume Pawulo—ekigambo kino kinywezebwa, kwe kugamba nti okwenenya kye kigobererwa ekitasoboka kwewalibwa nga oyagala okuyingira mu Bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Abantu awamu batabuka nnyo ku nsonga eno, ng’abanywerera ku kigambo nti okwenenya nteekateeka Katonda gy’ateekawo mu bwetavu bwe yekka. Nzikiriza nti Katonda yakola obulokozi bw’omuntu okuba obwangu nnyo nga bwe kyali kisoboka eri amagezi ge Ayinzabyonna, agataliiko kkomo. Naye waliwo obwetaavu mu nsonga eno, nti kitugwanira “okwenenya n’okukyukira Katonda.” Kyetaagisa ddala nti enneewulira zange zikyusibwe era zireetebwe mu kwenenya eri Katonda, nga bwe kyetaagisa nti omulenzi omwonoonyi atawulira, enneewulira ze zizzibwe mu bumu ne kitaawe nga tannaba kusonyiyibwa. Amateeka ge gamu ag’omutima ge gakolebwa mu mbeera zombi, era obwetaavu bwe bumu mu byombi. Bwe wabaawo kitaawe w’omwana yenna wano alina mutabani we omukirivu, mbuuza nti, Lwaki tommagana na mutabani wo? Omwagala—omwagala nnyo. Oboolyawo okwagala kwo gy’ali kw’omanyi okusinga eri abaana bo abalala bonna. Omutima gwo gumwegomba buli lunaku; omusabira emisana n’ekiro; omuloota ekiro; omutima gwo gwegomba mutabani wo, era ogamba, nga Dawudi bwe yagamba nti, “Abusaalomu, Abusaalomu, mutabani wange, mutabani wange.” Lwaki tommagana naye? Lwaki tomukuba ku mutwe, oba n’omusiimuula ku maaso, n’ogamba nti, “Mutabani wange omwagalwa, nsanyufu naawe nnyo. Nkwagala n’essanyu; nkusiima?” Lwaki bulijjo omunenya? Lwaki oteekwa okumuwanika ewala? Lwaki toyinza kubeera naye mu bulikwano? Lwaki toyinza kumuleka ng’ayingira n’afuluma, n’abeera naawe mu mbeera y’emu ng’omuwala ow’okwagala, omuwulize? “Wangaana!” ogamba, “ensonga y’enjawulo; siyinza. Si nti, ‘Sandyagadde;’ wabula, ‘Siyinza.’ Ekyo nga tekinnaba kubaawo, enneewulira z’omulenzi zirina okukyuka gye ndi. Alwana nange; alina endowooza enkyamu ku nze; alowooza nti ndi muzibu, era wa ttima, era munyigiriza, era wa bukambwe. Nkoze byonna kitaawe w’omwana bye yandikoze, naye alaba ebintu mu ngeri endala eyawukana ku bye biri, era akutte enneewulira zino enzibu gye ndi okutuusa lw’ankyawa, era ajja kweyongerayo okujeemera by’enjagala. Ogamba nti, “Kyetaagisa nti, nga kitaawe w’omwana omugezi era omutuukirivu, nteekwa okunywerera ku nkyukakyuka mu ye. Siyinza kumusembeza nga mutabani wange, okutuusa lw’ajja ku bigere byange. Ateekwa okwatula ekibi kye, n’ansaba mmusonyiwe. Olwo, wangaana! okwagala kwange okw’obuzaale nga kulyanjaala n’essanyu lingi! Nga bwe nnandidduse okumusisinkana, ne mmubambira emikono ku bulago bwe! naye waliwo ‘siyinza’ mu nsonga.” Bwe kityo bwe kiri. Si nti takwagala, ggwe omwonoonyi; si nti omutima gwa Katonda omunene, ogw’ekisa, tegukukaabidde amaziga ag’omusaayi; si nti tandikubambidde emikono gye egy’okwagala kaakano kano, singa ojja ku bigere bye, n’oyatula nti wali mukyamu, n’onoonya okusonyiyibwa kwe; naye, obutali bwe kityo, tayinza—tasobola. Amateeka g’obutonde bwe gamuziyiza okukola bw’atyo. Obulungi, oboolyawo, obw’obukadde n’obukadde bw’ebitonde ebitafa, mwe biri. Tawakanya, era tasobola, okutuusa nga mu ggwe mubaddemu enkyukakyuka mu ndowooza. Oteekwa okwenenya. Lukka 13:3: “Bwe mutalyenenya, mwenna mulizikirira bwe mutyo.” Kale, obanga okwenenya kye kigobererwa ekitasoboka kwewalibwa olw’obulokozi, katutunuulireko akaseera, tugezaako okuzuula okwenenya kye kiri ddala; era, wangaana! ensi n’ekkanisa nga bijjudde okutabuka ku nsonga eno! Nkigamba, kubanga nkimanyi olw’okwogera n’abantu ebikumi. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyambe! Kale, okusooka, okwenenya si kukakasibwa kwokka nti oli mwonoonyi. Wangaana! singa kibadde kityo kyokka, ensi endala nga bwe twandibadde nayo leero, kubanga waliwo obukumi n’obukumi ku mitima gyabwe Omwoyo wa Katonda kw’akoledde omulimu gwe ng’abakakasa nti balina ekibi. Ntya nti twandyewuunyizza ddala, ne tutya, ne tusobezebwa, singa twategeeredde ekibiina ky’abantu Katonda b’akakasizza nti balina ekibi, nga bwe yakola Agulipa ne Fesuto. Wangaana! sandisobodde kubagamba muwendo gw’abantu, mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe ez’okweraliikirira, abankutte ku mukono, ne baŋŋamba nti, “Wangaana! nnandiwaddeyo ki okuwulira nga bwe nnali nawulira edda! Waaliwo ekiseera, emyaka kkumi n’etaano, oba kkumi na musanvu, oba amakumi abiri egiyise,” n’ebirala, “lwe nnali nkakasibwa nnyo nti ndi mwonoonyi ne siyinza kwebaka wadde okulya—ne siyinza kufuna kuwummula; naye, mu kifo ky’okweyongerayo okutuusa lwe nnafuna emirembe, nnawugulwa, ne mpola, era kaakano, mpulira nga nkaluba ng’ejjinja.” Ntya nti waliwo obukumi n’obukumi mu mbeera eno—abaakakasibwa edda nti balina ekibi. Waliwo abalala enkumi, abakakasibwa kaakano. Bagamba nti, “Yee, kya mazima omuweereza ky’agamba. Mmanyi nti nsaanira okussa wansi ebyokulwanyisa bye ndwanyisa Katonda; mmanyi nti nsaanira okutema omukono guno ogwa ddyo, n’okuggyamu eriiso lino erya ddyo.” Bakakasibwa nti balina ekibi, naye tebeeyongerayo. Ekyo si kwenenya. Bawuluma essabbiiti eno nga bwe baawuluma eyayita. Tewali kwanukula Mwoyo; bagaana Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ate era okwenenya si nnaku ya kibi yokka. Ndabye abantu nga bakaaba nnyo, ne beekulungujja, ne balwana, naye ate nga banywerera ku bakatonda baabwe, era mu bwereere ogezaako okubakunkumula okuva ku bo. Wangaana! Singa Yesu Kristo yandibalokodde nga bali ne bakatonda abo, tebandibaddeko kigaana n’akatono. Singa bandiyise mu mulyango omufunda nga bakyakutte akatonda kano akamu, bandiyiseemu dda; naye okwawukana ne kako—ekyo kintu kirala. Abantu ng’abo balikaaba ng’omwana wo omukakanyavu, bw’oba oyagala akole ekintu ky’atayagala kukola. Alikaaba, era bw’omuteera oluga alikaaba n’okusingawo, naye tajja kuwuliriza. Bw’awuliriza, afuuka eyeenenyezza; naye, okutuusa lw’akikola, aba mwonoonyi eyakakasibwa nti alina ekibi kyokka. Katonda bw’akozesa oluga olw’Omwoyo we, oluga olw’okulabirira kwe, oluga olw’Ekigambo kye, abonoonyi balikaaba, ne beekulungujja, ne bawuluma, ne bakukakasa nti basaba, era baagala okulokolebwa, naye ekiseera kyonna nga banywezezza ensingo zaabwe ng’ekyuma. Tebajja kwewaayo. Mu kaseera we beewaayo, bafuuka abeenenya ab’amazima, ne balokolebwa. Tewali nsobi esinga okubeera eya bulijjo okusinga abantu okulowooza nti beenenyezza so nga tebeenenyezza. Waliwo abamu ku mmwe mu mbeera eno, mmanyi. Ntya nti mukyamu ddala—temuli beenenya. Katonda wa mazima newankubadde nti buli muntu mulimba; era, singa wanoonya, nga bw’ogamba nti wanoonya, era oboolyawo, olowooza nti wanoonya; singa wali wa mazima era wa bwesigwa eri Katonda, wandirokoddwa emyaka mingi egiyise. Wangaana! Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu, akuyambe ovaayo obeere WA MAZIMA. Ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala—nti obeere wa mazima. “Wangaana,” agamba, “lwaki mubikka ekyoto kyange n’amaziga, ne muleeta ebiweebwayo byammwe eby’obwereere? Beera wa mazima bwenkanidde, nange nnaba wa mazima gy’oli ne nkuwa omukisa; naye bwe mujja mu maaso gange ne mukaaba ne mwatula, ne muleeta ab’enkenyera, n’abaziruggwa, n’abazibe b’amaaso, ekikolimo kibeere ku mmwe.” Akutunuulira ng’ali walako. Beera wa mazima. Okwenenya si nnaku ya kibi yokka. Oyinza okuba omunakuwavu ennyo, naye okutuusa mu kufa ng’onywerera ku kintu ekimu ekigaaniddwa, nga bwe yali omufuzi omuvubuka. Ekyo si kwenenya. Ate era okwenenya si kusuubiza nti olireka ekibi mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Wangaana! Singa kibadde kityo, wandibaddewo abeenenya bangi wano ekiro kino. Tewali n’omutamiivu omwavu atasuubiza, mu mutima gwe, oba eri mukazi we omwavu, oba omuntu omulala, nti alireka okutamiira. Tewali ngeri ya mwonoonyi yenna atasuubiza bulijjo nti alireka ekibi kye, n’aweereza Katonda, naye takikola. Kale okwenenya kye ki? Okwenenya kwe kwegaana ekibi kyokka—okukyuka okuva mu kizikiza okudda mu kitangaala—okuva mu buyinza bwa Setaani okudda eri Katonda. Kuno kwe kuleka ekibi mu mutima gwo, mu kigendererwa, mu kuteesa, mu kwegomba, ng’omalirira nti olireka buli kintu ekibi, era KIKOLE KAAKANO. Mazima ddala, kino kizingiramu ennaku, kubanga omuntu omuteefu ayinza atya okwekyusa okuva mu kkubo eddala okudda mu lirala, bw’ateenenya olw’okuba nga yakwata ekkubo eryo? Era kitegeeza okukyawa ekibi. Akyawa ekkubo lye yakwata edda, n’alikyukira. Ali ng’omukirivu, bwe yatuula mu kiraalo ky’embizzi mu bikuta ne mu bucaafu, yamalirira ddala, era ku nkomerero n’akola. Yagenda, era ekyo kye kyali ekigezo ky’okwenenya kwe! Yandituuseeko ng’amalirira era ng’asuubiza okutuusa kaakano, singa yawangaala bwe kityo, so tandifunye kunywegera kwa kitaawe, okwanirizibwa kwa kitaawe, singa teyasituka; naye yagenda. Yaleka obucaafu, ekiraalo ky’embizzi, ebikuta—yabirinnyirira wansi w’ebigere bye; yaleka omutuuze w’ensi eyo, n’aleka ebyokwewolereza bye byonna n’ebyokwewogoma, n’agenda eri kitaawe mu mazima, n’agamba nti, “Nnyonoonye!” ekyategeeza ebisingako nnyo mu lulimi lwe olwo okusinga bwe kitegeeza mu lwaffe kaakano. “Nnyonoonye eri eggulu ne mu maaso go;” olwo ne wajja obukakafu bw’okwewaayo kwe, “era sikyasaanira kuyitibwa mutabani wo: mfuula ng’omu ku baweereza bo abapangise”—nteeke mu kiraalo ky’ente, oba onnkwase okulongoosa engatto, ndyoke mbeere mu maka go era mfune okumwenyera kwo. Okwo kwe kwenenya—ekyokulabirako kya Yesu Kristo yennyini ekirungi eky’okwenenya okw’amazima. Ekyo okikoze? Oledde ekintu ekikolimiddwa? Otemye ekintu ekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky’akubikkulidde? “Naye” oyo ye kiziyiza ekikutwalira ebweru w’Obwakabaka? Okimanyi kye kiri, era tojja kulokolebwa okutuusa lw’okyegaana. Okwewaayo kye kigezo ky’okwenenya. Omwana wange ayinza okwagala okukola ebintu ebirala kikumi mu ataano, naye, bw’aba tayagala kwewaayo ku nsonga eyo emu ey’empaka, aba mujeemu, era abeera bw’atyo okutuusa lw’awuliriza. Kaakano, lino lye njawulo wakati w’okwenenya okw’obulimba n’okw’amazima. Ntya nti tulina enkumi mu makanisa gaffe abaalina okwenenya okw’obulimba: baakakasibwa nti balina ekibi—baali banakuwavu olw’ekyo; baayagala okubeera n’obulamu obulungi, okwagala Katonda mu ngeri ey’awamu; naye baabuuka ku nsonga entuufu ey’empaka ne Katonda; baagikweka omusumba waabwe, oboolyawo, n’abadiikoni, n’abantu abaayogera nabo. Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, Ibulayimu yandyagadde okuleka buli kintu ekirala kye yalina; naye, singa teyayagala kuleka Isaaka, ebirala byonna byandibadde bya bwereere. Isaaka wo Katonda gw’ayagala. Olina Isaaka, nga bwe kityo n’omufuzi omuvubuka bwe yalina ebintu bye. Olina ekintu ky’onywereddeko, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky’agamba nti oteekwa okuleka, naawe n’ogamba nti, “Siyinza.” Kirungi nnyo; kale oteekwa okusigala ebweru w’obwakabaka. Mbeegayirira, temwerimba nga mulowooza nti mwenenyezza, kubanga temwenenyezza; naye, wangaana! Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ka mbeegayirire mwenenye. Omutume agamba nti, “Kale nga tumanyi entiisa ya Mukama, tukakasa abantu;” era kino, nzikiriza, gwe mulimu ogusinga obukulu ogw’obuweereza. Okukola ki? Okukakasa abantu okwewaayo. Bulijjo twogera n’abantu enkumi abamanyi ddala Katonda ky’abaagalako. Tetusobola kubaleetera bangi ku bo kitangaala kiggya oba Njiri mpya. Bakimanyidde ddala byonna. Baali banjagulizaako emirundi mingi, ne njagala nnyo ekibiina ky’abakaafiiri, kye nfunye okuva olwo. N’olwekyo, bwe bawulira Enjiri, ng’abasolooza b’omusolo n’abonoonyi ab’edda, bayingira mu bwakabaka, so nga abamu ku mmwe abaana b’obwakabaka mu buzaale, muggalibwa ebweru, kubanga bwe bawulira bakkiriza, ne beewaayo, ne bagondera, so nga mmwe muyimirira ebweru ne munywerera ku bakatonda bammwe, ne muwakana, ne muteesateesa, ne mugaana! Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ka mbakakase okulinnyirira wansi w’ebigere akatonda ako, okumenya ekiddukiro ky’obulimba ekyo, n’okujja eri Katonda mu mazima, ne mugamba nti, “Mukama, nze nzuuno, okuba omuweereza, okuba atalina kintu, okukola ekintu kyonna, okubonaabona ekintu kyonna. Mmanyi nti nnaasanyuka n’okumwenyera kwo n’omukisa gwo okusinga ebintu bino byonna ebibi bwe binfuula kaakano awatali ggwe.” Bw’ojja eri okwewaayo okutuufu, mikwano gyange, olifuna ky’obadde onoonya, abamu ku mmwe, okumala emyaka. Naye olwo ekizibu ekirala kijja, abantu ne bagamba nti, “Sirina maanyi ga kwenenya.” Wangaana! weewaawo, olina. Eyo nsobi nnene. Olina amaanyi, kubanga singa tebyali bwe kityo Katonda teyandikiragidde. Osobola okwenenya. Osobola kaakano kano okuyimusa amaaso go eri eggulu, n’ogamba, nga omukirivu bwe yagamba, nti, “Kitange, nnyonoonye, era neegaana ekibi kyange.” Oyinza obutasobola kukaaba—Katonda tewali w’ayagaliza oba kulagira ekyo; naye osobola, kaakano kano ddala, okwegaana ekibi, mu kigendererwa, mu kumalirira, mu kuteesa. Weegendereze, tojjaganya kwegaana kibi n’amaanyi ag’okwerokola okukivaamu. Bw’okyegaana, Yesu alijja akulokole okukivaamu. Ng’omusajja eyalina omukono ogwakala—Yesu yali agenderedde okuwonya omusajja oyo. Amaanyi ag’okumuwonya gandivudde wa? Okuva eri Yesu, mazima. Ekisa, okwagala, ekyaleeta okuwona okwo, byonna byava eri Yesu; naye Yesu yayagala ekigobererwa. Kye ki? Okwanukula kw’okwagala kw’omusajja; bw’atyo n’agamba nti, “Golola omukono gwo.” Singa yali ng’abamu ku mmwe, yandigambye nti, “Kiragiro kya ki ekitali kya magezi! Omanyi nti siyinza kukikola—siyinza.” Abamu ku mmwe mugamba bwe mutyo; naye nze ŋŋamba nti musobola, era mujja kwetaaga okukikola, oba mujja kuzikirira. Yesu yayagala ki? Yayagala ekyo, “Nnaakikola, Mukama,” munda mu musajja—okwanukula kw’okwagala kwe. Yayagala agambe nti, “Yee, Mukama;” era, mu kaseera we yagambira ekyo, Yesu yamuwa amaanyi, n’agugolola, era mumanyi ekyaliwo. Totunuulira mu maaso, n’ogamba nti, “Sijja kubaako maanyi;” ekyo si nsonga yo—eyo ya ye. Alikuwanirira;—asobola, bw’omala okwewaayo gy’ali. Kale nno, gamba nti, “Nnaakikola.” Toteganya ku ky’obonaabona—kirikolebwa. Alifuka amafuta n’eddagala. Okubeerawo kwe okw’ekitiibwa, okw’omukisa, kulikukolera ebisingawo mu ssaawa emu, okusinga okulwana kwo kwonna, n’okusaba, n’okwegalamira, bye bikoledde emyaka gino gyonna egy’okukoowa. Alikusitula okukuggya mu bunnya. Kaakano oli mu bitosi, era gye weeyongera okulwana gye weeyongera okusaanawo; naye alikuggyamu, n’ateeka ebigere byo ku lwazi, olwo n’oyimirira nga winywevu. Golola omukono gwo ogwakala, gwe guba gwonna;—gamba nti, “Nnaakikola, Mukama.” Olina amaanyi, era weegendereze, olina obuvunaanyizibwa, obw’abantu bonna era obwa kaakano. Katonda “kaakano alagira abantu bonna buli wamu beenenye,” era bakkirize Enjiri. Wa ttima atya bw’aba nga alagira ekyo, ate ng’amanyi nti tolina maanyi! Kaakano, weenenya? Weegendereze omutego ogw’edda. Si nti, okaaba? Enneewulira erijja oluvannyuma lw’okwewaayo. Kaakano, togamba nti, “Sirina nneewulira emala.” Olina enneewulira emala okwagala okuleka ekibi kyo? eyo y’ensonga. Emmeeme yonna eteenenya kumala kuleka kibi kyayo, si yeenenyezza n’akatono! Bw’oyenenya okumala okuleka ekibi kyo, mu kaseera ako okwenenya kwo kuba kutuufu, era oyinza okukwata Yesu n’okunywerera. Olina obuyinza okwetwalira ekisuubizo, olwo kiba nti “tunula obeere mulamu.” “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu, olokolebwa.” Onoojja ku nsonga eyo kaakano? Totandika kwewolereza. Kaakano—abantu bonna, buli wamu—kaakano! Wangaana, munnange, singa wakikoze emyaka kkumi egiyise? Okuva olwo, obadde otuuma ekibi, okusalirwa omusango, n’omusango. Emyaka gino gyonna, Katonda akuyise okwenenya n’okukkiriza Enjiri, ate nga okyali wano. Emmboozi emeka z’owulidde? Obuyita bumeka bwe wagaanye? Okukakasa okw’okwagala n’okukakasibwa okuva mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kumeka kw’ogaanye? Ekisa kya Katonda kimeka ky’ofunye mu bwereere? Nkankana bwe ndowooza ku muzigo gw’emikisa egyayonoonebwa, enkizo ezaalagajjalirwa, n’obuyinza obwabula, abantu bye baliteekwa okuddamu olunaku olumu. Yogera ku ggeyeena—obuzito bw’ebintu bino butiisa bumala. Abantu bangi balabika ng’abatafaayo ku ngeri gye bayisaamu Katonda. Abantu bulijjo bamanyi nnyo ekibi kye bakola abalala. Bayinza okutegeera mangu ekibi eky’okukolako muliraanwa akabi okusinga ekibi eky’okunyiiza Katonda. Naye agamba nti: Malaki 3:8 “Omuntu anyaga Katonda? Naye mmwe munnyaga.” Tolaba musango gw’okusalirwa omunene oguva mu kulwawo, okugaana, okuziyiza, okusookerera, n’okusagaasagana, Katonda ng’agamba nti, “Kaakano”? Abadde n’obuyinza obutuufu ku buli mukka gw’ossizza, buli buyinza bw’obadde nabwo, na buli ssaawa eya buli lunaku mu bulamu bwo bwonna. Si kiseera kya kumaliriza mpaka zino? Ayinza okukukolako nga bwe yakola abo abaamugaana emirundi mingi edda, abawandiikibwako nti: Abaebbulaniya 3:11 “Nga bwe nnalayira mu busungu bwange nti, ‘Tebaliyingira mu kuwummula kwange.’” Tomunyiiza nga bo bwe baamunyiiza? Wangaana, munnange, kakasibwa okwenenya leero. Leka ekibi kyo ojje ku bigere bya Yesu. Ku lulwo ggwe, kakasibwa. Olw’emirembe, essanyu, amaanyi, ekitiibwa, n’okujaguza ebiva mu bulamu obweweereddeyo ddala eri Katonda era obumaliddwa mu kuweereza abalala, muwuliddemu. Naye okusinga byonna, weewaayo olw’okwagala kwe okunene gy’oli. Omusajja omunene, omukambwe, eyali akakasibbwa nnyo yagamba baze wange wiiki ntono ezaayita, bwe yatunuulira ekifo abalala gye baali bafunira obulokozi, nti, “Mwami Booth, sandigenzeeyo wadde okuweebwa pawundi kikumi!” Baze wange n’addamu mpola nti, “Onoogendayo olw’okwagala?” Oluvannyuma lw’okusookerera akaseera, omusajja n’asangula amaziga ge, n’ayimirira, n’amugoberera. Onoojja olw’okwagala—okwagala kwa Yesu? Onoojja olw’okwagala okunene kwe yakwagala nakwo n’yewaayo ku lulwo? Onoojja olw’okwegomba okungi Kitaawo ali mu ggulu kw’akugobeddemu emyaka gino gyonna? Ku lw’okwagala kwe, onoojja? Vuunama ku bigere bye owewaayo gy’ali. Mukama akuyambe. Amiina.

fields.title: Okukkiriza Okulokola
fields.body_html:
“Awo n’abaggya ebweru n’agamba nti, ‘Bassebo, nkole ntya okulokolebwa?’ Ne bamuddamu nti, ‘Kkiriza Mukama Yesu, olokolebwe, ggwe n’ab’omu nnyumba yo.’” Ebikolwa 16:30–31 Kino kye kimu ku byawandiikibwa ebisinga okutegeererwa obubi n’okukozesebwa obubi mu Bayibuli, era oboolyawo ekimu ku byo ebikoledwa Setaani omulimu munene nga bwe kikolera Katonda. Buli mukkiriza ali wano ka asabe mu kukkiriza omusana gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga bwe tugezaako okukitegeera n’okukikozesa obulungi. Ka tulowooze: Ani agwanira okukkiriza?

Bagwanira kukkiriza ddi?

Bagwanira kukkiriza batya?

1. Ani Agwanira Okukkiriza?

Omwoyo Omutukuvu agamba ani nti, “Kkiriza Mukama Yesu, olokolebwe”? Weetegereze bulungi: si aboonoonyi bonna awatali kwawula.

Wano waliwo ensobi enkulu esangibwa mu bungi bw’okuyigiriza okw’ennaku zaffe. Ebigambo bino batera okubiggya mu bigyetooloodde ne mu byawandiikibwa ebirala bingi ebibinnyonnyola. Babyanjula nga tebiriimu mateeka agaabyawerezanga bulijjo mu kuyigiriza n’empisa z’abatume. Ddala, mu myaka nkaaga oba nsanvu egiyise gyokka mu kwe enkola eno empya efuuse eya bulijjo—okubuulira awatali kwawula aboonoonyi abatannazuukusibwa, abatannakyuka, era abatannenenya nti, “Kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo.”

Kirabika gye ndi nti akabi kanene kakoledwa ku mulimu gwa Kristo olw’okukwata bubi kuno Ekigambo kya Katonda. Ng’okwo tekugoberera Byawandiikibwa, ate era tekulina na magezi. Omwonoonyi atannazuukusibwa, atannakkirizibwa, era atannenenya ayinza atya okukkiriza mu mazima? Kyandyanguyiddeko okusuubira Setaani okukkiriza mu kifo kye. Tekisoboka.

Enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu ng’abo bagamba nti, “Nzikiriza.” Waakati wa lwa, mutabani wange omwagalwa yali ayogera n’omusajja eyali atudde waggulu ku mmotoka eyali atamidde era ng’akozesa ebigambo ebitasaana nnyo. Mutabani wange yali agezaako okumulaga akabi k’empisa ye ez’ekibi ng’omumenyi w’amateeka ga Katonda. “Woowe!” omusajja n’agamba, “si lwa bikolwa; lwa kukkiriza, era nkkiriza nga bw’okkiriza.”

“Weewaawo,” mutabani wange n’addamu, “naye okkiriza ki?”

“Woowe,” n’addamu, “nzikiriza Yesu Kristo, era mazima ddala ndirokolebwa.”

Omusajja oyo ky’akyokerwako ku nkumi n’enkumi. Abantu ng’abo mbasisinkana buli lunaku.

Bakkiriza nti waaliwo omusajja ayitibwa Yesu, era nti yafiira aboonoonyi—n’okubafiirira bo. Naye ku by’okukozesa okukkiriza okulokola, tebamanyi ku ako okusinga Agulipa oba Fericisi. Kino kyeyoleka nga basembeddemu okufa. Olwo abantu bano be bamu banyiga engalo zaabwe, ne bagwa mu buggwanjuba, ne bayita Abakristaayo bajje basabe nabo.

Singa baali bakkirizza ddala, lwaki okutya n’okweraliikirira kuno kwonna okufa nga kusembera? Baali bakkiriza mu birowoozo byokka, so si mu mutima. Baayaniriza ebituufu ebyawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, naye tebaakkiriza mu ntegeera ya Bayibuli ey’ekigambo. Singa baakkiriza, okukkiriza kwabwe kwandibalokodde. Tugumira nti kya bwereere era tekigoberera Byawandiikibwa okubuulira abantu ng’abo nti “kkiriza kyokka.”

Abakristaayo tebaba bamalirizza mulimu gwabwe nga bagamba buggamba aboonoonyi nti Yesu yabafiirira era nti basaanira okumukkiriza. Balina omulimu omuzibu okusinga: okuyamba okuzibula amaaso gaabwe balabe embeera yaabwe eya ddala, ne, olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo, bategeere nti baboonoonyi abeetaaga obulokozi.

Abantu bwe bategeera nti balwadde mu mwoyo, banaddukira eri Omusawo Omukulu. Amaaso g’emmeeme gateekwa okuzibulwa galabe amazima g’ekibi n’ebiva mu kibi. Okutegeera kuno kusaanira okuleeta okwegomba okw’amaanyi okulokolebwa mu kyo. Ekyuma kya Katonda ekikulu eky’okutuukiriza kino ge mateeka ge, agakola ng’omusomesa aleeta aboonoonyi eri Kristo Omulokozi waabwe.

Tewali kifo na kimu mu Ndagaano Empya awatume gye baakubiriza abantu okukkiriza, oba omuntu gy’annyonnyolwa ng’akkiriza, awatali nsonga nnungi ey’okusalirawo nti okukkirizibwa ku kibi n’okwenenya byali bimaze okubaawo.

Ekyokulabirako kimu ekirabika ng’ekyawukana ye Simoni omulogo.

Nga bangi abantu mu biseera by’okusesema kw’eddiini okw’amaanyi, Simoni yatwalibwa amaanyi g’enkuŋŋaana n’ekyokulabirako ky’abo abaali bamwetoolodde. Yaatula okukkiriza.

Awatali kubuusabuusa yakkiriza nti Yesu yafiira ku musaalaba. Yaaniriza amazima g’Obukristaayo mu birowoozo bye era, mu ngeri eyo, n’afuuka omukkiriza—nga obukumi n’obukumi bwe bukola leero. Yabatizibwa. Naye ekiseera eky’okugezesebwa bwe kyatuuka—oba ebbeetu lye oba eya Katonda bye byamusinga obukulu—embeera ye eya ddala n’eyeeyoleka.

Ng’omutume bwe yagamba: “Omutima gwo teguli mulongoofu mu maaso ga Katonda.” Ebikolwa 8:21 Tewali n’omu akyusibwa ng’omutima gwe teguli mulongoofu eri Katonda. Ako ke kagezo.

Singa Simoni yali akyusibwa ddala, omutima gwe gwandibadde mulongoofu eri Katonda, era teyandirowoozezza nti ekirabo ky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu kiyinza okugulibwa n’ensimbi. Peetero n’ayongera okugamba: “Kubanga ndaba ng’oli mu mususa ogukaawa ne mu bukambwe bw’obutali butuukirivu.” Ebikolwa 8:23 Kale yagamba ki oluvannyuma?

Yagamba nti, “Kkiriza kaakati kaakati”?

Nedda.

Wabula yagamba nti: “Kale weenenye obubi bwo buno, osabe Mukama, oba kisoboka, ekirowoozo ky’omutima gwo kisonyiyibwe.”

Sooka weenenye, olwo olyoke ofune okusonyiyibwa.

Bwe tutyo, tuggya essomo eryamaddu mu kifo kino.

Simoni ye yekka eyawandiikibwa ng’aatula okukkiriza awatali bujulizi bulambulukufu mu kifo kyennyini nti okukkirizibwa n’okwenenya byakulembera okukkiriza. Naye n’ewano, ebivaamu biraga amazima.

Simoni yalina okukkiriza kw’ebirowoozo, naye si kukkiriza kwa mutima. Noolwekyo, okwatula kwe kwakoma mu kugwa n’obuggwanjuba. Abamu bampandiikidde ku wiiki eno nga bagamba nti baali bakkirizza.

Baali basendeddwa okwatula okukkiriza, naye tewali bibala ebyavaamu.

Ah, tekwali kukkiriza kwa mutima. Kwali kukkiriza kwa birowoozo byokka—ng’okwa Simoni. Kwabaleka mu mbeera embi okusinga bwe kwabasanga, era okuva olwo mubadde mulwana era mubungeeta mu kizikiza ky’omwoyo.

Naye temumaliriza nti kuno kwali kukkiriza okwa mazima era nti okukkiriza okwa mazima kugudde. Wabula, mugume omwoyo, era mutandike buggya. Mwenenye, munoonye ekintu ekya mazima.

Setaani bulijjo aleeta ekyabulimba. Noolwekyo, temugwa mu buggwanjuba olw’okuba nti okukkiriza okutali kwo tekwawangula. Okugwa okwo tekufuula kukkiriza kwa Katonda okwa mazima okutalina makulu. Nedda ddala!

Mulowooze ekyokulabirako ekirala—abantu enkumi ssatu abaakyusibwa mu lunaku lumu. Mazima kino kye kyokulabirako kya Bayibuli. Tewali ayinza kukiyita kya kukontana n’enjiri oba kya mateeka.

Ekisooka Peetero kye yakola kye ki?

Yakuba amazima ga Katonda amawagguufu mu mitima gyabwe n’abaleeta mu kukkirizibwa.

Yabazuukusa eri obuzibu bw’embeera yaabwe okutuusa lwe baakaaba nti: “Abooluganda, tukole ki?” Ebikolwa 2:37 Baali beeraliikiridde nnyo. Emitima gyabwe gyafumitibwa. Amaaso gaabwe gaazibulwa okulaba ebiva mu kibi kyabwe ebibi ennyo.

Olw’ekyo, baakaaba mu maaso g’ekibiina ekinene, nga banoonya ekkubo ery’obulokozi.

Peetero yasooka kubakkiriza ku kibi, era mu kukola bw’atyo yagoberera enteekateeka ya Katonda gye yateekawo.

Ate era, omulaawe atera okujuliizibwa ng’ekyokulabirako ky’okukkiriza; naye yali mu mbeera ki mu birowoozo? Yali mwonoonyi atafaayo, atannakkirizibwa? Yali eyo—Omuwesiyopiya, omukaafiiri; naye yali abadde wa?

E Yerusaalemi, okusinza Katonda ow’amazima era omulamu mu ngeri esinga gye yamanya n’okusinziira ku kutegeera kwe yalina. Kale, yali akola ki Firipo bwe yamusanga? Teyamatira kusinza businzi mu yeekaalu n’oluvannyuma n’addayo mu bulamu bwe obwa bulijjo awatali kufaayo. Yali anoonya mu Byawandiikibwa. Yali anoonya Katonda mu bwesimbu, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bulijjo amanyi emyoyo egifaanana bwe giri gye giri. Kale n’agamba Firipo nti, “Genda osemberere eggaali lino.” Waliwo omusajja annoonya; waliwo omusajja alina omutima ogwesimbye okunnoonya. Genda obuulire Kristo, era omugambe akkirize. Omusajja oyo yandiweeyo, yandikoze, oba yandifiiriddwa ekintu kyonna olw’obulokozi, era Firipo amaze kunnyonnyola ekkubo ery’okukkiriza, n’akikkiriza, nga bwe kiri, ng’emyoyo gyonna egifaanana bwe girikola.

Sawulo, ng’ali mu kkubo okugenda e Damasiko, kye kyokulabirako ekirala. Yesu Kristo yennyini ye yali omubuulizi eyo, era mazima teyandisobezza. Enkola ye yali etuukiridde. Yasooka wa? Yagamba Sawulo ki? Yalaba omusajja ow’omutima omwesimbu. Sawulo yali mwesimbu, okutuuka we yategeerera, era singa wandibaddewo omuntu yenna eyandyetaaze okwaniriza Kristo amangu ago olw’okukkiriza, yali ye.

Naye Mukama Yesu Kristo teyayogera kigambo na kimu ku kukkiriza. “Sawulo, Sawulo, onjigganyiza ki?” (Ebikolwa 9:4)—ng’aggyako obwambazo bw’obulimba ku maaso ge n’amuleka alabe obubi bw’empisa ye.

Sawulo bwe yagamba nti, “Ggwe ani, Mukama wange?” (Ebikolwa 9:5), yaddamu okumuvunaana. Teyajja na bigambo bya kubudaabuda. Teyawonya kiwundu amangu ago; naye yagamba nti, “Nze Yesu gw’oyigganya” (Ebikolwa 9:5). Yasindika amazima okukka wansi ennyo, ng’azibula amaaso ga Sawulo okusingawo n’amufuula okutegeera bulungi omusango gwe. Olwo n’amusindika e Damasiko, gye yamala ennaku ssatu nga tannawonyezebwa. Katonda n’amuweereza ekyuma eky’obuntu ekyetoowaza, era Sawulo kyamugwanira okuwulira n’okugondera ebigambo bye ng’amagulwe tegannava ku maaso ge, ng’obukakafu bw’okusonyiyibwa tebunnajja, era ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu tannajjuza mmeeme ye.

Neebuuza Pawulo kye yali akola mu nnaku ezo essatu! Si kuyimba nnyimba za kwebaza na kutendereza. Ekyo kyandijjidde oluvannyuma. Olowooza yali akola ki? Teyalya so teyanywa, era yasigala mu kizikiza. Yali akola ki? Awatali kubuusabuusa yali asaba. Awatali kubuusabuusa yali anoonya Kristo ono eyayogera naye ku luguudo. Awatali kubuusabuusa yali atunuulira n’entiisa obulamu bwe obw’edda era ng’avaako emirembe gyonna okuwakanya Yesu Kristo n’Enjiri ye.

Mazima, yali aleeta ebibala ebisaanira okwenenya, ng’enteekateeka ya Katonda bw’eri (Ebikolwa 26). Olwo Ananiya n’ajja n’amubuulira Kristo. Yakkiriza n’alokolebwa, amagulwe ne gava ku maaso ge, era akamwa ke ne kajjula okutendereza n’okwebaza Katonda.

Koluneriyo kye kyokulabirako ekirala, naye yali mu mbeera ki mu birowoozo ne mu mutima? Tumanyi nti yatya Katonda era n’akola eby’obutuukirivu okutuuka kwe yasobola. Yagabira abantu n’omukwano era n’asaba obutayosa. Ekyo kisinga bamu ku mmwe kye mutakolangako, wadde nga mubeera mu biseera by’Enjiri. Temwali kumala kiro kyonna nga musabira emmeeme yammwe—wadde ekitundu ky’ekiro, abamu ku mmwe. Koluneriyo yakola bw’atyo. Yali anoonya Katonda. Yali ayagala nnyo okumumanya. Yali mwetegefu, ka kibe kitya, okukola by’ayagala. Olw’ekyo, Mukama n’amuweereza obubaka obw’ekitiibwa obw’okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu Kristo.

Nnandyeyongedde okuwa ebyokulabirako, naye nteekwa okukoma. Twogedde ebimala okulaga abagwanira okukkiriza: aboonoonyi abeenenya ddala, era bo bokka.

Ekyawandiikibwa kino kyolekera omwonoonyi eyeenenya, eyazibulwa amaaso, era eyakkirizibwa ku kibi. Abamu ku mmwe muzibuliddwa amaaso, mukkirizibbwa, era mweraliikiridde nnyo n’okuba nti temusobola kwebaka. Mwenenya ddala. Mmwe abantu ddala, kale, ekyawandiikibwa kino gye kijjira: Kkiriza. Muli mu mbeera y’omukuumi w’ekkomera.

“Kkiriza Mukama Yesu, olokolebwe” (Ebikolwa 16:31). Kale ka tulowooze embeera y’ebirowoozo omukuumi w’ekkomera gye yalimu. Tulaba okuva mu byonna ebyabaawo engeri amaaso ge gye gaazibulwa. Musisi ye yakikola. Abantu abamu beetaaga musisi ng’amaaso gaabwe tegannazibulwa, era ateekwa okuba ow’amaanyi. Amaaso g’omukuumi w’ekkomera gaazibulwa, era yakozesa bulungi omukisa.

Ekiseera ekitono nga tekinnaba, yali akambuwaza abatume. Woogera ku nkyukakyuka—wano waali nkyukakyuka.

Olwo n’akaaba nti, “Bassebo, nkole ntya okulokolebwa?” (Ebikolwa 16:30). Mu butuufu, yali agamba nti, “Nneetegese okukola kyonna; kunnyonnyola bukunnyonnyozi kye nkola.” Emmeeme bw’etuuka mu mbeera eyo ey’ebirowoozo, tewaba kirala kya kukola wabula okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Yajja ng’akankana, n’agwa mu maaso gaabwe, era oluvannyuma n’anaaza ebiwundu byabwe. Bw’otuuka mu mbeera eyo ey’ebirowoozo, tolwa kulokolebwa. Tolibaako kirala kya kukola wabula okukkiriza. Olwo kirikuwera.

2. Omwonoonyi Agwanira Okukkiriza Ddi?

Ng’amaze okwenenya.

Ne wano nnaddamu ebbaluwa zammwe ezimu. Omu awandiika nti: “Ntya nti sitegeera kibi kyange bulungi. Sirina nnaku ya njawulo olw’ekibi, naye ndaba obulamu bwange bwonna ng’ensobi emu ennene n’ekibi.”

Tewali kya bulijjo okusinga abantu okwerimba ku nsonga eno. Omuntu oyo atabula okuwulira n’okukkirizibwa. Alowooza nti olw’okuba nga tafunye nnaku ya maanyi ng’abamu bwe baafuna, kyeva atategeezebwa bulungi ku kibi. Naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu azibudde amaaso ge okulaba nti obulamu bwe bwonna bubadde nsobi emu nnene n’ekibi. Akkirizibbwa nti byonna bibadde bibi—si bibi bimu wano ne wali, ebyawukana ku bulamu bwe obulala, wabula okutegeera embeera ye eya ddala okumuleetera okulaba obulamu bwe bwonna nga bwa kibi.

Mazima, munnange, okkirizibbwa. Ani okuggyako Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayinza okukikulaga? Kale, emmeeme eyeenenya ddala esooka kulaba kibi; eky’okubiri ekyawa kibi; eky’okusatu evaako kibi.

Ka nkugezese buli kimu ku bubonero buno. Toleka Setaani akulimbe akuleetere okwegaana Katonda ky’abadde akola mu mutima gwo. Tunuulira amazima. Bw’otuuka ku kusalawo, tomuleka atandika mpaka mu birowoozo byo. Nywerera ku ky’omanyi nga kya mazima ogende mu maaso okuva awo, oba toligenda kufuna mirembe. Setaani ye muwawaabizi w’abooluganda—era, ndowooza, n’abannyinaffe nabo.

Nnaaba mwesimbu era nga nkukebera nga bwe nnaasobola. Sijja kwewala kukebera, naye bwe tunaamala okukebera ne tuzuula amazima, yimirira ku go olwa Kristo, era togaleka gaweera wansi w’ebigere byo. Setaani ajja kugezaako okukunyaga amagezi go, omuntu wo ow’omunda, n’enkkiriza zo.

Olaba ekibi. Emmeeme etazuukusibbwa ddala telaba kibi mu kifaananyi kyakyo eky’amazima, mu buzibu bwakyo, oba mu biva mu kyo. Omuntu ng’oyo akkiriza nti abantu bonna baboonoonyi. Woowe weewaawo, naye talaba butonde bwa kibi obw’obufu n’obw’okusalirwa omusango. Talaba nga ekibi bwe kiri ekintu ekibi era ekikaawa mu kyokka.

Kale, Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka y’ayinza okuzibula amaaso g’omuntu okulaba kino. Awatali ye, okubuulira kwange kwonna—oba okw’omuntu omulala yenna—n’okubuulira kwa bamalayika, singa baakkirizibwa okubuulira, kwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna ne kutaleeta kukkirizibwa kwa kibi. Bw’olaba ekibi, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yazibudde amaaso go. Mwebaze era gume omwoyo, munnange. Katonda bw’akukoledde okutuuka wano n’azibula amaaso go okulaba obutonde n’ebiva mu kibi, tekiraga nti era ayagala okukulokola mu kyo? Yazibula amaaso go alyoke agasiige eddagala ery’amaaso, akusobozese okulaba omusana mu musana gwe.

Kale, otuuse wano? Ontegeezezza nti obulamu bwo bubadde kibi kimu kinene. Abalala boogera ku kibi kimu kya njawulo. Ka kibe kitya, bw’okkirizibwa ku kibi, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yakukkirizza. Noolwekyo, webaze Katonda era gume omwoyo okutuuka wano.

Ate era, eyeenenya ddala akyawa ekibi; kwe kugamba nti, endowooza ye ku kibi eyawukana ddala ku bwe yali. Waaliwo ekiseera lwe wasobolanga okukola ekibi awatali kukyerowoozaako oba kufaayo. Abantu batera obutategeera nkyukakyuka enkulu ebaddewo mu bo mu nsonga eno kubanga bagireetebwako mpolampola.

Ddayo mu mbeera yo etazuukusibbwa. Wabeeranga otya olwo? Ebintu ebikuleetera kaakati ennaku enkulu bye byali bye wakolanga buli lunaku awatali kufaayo. Ebintu ebikutiisa kaakati, wadde mu birowoozo oba mu kukemebwa, byali kitundu ky’obulamu bwo obwa bulijjo awatali kuwulira musango.

Wali tolina kukyawa kibi so tolina kukitya. Wali muddu wa Setaani ow’okweyagalira. Kaakati oli muddu atayagala. Olwo wadduka eri ekibi; kaakati amaanyi galina okukugoba okukituukako. Bw’ogwa, kiba ku buyinza bwo. Okyawa ekibi.

Kaakati, kino tekitegeeza nti omaze okulokolebwa mu kyo. So tekitegeeza nti olina amaanyi okwelokola mu kyo. Mazima, kuno kwe kulwana kwennyini omutume kw’annyonnyola ng’akubaga okugezaako okutawangula okw’omwonoonyi eyakkirizibwa. Ebintu by’otoyagala kukola, weezuula ng’obikola; n’ebintu by’oyagala okukola, tolina maanyi kubituukiriza. Naye era, oyagala okukola ekituufu. Eyo y’enjawulo.

Emirundi gimu, wali tolina kwegomba kukola bintu ebyo. Mazima, oyinza n’okuba nga wali olowooza nti abaali babikola baali bannanfuusi. Kaakati, owulira mu ngeri eyawukanako ddala. Olwana, ofuba, osaba, era otunula ng’oli mukuumi.

Abamu ku mmwe mumbulidde bwe kityo, naye era mugamba nti, “Nwangulwa emirundi n’emirundi.”

Mazima muwangulwa, kubanga temunnalokolebwa. Naye temulaba nti mwagala okulokolebwa? Mukyawa ekibi ekibanyaze. Mukirwanyisa. Mukikuuma. Oboolyawo temuwangulwa mirundi mingi nga bwe kyali edda.

Abantu tebategeera nga bwe balina ebbanja eri amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu agakkiriza n’agaziyiza, agabayamba mu bunafu bwabwe ne kaakati, agabasobozesa okusala omukono ogwa ddyo n’okuggyamu eriiso erya ddyo, era agabaleeta mu mbeera y’okulindirira mu maaso ga Katonda, nga Koluneriyo n’omulaawe.

Abamu ku mmwe, abawuliriza bange, munoonya Katonda. Mwegomba okununulibwa era mulwanyisa ekibi.

Twala ekyokulabirako ekirala. Sitegeeza nti emmeeme erina amaanyi okwelokola mu bwonoonefu bwayo obw’omunda. Ekyo Yesu Kristo ky’awa bw’alokola. Naye lowooza kino: wano waliwo omusajja atamiira. Mutamiivu. Olwo n’akkirizibwa ku kibi. Omwoyo gwa Katonda amugamba nti, “Onooleka ekikopo?” Olwo okulwana ne kutandika.

Kale, omusajja oyo ayigirizibwe okweyongera okunywa n’okusuubira buggolokofu nti Katonda anaamulokola? Munaamugambanga nti, “Toleka mwenge; kkiriza kyokka Mukama Yesu Kristo olokolebwe”? Oba munaamugambanga nti, “Oteekwa okuggyawo ekibi kyo. Sala omukono ogwo ogwa ddyo. Ggyamu eriiso eryo erya ddyo. Vaako omwenge ogwo emirembe gyonna mu mutima gwo, mu kigendererwa kyo, ne mu buyinza bwo. Okutuusa lw’onookikola, toyinza kukkiriza mu mazima Mukama Yesu”?

Wano waliwo omuntu omulala atamanyiira kulimba. Bw’akkirizibwa ku kibi, atandika okukuuma emimwa gye aleme okwonoona n’akamwa ke. Awangula mu kigero ekimu, oba, mu butuufu, Omwoyo Omutukuvu amuyamba okuwangula, aleme kulimba nga bwe yakolanga edda. Akyafirwa oluusi kubanga tannafuna maanyi gonna ku kyo, naye amaliridde nnyo, era ku ludda lw’obuyinza bwe, asala ekibi kino eky’ebweru era alinda mu buwulize okununulibwa n’obulokozi obujjuvu.

Waliwo n’omuweereza atera okubba mu ssanduuko y’ensimbi za mukama we. Agenda mu nkuŋŋaana y’eddiini n’akkirizibwa ku kibi. Olwo Omwoyo gwa Katonda agamba nti, “Oteekwa okulekera awo obubbi obwo. Toyinza kujja mu nkuŋŋaana eno buli kiro, ng’ogamba nti oyagala obulokozi, ng’ate buli lunaku oyongera okubba ku mukama wo. Oteekwa okusala omukono ogwo ogwa ddyo. Leka obubbi obwo. Malirira okuzzaawo bye wabba, era linda mu maaso gange nga bw’oleeta ebibala ebisaanira okwenenya.”

Mulaba kye ntegeeza. Abamu ku mmwe muli mu mbeera eyo ddala—mukimanyi. Ka kibe kibi kya mpisa ki ekibanyaze, ensonga y’emu. Yesu Kristo ayagala mulekeere awo empisa eyo mu buyinza bwammwe, mu kumalirira, ne mu kigendererwa kyammwe. Temulina maanyi kwelokola mu kyo. Muyinza okulwana, ng’abamu ku mmwe bwe mugamba nga mukola, naye era kibawangula. Amanyi byonna ebyo. Naye era asiima okulwana, okufuba, okutunula, n’okumalirira.

Bw’anaabalokola, anaabawa amaanyi, olwo muliyimirira mu kifo ky’okugwa, kubanga ye yennyini y’anaabawanirira.

Kaakati mumanyi nti mutuuse wano. Mumanyi nti singa mubadde n’amaanyi kaakati gennyini okuzikiriza ddala obuyinza bw’empisa eyo embi ku bulamu bwammwe emirembe gyonna, mwandikikoze awatali kulwawo. Mugamba nti, “Woowe weewaawo, nandikikoze. Singa mbadde n’amaanyi.” Okwo kwe kwenenya. Okwo kwe kwenenya okwa mazima.

Ky’otosobola kwekolera, Kristo akusanga we oli n’agamba nti, “Nnaakikola ku lulwo. Nnaamenya amaanyi g’empisa eyo. Nnaakuwonya mu mukono gw’omulabe. Nnaakuggya mu buddu obwo. Kkiriza mu nze kyokka, nange nnaakuyimusa. Nnaakujjuza Omwoyo gwange.

Onooyimirira mu nze era ku bwange, era ky’okola kaakati ng’ofuba okwekolera, nnaakikola ku lulwo.”

Kale mutuuse wano—nti mukyawa ekibi?

“Weewaawo, nkyawa.”

Mukiwandiise mu bbaluwa zammwe gye ndi, era abalala bakigamba abatawandiika.

“Weewaawo,” mugamba, “njagala okulokolebwa mu kyo. Singa nsobola okwelokola mu kibi kaakati gennyini ne siddayo kwonoona, nandikikoze.”

Mwandikikoze? Ekyo si kwenenya? Kyandibadde ki ekirala?

Ka twogere nti wali n’omwana omujeemu era ateegondera. Yali abeera ng’awakanya obuyinza bwo, ng’ayonoona ensimbi zo, era ng’alinnyirira ebiragiro byo. Olwo ka twogere nti ajja okulaba obukyamu bw’amakubo ge. Oboolyawo okubonaabona kwe kwazibula amaaso ge. Oboolyawo obwavu bwe bwakikola. Oboolyawo kyali kirala. Wabula, akiraba.

Akomawo eka n’agamba nti: “Kitange, musirusiru ki bwe mbadde. Mubi ki bwe mbadde. Kaakati ndaba byonna. Saabirabanga nga mbikola. Ndaba amakubo gange ag’ekibi, ebibi ebyakuleetera ennaku ne bireeta obuyinike mu bulamu bwo. Woowe, byonna mbikyawa nnyo. Nneenenya mu nfuufu ne mu vvu. Kitange, byonna mbivaako. Nkomawo gy’oli.”

Wandigambye ki?

Wandigambye nti, “Mwana wange, tonnenenya bimala. Genda okomewo ng’owulira ennaku esingawo”?

Nedda. Omutima gwa kitaawo gwandigolodde n’okwagala n’okusonyiwa. Wandimuwambaatidde n’omwaniriza eka.

“Bwe ntyo, mbagamba nti, waliwo essanyu mu maaso ga bamalayika ba Katonda olw’omwonoonyi omu eyeenenya” (Lukka 15:10).

Wandibaddewo essanyu mu maka ago olw’okudda kw’omwana eyabula.

Naye ka twogere nti omwana yagamba nti: “Kitange, nneenenya ddala era nvaako ebibi byange, naye waliwo bannange abayinza okuddamu okunkyusa, era waliwo empisa ez’amaanyi ennyo n’okuba nti ntya nti ziyinza okumpangula. Ka mbeere kumpi naawe. Njetaaga amaanyi go.”

Wandigambye ki?

Toyinza kuddamu nti: “Kale yingira, mwana wange. Sigala nange, nange nnaakukuuma. Nnaakuyamba. Toligenda wekka. Nnaabeera naawe ne nkuwanirira”?

Nga omuntu yenna omuzadde bw’ayinza okukuuma omulala, wandikuumye mwana wo. Teyandibuliddwako kusaasira kwo wadde obuyambi bwo, emisana n’ekiro.

Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu tabuliddwako kusaasira wadde amaanyi. Eriiso lye teryebaka. Omukono gwe tegukoowa. Weetaaga bwokka okuleeta obunafu bwo obutalina maanyi eri amaanyi ge amasukkulumu ng’oyita mu kikolwa kino eky’okukkiriza, era anaakuwanirira, wadde ekibinja kya baddayimooni bwe kikwetooloola.

Eky’enkomerero, ovaako ebibi byo—kwe kugamba, mu buyinza bwo, mu kigendererwa kyo, ne mu kumalirira kwo.

Ogamba nti, “Sijja kuddamu kumunakuwaza.”

Okiyimba, era okimanyi mu mazima.

“Sijja kwagala kumunakuwaza nate.”

Singa osobola okubeera awatali kumunakuwaza, wandibalidde buli kiweebwayo nga kya muganyulo. Ekyo si kwenenya? Okimanyi nti kwe kuli.

Ovaako ekibi. Toyogera nti, “Mukama Yesu, ndokola nga nkyakwata ku mukono guno ogwa ddyo n’eriiso lino erya ddyo. Ndokola nga nkyanywerera ku bintu bino ebiziyiziddwa.”

Nedda.

Ogamba nti, “Mukama Yesu, ndokola mu byo. Nnongoosa.”

Okwo kwe kwenenya. Olaba ekibi. Okyawa ekibi. Ovaako ekibi.

Kale nno, kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo.

Woowe, Mwoyo Omutukuvu, bikkula ekkubo eryangu ery’okukkiriza.

Obuuza nti, “Nnaakkiriza ntya?”

Emmeeme eteganyizibbwa yali ennyimbuuza ekibuuzo kino mu nnukuta ennene: “Nnaakkiriza ntya?”

Omugole akkiriza atya bba ng’eweeyo gy’ali ku kyoto ky’obufumbo? Yeewaayo gy’ali. Amukkiriza. Ayingira naye mu ndagaano, olwo n’addayo eka n’abeera ng’endagaano eyo bwe ya mazima. Okwo kwe kukkiriza.

Okwo kwe kukkiriza.

Omusawo omwesiga otya ng’olwadde ng’ogalamidde ku kitanda kyo, oba mu mirembe oba mu kubonaabona? Oteeka embeera yo mu mikono gye. Weewaayo mu buyambi bwe. Weesiga obukugu bwe era ogoberera ebiragiro bye.

Beera n’okukkiriza okufaanana kuno mu Yesu Kristo.

Mwesige era omugondere, era osuubire nti kirikubeerera ng’Ekigambo kye bwe kiri.

Wabula, okukkiriza kw’abantu bangi kufaanana ng’okw’omuntu alwadde obulwadde obw’amaanyi. Mukwano gwe amubuulira ku musawo ow’ekitalo eyawonya abantu ebikumi mu mbeera ezifaanana, era n’awa obujulizi obungi nti omusawo asobola era ayagala okumuwonya, singa yeeteeka wansi w’obuyambi bwe. Omulwadde ayinza okukkiriza ddala obujulizi bwa mukwano gwe ku musawo, naye olw’ensonga eteeyoleka, agaana okweteeka mu mukono gwe.

Abantu bangi bakwata Yesu Kristo mu ngeri y’emu. Bakkiriza nti asobola okuwonya obulwadde bw’ekibi ku mbeera ze yateekawo. Bakkiriza nti tasosola. Bakkiriza nti awonyezza ebikumi abaali baboonoonyi nga bo bwe bali. Naye olw’ensonga emu, tebamwesiga. Beekuuma.

Kye weetaaga okukola kwe kuteeka embeera yo mu mikono gye n’ogamba nti: “Mukama Yesu, nzija nga bw’onnyanirizza, nga njatula era nga nvaako ekibi kyange. Singa nsobola, nandikirese emirembe gyonna kaakati gennyini. Omanyi nti nzija nga nkivaako, naye nga sirina maanyi kwelokola mu kyo. Ne kaakati, Mukama Yesu, ogambye nti, ‘Oyo ajja gye ndi sirimugoba bweru n’akatono’” (Yokaana 6:37).

“Nzija ddala. Toŋŋoba bweru. Onnyaniriza. Kitange ow’omu ggulu ow’omukisa, neewaayo gy’oli. Nteeka ebibi byange ku ssaddaaka y’Omwana wo. Ogambye nti onnyaniriza era onsonyiwa ku lulwe. Kaakati mpalula omugugu gwange ogw’omusango ne ngussa ku ye, era nzikiriza ekisuubizo kyo. Nkwesiga okuba omwesigwa eri Ekigambo kyo.”

Okwo kwe kukkiriza.

“Naye,” omukyala omwagalwa n’agamba, “sikuwulira.”

Nedda. Oteekwa okusooka okwesiga.

Weetegereze bulungi: tosaana kusooka kukkiriza nti olokoledwa, wabula okukkiriza nti akulokola kaakati ng’ekisuubizo kye bwe kiri.

“Byonna bye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nti mubifunye, binaabaawo gye muli” (Makko 11:24).

Eyo ye nteekateeka y’okukkiriza. Kkiriza nti ofuna nga tonnawulira. Bw’onoofuna, olwo onoowulira. Katonda anaaba wa mazima, era buli muntu oba dayimooni yenna amuwakanya anaazuulibwa nga mulimba.

Zingiza emikono gyo ku Oyo eyakomererwa. Kwata omukono gw’Omwana wa Katonda. Leeta emmeeme yo ey’omusango ku bigere by’omusaalaba gwe n’ogamba nti: “Onnyaniriza. Onsonyiwa. Onnongoosa. Ondokola.”

Weeyongere okwogera olulimi olw’okukkiriza.

Ndabye emmeeme nnyingi nga ziyingira mu ddembe nga ziddiŋŋana ebigambo bino eby’omuwendo mu bwannannyini: “Yafumitibwa olw’ebyonoono byange; yabetentebwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwange; ekibonerezo ekyandeetera emirembe kyali ku ye, era olw’ebiwundu bye nawonyezebwa” (Isaaya 53:5).

Weeyongere okwogera olulimi olw’okukkiriza ekkubo lyonna eddayo eka ekiro kino.

Yingira mu kisenge kyo ogambe nti: “Nnamalirira okulokolebwa, obanga obulokozi bunnaaweebwa ddala.”

Malirira nti bw’oba oyagala okuzikirira, olizikiririra awo ku bigere by’omusaalaba, ng’osaba okusaasirwa. Naye toolizikirire, kubanga asuubizza okusaasira abo abajja.

Sirabangako mmeeme kutuuka ku kifo kino ne buteera bwangu kufuna bulokozi.

Yingira mu lyato ery’okulokoka. Leka emabega ekyombo ky’obutuukirivu bwo n’ebikolwa byo.

Yingira ddala mu lyato ery’okulokoka ery’essaddaaka ya Kristo. Nywerera ku ye, era malirira obutamuleka n’akatono okutuusa Omwoyo lw’anaawa obujulizi mu mmeeme yo, ng’akaaba nti, “Abba! Kitaffe!” (Abaruumi 8:15), era ng’omanyi n’obukakafu nti oviiddemu okufa n’oyingira mu bulamu (Yokaana 5:24).

Mukama akuyambe.

Amiina.
fields.body_text: "Awo n’abaggya ebweru n’agamba nti, ‘Bassebo, nkole ntya okulokolebwa?’ Ne bamuddamu nti, ‘Kkiriza Mukama Yesu, olokolebwe, ggwe n’ab’omu nnyumba yo.’" Ebikolwa 16:30–31 Kino kye kimu ku byawandiikibwa ebisinga okutegeererwa obubi n’okukozesebwa obubi mu Bayibuli, era oboolyawo ekimu ku byo ebikoledwa Setaani omulimu munene nga bwe kikolera Katonda. Buli mukkiriza ali wano ka asabe mu kukkiriza omusana gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga bwe tugezaako okukitegeera n’okukikozesa obulungi. Ka tulowooze: Ani agwanira okukkiriza? Bagwanira kukkiriza ddi? Bagwanira kukkiriza batya? 1. Ani Agwanira Okukkiriza? Omwoyo Omutukuvu agamba ani nti, "Kkiriza Mukama Yesu, olokolebwe"? Weetegereze bulungi: si aboonoonyi bonna awatali kwawula. Wano waliwo ensobi enkulu esangibwa mu bungi bw’okuyigiriza okw’ennaku zaffe. Ebigambo bino batera okubiggya mu bigyetooloodde ne mu byawandiikibwa ebirala bingi ebibinnyonnyola. Babyanjula nga tebiriimu mateeka agaabyawerezanga bulijjo mu kuyigiriza n’empisa z’abatume. Ddala, mu myaka nkaaga oba nsanvu egiyise gyokka mu kwe enkola eno empya efuuse eya bulijjo—okubuulira awatali kwawula aboonoonyi abatannazuukusibwa, abatannakyuka, era abatannenenya nti, "Kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo." Kirabika gye ndi nti akabi kanene kakoledwa ku mulimu gwa Kristo olw’okukwata bubi kuno Ekigambo kya Katonda. Ng’okwo tekugoberera Byawandiikibwa, ate era tekulina na magezi. Omwonoonyi atannazuukusibwa, atannakkirizibwa, era atannenenya ayinza atya okukkiriza mu mazima? Kyandyanguyiddeko okusuubira Setaani okukkiriza mu kifo kye. Tekisoboka. Enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu ng’abo bagamba nti, "Nzikiriza." Waakati wa lwa, mutabani wange omwagalwa yali ayogera n’omusajja eyali atudde waggulu ku mmotoka eyali atamidde era ng’akozesa ebigambo ebitasaana nnyo. Mutabani wange yali agezaako okumulaga akabi k’empisa ye ez’ekibi ng’omumenyi w’amateeka ga Katonda. "Woowe!" omusajja n’agamba, "si lwa bikolwa; lwa kukkiriza, era nkkiriza nga bw’okkiriza." "Weewaawo," mutabani wange n’addamu, "naye okkiriza ki?" "Woowe," n’addamu, "nzikiriza Yesu Kristo, era mazima ddala ndirokolebwa." Omusajja oyo ky’akyokerwako ku nkumi n’enkumi. Abantu ng’abo mbasisinkana buli lunaku. Bakkiriza nti waaliwo omusajja ayitibwa Yesu, era nti yafiira aboonoonyi—n’okubafiirira bo. Naye ku by’okukozesa okukkiriza okulokola, tebamanyi ku ako okusinga Agulipa oba Fericisi. Kino kyeyoleka nga basembeddemu okufa. Olwo abantu bano be bamu banyiga engalo zaabwe, ne bagwa mu buggwanjuba, ne bayita Abakristaayo bajje basabe nabo. Singa baali bakkirizza ddala, lwaki okutya n’okweraliikirira kuno kwonna okufa nga kusembera? Baali bakkiriza mu birowoozo byokka, so si mu mutima. Baayaniriza ebituufu ebyawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, naye tebaakkiriza mu ntegeera ya Bayibuli ey’ekigambo. Singa baakkiriza, okukkiriza kwabwe kwandibalokodde.
