Tugumira nti kya bwereere era tekigoberera Byawandiikibwa okubuulira abantu ng’abo nti "kkiriza kyokka." Abakristaayo tebaba bamalirizza mulimu gwabwe nga bagamba buggamba aboonoonyi nti Yesu yabafiirira era nti basaanira okumukkiriza. Balina omulimu omuzibu okusinga: okuyamba okuzibula amaaso gaabwe balabe embeera yaabwe eya ddala, ne, olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo, bategeere nti baboonoonyi abeetaaga obulokozi. Abantu bwe bategeera nti balwadde mu mwoyo, banaddukira eri Omusawo Omukulu. Amaaso g’emmeeme gateekwa okuzibulwa galabe amazima g’ekibi n’ebiva mu kibi. Okutegeera kuno kusaanira okuleeta okwegomba okw’amaanyi okulokolebwa mu kyo. Ekyuma kya Katonda ekikulu eky’okutuukiriza kino ge mateeka ge, agakola ng’omusomesa aleeta aboonoonyi eri Kristo Omulokozi waabwe. Tewali kifo na kimu mu Ndagaano Empya awatume gye baakubiriza abantu okukkiriza, oba omuntu gy’annyonnyolwa ng’akkiriza, awatali nsonga nnungi ey’okusalirawo nti okukkirizibwa ku kibi n’okwenenya byali bimaze okubaawo. Ekyokulabirako kimu ekirabika ng’ekyawukana ye Simoni omulogo. Nga bangi abantu mu biseera by’okusesema kw’eddiini okw’amaanyi, Simoni yatwalibwa amaanyi g’enkuŋŋaana n’ekyokulabirako ky’abo abaali bamwetoolodde. Yaatula okukkiriza. Awatali kubuusabuusa yakkiriza nti Yesu yafiira ku musaalaba. Yaaniriza amazima g’Obukristaayo mu birowoozo bye era, mu ngeri eyo, n’afuuka omukkiriza—nga obukumi n’obukumi bwe bukola leero. Yabatizibwa. Naye ekiseera eky’okugezesebwa bwe kyatuuka—oba ebbeetu lye oba eya Katonda bye byamusinga obukulu—embeera ye eya ddala n’eyeeyoleka. Ng’omutume bwe yagamba: "Omutima gwo teguli mulongoofu mu maaso ga Katonda." Ebikolwa 8:21 Tewali n’omu akyusibwa ng’omutima gwe teguli mulongoofu eri Katonda. Ako ke kagezo. Singa Simoni yali akyusibwa ddala, omutima gwe gwandibadde mulongoofu eri Katonda, era teyandirowoozezza nti ekirabo ky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu kiyinza okugulibwa n’ensimbi. Peetero n’ayongera okugamba: "Kubanga ndaba ng’oli mu mususa ogukaawa ne mu bukambwe bw’obutali butuukirivu." Ebikolwa 8:23 Kale yagamba ki oluvannyuma? Yagamba nti, "Kkiriza kaakati kaakati"? Nedda. Wabula yagamba nti: "Kale weenenye obubi bwo buno, osabe Mukama, oba kisoboka, ekirowoozo ky’omutima gwo kisonyiyibwe." Sooka weenenye, olwo olyoke ofune okusonyiyibwa. Bwe tutyo, tuggya essomo eryamaddu mu kifo kino. Simoni ye yekka eyawandiikibwa ng’aatula okukkiriza awatali bujulizi bulambulukufu mu kifo kyennyini nti okukkirizibwa n’okwenenya byakulembera okukkiriza. Naye n’ewano, ebivaamu biraga amazima. Simoni yalina okukkiriza kw’ebirowoozo, naye si kukkiriza kwa mutima. Noolwekyo, okwatula kwe kwakoma mu kugwa n’obuggwanjuba. Abamu bampandiikidde ku wiiki eno nga bagamba nti baali bakkirizza. Baali basendeddwa okwatula okukkiriza, naye tewali bibala ebyavaamu. Ah, tekwali kukkiriza kwa mutima. Kwali kukkiriza kwa birowoozo byokka—ng’okwa Simoni. Kwabaleka mu mbeera embi okusinga bwe kwabasanga, era okuva olwo mubadde mulwana era mubungeeta mu kizikiza ky’omwoyo. Naye temumaliriza nti kuno kwali kukkiriza okwa mazima era nti okukkiriza okwa mazima kugudde. Wabula, mugume omwoyo, era mutandike buggya. Mwenenye, munoonye ekintu ekya mazima. Setaani bulijjo aleeta ekyabulimba. Noolwekyo, temugwa mu buggwanjuba olw’okuba nti okukkiriza okutali kwo tekwawangula. Okugwa okwo tekufuula kukkiriza kwa Katonda okwa mazima okutalina makulu. Nedda ddala! Mulowooze ekyokulabirako ekirala—abantu enkumi ssatu abaakyusibwa mu lunaku lumu. Mazima kino kye kyokulabirako kya Bayibuli. Tewali ayinza kukiyita kya kukontana n’enjiri oba kya mateeka. Ekisooka Peetero kye yakola kye ki? Yakuba amazima ga Katonda amawagguufu mu mitima gyabwe n’abaleeta mu kukkirizibwa. Yabazuukusa eri obuzibu bw’embeera yaabwe okutuusa lwe baakaaba nti: "Abooluganda, tukole ki?" Ebikolwa 2:37 Baali beeraliikiridde nnyo. Emitima gyabwe gyafumitibwa. Amaaso gaabwe gaazibulwa okulaba ebiva mu kibi kyabwe ebibi ennyo. Olw’ekyo, baakaaba mu maaso g’ekibiina ekinene, nga banoonya ekkubo ery’obulokozi. Peetero yasooka kubakkiriza ku kibi, era mu kukola bw’atyo yagoberera enteekateeka ya Katonda gye yateekawo. Ate era, omulaawe atera okujuliizibwa ng’ekyokulabirako ky’okukkiriza; naye yali mu mbeera ki mu birowoozo? Yali mwonoonyi atafaayo, atannakkirizibwa? Yali eyo—Omuwesiyopiya, omukaafiiri; naye yali abadde wa? E Yerusaalemi, okusinza Katonda ow’amazima era omulamu mu ngeri esinga gye yamanya n’okusinziira ku kutegeera kwe yalina. Kale, yali akola ki Firipo bwe yamusanga? Teyamatira kusinza businzi mu yeekaalu n’oluvannyuma n’addayo mu bulamu bwe obwa bulijjo awatali kufaayo. Yali anoonya mu Byawandiikibwa. Yali anoonya Katonda mu bwesimbu, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bulijjo amanyi emyoyo egifaanana bwe giri gye giri. Kale n’agamba Firipo nti, “Genda osemberere eggaali lino.” Waliwo omusajja annoonya; waliwo omusajja alina omutima ogwesimbye okunnoonya. Genda obuulire Kristo, era omugambe akkirize. Omusajja oyo yandiweeyo, yandikoze, oba yandifiiriddwa ekintu kyonna olw’obulokozi, era Firipo amaze kunnyonnyola ekkubo ery’okukkiriza, n’akikkiriza, nga bwe kiri, ng’emyoyo gyonna egifaanana bwe girikola. Sawulo, ng’ali mu kkubo okugenda e Damasiko, kye kyokulabirako ekirala. Yesu Kristo yennyini ye yali omubuulizi eyo, era mazima teyandisobezza. Enkola ye yali etuukiridde. Yasooka wa? Yagamba Sawulo ki? Yalaba omusajja ow’omutima omwesimbu. Sawulo yali mwesimbu, okutuuka we yategeerera, era singa wandibaddewo omuntu yenna eyandyetaaze okwaniriza Kristo amangu ago olw’okukkiriza, yali ye. Naye Mukama Yesu Kristo teyayogera kigambo na kimu ku kukkiriza. “Sawulo, Sawulo, onjigganyiza ki?” (Ebikolwa 9:4)—ng’aggyako obwambazo bw’obulimba ku maaso ge n’amuleka alabe obubi bw’empisa ye. Sawulo bwe yagamba nti, “Ggwe ani, Mukama wange?” (Ebikolwa 9:5), yaddamu okumuvunaana. Teyajja na bigambo bya kubudaabuda. Teyawonya kiwundu amangu ago; naye yagamba nti, “Nze Yesu gw’oyigganya” (Ebikolwa 9:5). Yasindika amazima okukka wansi ennyo, ng’azibula amaaso ga Sawulo okusingawo n’amufuula okutegeera bulungi omusango gwe. Olwo n’amusindika e Damasiko, gye yamala ennaku ssatu nga tannawonyezebwa. Katonda n’amuweereza ekyuma eky’obuntu ekyetoowaza, era Sawulo kyamugwanira okuwulira n’okugondera ebigambo bye ng’amagulwe tegannava ku maaso ge, ng’obukakafu bw’okusonyiyibwa tebunnajja, era ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu tannajjuza mmeeme ye. Neebuuza Pawulo kye yali akola mu nnaku ezo essatu! Si kuyimba nnyimba za kwebaza na kutendereza. Ekyo kyandijjidde oluvannyuma. Olowooza yali akola ki? Teyalya so teyanywa, era yasigala mu kizikiza. Yali akola ki? Awatali kubuusabuusa yali asaba. Awatali kubuusabuusa yali anoonya Kristo ono eyayogera naye ku luguudo. Awatali kubuusabuusa yali atunuulira n’entiisa obulamu bwe obw’edda era ng’avaako emirembe gyonna okuwakanya Yesu Kristo n’Enjiri ye. Mazima, yali aleeta ebibala ebisaanira okwenenya, ng’enteekateeka ya Katonda bw’eri (Ebikolwa 26). Olwo Ananiya n’ajja n’amubuulira Kristo. Yakkiriza n’alokolebwa, amagulwe ne gava ku maaso ge, era akamwa ke ne kajjula okutendereza n’okwebaza Katonda. Koluneriyo kye kyokulabirako ekirala, naye yali mu mbeera ki mu birowoozo ne mu mutima? Tumanyi nti yatya Katonda era n’akola eby’obutuukirivu okutuuka kwe yasobola. Yagabira abantu n’omukwano era n’asaba obutayosa. Ekyo kisinga bamu ku mmwe kye mutakolangako, wadde nga mubeera mu biseera by’Enjiri. Temwali kumala kiro kyonna nga musabira emmeeme yammwe—wadde ekitundu ky’ekiro, abamu ku mmwe. Koluneriyo yakola bw’atyo. Yali anoonya Katonda. Yali ayagala nnyo okumumanya. Yali mwetegefu, ka kibe kitya, okukola by’ayagala. Olw’ekyo, Mukama n’amuweereza obubaka obw’ekitiibwa obw’okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu Kristo. Nnandyeyongedde okuwa ebyokulabirako, naye nteekwa okukoma. Twogedde ebimala okulaga abagwanira okukkiriza: aboonoonyi abeenenya ddala, era bo bokka. Ekyawandiikibwa kino kyolekera omwonoonyi eyeenenya, eyazibulwa amaaso, era eyakkirizibwa ku kibi. Abamu ku mmwe muzibuliddwa amaaso, mukkirizibbwa, era mweraliikiridde nnyo n’okuba nti temusobola kwebaka. Mwenenya ddala. Mmwe abantu ddala, kale, ekyawandiikibwa kino gye kijjira: Kkiriza. Muli mu mbeera y’omukuumi w’ekkomera. “Kkiriza Mukama Yesu, olokolebwe” (Ebikolwa 16:31). Kale ka tulowooze embeera y’ebirowoozo omukuumi w’ekkomera gye yalimu. Tulaba okuva mu byonna ebyabaawo engeri amaaso ge gye gaazibulwa. Musisi ye yakikola. Abantu abamu beetaaga musisi ng’amaaso gaabwe tegannazibulwa, era ateekwa okuba ow’amaanyi. Amaaso g’omukuumi w’ekkomera gaazibulwa, era yakozesa bulungi omukisa. Ekiseera ekitono nga tekinnaba, yali akambuwaza abatume. Woogera ku nkyukakyuka—wano waali nkyukakyuka. Olwo n’akaaba nti, “Bassebo, nkole ntya okulokolebwa?” (Ebikolwa 16:30). Mu butuufu, yali agamba nti, “Nneetegese okukola kyonna; kunnyonnyola bukunnyonnyozi kye nkola.” Emmeeme bw’etuuka mu mbeera eyo ey’ebirowoozo, tewaba kirala kya kukola wabula okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Yajja ng’akankana, n’agwa mu maaso gaabwe, era oluvannyuma n’anaaza ebiwundu byabwe. Bw’otuuka mu mbeera eyo ey’ebirowoozo, tolwa kulokolebwa. Tolibaako kirala kya kukola wabula okukkiriza. Olwo kirikuwera. 2. Omwonoonyi Agwanira Okukkiriza Ddi? Ng’amaze okwenenya. Ne wano nnaddamu ebbaluwa zammwe ezimu. Omu awandiika nti: “Ntya nti sitegeera kibi kyange bulungi. Sirina nnaku ya njawulo olw’ekibi, naye ndaba obulamu bwange bwonna ng’ensobi emu ennene n’ekibi.” Tewali kya bulijjo okusinga abantu okwerimba ku nsonga eno. Omuntu oyo atabula okuwulira n’okukkirizibwa. Alowooza nti olw’okuba nga tafunye nnaku ya maanyi ng’abamu bwe baafuna, kyeva atategeezebwa bulungi ku kibi. Naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu azibudde amaaso ge okulaba nti obulamu bwe bwonna bubadde nsobi emu nnene n’ekibi. Akkirizibbwa nti byonna bibadde bibi—si bibi bimu wano ne wali, ebyawukana ku bulamu bwe obulala, wabula okutegeera embeera ye eya ddala okumuleetera okulaba obulamu bwe bwonna nga bwa kibi. Mazima, munnange, okkirizibbwa. Ani okuggyako Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayinza okukikulaga? Kale, emmeeme eyeenenya ddala esooka kulaba kibi; eky’okubiri ekyawa kibi; eky’okusatu evaako kibi. Ka nkugezese buli kimu ku bubonero buno. Toleka Setaani akulimbe akuleetere okwegaana Katonda ky’abadde akola mu mutima gwo. Tunuulira amazima. Bw’otuuka ku kusalawo, tomuleka atandika mpaka mu birowoozo byo. Nywerera ku ky’omanyi nga kya mazima ogende mu maaso okuva awo, oba toligenda kufuna mirembe. Setaani ye muwawaabizi w’abooluganda—era, ndowooza, n’abannyinaffe nabo. Nnaaba mwesimbu era nga nkukebera nga bwe nnaasobola. Sijja kwewala kukebera, naye bwe tunaamala okukebera ne tuzuula amazima, yimirira ku go olwa Kristo, era togaleka gaweera wansi w’ebigere byo. Setaani ajja kugezaako okukunyaga amagezi go, omuntu wo ow’omunda, n’enkkiriza zo. Olaba ekibi. Emmeeme etazuukusibbwa ddala telaba kibi mu kifaananyi kyakyo eky’amazima, mu buzibu bwakyo, oba mu biva mu kyo. Omuntu ng’oyo akkiriza nti abantu bonna baboonoonyi. Woowe weewaawo, naye talaba butonde bwa kibi obw’obufu n’obw’okusalirwa omusango. Talaba nga ekibi bwe kiri ekintu ekibi era ekikaawa mu kyokka. Kale, Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka y’ayinza okuzibula amaaso g’omuntu okulaba kino. Awatali ye, okubuulira kwange kwonna—oba okw’omuntu omulala yenna—n’okubuulira kwa bamalayika, singa baakkirizibwa okubuulira, kwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna ne kutaleeta kukkirizibwa kwa kibi. Bw’olaba ekibi, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yazibudde amaaso go. Mwebaze era gume omwoyo, munnange. Katonda bw’akukoledde okutuuka wano n’azibula amaaso go okulaba obutonde n’ebiva mu kibi, tekiraga nti era ayagala okukulokola mu kyo? Yazibula amaaso go alyoke agasiige eddagala ery’amaaso, akusobozese okulaba omusana mu musana gwe. Kale, otuuse wano? Ontegeezezza nti obulamu bwo bubadde kibi kimu kinene. Abalala boogera ku kibi kimu kya njawulo. Ka kibe kitya, bw’okkirizibwa ku kibi, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yakukkirizza. Noolwekyo, webaze Katonda era gume omwoyo okutuuka wano. Ate era, eyeenenya ddala akyawa ekibi; kwe kugamba nti, endowooza ye ku kibi eyawukana ddala ku bwe yali. Waaliwo ekiseera lwe wasobolanga okukola ekibi awatali kukyerowoozaako oba kufaayo. Abantu batera obutategeera nkyukakyuka enkulu ebaddewo mu bo mu nsonga eno kubanga bagireetebwako mpolampola. Ddayo mu mbeera yo etazuukusibbwa. Wabeeranga otya olwo? Ebintu ebikuleetera kaakati ennaku enkulu bye byali bye wakolanga buli lunaku awatali kufaayo. Ebintu ebikutiisa kaakati, wadde mu birowoozo oba mu kukemebwa, byali kitundu ky’obulamu bwo obwa bulijjo awatali kuwulira musango. Wali tolina kukyawa kibi so tolina kukitya. Wali muddu wa Setaani ow’okweyagalira. Kaakati oli muddu atayagala. Olwo wadduka eri ekibi; kaakati amaanyi galina okukugoba okukituukako. Bw’ogwa, kiba ku buyinza bwo. Okyawa ekibi. Kaakati, kino tekitegeeza nti omaze okulokolebwa mu kyo. So tekitegeeza nti olina amaanyi okwelokola mu kyo. Mazima, kuno kwe kulwana kwennyini omutume kw’annyonnyola ng’akubaga okugezaako okutawangula okw’omwonoonyi eyakkirizibwa. Ebintu by’otoyagala kukola, weezuula ng’obikola; n’ebintu by’oyagala okukola, tolina maanyi kubituukiriza. Naye era, oyagala okukola ekituufu. Eyo y’enjawulo. Emirundi gimu, wali tolina kwegomba kukola bintu ebyo. Mazima, oyinza n’okuba nga wali olowooza nti abaali babikola baali bannanfuusi. Kaakati, owulira mu ngeri eyawukanako ddala. Olwana, ofuba, osaba, era otunula ng’oli mukuumi. Abamu ku mmwe mumbulidde bwe kityo, naye era mugamba nti, “Nwangulwa emirundi n’emirundi.” Mazima muwangulwa, kubanga temunnalokolebwa. Naye temulaba nti mwagala okulokolebwa? Mukyawa ekibi ekibanyaze. Mukirwanyisa. Mukikuuma. Oboolyawo temuwangulwa mirundi mingi nga bwe kyali edda. Abantu tebategeera nga bwe balina ebbanja eri amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu agakkiriza n’agaziyiza, agabayamba mu bunafu bwabwe ne kaakati, agabasobozesa okusala omukono ogwa ddyo n’okuggyamu eriiso erya ddyo, era agabaleeta mu mbeera y’okulindirira mu maaso ga Katonda, nga Koluneriyo n’omulaawe. Abamu ku mmwe, abawuliriza bange, munoonya Katonda. Mwegomba okununulibwa era mulwanyisa ekibi. Twala ekyokulabirako ekirala. Sitegeeza nti emmeeme erina amaanyi okwelokola mu bwonoonefu bwayo obw’omunda. Ekyo Yesu Kristo ky’awa bw’alokola. Naye lowooza kino: wano waliwo omusajja atamiira. Mutamiivu. Olwo n’akkirizibwa ku kibi. Omwoyo gwa Katonda amugamba nti, “Onooleka ekikopo?” Olwo okulwana ne kutandika. Kale, omusajja oyo ayigirizibwe okweyongera okunywa n’okusuubira buggolokofu nti Katonda anaamulokola? Munaamugambanga nti, “Toleka mwenge; kkiriza kyokka Mukama Yesu Kristo olokolebwe”? Oba munaamugambanga nti, “Oteekwa okuggyawo ekibi kyo. Sala omukono ogwo ogwa ddyo. Ggyamu eriiso eryo erya ddyo. Vaako omwenge ogwo emirembe gyonna mu mutima gwo, mu kigendererwa kyo, ne mu buyinza bwo. Okutuusa lw’onookikola, toyinza kukkiriza mu mazima Mukama Yesu”? Wano waliwo omuntu omulala atamanyiira kulimba. Bw’akkirizibwa ku kibi, atandika okukuuma emimwa gye aleme okwonoona n’akamwa ke. Awangula mu kigero ekimu, oba, mu butuufu, Omwoyo Omutukuvu amuyamba okuwangula, aleme kulimba nga bwe yakolanga edda. Akyafirwa oluusi kubanga tannafuna maanyi gonna ku kyo, naye amaliridde nnyo, era ku ludda lw’obuyinza bwe, asala ekibi kino eky’ebweru era alinda mu buwulize okununulibwa n’obulokozi obujjuvu. Waliwo n’omuweereza atera okubba mu ssanduuko y’ensimbi za mukama we. Agenda mu nkuŋŋaana y’eddiini n’akkirizibwa ku kibi. Olwo Omwoyo gwa Katonda agamba nti, “Oteekwa okulekera awo obubbi obwo. Toyinza kujja mu nkuŋŋaana eno buli kiro, ng’ogamba nti oyagala obulokozi, ng’ate buli lunaku oyongera okubba ku mukama wo. Oteekwa okusala omukono ogwo ogwa ddyo. Leka obubbi obwo. Malirira okuzzaawo bye wabba, era linda mu maaso gange nga bw’oleeta ebibala ebisaanira okwenenya.” Mulaba kye ntegeeza. Abamu ku mmwe muli mu mbeera eyo ddala—mukimanyi. Ka kibe kibi kya mpisa ki ekibanyaze, ensonga y’emu. Yesu Kristo ayagala mulekeere awo empisa eyo mu buyinza bwammwe, mu kumalirira, ne mu kigendererwa kyammwe. Temulina maanyi kwelokola mu kyo. Muyinza okulwana, ng’abamu ku mmwe bwe mugamba nga mukola, naye era kibawangula. Amanyi byonna ebyo. Naye era asiima okulwana, okufuba, okutunula, n’okumalirira. Bw’anaabalokola, anaabawa amaanyi, olwo muliyimirira mu kifo ky’okugwa, kubanga ye yennyini y’anaabawanirira. Kaakati mumanyi nti mutuuse wano. Mumanyi nti singa mubadde n’amaanyi kaakati gennyini okuzikiriza ddala obuyinza bw’empisa eyo embi ku bulamu bwammwe emirembe gyonna, mwandikikoze awatali kulwawo. Mugamba nti, “Woowe weewaawo, nandikikoze. Singa mbadde n’amaanyi.” Okwo kwe kwenenya. Okwo kwe kwenenya okwa mazima. Ky’otosobola kwekolera, Kristo akusanga we oli n’agamba nti, “Nnaakikola ku lulwo. Nnaamenya amaanyi g’empisa eyo. Nnaakuwonya mu mukono gw’omulabe. Nnaakuggya mu buddu obwo. Kkiriza mu nze kyokka, nange nnaakuyimusa. Nnaakujjuza Omwoyo gwange. Onooyimirira mu nze era ku bwange, era ky’okola kaakati ng’ofuba okwekolera, nnaakikola ku lulwo.” Kale mutuuse wano—nti mukyawa ekibi? “Weewaawo, nkyawa.” Mukiwandiise mu bbaluwa zammwe gye ndi, era abalala bakigamba abatawandiika. “Weewaawo,” mugamba, “njagala okulokolebwa mu kyo. Singa nsobola okwelokola mu kibi kaakati gennyini ne siddayo kwonoona, nandikikoze.” Mwandikikoze? Ekyo si kwenenya? Kyandibadde ki ekirala? Ka twogere nti wali n’omwana omujeemu era ateegondera. Yali abeera ng’awakanya obuyinza bwo, ng’ayonoona ensimbi zo, era ng’alinnyirira ebiragiro byo. Olwo ka twogere nti ajja okulaba obukyamu bw’amakubo ge. Oboolyawo okubonaabona kwe kwazibula amaaso ge. Oboolyawo obwavu bwe bwakikola. Oboolyawo kyali kirala. Wabula, akiraba. Akomawo eka n’agamba nti: “Kitange, musirusiru ki bwe mbadde. Mubi ki bwe mbadde. Kaakati ndaba byonna. Saabirabanga nga mbikola. Ndaba amakubo gange ag’ekibi, ebibi ebyakuleetera ennaku ne bireeta obuyinike mu bulamu bwo. Woowe, byonna mbikyawa nnyo. Nneenenya mu nfuufu ne mu vvu. Kitange, byonna mbivaako. Nkomawo gy’oli.” Wandigambye ki? Wandigambye nti, “Mwana wange, tonnenenya bimala. Genda okomewo ng’owulira ennaku esingawo”? Nedda. Omutima gwa kitaawo gwandigolodde n’okwagala n’okusonyiwa. Wandimuwambaatidde n’omwaniriza eka. “Bwe ntyo, mbagamba nti, waliwo essanyu mu maaso ga bamalayika ba Katonda olw’omwonoonyi omu eyeenenya” (Lukka 15:10). Wandibaddewo essanyu mu maka ago olw’okudda kw’omwana eyabula. Naye ka twogere nti omwana yagamba nti: “Kitange, nneenenya ddala era nvaako ebibi byange, naye waliwo bannange abayinza okuddamu okunkyusa, era waliwo empisa ez’amaanyi ennyo n’okuba nti ntya nti ziyinza okumpangula. Ka mbeere kumpi naawe. Njetaaga amaanyi go.” Wandigambye ki? Toyinza kuddamu nti: “Kale yingira, mwana wange. Sigala nange, nange nnaakukuuma. Nnaakuyamba. Toligenda wekka. Nnaabeera naawe ne nkuwanirira”? Nga omuntu yenna omuzadde bw’ayinza okukuuma omulala, wandikuumye mwana wo. Teyandibuliddwako kusaasira kwo wadde obuyambi bwo, emisana n’ekiro. Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu tabuliddwako kusaasira wadde amaanyi. Eriiso lye teryebaka. Omukono gwe tegukoowa. Weetaaga bwokka okuleeta obunafu bwo obutalina maanyi eri amaanyi ge amasukkulumu ng’oyita mu kikolwa kino eky’okukkiriza, era anaakuwanirira, wadde ekibinja kya baddayimooni bwe kikwetooloola. Eky’enkomerero, ovaako ebibi byo—kwe kugamba, mu buyinza bwo, mu kigendererwa kyo, ne mu kumalirira kwo. Ogamba nti, “Sijja kuddamu kumunakuwaza.” Okiyimba, era okimanyi mu mazima. “Sijja kwagala kumunakuwaza nate.” Singa osobola okubeera awatali kumunakuwaza, wandibalidde buli kiweebwayo nga kya muganyulo. Ekyo si kwenenya? Okimanyi nti kwe kuli. Ovaako ekibi. Toyogera nti, “Mukama Yesu, ndokola nga nkyakwata ku mukono guno ogwa ddyo n’eriiso lino erya ddyo. Ndokola nga nkyanywerera ku bintu bino ebiziyiziddwa.” Nedda. Ogamba nti, “Mukama Yesu, ndokola mu byo. Nnongoosa.” Okwo kwe kwenenya. Olaba ekibi. Okyawa ekibi. Ovaako ekibi. Kale nno, kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Woowe, Mwoyo Omutukuvu, bikkula ekkubo eryangu ery’okukkiriza. Obuuza nti, “Nnaakkiriza ntya?” Emmeeme eteganyizibbwa yali ennyimbuuza ekibuuzo kino mu nnukuta ennene: “Nnaakkiriza ntya?” Omugole akkiriza atya bba ng’eweeyo gy’ali ku kyoto ky’obufumbo? Yeewaayo gy’ali. Amukkiriza. Ayingira naye mu ndagaano, olwo n’addayo eka n’abeera ng’endagaano eyo bwe ya mazima. Okwo kwe kukkiriza. Okwo kwe kukkiriza. Omusawo omwesiga otya ng’olwadde ng’ogalamidde ku kitanda kyo, oba mu mirembe oba mu kubonaabona? Oteeka embeera yo mu mikono gye. Weewaayo mu buyambi bwe. Weesiga obukugu bwe era ogoberera ebiragiro bye. Beera n’okukkiriza okufaanana kuno mu Yesu Kristo. Mwesige era omugondere, era osuubire nti kirikubeerera ng’Ekigambo kye bwe kiri. Wabula, okukkiriza kw’abantu bangi kufaanana ng’okw’omuntu alwadde obulwadde obw’amaanyi. Mukwano gwe amubuulira ku musawo ow’ekitalo eyawonya abantu ebikumi mu mbeera ezifaanana, era n’awa obujulizi obungi nti omusawo asobola era ayagala okumuwonya, singa yeeteeka wansi w’obuyambi bwe. Omulwadde ayinza okukkiriza ddala obujulizi bwa mukwano gwe ku musawo, naye olw’ensonga eteeyoleka, agaana okweteeka mu mukono gwe. Abantu bangi bakwata Yesu Kristo mu ngeri y’emu. Bakkiriza nti asobola okuwonya obulwadde bw’ekibi ku mbeera ze yateekawo. Bakkiriza nti tasosola. Bakkiriza nti awonyezza ebikumi abaali baboonoonyi nga bo bwe bali. Naye olw’ensonga emu, tebamwesiga. Beekuuma. Kye weetaaga okukola kwe kuteeka embeera yo mu mikono gye n’ogamba nti: “Mukama Yesu, nzija nga bw’onnyanirizza, nga njatula era nga nvaako ekibi kyange. Singa nsobola, nandikirese emirembe gyonna kaakati gennyini. Omanyi nti nzija nga nkivaako, naye nga sirina maanyi kwelokola mu kyo. Ne kaakati, Mukama Yesu, ogambye nti, ‘Oyo ajja gye ndi sirimugoba bweru n’akatono’” (Yokaana 6:37). “Nzija ddala. Toŋŋoba bweru. Onnyaniriza. Kitange ow’omu ggulu ow’omukisa, neewaayo gy’oli. Nteeka ebibi byange ku ssaddaaka y’Omwana wo. Ogambye nti onnyaniriza era onsonyiwa ku lulwe. Kaakati mpalula omugugu gwange ogw’omusango ne ngussa ku ye, era nzikiriza ekisuubizo kyo. Nkwesiga okuba omwesigwa eri Ekigambo kyo.” Okwo kwe kukkiriza. “Naye,” omukyala omwagalwa n’agamba, “sikuwulira.” Nedda. Oteekwa okusooka okwesiga. Weetegereze bulungi: tosaana kusooka kukkiriza nti olokoledwa, wabula okukkiriza nti akulokola kaakati ng’ekisuubizo kye bwe kiri. “Byonna bye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nti mubifunye, binaabaawo gye muli” (Makko 11:24). Eyo ye nteekateeka y’okukkiriza. Kkiriza nti ofuna nga tonnawulira. Bw’onoofuna, olwo onoowulira. Katonda anaaba wa mazima, era buli muntu oba dayimooni yenna amuwakanya anaazuulibwa nga mulimba. Zingiza emikono gyo ku Oyo eyakomererwa. Kwata omukono gw’Omwana wa Katonda. Leeta emmeeme yo ey’omusango ku bigere by’omusaalaba gwe n’ogamba nti: “Onnyaniriza. Onsonyiwa. Onnongoosa. Ondokola.” Weeyongere okwogera olulimi olw’okukkiriza. Ndabye emmeeme nnyingi nga ziyingira mu ddembe nga ziddiŋŋana ebigambo bino eby’omuwendo mu bwannannyini: “Yafumitibwa olw’ebyonoono byange; yabetentebwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwange; ekibonerezo ekyandeetera emirembe kyali ku ye, era olw’ebiwundu bye nawonyezebwa” (Isaaya 53:5). Weeyongere okwogera olulimi olw’okukkiriza ekkubo lyonna eddayo eka ekiro kino. Yingira mu kisenge kyo ogambe nti: “Nnamalirira okulokolebwa, obanga obulokozi bunnaaweebwa ddala.” Malirira nti bw’oba oyagala okuzikirira, olizikiririra awo ku bigere by’omusaalaba, ng’osaba okusaasirwa. Naye toolizikirire, kubanga asuubizza okusaasira abo abajja. Sirabangako mmeeme kutuuka ku kifo kino ne buteera bwangu kufuna bulokozi. Yingira mu lyato ery’okulokoka. Leka emabega ekyombo ky’obutuukirivu bwo n’ebikolwa byo. Yingira ddala mu lyato ery’okulokoka ery’essaddaaka ya Kristo. Nywerera ku ye, era malirira obutamuleka n’akatono okutuusa Omwoyo lw’anaawa obujulizi mu mmeeme yo, ng’akaaba nti, “Abba! Kitaffe!” (Abaruumi 8:15), era ng’omanyi n’obukakafu nti oviiddemu okufa n’oyingira mu bulamu (Yokaana 5:24). Mukama akuyambe. Amiina.

fields.title: Okwagala
fields.body_html:
“Kale kaakano okukkiriza, essuubi, n’okwagala, ebintu bino ebisatu bibeerawo; naye ekisinga mu ebyo kwe kwagala.” — 1 Abakkolinso 13:13 Kiteekwa okuba ekintu eky’omuwendo omungi okuba ekikira okukkiriza n’okusinga essuubi—kiteekwa okuba eky’omuwendo ddala! Era ng’ebintu bwe biba eby’omuwendo era eby’obugagga mu bantu, bwe batyo abantu bwe banaakozesa amaanyi n’okwewaayo mu kabi okubikoppa mu bulimba.

Ndowooza nti mu nsi eno ejjudde obukuusa, tewali kitundu kya bukuusa awaayibwa obudde bungi n’amagezi amangi okusinga mu kukola ssente ez’obulimba, naddala ebbaluwa z’ensimbi. Nga abantu ababi bwe bagezaako okukoppa ebintu eby’omuwendo ennyo ebikolebwa n’obukugu bw’abantu olw’okwefunira, bw’atyo Setaani bw’abadde agezaako okuva ku lubereberye okukoppa mu bulimba ebintu bya Katonda eby’omuwendo ennyo n’akola ekintu ekifaanana nnyo ne kiba nti abantu awamu tebayinza kwawula njawulo. Oboolyawo tewali kitundu mw’asinze okuwangula okukira mu kukola okwagala okw’obulimba. Ka mbeeko nga ndowooza nti akutuukirizza ddala mu nnaku zino. Sirowooza nti ayinza kweyongera nnyo ku kukoppa kuno okuliwo kaakano.

Okwagala kuno—okwagala kuno—kye kyobugagga kya Katonda ekisinga omuwendo. Kimwagalibwa mu mutima gwe okusinga ensi ze zonna ennene ez’obwengula—okusinga ebitonde byonna eby’ekitiibwa bye yatonda. N’okutuusa nti abamu ku myoyo egisinga waggulu mu bibinja bya bamalayika bwe baamenya okwagala kuno, yabasuula okuva mu ggulu erisinga waggulu okubatuusa mu ggeyeena erisinga wansi.

Lwaki?

Si lwa kubanga teyassaamu mwagalo bitonde ebyo eby’ekitalo, wabula lwa kubanga yassa ekitiibwa mu kwagala kuno okusinga. Yalaba nga kya mugaso nnyo eri obulamu obulungi obw’obwengula bwe okukuuma emirembe egy’okwagala mu ggulu okusinga okulekawo emyoyo egyo egyakkiriza obwerowoozi okugyonoona.

Kale Mukama waffe agamba nti: “Nalaba Setaani ng’agwa okuva mu ggulu ng’okumyansa kw’eraddu.” (Lukka 10:18) Olunaku lujja lw’aliraba n’ebibi byonna ebiva mu bujeemu obwo obwasooka nga bigwa. Yanguyako olunaku olwo olw’ekitiibwa!

Naye ka twekenneenye akaseera katono okwagala kuno okw’omuwendo era okulungi. Ka tusooke okugezaako okukunnyonnyola.

Kwe ki?

Ekisooka: Kwa Bukatonda Kiteekwa okufukibwa mu mutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Tunoonya bwereere ekimera kino eky’omu ggulu mu bantu abatazzeemu buggya. Tekimera mu ttaka eryonoonese ery’obuntu. Kimeruka kwokka we waliwo ekyuma eky’okulima eky’okwenenya okw’amazima ekimenye ettaka eggumu ery’omutima, we okukkiriza mu Mulokozi eyakomererwa kutukuzza, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu ow’omukisa we yeetwalidde ddala okubeera.

Kwe kwagala kwa Katonda—si kwagala kwa Katonda kwokka, wabula okwagala okufaanana nga Katonda, okuva eri Katonda, era okunuŋŋamizibwa eri ebigendererwa n’ebintu bye byebimu Katonda by’ayagala.

Mulimu gwa Bukatonda ogusimbibwa mu mutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Oboolyawo abamu ku mmwe mugamba nti, “Kale nga tekigasa kugezaako kukulima, kubanga sirina kwo.”

Bwe kityo ddala.

Oyinza okusala, okusaawa, n’okufukirira emirembe gyonna, naye toyinza n’akatono kulima kintu ekitasimbibwanga.

Kye weetaaga okusooka kwe kufukibwa okwagala kuno mu mutima gwo.

Ekimu ku nsobi ennene ez’omulembe guno kwe kukkiriza nti obuntu bwetaaga kusaawibwa, kulongoosebwa, n’okukulaakulanyizibwa kwokka, ne bwe biryoka bituukira ku bulungi.

Nedda, nedda!

“Buli kimera Kitange ali mu ggulu ky’atasimba kirisiguukululwa.” (Matayo 15:13) Bw’oba oyagala okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda, oteekwa okumenya ettaka lyo ery’omutima eritalimibwa era oyite Omulimi ow’omu ggulu ajje akusigemu—akufukemu mu mwoyo gwo.

Eky’okubiri: Kwe Kuteeka kwa Bukatonda Njagala mutegeere nti okwagala kuno kwe kuteeka kwa Bukatonda, okwawukana ku kwagala okwa buzaaliranwa obwereere.

Abantu bonna balina okwagala ng’ekintu eky’obuzaaliranwa. Baagala mu buzaaliranwa abo be baagala oba abo ababakola obulungi.

“Kubanga bwe mwagala abo ababaagala, mufuna mpeera ki? Abasolooza b’omusolo abo tebakola bwe batyo bo bennyini?” (Matayo 5:46) Abantu ababi baagalana olw’okwagala okw’obuzaaliranwa, nga engo bw’eyagala abaana baayo.

Waliwo obutabanguko bungi mu bantu ab’eddiini ku nsonga eno. Bawulira okusaasira n’okugaba eri bannaabwe abantu, era bayinza n’okugaba ebintu byabwe okuliisa abaavu, so nga tebalina n’akasasi k’okwagala okwa Bukatonda mu mitima gyabwe.

Sawulo, oluvannyuma lwa Katonda okumuvaako, teyabeera awatali nkumbuliro z’okugaba eri ab’omu maka ge n’obwakabaka bwe.

Omugagga eyali mu ggeyeena yalina okufaayo okumu ku baganda be.

Naye tewali n’omu ku bo eyalina akasasi k’okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda.

Weegendereze oleme okulimbibwa. Obukadde n’obukadde balimbibwa.

Ka twekenneenye ensonga emu oba bbiri gye okwagala okw’obulimba n’okwagala okwa Bukatonda gye byawukaniramu ddala era emirembe gyonna mu ngeri yaabyo.

Ekisooka: Okwagala okw’obulimba Kw’okwefaako Wekka Okwagala okw’obulimba kw’okwefaako wekka. Tekukolebwa okuggyako okumatiza ekigendererwa eky’okwefaako wekka ekiri mu buntu. Ebigendererwa enkumi n’enkumi biyinza okukusiikiriza—bingi nnyo okuwandiika—naye tujja kwekenneenya bibiri oba bisatu.

Tusoma mu ssuula eno nti omuntu ayinza okugaba ebintu bye byonna okuliisa abaavu n’okuwaayo n’omubiri gwe okubonaabona, so nga akyali awatali kwagala kwa mazima.

Nga kye kirowoozo eky’ekyewuunyo!

Kyokka waliwo ebyokulabirako bingi ebiraga nti ekintu ekyo kisoboka.

Ekisooka, omuntu ayinza okukola ebintu bino okuwagira n’okutumbula enkola y’enzikiriza gy’ayagala gy’eyeewaddeyo. Nga abantu bwe beeyingiza mu by’obufuzi oba mu ekyo kye balowooza okuba obulungi bw’eggwanga lyabwe, bayinza n’okuba abeetegefu okwolekagana n’akabi akanene basobole okutuusa ekigendererwa kyabwe.

Ate n’ekirala, omuntu ayinza okukola ebintu ng’ebyo mu kufuba okufuna obulamu obutaggwaawo. Pawulo yakola bw’atyo bwe yanoonya okunyweza obutuukirivu bwe ye. Oluvannyuma atugamba nti okwefaako yekka kwe kwali ensibuko eyavuganya obunyiikivu bwe bwonna. Byonna byali lwa kutumbula ye yennyini. Temwali kwagala kwa Bukatonda mu ebyo. Mu kiseera ekyo yali tannazzibwamu buggya, awatali Kristo, era ng’eyeefaako yekka, ne bwe yali akola ebintu ebyo.

Oba, eky’okusatu, omuntu ayinza okukola kokka okumatiza empisa ye ey’obugabi obw’obuzaaliranwa.

Nnali njogera eri mukwano gwange omugabi, bwe yayogeranga mu kyama ku kugaba kwe n’essanyu kwe lyamuleeteranga, ng’akwaliza ekisa kya Katonda kyokka, nti, “Linda, munnange. Sikakasa nti kyonna kisa. Osanyukira okugaba okusinga abamu abantu bwe basanyukira okuweebwa. Weegendereze oleme okufiirwa empeera yo olw’obutakebera gy’ebirabo byo gye bigenda. Tossaanga ssente zo mu buli nsonga ejja. Jjukira nti ovunaanyizibwa eri Katonda ku by’obugagga byo, era nti Katonda alyebuuza ku ngeri gy’obikozesezza.”

Okwagala okw’amazima kwewaayo ekiseera okukebera obwetaavu obw’enjawulo era kunoonya emikisa emirungi egy’okugaba olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’olw’obulokozi bw’abantu.

Toyanguyiriza kwaliza bugabi bwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe buba nga si bwa ngeri eyo, kubanga tojja kufuna mpeera ku bwo, oba mu bulamu buno oba mu bulamu obw’omu maaso.

Okwagala okw’obulimba kutandikira ku kwefaako wekka ne kukoma ku nsi.

Wano waliwo engeri emu ey’okukwawulamu ku kwagala kwa Katonda.

Okwagala kwa Setaani kweyongera okussa essira ku ludda olw’ensi olw’abantu ne kussaako essira ttono ku ludda olw’omwoyo. Mu nsonga eno kyolekagana butereevu n’okwagala okwa Bukatonda, okutunuulira abantu ng’ebitonde ebituukiridde era bulijjo kussa essira erisooka ku mwoyo.

Tulaba ebikolwa by’ekisa eby’obulimba bingi mu nnaku zino.

Olulala nnaddira ekitabo ekiyitibwa eky’eddiini ne nsoma ettendo eddungi lye kyawa omuntu omu eyali yaakafa. Ne neebuuza mu mutima gwange nti, waliwo omuntu ayinza okulowooza nti kino kyali kitabo kya Kikristaayo mu nsi ey’Ekikristaayo?

Tewaali na katono kutegeera mwoyo. Tewaali kwogera ku mbeera ye ey’omwoyo oba ekifo kye eky’emirembe n’emirembe. Empisa emu oba bbiri eza bulijjo ez’obuntu zaggyibwa mu lujjudde ne zitenderezebwa okutuusa lwe yalabika ng’ekintu eky’ekitalo. Naye tewaali kwogera ku mwoyo, tewaali kwogera ku Katonda alimusalira omusango, so tewaali kwogera ku ggulu oba ku ggeyeena.

Abantu batera okugamba, nga boogera ku bantu abatatya Katonda oba n’ababi, nti, “Oteekwa okuba ow’ekisa. Toteekwa kusala musango.”

Setaani tafaayo ku muwendo gw’okwagala kuno okw’oluuyi olumu bwe kuli. Gye kweyongera obungi, gye kusingira okuweereza ekigendererwa kye. Kufuula abantu okubeera mu mirembe mu bibi byabwe era kuyamba okubakulembera mangu eri okuzikirira.

Bannange, mufaayo nnyo ku kuwewula okubonaabona okw’ekiseera okusinga bwe mufaayo ku kuliisa emyoyo egirumwa enjala? Bwe muba mufaayo bwe mutyo, muyinza okumanya okwagala kwammwe gye kuva! Temumpotoola, ne mugamba nti njigiriza kimu kyokka, so si kirala. Kikafuuwe, kubanga omuntu yenna “bw’aba n’eby’ensi eno, n’alaba muganda we ng’ali mu bwetaavu, n’amuggalirawo embuto ze ez’okusaasira, okwagala kwa Katonda kuli ludda wa mu ye?” Naye ku luuyi olulala, bw’aba amulaba ng’alumwa enjala mu mwoyo—ng’afa olw’okubulwa emmere ey’obulamu—okwagala kwa Kristo kuli ludda wa mu ye, bw’aba nga taweereza mu bwavu buno obw’omwoyo? Mmanyi nti Obukristaayo obw’amazima bufaayo ku mubiri n’omwoyo. Katonda yeebazibwe, bukola bwe kityo; naye, bulijjo mujjukire nti bussa omwoyo KUMAASO. Mmanyi nti Mukama yaliisa ekibiina; naye, nga tekinnaba, yamala nabo ennaku ssatu, ng’agezaako okulokola emyoyo gyabwe, era bwe baalumwa enjala mu kukola ekyo, n’alyoka abatuuza wansi, n’aliisa emibiri gyabwe. Bulijjo yasooka kufaayo ku mwoyo, era bwe kityo bwe kiri eri buli muntu alina okwagala okwa Bukatonda.

Lwaki? Kubanga okwagala okwa Bukatonda kumuzibudde amaaso. Ategeera omuwendo gw’emyoyo. Agiraba nga girumwa enjala. Agiraba nga gizikirizibwa, so tayinza kwekakkanya. Okwegomba kwe okugirokola kumufubutukamu ng’omugga ogwanjaala; agitunuulira, n’agisaasira. Gezesa okwagala kwo n’akabonero kano: Olowooza ku myoyo egya banno abantu egifa, egirumwa enjala, egiri ekitundu ky’okuzikirira? Otunuulira embeera y’ensi, n’embeera y’ekkanisa? Okirowoozako? Oyingira mu kasenge ko, n’okyanjuluza mu maaso ga Mukama, nga Keezeekiya ne Yeremiya ne Koseya bwe baakola? Okitunuulira, n’okivuunika, n’okikaabira, n’osaba n’okaaba, nga Danyeeri ne Pawulo bwe baakola? Mwegezese, baganda bange, bannyinaze, n’akabonero kano.

Okwagala okwa Bukatonda bulijjo kwessimba ku kibuuzo ekyo ekinene eky’okwagala okutaliiko kkomo: Matayo 16:26: “Kubanga omuntu kimugasa ki bw’aliba afunye ensi yonna, n’afiirwa emmeeme ye?

Oba omuntu aliwaayo ki mu kifo ky’emmeeme ye?”

Woowe, siyinza kukiggya mu matu gange oba okukiggya ku mutima gwange! Nga ndaba bulungi obwereere n’obutaliimu bwa buli kintu bwe bugeraageranyizibwa n’obulokozi bw’omwoyo! Kigasa ki omuntu okufiira mu nnyumba y’abaavu—oba okufiira ku mulyango, ng’abikkiddwa ebiwundu nga Laazaalo—kigasa ki singa omwoyo gwe gulokolebwa? Kwe kukkiriza kwo nga bwe kuli okwange nti omwoyo tegufa, era nti okufa kw’omubiri kwe kuyingira kwokka, bwe guba gulokoddwa, mu bulamu obw’omu maaso obw’ekitiibwa obw’essanyu, obw’enkulaakulana, n’obutukuvu obutaggwaawo.

Omwana ajjukira bw’aakaabiranga essomo lye bw’afuuka omusajja omukulu? Afumiitiriza ku buzibu bwonna obutono obw’ennaku ze ez’essomero bw’aba anyumirwa emigaso gye zaamuleetera? Mu ngeri y’emu, okubonaabona kwaffe kwonna, okugezesebwa, n’ennaku yaffe wano bijja kulabika ng’ebitali bya mugaso nnyo bwe tulokola emyoyo gyaffe ne tuyamba okulokola emyoyo gy’abalala.

Okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda kufuula buli kintu ekirala okuweereza obulokozi bw’emyoyo; kukozesa buli kintu ekirala okulokola n’okuwa omukisa omuntu ow’omunda era ow’omwoyo. Ojjukira omukolo Mukama lwe yaliisa ebibiina, era bwe baamujjira nate okuliisibwa, n’agamba nti: “Mazima, mazima, mbagamba nti, munnoonya, si lwa kubanga mwalaba obubonero, wabula lwa kubanga mwalya emigaati ne mukkuta.” Yokaana 6:26 Wanditegedde nti, “Kirungi ddala; abantu baagala mmere; balumwa enjala.” Naye owulira ennaku ya Bukatonda eyoleseddwa mu bigambo bino—nti baali baayongoberedde mu mwoyo nnyo ne bassa omuwendo ku mmere ey’ensi okusinga emmere ey’omu ggulu? Wa abantu emmere ey’omubiri nga bw’osobola, naye kakasa nti obasooka kuwa mmere ya mwoyo, kubanga kano kabonero k’okwagala okw’amazima.

Olina okwagala kuno? Buli mwoyo gumanyi oba gulina oba nedda. Abantu batera okuba abatategeera mu nsonga z’eddiini; boogera ku butamanya. Naye oyinza okuzuula mu ddakiika bbiri oba oyagala Katonda oba weeyagala wekka okusinga. Ompi nti omukazi tamanyi oba ayagala bba oba yeeyagala yekka okusinga! Kya busirusiru! Obukakafu kye ki? Anoonya okumusanyusa era yeetegese okwewaayo ku lulwe; mu butuufu, afuula ebimwegomba okuba ebibye ye.

Oyagala Katonda okusinga byonna? Weetegese okuvaako ebibyo ebikwegomba n’onoonya ebibye? Olina okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda, okuzaalibwa okuva mu Ggulu era okutuusa mu Ggulu? Bw’oba tolina, munnange, malirira nti onookufuna kaakano. Tandika okukaabirira Katonda n’omutima gwo gwonna Omwoyo Omutukuvu akufukemu mu mutima gwo. Leka empaka zo n’ebigambo byo eby’okwewolereza, ojje ku kigere ky’omusaalaba omusabe nti, “Jjangu, Mukama, menya omutima guno ogwange omwavu, ogw’ekibi, ofukemu okwagala kuno okulungi, okutukuvu, okwa Bukatonda.” Olwo toliddayo kunoonya bibyo byokka ebikwegomba, wabula ebintu ebya Yesu Kristo.
fields.body_text: “Kale kaakano okukkiriza, essuubi, n’okwagala, ebintu bino ebisatu bibeerawo; naye ekisinga mu ebyo kwe kwagala.” — 1 Abakkolinso 13:13 Kiteekwa okuba ekintu eky’omuwendo omungi okuba ekikira okukkiriza n’okusinga essuubi—kiteekwa okuba eky’omuwendo ddala! Era ng’ebintu bwe biba eby’omuwendo era eby’obugagga mu bantu, bwe batyo abantu bwe banaakozesa amaanyi n’okwewaayo mu kabi okubikoppa mu bulimba. Ndowooza nti mu nsi eno ejjudde obukuusa, tewali kitundu kya bukuusa awaayibwa obudde bungi n’amagezi amangi okusinga mu kukola ssente ez’obulimba, naddala ebbaluwa z’ensimbi. Nga abantu ababi bwe bagezaako okukoppa ebintu eby’omuwendo ennyo ebikolebwa n’obukugu bw’abantu olw’okwefunira, bw’atyo Setaani bw’abadde agezaako okuva ku lubereberye okukoppa mu bulimba ebintu bya Katonda eby’omuwendo ennyo n’akola ekintu ekifaanana nnyo ne kiba nti abantu awamu tebayinza kwawula njawulo. Oboolyawo tewali kitundu mw’asinze okuwangula okukira mu kukola okwagala okw’obulimba. Ka mbeeko nga ndowooza nti akutuukirizza ddala mu nnaku zino. Sirowooza nti ayinza kweyongera nnyo ku kukoppa kuno okuliwo kaakano. Okwagala kuno—okwagala kuno—kye kyobugagga kya Katonda ekisinga omuwendo. Kimwagalibwa mu mutima gwe okusinga ensi ze zonna ennene ez’obwengula—okusinga ebitonde byonna eby’ekitiibwa bye yatonda. N’okutuusa nti abamu ku myoyo egisinga waggulu mu bibinja bya bamalayika bwe baamenya okwagala kuno, yabasuula okuva mu ggulu erisinga waggulu okubatuusa mu ggeyeena erisinga wansi. Lwaki? Si lwa kubanga teyassaamu mwagalo bitonde ebyo eby’ekitalo, wabula lwa kubanga yassa ekitiibwa mu kwagala kuno okusinga. Yalaba nga kya mugaso nnyo eri obulamu obulungi obw’obwengula bwe okukuuma emirembe egy’okwagala mu ggulu okusinga okulekawo emyoyo egyo egyakkiriza obwerowoozi okugyonoona. Kale Mukama waffe agamba nti: “Nalaba Setaani ng’agwa okuva mu ggulu ng’okumyansa kw’eraddu.” (Lukka 10:18) Olunaku lujja lw’aliraba n’ebibi byonna ebiva mu bujeemu obwo obwasooka nga bigwa. Yanguyako olunaku olwo olw’ekitiibwa! Naye ka twekenneenye akaseera katono okwagala kuno okw’omuwendo era okulungi. Ka tusooke okugezaako okukunnyonnyola. Kwe ki? Ekisooka: Kwa Bukatonda Kiteekwa okufukibwa mu mutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tunoonya bwereere ekimera kino eky’omu ggulu mu bantu abatazzeemu buggya. Tekimera mu ttaka eryonoonese ery’obuntu. Kimeruka kwokka we waliwo ekyuma eky’okulima eky’okwenenya okw’amazima ekimenye ettaka eggumu ery’omutima, we okukkiriza mu Mulokozi eyakomererwa kutukuzza, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu ow’omukisa we yeetwalidde ddala okubeera. Kwe kwagala kwa Katonda—si kwagala kwa Katonda kwokka, wabula okwagala okufaanana nga Katonda, okuva eri Katonda, era okunuŋŋamizibwa eri ebigendererwa n’ebintu bye byebimu Katonda by’ayagala. Mulimu gwa Bukatonda ogusimbibwa mu mutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Oboolyawo abamu ku mmwe mugamba nti, “Kale nga tekigasa kugezaako kukulima, kubanga sirina kwo.” Bwe kityo ddala. Oyinza okusala, okusaawa, n’okufukirira emirembe gyonna, naye toyinza n’akatono kulima kintu ekitasimbibwanga. Kye weetaaga okusooka kwe kufukibwa okwagala kuno mu mutima gwo. Ekimu ku nsobi ennene ez’omulembe guno kwe kukkiriza nti obuntu bwetaaga kusaawibwa, kulongoosebwa, n’okukulaakulanyizibwa kwokka, ne bwe biryoka bituukira ku bulungi. Nedda, nedda! “Buli kimera Kitange ali mu ggulu ky’atasimba kirisiguukululwa.” (Matayo 15:13) Bw’oba oyagala okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda, oteekwa okumenya ettaka lyo ery’omutima eritalimibwa era oyite Omulimi ow’omu ggulu ajje akusigemu—akufukemu mu mwoyo gwo. Eky’okubiri: Kwe Kuteeka kwa Bukatonda Njagala mutegeere nti okwagala kuno kwe kuteeka kwa Bukatonda, okwawukana ku kwagala okwa buzaaliranwa obwereere. Abantu bonna balina okwagala ng’ekintu eky’obuzaaliranwa. Baagala mu buzaaliranwa abo be baagala oba abo ababakola obulungi. “Kubanga bwe mwagala abo ababaagala, mufuna mpeera ki? Abasolooza b’omusolo abo tebakola bwe batyo bo bennyini?” (Matayo 5:46) Abantu ababi baagalana olw’okwagala okw’obuzaaliranwa, nga engo bw’eyagala abaana baayo. Waliwo obutabanguko bungi mu bantu ab’eddiini ku nsonga eno. Bawulira okusaasira n’okugaba eri bannaabwe abantu, era bayinza n’okugaba ebintu byabwe okuliisa abaavu, so nga tebalina n’akasasi k’okwagala okwa Bukatonda mu mitima gyabwe. Sawulo, oluvannyuma lwa Katonda okumuvaako, teyabeera awatali nkumbuliro z’okugaba eri ab’omu maka ge n’obwakabaka bwe. Omugagga eyali mu ggeyeena yalina okufaayo okumu ku baganda be. Naye tewali n’omu ku bo eyalina akasasi k’okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda. Weegendereze oleme okulimbibwa. Obukadde n’obukadde balimbibwa. Ka twekenneenye ensonga emu oba bbiri gye okwagala okw’obulimba n’okwagala okwa Bukatonda gye byawukaniramu ddala era emirembe gyonna mu ngeri yaabyo. Ekisooka: Okwagala okw’obulimba Kw’okwefaako Wekka Okwagala okw’obulimba kw’okwefaako wekka. Tekukolebwa okuggyako okumatiza ekigendererwa eky’okwefaako wekka ekiri mu buntu. Ebigendererwa enkumi n’enkumi biyinza okukusiikiriza—bingi nnyo okuwandiika—naye tujja kwekenneenya bibiri oba bisatu. Tusoma mu ssuula eno nti omuntu ayinza okugaba ebintu bye byonna okuliisa abaavu n’okuwaayo n’omubiri gwe okubonaabona, so nga akyali awatali kwagala kwa mazima. Nga kye kirowoozo eky’ekyewuunyo! Kyokka waliwo ebyokulabirako bingi ebiraga nti ekintu ekyo kisoboka. Ekisooka, omuntu ayinza okukola ebintu bino okuwagira n’okutumbula enkola y’enzikiriza gy’ayagala gy’eyeewaddeyo. Nga abantu bwe beeyingiza mu by’obufuzi oba mu ekyo kye balowooza okuba obulungi bw’eggwanga lyabwe, bayinza n’okuba abeetegefu okwolekagana n’akabi akanene basobole okutuusa ekigendererwa kyabwe. Ate n’ekirala, omuntu ayinza okukola ebintu ng’ebyo mu kufuba okufuna obulamu obutaggwaawo. Pawulo yakola bw’atyo bwe yanoonya okunyweza obutuukirivu bwe ye. Oluvannyuma atugamba nti okwefaako yekka kwe kwali ensibuko eyavuganya obunyiikivu bwe bwonna. Byonna byali lwa kutumbula ye yennyini. Temwali kwagala kwa Bukatonda mu ebyo. Mu kiseera ekyo yali tannazzibwamu buggya, awatali Kristo, era ng’eyeefaako yekka, ne bwe yali akola ebintu ebyo. Oba, eky’okusatu, omuntu ayinza okukola kokka okumatiza empisa ye ey’obugabi obw’obuzaaliranwa. Nnali njogera eri mukwano gwange omugabi, bwe yayogeranga mu kyama ku kugaba kwe n’essanyu kwe lyamuleeteranga, ng’akwaliza ekisa kya Katonda kyokka, nti, “Linda, munnange. Sikakasa nti kyonna kisa. Osanyukira okugaba okusinga abamu abantu bwe basanyukira okuweebwa. Weegendereze oleme okufiirwa empeera yo olw’obutakebera gy’ebirabo byo gye bigenda. Tossaanga ssente zo mu buli nsonga ejja. Jjukira nti ovunaanyizibwa eri Katonda ku by’obugagga byo, era nti Katonda alyebuuza ku ngeri gy’obikozesezza.” Okwagala okw’amazima kwewaayo ekiseera okukebera obwetaavu obw’enjawulo era kunoonya emikisa emirungi egy’okugaba olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’olw’obulokozi bw’abantu. Toyanguyiriza kwaliza bugabi bwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe buba nga si bwa ngeri eyo, kubanga tojja kufuna mpeera ku bwo, oba mu bulamu buno oba mu bulamu obw’omu maaso. Okwagala okw’obulimba kutandikira ku kwefaako wekka ne kukoma ku nsi. Wano waliwo engeri emu ey’okukwawulamu ku kwagala kwa Katonda. Okwagala kwa Setaani kweyongera okussa essira ku ludda olw’ensi olw’abantu ne kussaako essira ttono ku ludda olw’omwoyo. Mu nsonga eno kyolekagana butereevu n’okwagala okwa Bukatonda, okutunuulira abantu ng’ebitonde ebituukiridde era bulijjo kussa essira erisooka ku mwoyo. Tulaba ebikolwa by’ekisa eby’obulimba bingi mu nnaku zino. Olulala nnaddira ekitabo ekiyitibwa eky’eddiini ne nsoma ettendo eddungi lye kyawa omuntu omu eyali yaakafa. Ne neebuuza mu mutima gwange nti, waliwo omuntu ayinza okulowooza nti kino kyali kitabo kya Kikristaayo mu nsi ey’Ekikristaayo? Tewaali na katono kutegeera mwoyo. Tewaali kwogera ku mbeera ye ey’omwoyo oba ekifo kye eky’emirembe n’emirembe. Empisa emu oba bbiri eza bulijjo ez’obuntu zaggyibwa mu lujjudde ne zitenderezebwa okutuusa lwe yalabika ng’ekintu eky’ekitalo. Naye tewaali kwogera ku mwoyo, tewaali kwogera ku Katonda alimusalira omusango, so tewaali kwogera ku ggulu oba ku ggeyeena. Abantu batera okugamba, nga boogera ku bantu abatatya Katonda oba n’ababi, nti, “Oteekwa okuba ow’ekisa. Toteekwa kusala musango.” Setaani tafaayo ku muwendo gw’okwagala kuno okw’oluuyi olumu bwe kuli. Gye kweyongera obungi, gye kusingira okuweereza ekigendererwa kye. Kufuula abantu okubeera mu mirembe mu bibi byabwe era kuyamba okubakulembera mangu eri okuzikirira. Bannange, mufaayo nnyo ku kuwewula okubonaabona okw’ekiseera okusinga bwe mufaayo ku kuliisa emyoyo egirumwa enjala? Bwe muba mufaayo bwe mutyo, muyinza okumanya okwagala kwammwe gye kuva! Temumpotoola, ne mugamba nti njigiriza kimu kyokka, so si kirala. Kikafuuwe, kubanga omuntu yenna “bw’aba n’eby’ensi eno, n’alaba muganda we ng’ali mu bwetaavu, n’amuggalirawo embuto ze ez’okusaasira, okwagala kwa Katonda kuli ludda wa mu ye?” Naye ku luuyi olulala, bw’aba amulaba ng’alumwa enjala mu mwoyo—ng’afa olw’okubulwa emmere ey’obulamu—okwagala kwa Kristo kuli ludda wa mu ye, bw’aba nga taweereza mu bwavu buno obw’omwoyo? Mmanyi nti Obukristaayo obw’amazima bufaayo ku mubiri n’omwoyo. Katonda yeebazibwe, bukola bwe kityo; naye, bulijjo mujjukire nti bussa omwoyo KUMAASO. Mmanyi nti Mukama yaliisa ekibiina; naye, nga tekinnaba, yamala nabo ennaku ssatu, ng’agezaako okulokola emyoyo gyabwe, era bwe baalumwa enjala mu kukola ekyo, n’alyoka abatuuza wansi, n’aliisa emibiri gyabwe. Bulijjo yasooka kufaayo ku mwoyo, era bwe kityo bwe kiri eri buli muntu alina okwagala okwa Bukatonda. Lwaki? Kubanga okwagala okwa Bukatonda kumuzibudde amaaso. Ategeera omuwendo gw’emyoyo. Agiraba nga girumwa enjala. Agiraba nga gizikirizibwa, so tayinza kwekakkanya. Okwegomba kwe okugirokola kumufubutukamu ng’omugga ogwanjaala; agitunuulira, n’agisaasira. Gezesa okwagala kwo n’akabonero kano: Olowooza ku myoyo egya banno abantu egifa, egirumwa enjala, egiri ekitundu ky’okuzikirira? Otunuulira embeera y’ensi, n’embeera y’ekkanisa? Okirowoozako? Oyingira mu kasenge ko, n’okyanjuluza mu maaso ga Mukama, nga Keezeekiya ne Yeremiya ne Koseya bwe baakola? Okitunuulira, n’okivuunika, n’okikaabira, n’osaba n’okaaba, nga Danyeeri ne Pawulo bwe baakola? Mwegezese, baganda bange, bannyinaze, n’akabonero kano. Okwagala okwa Bukatonda bulijjo kwessimba ku kibuuzo ekyo ekinene eky’okwagala okutaliiko kkomo: Matayo 16:26: “Kubanga omuntu kimugasa ki bw’aliba afunye ensi yonna, n’afiirwa emmeeme ye? Oba omuntu aliwaayo ki mu kifo ky’emmeeme ye?” Woowe, siyinza kukiggya mu matu gange oba okukiggya ku mutima gwange! Nga ndaba bulungi obwereere n’obutaliimu bwa buli kintu bwe bugeraageranyizibwa n’obulokozi bw’omwoyo! Kigasa ki omuntu okufiira mu nnyumba y’abaavu—oba okufiira ku mulyango, ng’abikkiddwa ebiwundu nga Laazaalo—kigasa ki singa omwoyo gwe gulokolebwa? Kwe kukkiriza kwo nga bwe kuli okwange nti omwoyo tegufa, era nti okufa kw’omubiri kwe kuyingira kwokka, bwe guba gulokoddwa, mu bulamu obw’omu maaso obw’ekitiibwa obw’essanyu, obw’enkulaakulana, n’obutukuvu obutaggwaawo. Omwana ajjukira bw’aakaabiranga essomo lye bw’afuuka omusajja omukulu? Afumiitiriza ku buzibu bwonna obutono obw’ennaku ze ez’essomero bw’aba anyumirwa emigaso gye zaamuleetera? Mu ngeri y’emu, okubonaabona kwaffe kwonna, okugezesebwa, n’ennaku yaffe wano bijja kulabika ng’ebitali bya mugaso nnyo bwe tulokola emyoyo gyaffe ne tuyamba okulokola emyoyo gy’abalala. Okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda kufuula buli kintu ekirala okuweereza obulokozi bw’emyoyo; kukozesa buli kintu ekirala okulokola n’okuwa omukisa omuntu ow’omunda era ow’omwoyo. Ojjukira omukolo Mukama lwe yaliisa ebibiina, era bwe baamujjira nate okuliisibwa, n’agamba nti: “Mazima, mazima, mbagamba nti, munnoonya, si lwa kubanga mwalaba obubonero, wabula lwa kubanga mwalya emigaati ne mukkuta.” Yokaana 6:26 Wanditegedde nti, “Kirungi ddala; abantu baagala mmere; balumwa enjala.” Naye owulira ennaku ya Bukatonda eyoleseddwa mu bigambo bino—nti baali baayongoberedde mu mwoyo nnyo ne bassa omuwendo ku mmere ey’ensi okusinga emmere ey’omu ggulu? Wa abantu emmere ey’omubiri nga bw’osobola, naye kakasa nti obasooka kuwa mmere ya mwoyo, kubanga kano kabonero k’okwagala okw’amazima. Olina okwagala kuno? Buli mwoyo gumanyi oba gulina oba nedda. Abantu batera okuba abatategeera mu nsonga z’eddiini; boogera ku butamanya. Naye oyinza okuzuula mu ddakiika bbiri oba oyagala Katonda oba weeyagala wekka okusinga. Ompi nti omukazi tamanyi oba ayagala bba oba yeeyagala yekka okusinga! Kya busirusiru! Obukakafu kye ki? Anoonya okumusanyusa era yeetegese okwewaayo ku lulwe; mu butuufu, afuula ebimwegomba okuba ebibye ye. Oyagala Katonda okusinga byonna? Weetegese okuvaako ebibyo ebikwegomba n’onoonya ebibye? Olina okwagala kuno okwa Bukatonda, okuzaalibwa okuva mu Ggulu era okutuusa mu Ggulu? Bw’oba tolina, munnange, malirira nti onookufuna kaakano. Tandika okukaabirira Katonda n’omutima gwo gwonna Omwoyo Omutukuvu akufukemu mu mutima gwo. fields.title: Okwagala n'Okunenya
fields.body_html:
“Kale kaakano okukkiriza, essuubi, n'okwagala bibeerawo, bino ebisatu; naye ekisinga mu bino kwe kwagala.” 1 Abakkolinso 13:13 Enjawulo enkulu ey'okubiri wakati w'okwagala okw'amazima n'okw'obulimba gye twagala okwoleka y'eno: Okwagala okwa Katonda tekukoma ku kukwatagana n'okunenya n'okukangavvula, wabula emirundi mingi kubyetaaga eri abo abakulina. Kufuula omulimu gw'abo abalina okwo okunenya n'okukangavvula buli ekibi — buli ekitaleeta birungi bya waggulu eri omuntu oyo ekikwatako.

Mu kino, nga bwe kiri mu buli kintu ekirala, okwagala kuno kugoberera ekyokulabirako kyakwo ekya Katonda: “Bonna be njagala mbanenya ne mbakangavvula; kale ba nnyiikivu weenenye.” Okubikkulirwa 3:19 Bwe kiba kyetaagisa olw'obulungi bw'omuntu, Katonda anenya era akangavvula. Tanakuwaza wadde okunakuwaza abantu n'akatono, nga kitaawe bw'atayagala kukangavvula mwana ajeema. Naye bw'aba kitaawe ow'amagezi, ajja kukikola kubanga ayagala omwana. Mu ngeri y'emu, omuntu alina okwagala kuno okwa Katonda amaliridde okukangavvula n'okunenya ekibi buli we kisangibwa. Tajja kuleka kibi kubeerawo mu muliraanwa we nga tekivunaanibbwa, wabula alimunenya n'obwesigwa era anaaba anoonya okumutwala eri ekituufu.

Ka tulabe ekyokulabirako ekirungi (kimu ku bingi) eky'okwagala kuno okwa Katonda nga kukola mu mutima ne mu bulamu bw'omutume yennyini eyawandiika 1 Abakkolinso 13. Tetuyinza kukyamira mu kulonda ekyokulabirako kino kubanga kiva eri Pawulo yennyini.

“Naye Keefa bwe yajja e Antiyokiya, namuwakanya nga mmwolekedde, kubanga yali asingiddwa omusango. Kubanga abasajja abamu nga tebannava eri Yakobo, yalyanga wamu n'Abamawanga; naye bwe bajja, ne yeggyako ne yeeyawula, ng'atya ab'ekibiina eky'okukomola. N'Abayudaaya abalala ne bakola eby'obunnanfuusi wamu naye, ne Balunabba n'atwalibwa okukyama olw'obunnanfuusi bwabwe. Naye bwe nalaba nti empisa zaabwe tezaali za magezi ga mazima g'enjiri, ne ŋŋamba Keefa mu maaso gaabwe bonna nti, ‘Oba ggwe, newankubadde ng'oli Muyudaaya, obeera ng'Omumawanga so si ng'Omuyudaaya, oyinza otya okuwaliriza Abamawanga okubeera ng'Abayudaaya?’” Abaggalatiya 2:11–15 Weebale, Pawulo — okwagala okw'ekitiibwa era okw'obuvumu! Teyagenda kwogera mu kaama emabega wa Peetero wadde okumulumba mu kyama.

“Ne ŋŋamba Keefa mu maaso gaabwe bonna...”

Bw'oba oyagala akabonero k'okwagala okw'amazima, kano wano.

Kiteekwa okuba nga kyali kya bulumi bungi nnyo eri Pawulo okunenya Peetero mu lujjudde. Baali baagalana. Mu butuufu, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka, Peetero yayogera ku Pawulo nti: “...owooluganda omwagalwa Pawulo...” 2 Peetero 3:15 Baali beefaako ddala. Pawulo yategeera bye kwetaaga okwagala okw'amazima, kubanga ye yawandiika essuula eno ey'ekkumi n'esatu ey'Abakkolinso. Bwe yali ayagala Peetero, era bwe yali ategeera okwagala okw'amazima, lwaki yamunenya mu lwatu? Lwaki yeeteeka mu bulumi obw'okukikola?

Obwesigwa eri Peetero, obwesigwa eri amazima, n'obwesigwa eri Yesu Kristo kye kyakyetaaga.

Noolwekyo, Pawulo yaggyawo enneewulira ze yennyini n'agumiikiriza obulumi obw'okuwakana mu kifo ky'okuleka Peetero okweyongera mu nsobi, abakkiriza Abamawanga okubuzibwabuzibwa, n'Abayudaaya okusendebwasendebwa endowooza ez'ensi.

Pawulo yanenya Peetero mu lwatu kubanga amazima gaali mu katyabaga. Nga bwe kitera okubaawo, amazima gaali ku ludda lw'abatono. Obuyinza obungi bwali ku ludda lw'ab'ekibiina eky'okukomola. Baali mu bakkiriza abaali n'obuyinza obusinga, kyokka Pawulo yayimirira ng'awakanya obuyinza obwo mu kunenya kwe Peetero.

Lwaki?

Kubanga obwesigwa eri amazima kye kyakyetaaga, era okwagala okwa Katonda kusooka kuba kulongoofu .

Waliwo ekyokulabirako ekisingako obukulu mu Mukama waffe yennyini — Omukama emmeeme ye yonna kye yali kwagala era obulamu bwe kye kyali ekiweebwayo eky'olubeerera olw'obulungi bw'abalala. Kyokka nga yakomyawo n'obwesigwa abagoberezi be bo bennyini bwe baava mu mazima, era nga yayolekera awatali kutya n'anenya obutakwatibwa n'obunnanfuusi bw'abo abeeyita ng'abaagala Katonda ate nga bawakanya okwo mu bulamu bwabwe.

Nga yanenya ekibi awatali kutya buli we yakisanga.

Ku lulala yagamba abayigirizwa be nti: “Naye n'akyuka n'abanenya.” Lukka 9:55–56 (Ebigambo ebiwanvuko ebisangibwa mu nkyusa ez'edda ezimu — “Temumanyi mwoyo ki gwe muli. Kubanga Omwana w'Omuntu teyajja kuzikiriza bulamu bwa bantu wabula okubulokola” — tebiri mu kiwandiiko kya ESV.)

Kyali ng'agamba nti, “Kino mwandibadde mumaze kukitegeera.”

Ku mulundi omulala yagamba nti: “Nammwe mukyali abatategeera?” Matayo 15:16 Ate era nti: “Dda emabega wange, Setaani! Oli nkonge gye ndi. Kubanga tossa mwoyo gwo ku bintu bya Katonda, wabula ku bintu bya bantu.” Matayo 16:23 Okwo kwe kwali okwagala okwa Katonda. Okwo kwe kwali okwagala okwesigwa — okwagala okwali kwetegese okunenya mu kifo ky'okuleka gwe kwakwatako okweyongera mu kibi n'anyiiza Katonda.

Ate era, bwe yali ayogera n'Abafalisaayo n'abalala abeeyita ng'abeesigwa eri Katonda, yagamba nti: Yokaana 8:39, 42, 44 “Singa mwali baana ba Ibulayimu, mwandikoze emirimu Ibulayimu gye yakola.”

“Singa Katonda ye Kitammwe, mwandinjagadde, kubanga nava eri Katonda era ndi wano.”

“Muli ba kitammwe Setaani, era okwagala kwammwe kwe kukola bya kitammwe by'ayagala.”

Tekyali kyangu eri Yesu Kristo okuwakana n'abantu ab'eddiini ab'omu kiseera kye okusinga bwe kiri eri abaddu be okuwakana n'abeeyita abakkiriza abatambulira mu butakwatagana leero.

Kyokka omutima gwe ogwa Katonda gwali gujjudde okwagala. Yeewaayo ku musaalaba ku lwabwe n'asaba nti: “Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga tebamanyi kye bakola.” Lukka 23:34 Woowe, singa okwagala kwo n'okwange tekwabulwa kabonero kano ak'okufaananako Katonda! Singa waaliwo okwagala kuno okwesigwa, okw'okwagala okuguma okunenya ekibi ne kukangavvula owooluganda mu kwagala, mu kifo ky'okwagala okw'obulimba okuwaanawaana omuntu mu maaso ge ate ne kumuwaayiriza emabega we.

Olowooza nti Abakristaayo abasinga obungi abeeyita mu mulembe guno mu butuufu bakkiriza nti bannaabwe batambula bulungi? Lowooza ku kkanisa yonna ng'oyagala. Olowooza nti abasinga obungi mu bammemba mu mazima bakkiriza nti bammemba bannaabwe — baganda baabwe ne bannyinaabwe mu kukkiriza — batambulira mu bulamu obw'okutya Katonda mu butakyukakyuka, so si mu kungulu kwokka wabula ne mu mutima?

Eky'ennaku, abantu bye boogera emabega wa bannaabwe emirundi mingi bilaga engeri endala. Mu butuufu tebakikkiriza. Bamanyi bulungi, era banguwa okubuulira abalala ku nsobi ze balaba. Kyokka teri n'omu ku lukumi eyali agenze mu kyama eri owooluganda, n'amukwata ku mukono mu kwagala, n'amunenya mpolampola ku mpisa ze embi oba ez'okudda ennyuma.

Abantu bandirowoozezza ki ku mukazi eyalaba nti, ng'agenze mu kkanisa olunaku olwayita, yasaba okusisinkana mu kyama ne Mukyala —— era, bwe yali naye yekka, n'ayogera ng'alina amaziga mu maaso ge era n'obwesimbu obungi nti: “Mukyala —— omwagalwa, nzize kukulaba ku nsonga nzibu nnyo. Onookkiriza ekigambo eky'okuzzaamu amaanyi n'okugolola okuva eri omuntu eyeewulira nga munafu nnyo era nga tasaanidde, kyokka ng'aweeza obwesige nti Omwoyo wa Katonda ye yamuleese? Onzikirize nkubuulire nti nnali neeraliikiridde olw'empisa zo mu kkanisa eggulo. Kyandabikira nti obwongofu bwo tebwali ku bukulu bw'okusinza, wabula bwali ku kwekaliriza n'okunenya ekyambalo ky'oyo eyali atudde okwolekera ggwe. Era nnalaba nti bwe wava mu kkanisa, amangwago n'otandika okuseka n'okwogera mu ngeri eyandabikira nga tekwatagana n'okusinza kw'oli okamaze okwenyigiramu.”

Ka tugambe nti yeeyongera: “Mukyala —— omwagalwa, sinnaba kukyogera eri muntu yenna — n'eri baze wange nedda — naye nzize kwogera naawe ggwe kennyini. Ka tugende mu maaso ga Mukama ffembi tumusabe atuwe Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, alyoke akulage w'oli omukyamu era akubikkulire oba oseeyeeya ng'ova mu kwagala kwa Katonda.”

Abantu bandirowoozezza ki? Bandyogedde ki ku mpisa ng'ezo?

Kyokka singa buli muntu eyalaba ekibi mu muliraanwa yakola bw'atyo — singa bagoberera ekiragiro kya Mukama ne bagenda mu kyama eri owooluganda oba mwannyinaabwe ne balaga ensobi — bantu bameka abandirokoddwa mu kudda ennyuma, era njawukana n'empaka mmeka ezinakuwaza mu kkanisa ezandyewaliddwa!

Naye bali ludda wa abantu abanaakikola?

Sitegeeza nti tewali n'omu — Katonda akyewale. Mmanyi nti waliwo abamu. Naye bwe tugeraageranya, bali ludda wa? Ali ludda wa omuntu eyeetegese okugumiikiriza obuzibu bwe ye kennyini alyoke ayambe omulala?

Eyo y'ensonga entuufu. Singa gwali mulimu mwangu era ogusanyusa, bangi bandiguukoze awatali kwekaanya. Naye kubanga gulumya, beekaanya okugukola.

Ali ludda wa omuntu anaakikola mu kifo ky'okuleka owooluganda okusigala ng'eebase mu kibi? Ali ludda wa omuntu anaakola mu kifo ky'okulaba ensonga ya Kristo ng'eswazibwa era ng'ekolebwa akabi? Bali ludda wa abatukuvu abagenda mu buwombeefu ne mu kwagala okukomyawo oyo eyabula?

Nsuubira ng'omanyi abantu bangi ng'abo. Eky'ennaku, mmanyi batono bwatono. Bw'oba omanyi bangi, nsanyuka, era gy'okoma okumanya abangi, gy'okoma okuba obulungi. Bw'oba oli omu ku bo, kale oyo mulala ku bo. Singa buli Mukristaayo yabeera n'okwagala kwa ngeri eno, nga waliba wabaddewo enkyukakyuka nnene mu bwangu. Kino kye kkanisa kye yeetaaga — abantu abasobola okunenya n'okugolola kubanga tebafaayo ku abalala kye babalowoozaako. Ekibafaako kyokka kwe kusanyusa Mukama waabwe era n'okukola by'ayagala.

Olina okwagala kuno okutanoonya bikwata ku kwo?

Waliwo enjawulo nnene ng'eri wakati wa Sawulo ne Pawulo. Wali okirowoozezzaako? Sawulo agamba ki?

“Kubanga olw'obutamanya butuukirivu bwa Katonda, era nga banoonya okunyweza obwabwe ku bwabwe, tebaagondera butuukirivu bwa Katonda.” Abaruumi 10:3 Nga tannafuna kwagala kwa mazima, ekyamuluŋŋamya kwali kwefaako yekka. Teyafaayo ku bwakabaka bwa Katonda; yafaayo ku kitiibwa kye ye, erinnya lye, n'okukulaakulana kwe. Yayagala okusiimibwa eggwanga lye.

Kaakano geraageranya ekyo ne Pawulo oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka kwe. Agamba ki?

“Nti nnina ennaku nnyingi n'obuyinike obutakoma mu mutima gwange. Kubanga nnandyagadde nze kennyini nkolimirwe era nsalibwe okuva ku Kristo ku lwa baganda bange, ab'ekika kyange mu mubiri.”

Abaruumi 9:2–3 Okwo kwe kwagala okutuufu ddala.

Bano be baali abantu bennyini be yayagala okusiimibwa. Kyokka bwe yamala okufuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaaso ge ne gazibulwa okulaba embeera yaabwe ey'okuzikirira, yabanakuwalira nnyo. Agamba nti: “Nti nnina ennaku nnyingi n'obuyinike obutakoma mu mutima gwange. Kubanga nnandyagadde nze kennyini nkolimirwe era nsalibwe okuva ku Kristo ku lwa baganda bange, ab'ekika kyange mu mubiri.”

Abaruumi 9:2–3 Enjawulo nnene nnyo!

Takyafaayo kye bamulowoozaako. Wabula agenda ng'agezaako okuzibula amaaso gaabwe, ng'abalaga nti enkizo ey'eddiini yokka teyinza kubalokola era nti bateekwa okukyukira Katonda. Obwefaako bumaze okubula ddala mu kulaba. Omutima gwa Pawulo, emmeeme ye, n'okufuba kwe kaakano biweereddwayo eri obulokozi bw'abalala.

Abantu bwe bamutendereza, akikkiriza. Bwe bamuvumirira, ekyo nakyo akikkiriza. Ky'assaako omwoyo bwe bwakabaka bwa Katonda, era ka babe nga bamuyisa batya, yeeyongera okunoonya obwakabaka obwo — ne bwe kiba okutuuka ku kufiira obukakafu. Agumiikiriza obukyayi bwabwe n'obuwakanyi obusinga obungi alyoke ayambe okukyusa abantu okuva eri Setaani okudda eri Katonda era okuva mu kibi okudda mu butuukirivu.

Obwefaako tebukyali wakati. Si Pawulo akyakulira — wabula Kristo n'obwakabaka bwe.

Okwagala okw'obulimba kwe njawulo ddala.

Omuntu alina okwagala okw'obulimba asinga kufaayo ku abantu kye bamulowoozaako, so si ku ngeri gye bayisaamu Mukama gwe yeeyita nti akkiririza. Omuntu ng'oyo tasobola kugumira ndowooza ya kugolola muntu yenna. Endowooza yennyini emutiisa. Ayita abo abakikola ab'ekyejjo, abakwata ku mateeka gokka, oba abasalira abalala emisango. Kyokka ayinza obutaakaanya kunenya muntu emabega we.

Ebigambo by'okwagala okw'obulimba bibikkula obuntu bwakwo obw'amazima. Kuwaanawaana n'emimwa gyakwo. Omubisi gw'enjuki guli ku lulimi lwakwo, naye obutwa buli wansi. Kwewale.

N'ekiseera lwe kulabika ng'okutendereza owooluganda oba muliraanwa, emirundi mingi kwongerako akaziyiza akoonoona: “Woowe, muntu mulungi, naye...”

“Weewaawo, mmussaamu ekitiibwa kinene, wabula...”

Akabi mmeka akaleeteddwa ebigambo ng'ebyo! Amannya amalungi mmeka agonoonebbwa omwoyo guno! Obuyinza mmeka obw'okukola obulungi obunafuyiziddwa oba obuzikiriziddwa okunenya okutaliimu kufaayo n'obukyayi obukwese!

Kyayogerwa mu butuufu nti tewali mpisa nnungi n'entono etukuvu nnyo ngeri okwogera obulimba we kutaligezaako kugivumbagira.

N'obulamu bw'abantu abatya Katonda, abo abanoonya ensobi bulijjo basobola okuzuula ekintu kye banenya.

Noolwekyo, weegendereze kwagala ki kw'olina.

Okwagala okw'amazima tekusanyukira bukyamu.

“Tekusanyukira butali butuukirivu, wabula kusanyukira wamu n'amazima.” 1 Abakkolinso 13:6 Wewulira enneewulira ey'okumatira omuntu gw'otoyagala bw'agwa mu kibi oba mu kabi?

Bwe kiba bwe kityo, weegendereze. Omwoyo ogwo teguva eri Katonda.

Osanyukira mu kyama akabi bwe kajjira omulabe wo? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, olina okuggyawo obutwa obwo.

Katonda tajja kukkiriza mwoyo ng'ogwo mu ggulu. Omuntu omu eyeetisse obukyayi obwo yandyonoonye n'Olusuku lwennyini olwa Katonda. Mukama waffe yagamba nti: “Naye mbagamba nti, Mwagalenga abalabe bammwe era musabirenga abo ababayigganya, mulyoke mube abaana ba Kitammwe ali mu ggulu.” Matayo 5:44–45 Kaakano, owooluganda wange, mwannyinaze, weekebere wekka.

Tuliddamu okusisinkana, era olizuula nti bino si ndowooza za kulowoozaawoolowoozaawo oba enkola ez'obwereere.

Bya mazima ddala. Newankubadde amazima gano amakulu ag'Obukristaayo tegatera kubuulirwa mu biseera byaffe, gasigala nga ga mazima. Gasangibwa mu Kigambo kya Katonda, era temuli Bukristaayo bwa mazima mu ffe wabula nga tulina okwagala kuno okukyawa ekibi olw'okuba nga kibi, okukinenya mu kwagala, okunoonya okukiggyawo, era okuyaayaanira okukiraba nga kiwonyezebwa.

Ne wano nate, okwagala okw'obulimba kwe njawulo ddala eri okwagala okwa Katonda. Tekufaayo nnyo ku butuukirivu. Ekigendererwa kyakwo ekisinga obukulu kwe mirembe n'okusirika bwokka. Kugamba nti, “Ka tusigaze ebintu nga bitereevu; tetusaana kusasamaza mirembe gya kkanisa.” Kwogerera waggulu nti, “Mirembe, mirembe,” songa tewali mirembe gya mazima.

Kugamba nti, “Tetuyinza kuyamba ku bizibu bino. Buli omu ateekwa okwerabirira. Tetuvunaanyizibwa ku muliraanwa waffe.”

Emirundi mingi kumanya bulungi nti obukyamu obukulu buliwo wansi w'amaaso — enkola embi, enteekateeka ez'akabi, n'empisa ez'ekibi kwe kwerondera okugumiikiriza oba okuwagira. Naye kubanga ebintu bino bikwekeddwa amaaso g'abantu bonna, kugamba nti, “Bireke awo. Tetusaana kusasamaza bintu. Mirembe! Mirembe!”

Kugamba nti, “Tofaayo ku butuukirivu; kkanisa eteekwa okuwagirwa, ka ssente zive we ziva. Tofaayo ku bukyamu obuyinza okubeera nga bukwatagana nazo. Tuteekwa okuba n'emirembe.”

Kwagala kubikka ku kibi okusinga okukyoleka n'okukiggyawo. Kugamba nti, “Tofaayo. Tetuyinza kukkiriza nsonga zino kunoonyerezebwako, kugololwa, oba kusigulibwa. Mirembe — tuteekwa okuba n'emirembe!”

Awo, omuntu bw'agema okwoleka ekizibu n'abikkula obuvundu obuli wansi, bamuyisa nga Eriya bwe yayisibwa Akabu.

“Akabu bwe yalaba Eriya, Akabu n'amugamba nti, ‘Ggwe wuuno, ggwe eyeeraliikiriza Isirayiri?’” 1 Bassekabaka 18:17 Mu ngeri y'emu, abo abawakanya obukyamu emirundi mingi bavunaanibwa okuleeta enjawukana mu kifo ky'abo abavunaanyizibwa ku bukyamu bwennyini.

Era bw'ojjukiza abantu etteeka ekkulu nti: “Kale buli kye mwagala abantu okubakolera, mubakolerenga nammwe bwe mutyo, kubanga guno gwe Mateeka ne Bannabbi.” Matayo 7:12 Oluusi baddamu nti, “Naye tetusuubirwa kuba batuukirivu ba njakuŋŋaana mu bulamu buno,” ne bakikozesa ng'ekyokwewaza okwewala okukwata ku nsonga. Mu ngeri eno, bateeka bukka ekibikka ekirala ku kizibu ne bakireka ne kyeyongera.

Kuno kwe kwagala kwa Setaani, era gye kweyongera obungi, gye kukoma okukola ekigendererwa kye obulungi.

Naye okwagala n'amagezi ebiva waggulu bya njawulo.

“Naye amagezi agava waggulu gasooka kuba malongoofu, ne gabaako emirembe, ga bukkakkamu, agawulira, agajjudde okusaasira n'ebibala ebirungi, agatasosola era agatalimba.” Yakobo 3:17 Weetegereze nti gasooka kuba malongoofu, ne galyoka gabaako emirembe .

Nnandisinze okubeera mu kulwana okutakoma nga ndi ku ludda lw'ekituufu, ekyalimu obutuukirivu, n'ekirungi okusinga okusanyukira obumu n'ekitaliimu, ekyonoonefu, n'ekibi, era ekyategekerwa okuzikirizibwa.

Mukama akuyambe okukola okulonda kwe kimu.
fields.body_text: “Kale kaakano okukkiriza, essuubi, n'okwagala bibeerawo, bino ebisatu; naye ekisinga mu bino kwe kwagala.” 1 Abakkolinso 13:13 Enjawulo enkulu ey'okubiri wakati w'okwagala okw'amazima n'okw'obulimba gye twagala okwoleka y'eno: Okwagala okwa Katonda tekukoma ku kukwatagana n'okunenya n'okukangavvula, wabula emirundi mingi kubyetaaga eri abo abakulina. Kufuula omulimu gw'abo abalina okwo okunenya n'okukangavvula buli ekibi — buli ekitaleeta birungi bya waggulu eri omuntu oyo ekikwatako. Mu kino, nga bwe kiri mu buli kintu ekirala, okwagala kuno kugoberera ekyokulabirako kyakwo ekya Katonda: “Bonna be njagala mbanenya ne mbakangavvula; kale ba nnyiikivu weenenye.” Okubikkulirwa 3:19 Bwe kiba kyetaagisa olw'obulungi bw'omuntu, Katonda anenya era akangavvula. Tanakuwaza wadde okunakuwaza abantu n'akatono, nga kitaawe bw'atayagala kukangavvula mwana ajeema. Naye bw'aba kitaawe ow'amagezi, ajja kukikola kubanga ayagala omwana. Mu ngeri y'emu, omuntu alina okwagala kuno okwa Katonda amaliridde okukangavvula n'okunenya ekibi buli we kisangibwa. Tajja kuleka kibi kubeerawo mu muliraanwa we nga tekivunaanibbwa, wabula alimunenya n'obwesigwa era anaaba anoonya okumutwala eri ekituufu. Ka tulabe ekyokulabirako ekirungi (kimu ku bingi) eky'okwagala kuno okwa Katonda nga kukola mu mutima ne mu bulamu bw'omutume yennyini eyawandiika 1 Abakkolinso 13. Tetuyinza kukyamira mu kulonda ekyokulabirako kino kubanga kiva eri Pawulo yennyini. “Naye Keefa bwe yajja e Antiyokiya, namuwakanya nga mmwolekedde, kubanga yali asingiddwa omusango. Kubanga abasajja abamu nga tebannava eri Yakobo, yalyanga wamu n'Abamawanga; naye bwe bajja, ne yeggyako ne yeeyawula, ng'atya ab'ekibiina eky'okukomola. N'Abayudaaya abalala ne bakola eby'obunnanfuusi wamu naye, ne Balunabba n'atwalibwa okukyama olw'obunnanfuusi bwabwe. Naye bwe nalaba nti empisa zaabwe tezaali za magezi ga mazima g'enjiri, ne ŋŋamba Keefa mu maaso gaabwe bonna nti, ‘Oba ggwe, newankubadde ng'oli Muyudaaya, obeera ng'Omumawanga so si ng'Omuyudaaya, oyinza otya okuwaliriza Abamawanga okubeera ng'Abayudaaya?’” Abaggalatiya 2:11–15 Weebale, Pawulo — okwagala okw'ekitiibwa era okw'obuvumu! Teyagenda kwogera mu kaama emabega wa Peetero wadde okumulumba mu kyama. “Ne ŋŋamba Keefa mu maaso gaabwe bonna...” Bw'oba oyagala akabonero k'okwagala okw'amazima, kano wano. Kiteekwa okuba nga kyali kya bulumi bungi nnyo eri Pawulo okunenya Peetero mu lujjudde. Baali baagalana. Mu butuufu, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka, Peetero yayogera ku Pawulo nti: “...owooluganda omwagalwa Pawulo...” 2 Peetero 3:15 Baali beefaako ddala. Pawulo yategeera bye kwetaaga okwagala okw'amazima, kubanga ye yawandiika essuula eno ey'ekkumi n'esatu ey'Abakkolinso. Bwe yali ayagala Peetero, era bwe yali ategeera okwagala okw'amazima, lwaki yamunenya mu lwatu? Lwaki yeeteeka mu bulumi obw'okukikola? Obwesigwa eri Peetero, obwesigwa eri amazima, n'obwesigwa eri Yesu Kristo kye kyakyetaaga. Noolwekyo, Pawulo yaggyawo enneewulira ze yennyini n'agumiikiriza obulumi obw'okuwakana mu kifo ky'okuleka Peetero okweyongera mu nsobi, abakkiriza Abamawanga okubuzibwabuzibwa, n'Abayudaaya okusendebwasendebwa endowooza ez'ensi. Pawulo yanenya Peetero mu lwatu kubanga amazima gaali mu katyabaga. Nga bwe kitera okubaawo, amazima gaali ku ludda lw'abatono. Obuyinza obungi bwali ku ludda lw'ab'ekibiina eky'okukomola. Baali mu bakkiriza abaali n'obuyinza obusinga, kyokka Pawulo yayimirira ng'awakanya obuyinza obwo mu kunenya kwe Peetero. Lwaki? Kubanga obwesigwa eri amazima kye kyakyetaaga, era okwagala okwa Katonda kusooka kuba kulongoofu . Waliwo ekyokulabirako ekisingako obukulu mu Mukama waffe yennyini — Omukama emmeeme ye yonna kye yali kwagala era obulamu bwe kye kyali ekiweebwayo eky'olubeerera olw'obulungi bw'abalala. Kyokka nga yakomyawo n'obwesigwa abagoberezi be bo bennyini bwe baava mu mazima, era nga yayolekera awatali kutya n'anenya obutakwatibwa n'obunnanfuusi bw'abo abeeyita ng'abaagala Katonda ate nga bawakanya okwo mu bulamu bwabwe. Nga yanenya ekibi awatali kutya buli we yakisanga. Ku lulala yagamba abayigirizwa be nti: “Naye n'akyuka n'abanenya.” Lukka 9:55–56 (Ebigambo ebiwanvuko ebisangibwa mu nkyusa ez'edda ezimu — “Temumanyi mwoyo ki gwe muli. Kubanga Omwana w'Omuntu teyajja kuzikiriza bulamu bwa bantu wabula okubulokola” — tebiri mu kiwandiiko kya ESV.) Kyali ng'agamba nti, “Kino mwandibadde mumaze kukitegeera.” Ku mulundi omulala yagamba nti: “Nammwe mukyali abatategeera?” Matayo 15:16 Ate era nti: “Dda emabega wange, Setaani! Oli nkonge gye ndi. Kubanga tossa mwoyo gwo ku bintu bya Katonda, wabula ku bintu bya bantu.” Matayo 16:23 Okwo kwe kwali okwagala okwa Katonda. Okwo kwe kwali okwagala okwesigwa — okwagala okwali kwetegese okunenya mu kifo ky'okuleka gwe kwakwatako okweyongera mu kibi n'anyiiza Katonda. Ate era, bwe yali ayogera n'Abafalisaayo n'abalala abeeyita ng'abeesigwa eri Katonda, yagamba nti: Yokaana 8:39, 42, 44 “Singa mwali baana ba Ibulayimu, mwandikoze emirimu Ibulayimu gye yakola.” “Singa Katonda ye Kitammwe, mwandinjagadde, kubanga nava eri Katonda era ndi wano.” “Muli ba kitammwe Setaani, era okwagala kwammwe kwe kukola bya kitammwe by'ayagala.” Tekyali kyangu eri Yesu Kristo okuwakana n'abantu ab'eddiini ab'omu kiseera kye okusinga bwe kiri eri abaddu be okuwakana n'abeeyita abakkiriza abatambulira mu butakwatagana leero. Kyokka omutima gwe ogwa Katonda gwali gujjudde okwagala. Yeewaayo ku musaalaba ku lwabwe n'asaba nti: “Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga tebamanyi kye bakola.” Lukka 23:34 Woowe, singa okwagala kwo n'okwange tekwabulwa kabonero kano ak'okufaananako Katonda! Singa waaliwo okwagala kuno okwesigwa, okw'okwagala okuguma okunenya ekibi ne kukangavvula owooluganda mu kwagala, mu kifo ky'okwagala okw'obulimba okuwaanawaana omuntu mu maaso ge ate ne kumuwaayiriza emabega we. Olowooza nti Abakristaayo abasinga obungi abeeyita mu mulembe guno mu butuufu bakkiriza nti bannaabwe batambula bulungi? Lowooza ku kkanisa yonna ng'oyagala. Olowooza nti abasinga obungi mu bammemba mu mazima bakkiriza nti bammemba bannaabwe — baganda baabwe ne bannyinaabwe mu kukkiriza — batambulira mu bulamu obw'okutya Katonda mu butakyukakyuka, so si mu kungulu kwokka wabula ne mu mutima? Eky'ennaku, abantu bye boogera emabega wa bannaabwe emirundi mingi bilaga engeri endala. Mu butuufu tebakikkiriza. Bamanyi bulungi, era banguwa okubuulira abalala ku nsobi ze balaba. Kyokka teri n'omu ku lukumi eyali agenze mu kyama eri owooluganda, n'amukwata ku mukono mu kwagala, n'amunenya mpolampola ku mpisa ze embi oba ez'okudda ennyuma. Abantu bandirowoozezza ki ku mukazi eyalaba nti, ng'agenze mu kkanisa olunaku olwayita, yasaba okusisinkana mu kyama ne Mukyala —— era, bwe yali naye yekka, n'ayogera ng'alina amaziga mu maaso ge era n'obwesimbu obungi nti: “Mukyala —— omwagalwa, nzize kukulaba ku nsonga nzibu nnyo. Onookkiriza ekigambo eky'okuzzaamu amaanyi n'okugolola okuva eri omuntu eyeewulira nga munafu nnyo era nga tasaanidde, kyokka ng'aweeza obwesige nti Omwoyo wa Katonda ye yamuleese? Onzikirize nkubuulire nti nnali neeraliikiridde olw'empisa zo mu kkanisa eggulo. Kyandabikira nti obwongofu bwo tebwali ku bukulu bw'okusinza, wabula bwali ku kwekaliriza n'okunenya ekyambalo ky'oyo eyali atudde okwolekera ggwe. Era nnalaba nti bwe wava mu kkanisa, amangwago n'otandika okuseka n'okwogera mu ngeri eyandabikira nga tekwatagana n'okusinza kw'oli okamaze okwenyigiramu.” Ka tugambe nti yeeyongera: “Mukyala —— omwagalwa, sinnaba kukyogera eri muntu yenna — n'eri baze wange nedda — naye nzize kwogera naawe ggwe kennyini. Ka tugende mu maaso ga Mukama ffembi tumusabe atuwe Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, alyoke akulage w'oli omukyamu era akubikkulire oba oseeyeeya ng'ova mu kwagala kwa Katonda.” Abantu bandirowoozezza ki? Bandyogedde ki ku mpisa ng'ezo? Kyokka singa buli muntu eyalaba ekibi mu muliraanwa yakola bw'atyo — singa bagoberera ekiragiro kya Mukama ne bagenda mu kyama eri owooluganda oba mwannyinaabwe ne balaga ensobi — bantu bameka abandirokoddwa mu kudda ennyuma, era njawukana n'empaka mmeka ezinakuwaza mu kkanisa ezandyewaliddwa! Naye bali ludda wa abantu abanaakikola? Sitegeeza nti tewali n'omu — Katonda akyewale. Mmanyi nti waliwo abamu. Naye bwe tugeraageranya, bali ludda wa? Ali ludda wa omuntu eyeetegese okugumiikiriza obuzibu bwe ye kennyini alyoke ayambe omulala? Eyo y'ensonga entuufu. Singa gwali mulimu mwangu era ogusanyusa, bangi bandiguukoze awatali kwekaanya. Naye kubanga gulumya, beekaanya okugukola. Ali ludda wa omuntu anaakikola mu kifo ky'okuleka owooluganda okusigala ng'eebase mu kibi? Ali ludda wa omuntu anaakola mu kifo ky'okulaba ensonga ya Kristo ng'eswazibwa era ng'ekolebwa akabi? Bali ludda wa abatukuvu abagenda mu buwombeefu ne mu kwagala okukomyawo oyo eyabula? Nsuubira ng'omanyi abantu bangi ng'abo. Eky'ennaku, mmanyi batono bwatono. Bw'oba omanyi bangi, nsanyuka, era gy'okoma okumanya abangi, gy'okoma okuba obulungi. Bw'oba oli omu ku bo, kale oyo mulala ku bo. Singa buli Mukristaayo yabeera n'okwagala kwa ngeri eno, nga waliba wabaddewo enkyukakyuka nnene mu bwangu. Kino kye kkanisa kye yeetaaga — abantu abasobola okunenya n'okugolola kubanga tebafaayo ku abalala kye babalowoozaako. Ekibafaako kyokka kwe kusanyusa Mukama waabwe era n'okukola by'ayagala. Olina okwagala kuno okutanoonya bikwata ku kwo? Waliwo enjawulo nnene ng'eri wakati wa Sawulo ne Pawulo. Wali okirowoozezzaako? Sawulo agamba ki? “Kubanga olw'obutamanya butuukirivu bwa Katonda, era nga banoonya okunyweza obwabwe ku bwabwe, tebaagondera butuukirivu bwa Katonda.” Abaruumi 10:3 Nga tannafuna kwagala kwa mazima, ekyamuluŋŋamya kwali kwefaako yekka. Teyafaayo ku bwakabaka bwa Katonda; yafaayo ku kitiibwa kye ye, erinnya lye, n'okukulaakulana kwe. Yayagala okusiimibwa eggwanga lye. Kaakano geraageranya ekyo ne Pawulo oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka kwe. Agamba ki? “Nti nnina ennaku nnyingi n'obuyinike obutakoma mu mutima gwange. Kubanga nnandyagadde nze kennyini nkolimirwe era nsalibwe okuva ku Kristo ku lwa baganda bange, ab'ekika kyange mu mubiri.” Abaruumi 9:2–3 Okwo kwe kwagala okutuufu ddala. Bano be baali abantu bennyini be yayagala okusiimibwa. Kyokka bwe yamala okufuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaaso ge ne gazibulwa okulaba embeera yaabwe ey'okuzikirira, yabanakuwalira nnyo. Agamba nti: “Nti nnina ennaku nnyingi n'obuyinike obutakoma mu mutima gwange. Kubanga nnandyagadde nze kennyini nkolimirwe era nsalibwe okuva ku Kristo ku lwa baganda bange, ab'ekika kyange mu mubiri.” Abaruumi 9:2–3 Enjawulo nnene nnyo! Takyafaayo kye bamulowoozaako. Wabula agenda ng'agezaako okuzibula amaaso gaabwe, ng'abalaga nti enkizo ey'eddiini yokka teyinza kubalokola era nti bateekwa okukyukira Katonda. Obwefaako bumaze okubula ddala mu kulaba. Omutima gwa Pawulo, emmeeme ye, n'okufuba kwe kaakano biweereddwayo eri obulokozi bw'abalala. Abantu bwe bamutendereza, akikkiriza. Bwe bamuvumirira, ekyo nakyo akikkiriza. Ky'assaako omwoyo bwe bwakabaka bwa Katonda, era ka babe nga bamuyisa batya, yeeyongera okunoonya obwakabaka obwo — ne bwe kiba okutuuka ku kufiira obukakafu. Agumiikiriza obukyayi bwabwe n'obuwakanyi obusinga obungi alyoke ayambe okukyusa abantu okuva eri Setaani okudda eri Katonda era okuva mu kibi okudda mu butuukirivu. Obwefaako tebukyali wakati. Si Pawulo akyakulira — wabula Kristo n'obwakabaka bwe. Okwagala okw'obulimba kwe njawulo ddala. Omuntu alina okwagala okw'obulimba asinga kufaayo ku abantu kye bamulowoozaako, so si ku ngeri gye bayisaamu Mukama gwe yeeyita nti akkiririza. Omuntu ng'oyo tasobola kugumira ndowooza ya kugolola muntu yenna. Endowooza yennyini emutiisa. Ayita abo abakikola ab'ekyejjo, abakwata ku mateeka gokka, oba abasalira abalala emisango. Kyokka ayinza obutaakaanya kunenya muntu emabega we. Ebigambo by'okwagala okw'obulimba bibikkula obuntu bwakwo obw'amazima. Kuwaanawaana n'emimwa gyakwo. Omubisi gw'enjuki guli ku lulimi lwakwo, naye obutwa buli wansi. Kwewale. N'ekiseera lwe kulabika ng'okutendereza owooluganda oba muliraanwa, emirundi mingi kwongerako akaziyiza akoonoona: “Woowe, muntu mulungi, naye...” “Weewaawo, mmussaamu ekitiibwa kinene, wabula...” Akabi mmeka akaleeteddwa ebigambo ng'ebyo! Amannya amalungi mmeka agonoonebbwa omwoyo guno! Obuyinza mmeka obw'okukola obulungi obunafuyiziddwa oba obuzikiriziddwa okunenya okutaliimu kufaayo n'obukyayi obukwese! Kyayogerwa mu butuufu nti tewali mpisa nnungi n'entono etukuvu nnyo ngeri okwogera obulimba we kutaligezaako kugivumbagira. N'obulamu bw'abantu abatya Katonda, abo abanoonya ensobi bulijjo basobola okuzuula ekintu kye banenya. Noolwekyo, weegendereze kwagala ki kw'olina. Okwagala okw'amazima tekusanyukira bukyamu. “Tekusanyukira butali butuukirivu, wabula kusanyukira wamu n'amazima.” 1 Abakkolinso 13:6 Wewulira enneewulira ey'okumatira omuntu gw'otoyagala bw'agwa mu kibi oba mu kabi? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, weegendereze. Omwoyo ogwo teguva eri Katonda. Osanyukira mu kyama akabi bwe kajjira omulabe wo? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, olina okuggyawo obutwa obwo. Katonda tajja kukkiriza mwoyo ng'ogwo mu ggulu. Omuntu omu eyeetisse obukyayi obwo yandyonoonye n'Olusuku lwennyini olwa Katonda. Mukama waffe yagamba nti: “Naye mbagamba nti, Mwagalenga abalabe bammwe era musabirenga abo ababayigganya, mulyoke mube abaana ba Kitammwe ali mu ggulu.” Matayo 5:44–45 Kaakano, owooluganda wange, mwannyinaze, weekebere wekka. Tuliddamu okusisinkana, era olizuula nti bino si ndowooza za kulowoozaawoolowoozaawo oba enkola ez'obwereere. Bya mazima ddala.
