Kubanga njagala Kabaka afune ekimugwanira. Njagala ebigendererwa bya Kristo bituukirizibwe, era neegomba akozese si nze nzekka wabula n'abo ab'omuwendo ennyo gye ndi olw'ekitiibwa kye. Bakitaawe ne bannyaabwe, mwegendereze. Bwe muziyiza abaana bammwe eri Katonda, mwessa mu kifo eky'akabi. “Abo abampa ekitiibwa nange ndibawa ekitiibwa, n'abo abannyooma banaanyoomebwa.” 1 Samwiri 2:30 Wegendereze obuteeziyiza Katonda ekintu ekisinga omuwendo. Wegendereze obutafuna kisa kye kya bwereere. Eky'ennaku, abamu bakikola. Ekitundu eky'okutaano okwagala okuva eri Katonda n'okwagala okw'obulimba mwe kwawukana kye kino: okwagala okuva eri Katonda kugondera amateeka. Kino ntegeeza nti bulijjo kukolera mu kutabagana n'etteeka lya Katonda ery'empisa. Tekukola bubi n'akatono olw'okutuukiriza obulungi. Toowuliranga okwagala okw'amazima nga kugamba nti: "Mmanyi nti kino si kituufu ddala, naye nsobola okutuukiriza ekivaamu ekirungi nga nkikola." Tekisoboka n'akatono. Endowooza eyo teva eri Katonda. Obutuukirivu bulukiddwa mu mutima gwennyini ogw'okwagala okuva eri Katonda. Nga obwenkanya n'obutuukirivu bwe biri omusingi gw'entebe ya Katonda ey'obwakabaka, obutuukirivu buli wakati mu kwagala okw'amazima. Okwagala okuva eri Katonda tekwaddirenga butuukirivu ssaddaaka olw'emirembe, oba okwataganya, oba obwangu, oba enkizo endala yonna. Kale, obuvunaanyizibwa bw'omuntu kiki? “Akubuulidde, ggwe omuntu, ekirungi kye kiruwa; era Mukama ky'akwetaagisa kiki wabula okukola eby'obwenkanya, n'okwagala ekisa, n'okutambula n'obwetoowaze ne Katonda wo?” Mikka 6:8 Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'aleeta engeri zino mu bulamu bw'omuntu, Katonda amutunuulira n'okukkiriza, era atambulira mu kitangaala ky'ekisa kye. Kola eby'obwenkanya. Yagala okusaasira. Tambula n'obwetoowaze ne Katonda. Ekitundu ekinene eky'obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe kirimu mu bigambo ebyo. Owulira kino, ggwe atera okusuula mu mitindo gya Katonda? Ggwe agamba nti Abakristaayo balina okufuuka ng'ensi okusingawo olwo balyoke bawangule ensi? Ggwe awakana nti tuteekwa okwessa wansi ku mitindo gy'ensi tulyoke tuleete abantu eri Katonda? Mbagamba lwatu: obutali butuukirivu bwonna kibi, kale bantu ki abakozesa okwagala okw'obulimba okuwolereza ebibi ebizikiriza obulamu obutabalika? Bantu ki abateeka amateeka n'enkola ebikuuma obutali bwenkanya nga bwe boogera nti bakolera obulungi bwa bonna? Ka twebuuze ekibuuzo ekyangu: Kya bwenkanya okuwaayo ekibinja ky'abantu ekimu ssaddaaka—naddala aba nnafu era abasinga obunafu—olw'omugaso ogutebereberezebwa ogw'ekibinja ekirala? Obwo bwe bwenkanya? Kwo kwe kusaasira? Era weetegereze nti ŋŋamba omugaso ogutebereberezebwa. Kubanga ebyafaayo emirundi mingi biraga nti obutali bwenkanya tebuvaamu bulungi bwa lubeerera. Ekitundu ky'abantu kimu kiyinza okujoogebwa awatali bivaamu ku nkomerero okudda ku oyo ajooga? Ekyo kyali kibaddewo? Kirijjanga okubaawo? Nedda, Katonda ng'akyafuga obulamu bwe bwonna. Tewali ndowooza ya magezi yonna esobola okusazaamu etteeka lya Katonda ery'empisa. “Temulimbibwalimbibwanga: Katonda tasekererwa, kubanga buli muntu ky'asiga, era ekyo ky'alikungula.” Abaggalatiya 6:7 Tewali n'omu awona amateeka ago. Ekiraga eky'enkomerero eky'okwagala okw'amazima kye nnaayogerako kye kino: Kugumiikiriza wadde nga waliyo obutebaza, obuwakanyi, n'okuyigganyizibwa. Omuntu alina okwagala kuno anoonya obulungi bw'abalala si lwa kubanga kya buvunaanyizibwa kyokka, wabula kubanga omutima gwe gukyusiddwa. Omutima gwe gutuukagana ne Katonda, amazima, n'obutuukirivu. Olw'okuba ayagala ekituufu, tasobola kulekeraawo kunoonya kuyamba balala nabo bakyagale—ne bwe kiba nga abantu abo bamugaana, tebamutegeera, oba bamunyooma. Yesu yalaga okwagala kuno mu bujjuvu. Ne bwe yali abonaabonera ku musaalaba, yasaba nti: “Kitange, basonyiye, kubanga tebamanyi kye bakola.” Lukka 23:34 Omutima gwe gwasigala nga gwemalidde ku kukomyawo abantu eri Katonda. Teyakyuka kudda mabega n'akatono. Okwagala kwe kwamutwala okutuusa ku kufa. Pawulo yagoberera ekyokulabirako kya Mukama we. Wadde ng'abantu abamu baamwagalanga katono nga bw'aleeta okubaagala okusingawo, yeeyongera okunoonya obulungi bwabwe obusingayo. Yabaagala—so si ttendo lyabwe, oba okukkiriza kwabwe, oba okwewuunya kwabwe. Okwagala okw'obulimba kweyisa mu ngeri endala. Kukoowa mangu ng'okufuba kwakwo tekusiimibwa. Endowooza yaakwo efuuka nti: "Nkoze ekimala. Gye nsingira okuba ow'ekisa, gye batwalirira abantu okumpisa obubi. Nnaalekeraawo okuyamba okutuusa lwe nnaafuna okusiimibwa okusingawo." Lwaki? Kubanga okwegulumiza kwe bulamu bw'okwagala okw'obulimba. Okwebaza n'okwewuunya bwe biggwaawo, okwagala okw'obulimba mangu kufa. Kale kika ki eky'okwagala kw'olina, muganda wange? Mwannyinaze? Nnawulirako ku musuubuzi omuvubuka era omuwanguzi eyagenda mu kusinza gye yawulira amazima ag'omu Byawandiikibwa agatereevu. Omuntu bwe yamubuuza oluvannyuma kye yalowooza, yeenyeenya n'obutabeera bulungi n'addamu nti: "Kale, kyali kya ntiisa. Oba nga kye nawulira kya mazima, kale ndi mu lugendo lwange olw'okugenda mu ggeyeena." Naye oboolyawo okutegeera okwo kwe kwali entandikwa yennyini ey'essuubi eri ye. Kaakano ka nkubuuze: Olina okwagala kuno okuva eri Katonda? Jjukira, nga bwe nagamba ku ntandikwa, tekukulira mu buutonde mu mutima gw'omuntu ogutazziddwabuggya. Bw'oba tonnayitamu mu mulimu ogukyusa ogwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu, kale olina okutandikira awo. Ne bw'oba olina okukoppa okw'ebweru kumeka, tekuyinza kudda mu kifo ky'okwagala kwa Katonda. Okulina, muganda wange? Okulina, mwannyinaze? Bw'oba tokulina, oyinza okukufuna leero. Onookunoonya? Ffenna edda twali tetulina kwo. “Ffenna edda twabeeranga... era mu buzaaliranwa twali baana ba busungu, ng'abantu abalala bonna.” Abaefeso 2:3 Twayagalanga ne tukyawa nga tugoberera ebyetaago byaffe eby'omululu. Naye Katonda azza obuggya emitima. Atufuula, ku kigero ekimu, nga Kristo yennyini. Ku Ye kyawandiikibwa nti: “Wayagala obutuukirivu n'okyawa obwonoonyi; kyekyava Katonda, Katonda wo, akufukako amafuta ag'essanyu okusinga banno.” Abaebbulaniya 1:9 Gye weeyongera okwagala obutuukirivu n'okukyawa obubi, gye lyeyongera essanyu lyo okuba eddene, era n'obujulizi bwo eri Katonda ne buba obw'amaanyi okusingawo. Onoosobola okugamba ne Dawudi nti: “Sikwese bulokozi bwo munda mu mutima gwange; njogedde ku bwesigwa bwo n'obulokozi bwo; sikwese kwagala kwo okunywevu n'obwesigwa bwo eri ekkuŋŋaaniro ekinene.” Zabbuli 40:10 Abantu bwe bafuna okwagala kuno okw'amazima, mu buutonde baagala okukugabana. Kubooga ne kufukumuka. Tekuyinza kusigala nga kukwese. Nga Mukama waffe bwe yagamba: “Amazzi ge ndimuwa galifuuka mu ye ensulo y'amazzi eganukuka okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.” Yokaana 4:14 Era nga Ekyawandiikibwa bwe kyatula: “Amazzi amangi tegayinza kuzikiza kwagala.” Oluyimba lwa Sulemaani 8:7 Ofunye okwagala kuno? Kukusitudde waggulu w'ebyetaago byo eby'omululu? Oba okyapima buli mukisa ng'osooka kwebuuza engeri gye gunaakukwatako ggwe okusinga engeri gye gunaakwatako obwakabaka bwa Katonda? Ne ggwe amanyi nti tonnaba kukufuna: Waliwo essuubi. Omutima gwa Kristo gujjudde okusaasira gy'oli. Alindirira okufuka okwagala kuno mu mwoyo gwo. Embaga eteekeddwateekeddwa. Buli kintu kyetegese. Jjangu mu nnyumba ye ey'embaga. Wummulira wansi w'ebbendera lye ery'okwagala. Era beera omwo emirembe gyonna.

fields.title: Embeera z'Okusaba Okw'Amaanyi
fields.body_html:
“Bwe munaabeeranga mu nze, n'ebigambo byange ne bibeera mu mmwe, munaasabanga kye mwagala kyonna, era munaakikolerwa.” Yokaana 15:7 “Kyenva mbagamba nti, byonna bye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nga mubifunye, era munaabifuna.” Makko 11:24 “Omuntu yenna ku mmwe bw'abulwa amagezi, asabe Katonda, agabira bonna atakwatirwa nsonyi, era anaagaweebwa. Naye asabe mu kukkiriza, nga tabuusabuusa; kubanga abuusabuusa afaanana ng'amayengo g'ennyanja agasundibwa empewo ne gasindikibwa eno n'eri. Kubanga omuntu oyo tateebereze nti aliweebwa ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama.” Yakobo 1:5- “Era n'Omwoyo bw'atyo atuyamba mu bunafu bwaffe. Kubanga tetumanyi kye tusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n'okusinda okutayogerekeka.

Era oyo akebera emitima amanyi endowooza y'Omwoyo, kubanga Omwoyo yeegayiririra abatukuvu ng'okwagala kwa Katonda bwe kuli.” Abaruumi 8:26-27 Ebyawandiikibwa bino sibitutte mu ntegeka gye biriimu, wabula mu ntegeka gye bigobererezaganamu mu ndowooza, era gye binnyonnyolamu ensonga eno.

Kaakano, mu bigambo ebitono bye njagala okwogera, nnaagezaako okuli n'okuddamu ebbaluwa ze nfunye ku nsonga eno. Tewali kintu, oboolyawo, ekibaawo emirundi mingi mu nnaku zino okusinga kino, era tewali kigambo Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo kye bantera okuŋŋamba okusinga kino nti: “Weewaawo, mmaze ebbanga ddene nga nsabira ebintu ebimu, naye nga sirabako kuddibwamu kwonna mu kusaba kwange.” Ntera okwewuunya lwaki abantu ng'abo tebava ku kusaba n'akatono. Ndowooza nze nnandikikoze singa saddibwangamu.

Kaakano ŋŋamba nti, kino kintu ekiswaza Katonda nnyo, era wateekwa okubaawo ekitali kituufu awo bwe kiba bwe kityo. Wateekwa okubaawo ekisobu, oba mu abo abasaba oba mu Omuwi. Nga bwe mpulira emirundi mingi ekintu eky'okuswaza Katonda ennyo bwe kiba, ng'Abakristaayo bakuŋŋaana, nga bwe batera okukola mu ggwanga lyonna, okusabira okuzuukuka kw'eddiini, okusabira ekintu ekimu mu Kkanisa zaabwe ne mu maka gaabwe, naye ne kitajja n'akatono.

Emyaka egiyise, ejjunga ery'okuzuukuka kw'eddiini bwe lyali libuna Ireland ne Amerika, mumanyi nga Kkanisa mu nsi eno zaakuŋŋaana mu nkuŋŋaana z'okusaba ezigatta okusaba lyandizze mu Bungereza; naye teryajja, era abakubaganya ne banyeenya emitwe gyabwe, ne bawandiika mu mpapula zaabwe ez'amawulire nti: “Mulabe, Katonda w'Abakristaayo oba muggavu wa matu oba agenze okuyigga, kubanga babadde n'enkuŋŋaana z'okusaba mu ggwanga lyonna nga basabira okuzuukuka kw'eddiini, naye ne kutajja.” Ng'amatama gange bwe gaayakira mu nsonyi bwe nakirowoozaako; nga bwe nakikungubagira! Nnamanya nga si lwa kubanga Katonda waffe yali yeebase—si lwa kubanga amaanyi ge gaali gakomekkerezeddwa—si lwa kubanga omutima gwe ogw'ekisa tegwali gwegomba abalina ebibi—si lwa kubanga teyandisobodde okufuka Omwoyo we n'atuwa ebiseera ebimu eby'ekitiibwa eby'okuwummuzibwa nga bwe baalina mu bifo ebirala. Eyo si ye nsonga. Waaliwo ensonga emu yokka, era yali nti, abantu be baasaba obubi.

Tebaategeera mbeera z'okusaba okw'amaanyi, okuwangula. Tebaazituukiriza.

Singa baasaba okutuusa kaakano, ne banywerera ku mbeera y'omutima gye gumu, tebandifunye kuddibwamu, kubanga waliwo embeera ku bisuubizo bino, nga bwe kiri ku bisuubizo ebirala byonna; era tuyinza okusaba ne tukoowa ennyo bwe tutagondera mbeera zino. Katonda taasejjere n'oluta okutusisinkana, era taatuukirize bisuubizo mu bulamu bwaffe. Mmwe abazuukuse okutegeera obuvunaanyizibwa bwammwe n'ebibagwanira ku nsi eno ezikirira, mussanga omwoyo ku bigambo byange, era mutwale eka bye ŋŋamba—mubirowoozeeko, mubisabireko, mugezaako okutegeera nti bubaka bwa Mukama gye muli.

Bino katundu butundu katono ku bisuubizo eby'ekitiibwa ebikwata ku kusaba. Biri bingi mu Baibuli, Katonda mwe yeesiba yekka okuddamu okusaba okw'obwesigwa okw'abantu be.

“Okusaba kw'omuntu omutuukirivu kulina amaanyi mangi nga kukola.” — Yakobo 5:16 Kale, lwaki ekibiina ekinene eky'Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo tebafuna kuddibwamu mu kusaba kwabwe? Okusooka, tebalina MPISA eyo Katonda gye yakolera ebisuubizo. Ebisuubizo bino bikolerwa abatukuvu ba Katonda—abo abakwata ebiragiro bye, abatambulira mu kitangaala era abalina obumu naye ku bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era, noolwekyo, Omwoyo asobola okubeegayiririra. Omwoyo ayinza atya okwegayiririra omuntu ng'atali munda ye? Abo abatambulira mu kitangaala basobola okulaba engeri y'okusaba, ekiseera ky'okubisaba, n'engeri gye basaba; balaba byonna, kubanga bali mu kitangaala. Abantu ng'abo basaba, ne baweebwa. Naye, nga kya nnaku! olw'okuba nga bano batono nnyo, empisa ya Katonda evvoolwa buli lunaku, era abakubaganya batusekerera ne baseka ne Katonda waffe.

Kaakano, togezaako kubuusa mbega kino oba kukisindika okukuvaako. Ebisuubizo bino bikolerwa baani? Nsomooza omuntu yenna okunfunira ebisuubizo mu Baibuli eno, bwe tugitunuulira awamu n'ebigyetoolodde (okuggyako abalina ebibi abeenenya, abo abali kika kya njawulo era abasisinkanyizibwa ebisuubizo eby'enjawulo), okuggyako abatukuvu.

Tewali bisuubizo bya kuddibwamu mu kusaba okuggyako eri ekika ky'abantu bano. Ebisuubizo bino tebikolerwa buli muntu, si bwe kiri? Okusaba kw'omubi kya muzizo eri Katonda, okuggyako nga basaba okuva ku bubi bwabwe. Olwo okusaba okwo tekuba kya muzizo; naye okusaba kwonna okulala okw'ababi kuba kya muzizo. Ebisuubizo bino bikolerwa abantu abatuukirivu—abantu abali: Okusooka, mu bumu ne Katonda. “Bwe munaabeeranga mu nze, n'ebigambo byange ne bibeera mu mmwe”—nga baaleeteddwa mu bumu obulamu olw'okukkiriza okulamu, ebisuubizo bikolerwa abantu abo abanywerera ku bumu obwo—abatambulira mu bwo, ababeera mu bwo, era abakozesa emikisa n'enkizo Yesu z'abawadde olw'obumu obwo.

Kaakano, mulaba, mikwano gyange, tekimala nti mwali mumu ne Yesu edda okusobola okufuna okuddibwamu mu kusaba kwammwe. Ntya nti waliwo enkumi n'enkumi abaddayo emabega. Baaleka okukwata okw'okukkiriza; tebabeera mu Kristo; babeera ebweru we, ate nga bulijjo basaba nga beebuuza lwaki Katonda taddamu kusaba kwabwe. Temulaba, embeera eyasooka ebulako. Tewali kkubo lyonna liyinzika okusemberera Kitaffe okuggyako ku bw'Omwana. Okusaba kwonna kuba kya muzizo eri Katonda okutalinnya gy'ali ku bw'Omwana we era mu Mwana we, okuggyako ng'okwa Koluneeriyo, ataali awulirako ku Kristo; naye eri abantu abaali balina ekitangaala era abaali bamanyi Omwana we, tewali kusaba kukkirizibwa nga bali ebweru w'obumu obulamu n'Omwana we. Era ekyo tekitegeeza kwogera bugagi nti, “Ku lwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.” Tekikulu nnyo abantu kye boogera.

Katonda tassaayo mwoyo ku bigambo by'abantu; kye bategeeza ne kye bawulira kye assaako omwoyo, era amanyi abantu bwe basaba mu bumu obwa nnamaddala n'Omwana we. Tebali mu bumu, era, noolwekyo, okusaba kwabwe tekulinnya waggulu okusinga ekisenge mwe basabira.

Tekwakiraawo na kuva mu bumwa bwabwe; Katonda takuwulira. Kuzikirira ne kuziikibwa mu bulago bwabwe bo.

Mmwe abakyusiddwa abaggya, temuvanga mu bumu obulamu ne Yesu. Mubeere mu bwo—mubunywezenga—mutambulire mu bwo, era munaafuna okuddibwamu mu kusaba kwammwe buli lunaku. Munaakikakasa ng'eyo mulaba Katonda ng'akola kye musaba era ne mumuwulira ng'ayogera nammwe. Munaasobola okugamba nti, “Mmanyi nti bulijjo ompulira.” Erinnya lye lifukibwe omukisa! Abo ababeera mu ye basobola okwogera bwe batyo mu kigero kyabwe.

Embeera eddako ku kusaba okuwangula kwe kugondera ekitangaala. Kaakano, kitegeeza ki okutambulira mu buwulize? Kale, tekitegeeza kunoonya mu Ndagaano Empya eno okuzuula ekisa kya Katonda ekitono ekinaakuyingiza mu Ggulu! Tekitegeeza kudduka ng'olaba omuntu ono ky'ayogera n'omulala ky'ayogera ku kyawandiikibwa, olwo osobole okudduka amakulu amatuufu, ag'obukozi ag'ekyawandiikibwa! Abantu ng'abo bannanfuusi mu mutima, ne bwe baba ba ani—oba wamu okwatula, tebeesimbu. Tebaagala kumanya kwagala kwa Katonda; kyandibasingira obulungi obutakumanya. Baagala okuva ku makulu amatereevu, ag'obukozi, ag'amagezi amalamu ag'ekyawandiikibwa, ne balyoka bagamba nti, “Tekitegeeza ekyo kye kigamba,” ne nti, “Kisaanidde okuvvuunulwa mu ngeri eno oba eri”; ne beezaamu amaanyi era ne bagezaako okwewuliza obulungi songa mu mitima bali balyamu olukwe. Ekyo si kwe kutambulira mu kitangaala.

Okutambulira mu kitangaala kifaanana ng'okutambulira mu njuba—si kudduka mabega w'empagi eri, n'omuti eri, okuva mu kitangaala. Kwe kufuluma mu lwatu n'ogamba nti, “Kaakano, Mukama Yesu, njagala okumanya okwagala kwo. Mukama, nfukako ekitangaala kyo. Neetegese okukigoberera, ne bwe kinaatuusa ku kuttibwa oba ku muti gw'okwokebwako.”

Okusooka, yaayaanira okuba n'ekitangaala. Kirumya omutima gwange—nnali nnaagamba nti kukuutuka olw'obusungu obutuukirivu, olw'obuggya ku lw'ekitiibwa kya Katonda, okulowooza nti asaanidde okuvoolwa bw'atyo n'okuvvoolwa abo abeeyita nti bamwagala—abagezaako okugamba nti bakola bubi kubanga babulwa ekitangaala. Si bwe kiri n'akatono. Waliwo ekitangaala kingi wano, naye oteekwa okugamba nti, “Weewaawo, Mukama, njagala okuba nakyo, ne bwe kinaansalira omusango. Bwe kisalira omutima gwange omusango, omutwe gwange, Mukama, nkifukireeko.

Bwe kisalira obulamu bwange omusango, nkifukireeko. Bwe kisalira omusango banne abo, okwejalabya okwo, nkifukireeko: nnaabireka. Bwe kisalira omusango ebyamaguzi byange, nkifukireeko: nnaaleka bizinensi eyo, era nsinga okufa mu bwavu okusinga okugyeyongera mu yo. Bwe kisalira omusango enkolagana yange n'ab'eŋŋanda zange, nnaava mu bo ne nkugoberera.”

Mukama bulijjo anaddamu emmeeme ng'eyo. Anaassa olugalo lwe ku kifo kino ekirumya ne ku kirala, era anaakubuulira ky'oteekwa okukola, era onaakikakasa ng'eyo owulidde eddoboozi lye eriwuliddwa. Kitegeeza ki okutambulira mu kitangaala? Gondera eddoboozi lye. Toyimirira kuwakana na magezi ga bantu, naye, nga Pawulo bwe yakola, golokoka ogende otandike omulimu Mukama wo gw'akulagira. Pawulo teyayimirira kwebuuza ku mubiri na musaayi. Teyayimirira kubala kye kyandimuwezezza, naye n'agenda mu maaso, so teyayimirira okutuusa lwe yatuuka ku nkomerero. Ekyo kwe kutambulira mu kitangaala—okugondera—so si kuyimirira awo ng'owakana ne Mukama ku kyo, so si kugamba nti, “Naye—“ naye kukikola.

Mikwano gyange, ne bwe wabaawo omuntu yenna abuulira Enjiri endala, ne bwe wabaawo ajja n'enjigiriza nti oyinza okukkirizibwa Katonda oba okuba omutukuvu ku mbeera endala yonna—ku bwa Kristo ne ku bw'emmeeme yo, tobakkiriza. Nga omutume Yokaana bw'agamba nti: “Omuntu yenna bw'ajja gye muli n'atareeta njigiriza eno, temumusembeza mu nnyumba yammwe so temumulamusa,” — 2 Yokaana 1:10 Ogamba nti, “Naye ekyo kiweebwayo kya muwendo mungi.” Kiri kityo, mu ngeri emu; naye bw'omala okusasula omuwendo, bw'omala okuwaayo ekiweebwayo, bw'oyingira mu kkubo, essanyu, ekitangaala, amaanyi, n'ekitiibwa biba bya muwendo emirundi kikumi okusinga. Waliwo omuntu yenna eyafuna Oluyinja olw'omuwendo omungi eyali awulira nti yakiwaayo ebisukkiridde, ne bwe yandiwaddeyo byonna bye yalina?

Nedda n'akatono! Abaffiira okukkiriza n'abaatula okukkiriza beenyumiririzza mu kuba nakyo nga babonyaabonyezebwa ku bibonerezo ne mu muliro, era tewali kujulira n'okumu kwe wali owuliddeko nti omusajja oba omukazi wa Katonda yali alowooza nti yasasula omuwendo omungi ekisukkiridde. Nedda n'akatono! Oyagala okusaba kwo kuddibwemu? Eryo lye kkubo. Tambula omutima gwo gwennyini guleme kukusalira musango. Omwana omuwulize abeera mu bumu obw'okwagala ne muzadde we talina kutya kujja kusaba ebyenkizo. Amanyi nti anaabifuna. Omutima gwe gwennyini tegumusalira musango.

“Abaagalwa, emitima gyaffe bwe gitatusalira musango, tuba n'obuvumu mu maaso ga Katonda;” — 1 Yokaana 3:21 Nsomooza omuntu yenna okwawula obuvumu n'obuwulize. Bw'otoobe muwulize, toyinza kuba na buvumu. Nsomooza Omukristaayo yenna wano okuŋŋamba nti asobola okulinnya ku ntebe ya Katonda mu kukkiriza olw'omukisa gwonna songa omutima gwe gwennyini gumusalira omusango. Amanyi nti tasobola. Asooka kuggibwako mbeera eyo ey'okusalirwa omusango nga tannaba kukozesa kukkiriza olw'omukisa gwonna.

Tambulira mu kitangaala, olwo onaaba n'obumu naye, era omusaayi gwe gunaakunaaza okuva mu kibi kyonna, era Omwoyo anaakuyigiriza engeri y'okusaba ne ky'osaba, ekibiina ekinene eky'Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo kye batamanyako kintu na kimu.

Ate era, okukulembera, okuyigiriza, n'okukubiriza kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mbeera eddako ku kusaba okw'amaanyi. Tuyinza okuyita embeera zino olujegere olw'ennyunga nnya, oluyunga emmeeme zaffe n'omutima gwennyini ogwa Katonda. Ekisooka, obumu ne Yesu; ekyokubiri, obuwulize eri ebiragiro bye, okutambulira mu kitangaala; ekyokusatu, okwegayiririra kw'Omwoyo abeera munda; n'ekyokuna, okukozesa okukkiriza. Bw'obulwa ennyunga yonna emu ku zino, okusaba kwo kufaafaaganye. Oyinza okuba n'endala zonna essatu, naye bw'obulwa emu, tojja kufuna kuddibwamu. Kunaasala okussa kimu, era tewaabe kuddibwamu.

Ntya nti Abakristaayo bangi abeeyita bwe batyo tebamanyi Omwoyo ow'okwegayiririra kye gutegeeza. Tebalina kye bamanyi ku Omwoyo okubeegayiririra n'okusinda okutayogerekeka. Bwe tunaafuna Omwoyo ono ow'okusaba okw'okwegayiririra mu bazadde, tunaalaba abaana ab'omwoyo bangi nga bazaalibwa. Kaakano, Omwoyo Omutukuvu wano agamba nti tetumanyi kye tusaba nga bwe kitugwanira okuggyako ng'Omwoyo ayigiriza; noolwekyo abantu bulijjo, nga Yakobo bw'agamba, basaba ne batafuna, kubanga basaba obubi.

“Musaba ne mutafuna, kubanga musaba obubi, mulyoke mukikozese ku kwegomba kwammwe.”

— Yakobo 4:3 Ekyo kitegeeza okwegomba kwammwe okw'ensi, okwagala kwammwe, n'ebigendererwa byammwe, ebikomekkerezebwa ensalo y'ensi.

Kaakano, nkkiriza nti eno ye nsonga enkulu lwaki enkumi n'enkumi z'Abakristaayo basaba ne batafuna kuddibwamu n'akatono.

Beefaako bokka mu kusaba kwabwe; bo ba nsi; basaba obubi, balyoke bakikozese ku kwegomba kwabwe okw'ensi, okwagala kwabwe, n'obuteego bwabwe obw'obuzaalirwa. Bamaama bambuulira nti baasabira abaana baabwe emyaka mingi ne batafuna na omu ku bo eyakyusibwa.

Ŋŋamba nti, “Kya nnaku nnyo; nsonyi nnyo gy'oli.” Lwaki? Kubanga baasaba okusaba kw'okwefaako bokka, okw'obuzaalirwa, kubanga baali baana baabwe, oba kubanga baali baagala babeere ab'eddiini baleme kugwa mu kibi oba okuleeta ensonyi oba okunyolwa ku maka, oba kubanga kyandibadde kirungi okubaba ab'eddiini. Naye tebaagala kubeera batuukirivu nnyo; tebaagala kubeera nga beewaddeyo eri Katonda okutuusa okusalako obutaliimu n'obusiru bw'ensi eno ne beewaayo mu bujjuvu eri Kristo—ekyo kingi nnyo; baagala eddiini emala okubafuula essanyu lyabwe bo. Wandiziremu okusaba ng'okwo singa wali Katonda? Okusaba amakumi n'enkumi kuweebwayo buli lunaku okutagenda mu buziba wadde waggulu okusinga ekyo, singa ebigendererwa byakebeddwa—era Omwoyo Omutukuvu abikebera.

Ntya nti abakyala bangi basabira babbaabwe mu ngeri y'emu. Tebeeraliikirira nti babbaabwe bali mu bujeemu eri Katonda, nga bayonoona obudde bwabwe, ebirabo byabwe, n'ensimbi zaabwe, era nga banyaga obwakabaka bwa Yesu Kristo ku ebyo bye bandibukoledde. Ekibanyolayo kwe kuba nti, singa baali ba ddiini, bandimaze obudde obungi ennyo eka; nti bayonoona ensimbi mu kifo ky'okuziterekera abaana; era nti singa baali ba ddiini, bino byonna byandirongooseddwa. Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, Katonda taaddemu okusaba kw'omukyala oyo ku lwa bba! Oteekwa okulowooza ku bba ky'ayinza okuba eri Katonda—ky'ayinza okukola ku bwakabaka bwa Katonda—nga Yesu Kristo bwe yamuyiwako omusaayi gwe—nga obulamu obw'ekibi bwe buswaza Katonda; era oteekwa okulowoozako kino okutuusa omutima gwo lwe gunaaba ompi n'okumenyeka, era onoofuna bba nga akyusiddwa mu bwangu, bw'onookolera n'amagezi awamu n'okusaba kwo.

Katonda akyawa okwefaako wekka—okwefaako wekka gwe mulabe, ye ngeri gy'atuulamu ddala. Oteekwa okuva mu ggwe wennyini; oteekwa okutunuulira omwana wo bulijjo nga wa Katonda, ng'alina emmeeme ey'omuwendo eyanunulibwa n'omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw'omuwendo, era ng'alina ebirabo n'obusobozi okumugulumiza n'okusaasaanya obwakabaka bwe; era oteekwa okussa okusaba kwo ku ekyo n'ogamba nti, “Nnandisinze okubagalaamiza mu ntaana emirundi lukumi—nnandisinze babe abaavu era abanyoomebwa—okusinga bakule ne bakuswaza.” Olwo onoofuna okusaba kwo nga kuddiddwamu!

Abantu basabira ebyamaguzi byabwe. Katonda alaba nti engeri y'okuzikiriza omuntu oyo kwe kumuleka n'awangula. Taaga sente okusobola okutwala omulimu gwe mu maaso. Katonda alaba nti okugaggawala kwandiridde emmeeme ye ng'endwadde, kyava atamuleka kuwangula. Omwoyo wa Katonda takulembera mmeeme kutuuka ku kusaba okw'okwefaako wekka. Nedda; akulembera emmeeme okukaaba kubanga abantu tebakwata mateeka ge, okukaaba ku by'enfuna bye okusinga ebibye. Yeetegese ennyumba yaayo okusigala nga njereere, singa ekyo kinaayamba okusaasaana kw'obwakabaka bwa Katonda. Yeetegese enkazaluggya okuzuula ekisu ku kyoto kyayo, singa mu ekyo eyinza okuddaabiriza n'okugulumiza ekyoto kya Yakuwa.

Olwo eno ennyunga esembayo—okukkiriza. Wano waliwo ekyama ekirala. Tewali mukkiriza asobola okukozesa okukkiriza olw'ekintu kyonna Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'atamutuusaako. Oyinza okusaba, n'osaba, naye tojja kukozesa kukkiriza okutuusa lw'onoobeera n'Omwoyo ng'akwegayiririramu. Waliwo obuzibu butono nnyo mu kukkiriza eri abantu abaakutte amatambula asatu agaakulembera.

Abo abali mu bumu ne Yesu, abo abatambulira mu kitangaala, abo abalina Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'Omwoyo ow'okwegayiririra—bamanyi kye basaba; bamanyi endowooza y'Omwoyo bw'eri; bamanyi engeri Omwoyo gy'abakulemberamu, era basobola okutambula okulinnya ku ntebe ne “basaba ne bafuna.” Bamanyi nti okusaba kwabwe kuli ng'endowooza ya Katonda bw'eri, era basobola okumeguza, bwe kiba kyetaagisa, ng'omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki, singa asiima okugezesa okukkiriza kwabwe. Taddamu bulijjo mangu ago. Abaleka okumeguza n'okusinda okutayogerekeka; naye bamanyi nti Omwoyo abeegayiririra, era banywerera oluusi wakati mu kuggwaamu amaanyi okunene n'okukemebwa okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja. Bafuna obukakafu obw'okukkiriza, obugamba nti, “Weewaawo, kinaakolebwa.” Abantu babatunuulira n'okwewuunya. Mikwano gy'Abakristaayo bamanyi nti ekintu kye basaba tekinnajja, ne bagamba nti, “Olabika ng'osanyuse ng'eyo okifunye;” “Mfunye omusingo; mmanyi nti kijja; nnina obukakafu nti kinaakolebwa.” Kaakano, buli muzadde asaba asaanidde okumeguza okutuusa ekyo lwe kifunibwa ku buli mwana. Tosaana kulekaayo okutuusa olwo, olwo n'otendeka era n'osaba—okolere awamu ne Katonda: eryo lye tteeka ery'obwakabaka, okutuuka ku nkomerero. Kkiriza nti okifuna, era onaakifuna.

Obutabanguko, okutabuka okuliwo, mu kukwatagana n'emmeeme enaku ku kifo ekyo. Abantu bagamba nti, “Kkiriza nti olokolebwa, era olokolebwa.” Mpulidde Abakristaayo nga bawa emmeeme okubuulirira okwo emirundi mingi. “Kkiriza nti olokolebwa, era olokolebwa.” Kkiriza obulimba, era bunaatuukirira. Eyo ye nfumiiriza ya Katonda? Kigasa ki okugamba omuntu okukkiriza nti alokolebwa nga tannalokolebwa?

Ekyo kwe kumugamba akkirize obulimba. Abantu bagamba nti, “Kkiriza nti otukuziddwa, era otukuziddwa.”

Mazima ddala! Watukuzibwa ddi? Katonda tagamba muntu kukkiriza kintu okutuusa lwe kibaawo. Yafuula okuweebwa kw'ekirabo okubeera awamu n'okukozesa okukkiriza mu kiseera kye kimu. Kkiriza nti ofuna, era onaafuna—so si nti wafuna essaawa emu emabega, kubanga ekyo tekyandibadde kya mazima; so si nti onoofuna essaawa emu okuva kaakano, kubanga ekyo kyandibadde kwewaana. Tewali kisuubizo kya ngeri eyo, naye kkiriza nti kaakano ofuna, era onaafuna. “Siriswaza muntu yenna avuma okunneesiga okutuuka ku kigero ekyo.” Banaakifuna. Ogamba nti ekiseera ky'ebyamagero kiyise.

Weewaawo, kubanga ekiseera ky'okukkiriza okw'engeri eyo kiyise. Onoddizibwa ebyamagero ng'okukkiriza okw'engeri eyo kudda. Katonda yeesibye ku kukkiriza kw'abantu be ab'amazima, era yandisoose okumenya amateeka gonna ag'obutonde okusinga okumenya amateeka ag'ekisa. Ayinza mangu okuggyawo etteeka ery'obutonde; naye taaggyewo tteeka lya kisa. Yeesibye ku kukkiriza—amaanyi gokka mu bwengula ge yeesibyeko—era tewali n'omu yali agolokose mu nsi eno n'agamba nti, “Nneesiga Katonda, n'annimba.”

Okukkiriza kitegeeza okwesiga—okukkiriza kitegeeza okwewaayo—ng'eyo ofa, nga tolina kirala kisigadde okuggyako ekisuubizo kya Katonda kyokka. Ogamba nti, “Ndi kufa; nteekwa okwesiga kaakano,” era omuntu oyo abuuka ku kisuubizo. Baleka okugezesa, ne beesiga ddala; era olabye ekitangaala nga kijja mu maaso gaabwe; owulidde oluyimba olw'ettendo nga lubwatuka okuva ku mimwa gyabwe, kubanga baakkiriza nti bafunye, era baafuna.

Kaakano, abamu ku mmwe abampandiikidde mumanyi nti mubeera mu bumu ne Yesu.

Abamu ku mmwe gye buvuddeko mwatandika okutambulira mu kitangaala. Mwasalako ne muggyawo bakatonda abakole n'emikono; mweewaddeyo eri okwagala kwa Katonda, ne musuubiza, ku bw'ekisa kye, nti munaamugoberera olugendo lwonna. Muwulira nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu mmwe. Mbeegayiridde okuwulira mu bujjuvu, okuleka Omwoyo okukola nga bw'ayagala. Temumuziyiza. Temulowooza nti kinaalumya emibiri gyammwe; temulowooza nti kingi nnyo; temulowooza nti mufuuka ba busungu bw'eddiini obw'ekitalo; temulowooza nti, ekya mazima, Katonda tayagala kika kya kintu kino—mugoberere Omwoyo. Muleke Omwoyo abakulembere, era asinde ng'ayita mu mmwe; muleke Omwoyo ameguze ne Katonda ng'ayita mu mmwe—mumugoberere. Singa twali tulina bino bingi mu nkuŋŋaana zino, twandibadde n'ebibala bingi; era singa ekkanisa yali erina bino bingi, wandibaddewo emmeeme nnyingi ezaazaalibwa mu bwakabaka.

Kimu ku bintu bye nanakuwaza Omwoyo wa Katonda mu nnaku zange ez'olubereberye kwe kuba nti saamuleka, okutuuka ku kigero ky'ayandinkoze, okunfuula omukazi ow'okusaba; ate, bwe twegeraageranya n'abangi, oboolyawo, nnali omu ku bo. Yatera okuteeka abantu ab'enjawulo n'ensonga ez'enjawulo ku mutima gwange, ne siyinza kwerema kusaba; naye nga bwe nejjusizza n'obulumi n'okukaabira mu maaso ga Mukama kubanga saamuleka kunkolako nga bw'ayagala mu nsonga eno. Weekuume! nammwe abo b'atandika okukulembera, mumuleke abakulembere. Muyiwe emmeeme zammwe ku lw'abalala era awamu n'abalala. Nkkiriza nti emmeeme nnyingi zikkirizibwa mu kusaba okwa nnamaddala okusinga mu kwogera.

Kino nkirabye emirundi mingi. Nnalaba wansi w'ekizimbe ekinene oba etiyeeta, oba mu galale, abasajja abasingira ddala obukambwe bwe wandirowoozezza, nga beeyisa mu ngeri esingira ddala obutasaana, nga bakwatiddwa amaanyi g'okusaba. Oboolyawo, akasaasamalo bwe kaali ku ntandikwa y'okumenyeka mu kuvuruguta okw'olwatu, omukazi omutono ayanjuluzza emikono gye ku kibiina, n'agamba nti, “Kaakano, ka tusabe”; ne ndaba ekibiina ky'abasajja kyonna nga kifuna embeera ey'obusirifu n'okussaamu ekitiibwa. Nnatunuulira endabika y'ekibiina, ne ndaba abasajja abanene, abakambwe, ab'ebyenyi ebiddugavu nga bakutamya emitwe gyabwe, oluusi ne basiimuula amaaso gaabwe; era bwe twagolokoka okuyimba, tewaali kwesooza kulala, wabula baatereera n'obuzito bw'okufa, okuwuliriza. Ebikumi ku bo baakakasibwa ekibi nga bakyali wansi w'okusaba okwo. Yali Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'ameguza olw'emmeeme ezo mu mutima gw'omukazi oyo ekyabakuba n'okukakasibwa.

Okusaba kwe kubonaabona kw'emmeeme—okumeguza kw'Omwoyo. Omanyi engeri abasajja n'abakazi gye bakwataganamu bwe baba mu kwesunga okw'amaanyi ennyo ekintu kikolebwe. Okwo kwe kusaba, kibe eri abantu oba eri Katonda; era bw'onoofuna omutima gwo nga gukwatiddwa, ne gusaanuuka, ne guleetebwa mu kunyiiga, ne gutikkibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku lw'emmeeme, onooba n'amaanyi, era tojja kusaba wabula waaliwo anaakakasibwa—amaaso ag'emmeeme enaku agakwafu ganaazibulwa, era obulamu obw'omwoyo bunaatandika.
fields.body_text: "Bwe munaabeeranga mu nze, n'ebigambo byange ne bibeera mu mmwe, munaasabanga kye mwagala kyonna, era munaakikolerwa." Yokaana 15:7 "Kyenva mbagamba nti, byonna bye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nga mubifunye, era munaabifuna." Makko 11:24 "Omuntu yenna ku mmwe bw'abulwa amagezi, asabe Katonda, agabira bonna atakwatirwa nsonyi, era anaagaweebwa. Naye asabe mu kukkiriza, nga tabuusabuusa; kubanga abuusabuusa afaanana ng'amayengo g'ennyanja agasundibwa empewo ne gasindikibwa eno n'eri. Kubanga omuntu oyo tateebereze nti aliweebwa ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama." Yakobo 1:5- "Era n'Omwoyo bw'atyo atuyamba mu bunafu bwaffe. Kubanga tetumanyi kye tusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n'okusinda okutayogerekeka. Era oyo akebera emitima amanyi endowooza y'Omwoyo, kubanga Omwoyo yeegayiririra abatukuvu ng'okwagala kwa Katonda bwe kuli." Abaruumi 8:26-27 Ebyawandiikibwa bino sibitutte mu ntegeka gye biriimu, wabula mu ntegeka gye bigobererezaganamu mu ndowooza, era gye binnyonnyolamu ensonga eno. Kaakano, mu bigambo ebitono bye njagala okwogera, nnaagezaako okuli n'okuddamu ebbaluwa ze nfunye ku nsonga eno. Tewali kintu, oboolyawo, ekibaawo emirundi mingi mu nnaku zino okusinga kino, era tewali kigambo Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo kye bantera okuŋŋamba okusinga kino nti: "Weewaawo, mmaze ebbanga ddene nga nsabira ebintu ebimu, naye nga sirabako kuddibwamu kwonna mu kusaba kwange." Ntera okwewuunya lwaki abantu ng'abo tebava ku kusaba n'akatono. Ndowooza nze nnandikikoze singa saddibwangamu. Kaakano ŋŋamba nti, kino kintu ekiswaza Katonda nnyo, era wateekwa okubaawo ekitali kituufu awo bwe kiba bwe kityo. Wateekwa okubaawo ekisobu, oba mu abo abasaba oba mu Omuwi. Nga bwe mpulira emirundi mingi ekintu eky'okuswaza Katonda ennyo bwe kiba, ng'Abakristaayo bakuŋŋaana, nga bwe batera okukola mu ggwanga lyonna, okusabira okuzuukuka kw'eddiini, okusabira ekintu ekimu mu Kkanisa zaabwe ne mu maka gaabwe, naye ne kitajja n'akatono. Emyaka egiyise, ejjunga ery'okuzuukuka kw'eddiini bwe lyali libuna Ireland ne Amerika, mumanyi nga Kkanisa mu nsi eno zaakuŋŋaana mu nkuŋŋaana z'okusaba ezigatta okusaba lyandizze mu Bungereza; naye teryajja, era abakubaganya ne banyeenya emitwe gyabwe, ne bawandiika mu mpapula zaabwe ez'amawulire nti: "Mulabe, Katonda w'Abakristaayo oba muggavu wa matu oba agenze okuyigga, kubanga babadde n'enkuŋŋaana z'okusaba mu ggwanga lyonna nga basabira okuzuukuka kw'eddiini, naye ne kutajja." Ng'amatama gange bwe gaayakira mu nsonyi bwe nakirowoozaako; nga bwe nakikungubagira! Nnamanya nga si lwa kubanga Katonda waffe yali yeebase—si lwa kubanga amaanyi ge gaali gakomekkerezeddwa—si lwa kubanga omutima gwe ogw'ekisa tegwali gwegomba abalina ebibi—si lwa kubanga teyandisobodde okufuka Omwoyo we n'atuwa ebiseera ebimu eby'ekitiibwa eby'okuwummuzibwa nga bwe baalina mu bifo ebirala. Eyo si ye nsonga. Waaliwo ensonga emu yokka, era yali nti, abantu be baasaba obubi. Tebaategeera mbeera z'okusaba okw'amaanyi, okuwangula. Tebaazituukiriza. Singa baasaba okutuusa kaakano, ne banywerera ku mbeera y'omutima gye gumu, tebandifunye kuddibwamu, kubanga waliwo embeera ku bisuubizo bino, nga bwe kiri ku bisuubizo ebirala byonna; era tuyinza okusaba ne tukoowa ennyo bwe tutagondera mbeera zino. Katonda taasejjere n'oluta okutusisinkana, era taatuukirize bisuubizo mu bulamu bwaffe. Mmwe abazuukuse okutegeera obuvunaanyizibwa bwammwe n'ebibagwanira ku nsi eno ezikirira, mussanga omwoyo ku bigambo byange, era mutwale eka bye ŋŋamba—mubirowoozeeko, mubisabireko, mugezaako okutegeera nti bubaka bwa Mukama gye muli. Bino katundu butundu katono ku bisuubizo eby'ekitiibwa ebikwata ku kusaba. Biri bingi mu Baibuli, Katonda mwe yeesiba yekka okuddamu okusaba okw'obwesigwa okw'abantu be. "Okusaba kw'omuntu omutuukirivu kulina amaanyi mangi nga kukola." — Yakobo 5:16 Kale, lwaki ekibiina ekinene eky'Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo tebafuna kuddibwamu mu kusaba kwabwe? Okusooka, tebalina MPISA eyo Katonda gye yakolera ebisuubizo. Ebisuubizo bino bikolerwa abatukuvu ba Katonda—abo abakwata ebiragiro bye, abatambulira mu kitangaala era abalina obumu naye ku bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era, noolwekyo, Omwoyo asobola okubeegayiririra. Omwoyo ayinza atya okwegayiririra omuntu ng'atali munda ye? Abo abatambulira mu kitangaala basobola okulaba engeri y'okusaba, ekiseera ky'okubisaba, n'engeri gye basaba; balaba byonna, kubanga bali mu kitangaala. Abantu ng'abo basaba, ne baweebwa. Naye, nga kya nnaku! olw'okuba nga bano batono nnyo, empisa ya Katonda evvoolwa buli lunaku, era abakubaganya batusekerera ne baseka ne Katonda waffe. Kaakano, togezaako kubuusa mbega kino oba kukisindika okukuvaako. Ebisuubizo bino bikolerwa baani? Nsomooza omuntu yenna okunfunira ebisuubizo mu Baibuli eno, bwe tugitunuulira awamu n'ebigyetoolodde (okuggyako abalina ebibi abeenenya, abo abali kika kya njawulo era abasisinkanyizibwa ebisuubizo eby'enjawulo), okuggyako abatukuvu. Tewali bisuubizo bya kuddibwamu mu kusaba okuggyako eri ekika ky'abantu bano. Ebisuubizo bino tebikolerwa buli muntu, si bwe kiri? Okusaba kw'omubi kya muzizo eri Katonda, okuggyako nga basaba okuva ku bubi bwabwe. Olwo okusaba okwo tekuba kya muzizo; naye okusaba kwonna okulala okw'ababi kuba kya muzizo. Ebisuubizo bino bikolerwa abantu abatuukirivu—abantu abali: Okusooka, mu bumu ne Katonda. "Bwe munaabeeranga mu nze, n'ebigambo byange ne bibeera mu mmwe"—nga baaleeteddwa mu bumu obulamu olw'okukkiriza okulamu, ebisuubizo bikolerwa abantu abo abanywerera ku bumu obwo—abatambulira mu bwo, ababeera mu bwo, era abakozesa emikisa n'enkizo Yesu z'abawadde olw'obumu obwo. Kaakano, mulaba, mikwano gyange, tekimala nti mwali mumu ne Yesu edda okusobola okufuna okuddibwamu mu kusaba kwammwe. Ntya nti waliwo enkumi n'enkumi abaddayo emabega. Baaleka okukwata okw'okukkiriza; tebabeera mu Kristo; babeera ebweru we, ate nga bulijjo basaba nga beebuuza lwaki Katonda taddamu kusaba kwabwe. Temulaba, embeera eyasooka ebulako. Tewali kkubo lyonna liyinzika okusemberera Kitaffe okuggyako ku bw'Omwana. Okusaba kwonna kuba kya muzizo eri Katonda okutalinnya gy'ali ku bw'Omwana we era mu Mwana we, okuggyako ng'okwa Koluneeriyo, ataali awulirako ku Kristo; naye eri abantu abaali balina ekitangaala era abaali bamanyi Omwana we, tewali kusaba kukkirizibwa nga bali ebweru w'obumu obulamu n'Omwana we. Era ekyo tekitegeeza kwogera bugagi nti, "Ku lwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo." Tekikulu nnyo abantu kye boogera. Katonda tassaayo mwoyo ku bigambo by'abantu; kye bategeeza ne kye bawulira kye assaako omwoyo, era amanyi abantu bwe basaba mu bumu obwa nnamaddala n'Omwana we. Tebali mu bumu, era, noolwekyo, okusaba kwabwe tekulinnya waggulu okusinga ekisenge mwe basabira. Tekwakiraawo na kuva mu bumwa bwabwe; Katonda takuwulira. Kuzikirira ne kuziikibwa mu bulago bwabwe bo. Mmwe abakyusiddwa abaggya, temuvanga mu bumu obulamu ne Yesu. Mubeere mu bwo—mubunywezenga—mutambulire mu bwo, era munaafuna okuddibwamu mu kusaba kwammwe buli lunaku. Munaakikakasa ng'eyo mulaba Katonda ng'akola kye musaba era ne mumuwulira ng'ayogera nammwe. Munaasobola okugamba nti, "Mmanyi nti bulijjo ompulira." Erinnya lye lifukibwe omukisa! Abo ababeera mu ye basobola okwogera bwe batyo mu kigero kyabwe. Embeera eddako ku kusaba okuwangula kwe kugondera ekitangaala. Kaakano, kitegeeza ki okutambulira mu buwulize? Kale, tekitegeeza kunoonya mu Ndagaano Empya eno okuzuula ekisa kya Katonda ekitono ekinaakuyingiza mu Ggulu! Tekitegeeza kudduka ng'olaba omuntu ono ky'ayogera n'omulala ky'ayogera ku kyawandiikibwa, olwo osobole okudduka amakulu amatuufu, ag'obukozi ag'ekyawandiikibwa! Abantu ng'abo bannanfuusi mu mutima, ne bwe baba ba ani—oba wamu okwatula, tebeesimbu. Tebaagala kumanya kwagala kwa Katonda; kyandibasingira obulungi obutakumanya. Baagala okuva ku makulu amatereevu, ag'obukozi, ag'amagezi amalamu ag'ekyawandiikibwa, ne balyoka bagamba nti, "Tekitegeeza ekyo kye kigamba," ne nti, "Kisaanidde okuvvuunulwa mu ngeri eno oba eri"; ne beezaamu amaanyi era ne bagezaako okwewuliza obulungi songa mu mitima bali balyamu olukwe. Ekyo si kwe kutambulira mu kitangaala. Okutambulira mu kitangaala kifaanana ng'okutambulira mu njuba—si kudduka mabega w'empagi eri, n'omuti eri, okuva mu kitangaala. Kwe kufuluma mu lwatu n'ogamba nti, "Kaakano, Mukama Yesu, njagala okumanya okwagala kwo. Mukama, nfukako ekitangaala kyo. Neetegese okukigoberera, ne bwe kinaatuusa ku kuttibwa oba ku muti gw'okwokebwako." Okusooka, yaayaanira okuba n'ekitangaala. Kirumya omutima gwange—nnali nnaagamba nti kukuutuka olw'obusungu obutuukirivu, olw'obuggya ku lw'ekitiibwa kya Katonda, okulowooza nti asaanidde okuvoolwa bw'atyo n'okuvvoolwa abo abeeyita nti bamwagala—abagezaako okugamba nti bakola bubi kubanga babulwa ekitangaala. Si bwe kiri n'akatono. Waliwo ekitangaala kingi wano, naye oteekwa okugamba nti, "Weewaawo, Mukama, njagala okuba nakyo, ne bwe kinaansalira omusango. Bwe kisalira omutima gwange omusango, omutwe gwange, Mukama, nkifukireeko. Bwe kisalira obulamu bwange omusango, nkifukireeko. Bwe kisalira omusango banne abo, okwejalabya okwo, nkifukireeko: nnaabireka. Bwe kisalira omusango ebyamaguzi byange, nkifukireeko: nnaaleka bizinensi eyo, era nsinga okufa mu bwavu okusinga okugyeyongera mu yo. Bwe kisalira omusango enkolagana yange n'ab'eŋŋanda zange, nnaava mu bo ne nkugoberera." Mukama bulijjo anaddamu emmeeme ng'eyo. Anaassa olugalo lwe ku kifo kino ekirumya ne ku kirala, era anaakubuulira ky'oteekwa okukola, era onaakikakasa ng'eyo owulidde eddoboozi lye eriwuliddwa. Kitegeeza ki okutambulira mu kitangaala? Gondera eddoboozi lye. Toyimirira kuwakana na magezi ga bantu, naye, nga Pawulo bwe yakola, golokoka ogende otandike omulimu Mukama wo gw'akulagira. Pawulo teyayimirira kwebuuza ku mubiri na musaayi. Teyayimirira kubala kye kyandimuwezezza, naye n'agenda mu maaso, so teyayimirira okutuusa lwe yatuuka ku nkomerero. Ekyo kwe kutambulira mu kitangaala—okugondera—so si kuyimirira awo ng'owakana ne Mukama ku kyo, so si kugamba nti, "Naye—" naye kukikola. Mikwano gyange, ne bwe wabaawo omuntu yenna abuulira Enjiri endala, ne bwe wabaawo ajja n'enjigiriza nti oyinza okukkirizibwa Katonda oba okuba omutukuvu ku mbeera endala yonna—ku bwa Kristo ne ku bw'emmeeme yo, tobakkiriza. Nga omutume Yokaana bw'agamba nti: "Omuntu yenna bw'ajja gye muli n'atareeta njigiriza eno, temumusembeza mu nnyumba yammwe so temumulamusa," — 2 Yokaana 1:10 Ogamba nti, "Naye ekyo kiweebwayo kya muwendo mungi." Kiri kityo, mu ngeri emu; naye bw'omala okusasula omuwendo, bw'omala okuwaayo ekiweebwayo, bw'oyingira mu kkubo, essanyu, ekitangaala, amaanyi, n'ekitiibwa biba bya muwendo emirundi kikumi okusinga. Waliwo omuntu yenna eyafuna Oluyinja olw'omuwendo omungi eyali awulira nti yakiwaayo ebisukkiridde, ne bwe yandiwaddeyo byonna bye yalina? Nedda n'akatono! Abaffiira okukkiriza n'abaatula okukkiriza beenyumiririzza mu kuba nakyo nga babonyaabonyezebwa ku bibonerezo ne mu muliro, era tewali kujulira n'okumu kwe wali owuliddeko nti omusajja oba omukazi wa Katonda yali alowooza nti yasasula omuwendo omungi ekisukkiridde. Nedda n'akatono! Oyagala okusaba kwo kuddibwemu? Eryo lye kkubo. Tambula omutima gwo gwennyini guleme kukusalira musango. Omwana omuwulize abeera mu bumu obw'okwagala ne muzadde we talina kutya kujja kusaba ebyenkizo. Amanyi nti anaabifuna. Omutima gwe gwennyini tegumusalira musango. "Abaagalwa, emitima gyaffe bwe gitatusalira musango, tuba n'obuvumu mu maaso ga Katonda;" — 1 Yokaana 3:21 Nsomooza omuntu yenna okwawula obuvumu n'obuwulize. Bw'otoobe muwulize, toyinza kuba na buvumu. Nsomooza Omukristaayo yenna wano okuŋŋamba nti asobola okulinnya ku ntebe ya Katonda mu kukkiriza olw'omukisa gwonna songa omutima gwe gwennyini gumusalira omusango. Amanyi nti tasobola. Asooka kuggibwako mbeera eyo ey'okusalirwa omusango nga tannaba kukozesa kukkiriza olw'omukisa gwonna. Tambulira mu kitangaala, olwo onaaba n'obumu naye, era omusaayi gwe gunaakunaaza okuva mu kibi kyonna, era Omwoyo anaakuyigiriza engeri y'okusaba ne ky'osaba, ekibiina ekinene eky'Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo kye batamanyako kintu na kimu. Ate era, okukulembera, okuyigiriza, n'okukubiriza kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mbeera eddako ku kusaba okw'amaanyi. Tuyinza okuyita embeera zino olujegere olw'ennyunga nnya, oluyunga emmeeme zaffe n'omutima gwennyini ogwa Katonda. Ekisooka, obumu ne Yesu; ekyokubiri, obuwulize eri ebiragiro bye, okutambulira mu kitangaala; ekyokusatu, okwegayiririra kw'Omwoyo abeera munda; n'ekyokuna, okukozesa okukkiriza. Bw'obulwa ennyunga yonna emu ku zino, okusaba kwo kufaafaaganye. Oyinza okuba n'endala zonna essatu, naye bw'obulwa emu, tojja kufuna kuddibwamu. Kunaasala okussa kimu, era tewaabe kuddibwamu. Ntya nti Abakristaayo bangi abeeyita bwe batyo tebamanyi Omwoyo ow'okwegayiririra kye gutegeeza. Tebalina kye bamanyi ku Omwoyo okubeegayiririra n'okusinda okutayogerekeka. Bwe tunaafuna Omwoyo ono ow'okusaba okw'okwegayiririra mu bazadde, tunaalaba abaana ab'omwoyo bangi nga bazaalibwa. Kaakano, Omwoyo Omutukuvu wano agamba nti tetumanyi kye tusaba nga bwe kitugwanira okuggyako ng'Omwoyo ayigiriza; noolwekyo abantu bulijjo, nga Yakobo bw'agamba, basaba ne batafuna, kubanga basaba obubi. "Musaba ne mutafuna, kubanga musaba obubi, mulyoke mukikozese ku kwegomba kwammwe." — Yakobo 4:3 Ekyo kitegeeza okwegomba kwammwe okw'ensi, okwagala kwammwe, n'ebigendererwa byammwe, ebikomekkerezebwa ensalo y'ensi. Kaakano, nkkiriza nti eno ye nsonga enkulu lwaki enkumi n'enkumi z'Abakristaayo basaba ne batafuna kuddibwamu n'akatono. Beefaako bokka mu kusaba kwabwe; bo ba nsi; basaba obubi, balyoke bakikozese ku kwegomba kwabwe okw'ensi, okwagala kwabwe, n'obuteego bwabwe obw'obuzaalirwa. Bamaama bambuulira nti baasabira abaana baabwe emyaka mingi ne batafuna na omu ku bo eyakyusibwa. Ŋŋamba nti, "Kya nnaku nnyo; nsonyi nnyo gy'oli." Lwaki? Kubanga baasaba okusaba kw'okwefaako bokka, okw'obuzaalirwa, kubanga baali baana baabwe, oba kubanga baali baagala babeere ab'eddiini baleme kugwa mu kibi oba okuleeta ensonyi oba okunyolwa ku maka, oba kubanga kyandibadde kirungi okubaba ab'eddiini. Naye tebaagala kubeera batuukirivu nnyo; tebaagala kubeera nga beewaddeyo eri Katonda okutuusa okusalako obutaliimu n'obusiru bw'ensi eno ne beewaayo mu bujjuvu eri Kristo—ekyo kingi nnyo; baagala eddiini emala okubafuula essanyu lyabwe bo. Wandiziremu okusaba ng'okwo singa wali Katonda? Okusaba amakumi n'enkumi kuweebwayo buli lunaku okutagenda mu buziba wadde waggulu okusinga ekyo, singa ebigendererwa byakebeddwa—era Omwoyo Omutukuvu abikebera. Ntya nti abakyala bangi basabira babbaabwe mu ngeri y'emu. Tebeeraliikirira nti babbaabwe bali mu bujeemu eri Katonda, nga bayonoona obudde bwabwe, ebirabo byabwe, n'ensimbi zaabwe, era nga banyaga obwakabaka bwa Yesu Kristo ku ebyo bye bandibukoledde. Ekibanyolayo kwe kuba nti, singa baali ba ddiini, bandimaze obudde obungi ennyo eka; nti bayonoona ensimbi mu kifo ky'okuziterekera abaana; era nti singa baali ba ddiini, bino byonna byandirongooseddwa. Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, Katonda taaddemu okusaba kw'omukyala oyo ku lwa bba! Oteekwa okulowooza ku bba ky'ayinza okuba eri Katonda—ky'ayinza okukola ku bwakabaka bwa Katonda—nga Yesu Kristo bwe yamuyiwako omusaayi gwe—nga obulamu obw'ekibi bwe buswaza Katonda; era oteekwa okulowoozako kino okutuusa omutima gwo lwe gunaaba ompi n'okumenyeka, era onoofuna bba nga akyusiddwa mu bwangu, bw'onookolera n'amagezi awamu n'okusaba kwo. Katonda akyawa okwefaako wekka—okwefaako wekka gwe mulabe, ye ngeri gy'atuulamu ddala. Oteekwa okuva mu ggwe wennyini; oteekwa okutunuulira omwana wo bulijjo nga wa Katonda, ng'alina emmeeme ey'omuwendo eyanunulibwa n'omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw'omuwendo, era ng'alina ebirabo n'obusobozi okumugulumiza n'okusaasaanya obwakabaka bwe; era oteekwa okussa okusaba kwo ku ekyo n'ogamba nti, "Nnandisinze okubagalaamiza mu ntaana emirundi lukumi—nnandisinze babe abaavu era abanyoomebwa—okusinga bakule ne bakuswaza." Olwo onoofuna okusaba kwo nga kuddiddwamu! Abantu basabira ebyamaguzi byabwe. Katonda alaba nti engeri y'okuzikiriza omuntu oyo kwe kumuleka n'awangula. Taaga sente okusobola okutwala omulimu gwe mu maaso. Katonda alaba nti okugaggawala kwandiridde emmeeme ye ng'endwadde, kyava atamuleka kuwangula. Omwoyo wa Katonda takulembera mmeeme kutuuka ku kusaba okw'okwefaako wekka. Nedda; akulembera emmeeme okukaaba kubanga abantu tebakwata mateeka ge, okukaaba ku by'enfuna bye okusinga ebibye. Yeetegese ennyumba yaayo okusigala nga njereere, singa ekyo kinaayamba okusaasaana kw'obwakabaka bwa Katonda. Yeetegese enkazaluggya okuzuula ekisu ku kyoto kyayo, singa mu ekyo eyinza okuddaabiriza n'okugulumiza ekyoto kya Yakuwa. Olwo eno ennyunga esembayo—okukkiriza. Wano waliwo ekyama ekirala. Tewali mukkiriza asobola okukozesa okukkiriza olw'ekintu kyonna Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'atamutuusaako. Oyinza okusaba, n'osaba, naye tojja kukozesa kukkiriza okutuusa lw'onoobeera n'Omwoyo ng'akwegayiririramu. Waliwo obuzibu butono nnyo mu kukkiriza eri abantu abaakutte amatambula asatu agaakulembera. Abo abali mu bumu ne Yesu, abo abatambulira mu kitangaala, abo abalina Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'Omwoyo ow'okwegayiririra—bamanyi kye basaba; bamanyi endowooza y'Omwoyo bw'eri; bamanyi engeri Omwoyo gy'abakulemberamu, era basobola okutambula okulinnya ku ntebe ne "basaba ne bafuna." Bamanyi nti okusaba kwabwe kuli ng'endowooza ya Katonda bw'eri, era basobola okumeguza, bwe kiba kyetaagisa, ng'omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki, singa asiima okugezesa okukkiriza kwabwe. Taddamu bulijjo mangu ago. Abaleka okumeguza n'okusinda okutayogerekeka; naye bamanyi nti Omwoyo abeegayiririra, era banywerera oluusi wakati mu kuggwaamu amaanyi okunene n'okukemebwa okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja. Bafuna obukakafu obw'okukkiriza, obugamba nti, "Weewaawo, kinaakolebwa." Abantu babatunuulira n'okwewuunya. Mikwano gy'Abakristaayo bamanyi nti ekintu kye basaba tekinnajja, ne bagamba nti, "Olabika ng'osanyuse ng'eyo okifunye;" "Mfunye omusingo; mmanyi nti kijja; nnina obukakafu nti kinaakolebwa." Kaakano, buli muzadde asaba asaanidde okumeguza okutuusa ekyo lwe kifunibwa ku buli mwana. Tosaana kulekaayo okutuusa olwo, olwo n'otendeka era n'osaba—okolere awamu ne Katonda: eryo lye tteeka ery'obwakabaka, okutuuka ku nkomerero. Kkiriza nti okifuna, era onaakifuna. Obutabanguko, okutabuka okuliwo, mu kukwatagana n'emmeeme enaku ku kifo ekyo. Abantu bagamba nti, "Kkiriza nti olokolebwa, era olokolebwa." Mpulidde Abakristaayo nga bawa emmeeme okubuulirira okwo emirundi mingi. "Kkiriza nti olokolebwa, era olokolebwa." Kkiriza obulimba, era bunaatuukirira. Eyo ye nfumiiriza ya Katonda? Kigasa ki okugamba omuntu okukkiriza nti alokolebwa nga tannalokolebwa? Ekyo kwe kumugamba akkirize obulimba. Abantu bagamba nti, "Kkiriza nti otukuziddwa, era otukuziddwa." Mazima ddala! Watukuzibwa ddi? Katonda tagamba muntu kukkiriza kintu okutuusa lwe kibaawo. Yafuula okuweebwa kw'ekirabo okubeera awamu n'okukozesa okukkiriza mu kiseera kye kimu. Kkiriza nti ofuna, era onaafuna—so si nti wafuna essaawa emu emabega, kubanga ekyo tekyandibadde kya mazima; so si nti onoofuna essaawa emu okuva kaakano, kubanga ekyo kyandibadde kwewaana. Tewali kisuubizo kya ngeri eyo, naye kkiriza nti kaakano ofuna, era onaafuna. "Siriswaza muntu yenna avuma okunneesiga okutuuka ku kigero ekyo." Banaakifuna. Ogamba nti ekiseera ky'ebyamagero kiyise. Weewaawo, kubanga ekiseera ky'okukkiriza okw'engeri eyo kiyise. Onoddizibwa ebyamagero ng'okukkiriza okw'engeri eyo kudda. Katonda yeesibye ku kukkiriza kw'abantu be ab'amazima, era yandisoose okumenya amateeka gonna ag'obutonde okusinga okumenya amateeka ag'ekisa. Ayinza mangu okuggyawo etteeka ery'obutonde; naye taaggyewo tteeka lya kisa. Yeesibye ku kukkiriza—amaanyi gokka mu bwengula ge yeesibyeko—era tewali n'omu yali agolokose mu nsi eno n'agamba nti, "Nneesiga Katonda, n'annimba." Okukkiriza kitegeeza okwesiga—okukkiriza kitegeeza okwewaayo—ng'eyo ofa, nga tolina kirala kisigadde okuggyako ekisuubizo kya Katonda kyokka. Ogamba nti, "Ndi kufa; nteekwa okwesiga kaakano," era omuntu oyo abuuka ku kisuubizo. Baleka okugezesa, ne beesiga ddala; era olabye ekitangaala nga kijja mu maaso gaabwe; owulidde oluyimba olw'ettendo nga lubwatuka okuva ku mimwa gyabwe, kubanga baakkiriza nti bafunye, era baafuna. Kaakano, abamu ku mmwe abampandiikidde mumanyi nti mubeera mu bumu ne Yesu. Abamu ku mmwe gye buvuddeko mwatandika okutambulira mu kitangaala. Mwasalako ne muggyawo bakatonda abakole n'emikono; mweewaddeyo eri okwagala kwa Katonda, ne musuubiza, ku bw'ekisa kye, nti munaamugoberera olugendo lwonna. Muwulira nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu mmwe. Mbeegayiridde okuwulira mu bujjuvu, okuleka Omwoyo okukola nga bw'ayagala. Temumuziyiza. Temulowooza nti kinaalumya emibiri gyammwe; temulowooza nti kingi nnyo; temulowooza nti mufuuka ba busungu bw'eddiini obw'ekitalo; temulowooza nti, ekya mazima, Katonda tayagala kika kya kintu kino—mugoberere Omwoyo. Muleke Omwoyo abakulembere, era asinde ng'ayita mu mmwe; muleke Omwoyo ameguze ne Katonda ng'ayita mu mmwe—mumugoberere. Singa twali tulina bino bingi mu nkuŋŋaana zino, twandibadde n'ebibala bingi; era singa ekkanisa yali erina bino bingi, wandibaddewo emmeeme nnyingi ezaazaalibwa mu bwakabaka. Kimu ku bintu bye nanakuwaza Omwoyo wa Katonda mu nnaku zange ez'olubereberye kwe kuba nti saamuleka, okutuuka ku kigero ky'ayandinkoze, okunfuula omukazi ow'okusaba; ate, bwe twegeraageranya n'abangi, oboolyawo, nnali omu ku bo. Yatera okuteeka abantu ab'enjawulo n'ensonga ez'enjawulo ku mutima gwange, ne siyinza kwerema kusaba; naye nga bwe nejjusizza n'obulumi n'okukaabira mu maaso ga Mukama kubanga saamuleka kunkolako nga bw'ayagala mu nsonga eno. Weekuume! nammwe abo b'atandika okukulembera, mumuleke abakulembere. Muyiwe emmeeme zammwe ku lw'abalala era awamu n'abalala. Nkkiriza nti emmeeme nnyingi zikkirizibwa mu kusaba okwa nnamaddala okusinga mu kwogera. Kino nkirabye emirundi mingi. Nnalaba wansi w'ekizimbe ekinene oba etiyeeta, oba mu galale, abasajja abasingira ddala obukambwe bwe wandirowoozezza, nga beeyisa mu ngeri esingira ddala obutasaana, nga bakwatiddwa amaanyi g'okusaba. Oboolyawo, akasaasamalo bwe kaali ku ntandikwa y'okumenyeka mu kuvuruguta okw'olwatu, omukazi omutono ayanjuluzza emikono gye ku kibiina, n'agamba nti, "Kaakano, ka tusabe"; ne ndaba ekibiina ky'abasajja kyonna nga kifuna embeera ey'obusirifu n'okussaamu ekitiibwa. Nnatunuulira endabika y'ekibiina, ne ndaba abasajja abanene, abakambwe, ab'ebyenyi ebiddugavu nga bakutamya emitwe gyabwe, oluusi ne basiimuula amaaso gaabwe; era bwe twagolokoka okuyimba, tewaali kwesooza kulala, wabula baatereera n'obuzito bw'okufa, okuwuliriza. Ebikumi ku bo baakakasibwa ekibi nga bakyali wansi w'okusaba okwo. Yali Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'ameguza olw'emmeeme ezo mu mutima gw'omukazi oyo ekyabakuba n'okukakasibwa. Okusaba kwe kubonaabona kw'emmeeme—okumeguza kw'Omwoyo. Omanyi engeri abasajja n'abakazi gye bakwataganamu bwe baba mu kwesunga okw'amaanyi ennyo ekintu kikolebwe. Okwo kwe kusaba, kibe eri abantu oba eri Katonda; era bw'onoofuna omutima gwo nga gukwatiddwa, ne gusaanuuka, ne guleetebwa mu kunyiiga, ne gutikkibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku lw'emmeeme, onooba n'amaanyi, era tojja kusaba wabula waaliwo anaakakasibwa—amaaso ag'emmeeme enaku agakwafu ganaazibulwa, era obulamu obw'omwoyo bunaatandika.

fields.title: Omutima Ogutuukiridde
fields.body_html:
“Kubanga amaaso ga Mukama gatunula wonna mu nsi yonna, okwoleka amaanyi ge eri abo abalina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali.” — 2 Ebyomumirembe 16:9 Ebigambo bino biva mu byafaayo bya Asa, omu ku bakabaka abaatya Katonda era abeewaayo ennyo abaali batudde ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka bwa Yuda. Mu ssuula ey'ekkumi n'ena tubuulirwa nti yatandika obufuzi bwe ng'amaliridde okuzikiriza okusinza ebifaananyi eggwanga lyonna kwe lyali liyingiziddwa omufuzi eyakulembera, n'okuzzaawo okusinza n'okuweereza Katonda wa Isirayiri. Yateekamu amaanyi okukomyawo eggwanga eri obwesigwa n'obuwulize eri Katonda; era obuwanguzi bwe kya kuzzaamu nnyo amaanyi eri buli muntu yenna anaamalirira, yekka era n'omutima ogutuukiridde eri Katonda, okukola kino mu kibiina kyonna, mu mbeera yonna.

Yawangula. Katonda yamuwa omukisa mu kufuba kwe okulongoosa obwakabaka bwe munda, era Katonda n'amuwonya abalabe be ab'ebweru, n'amusobozesa olw'amaanyi ge okuwangula kabaka wa Buwesiyopya, eyajja okumulwanyisa n'eggye eddene ennyo, kubanga Kabaka Asa yalina omutima ogutuukiridde eri Katonda.

Kabaka ono bwe yajja okumulwanyisa, Asa n'agenda n'akaabira Mukama, ne yeewaayo eri Katonda we, ng'amwesiga okumuwonya; era Katonda teyaswaza muntu n'omu, oba nga ye ku mirembe egya Asa oba oluvannyuma, eyakola bw'atyo. Katonda yagabula abalabe be mu mukono gwe, n'amufuula kabaka eyawangula era eyasanyuka ku bantu abaali bagaggawala era abeeyongera obungi.

Naye oluvannyuma, nga wayiseewo emyaka mingi—kubanga Asa yalina omutima ogutuukiridde eri Mukama okumala emyaka mingi egy'obufuzi bwe obuwanvu—oba nga kyali, nga bwe kitera okubaawo, nti obulamu obw'okuwummula n'obugagga ne bireeta mu Asa ebibi eby'okudda ennyuma mu kitundu, tetumanyi; naye nga emyaka gigenda mu maaso, olutalo olulala ne lulangibwa, era ku mulundi guno kabaka wa Isirayiri ye yajja okulwanyisa kabaka wa Yuda. Asa yakola ki? Yagenda, nga bwe yakola olubereberye, n'akaabira Mukama, n'ateeka olutalo lwe mu mikono gye? Nedda, teyakola bw'atyo. Yali aleseeyo okwagala kwe okusooka; yali afuuse, mu kigero, atali mwesigwa eri Mukama Katonda wa Isirayiri. Yeerabira amaanyi ge gye gaali; okutegeera kwe okw'omwoyo kwali kuziyaaziye; yali afiiriddwa okutegeera obusobozi bwa Katonda okumuyamba n'okumuwonya mu mikono gy'abalabe be, bw'atyo n'addira ku nkola ez'ensi. Yaserengeta e Busuuli n'ayooya Benikadadi, kabaka wa Busuuli, n'agamba nti, “Jjangu ompolereze, abalabe bange baveeko, kubanga nnyigirizibwa nnyo.” Nga bwe kifaananyi kya bantu abadda ennyuma!

Ku mulundi omulala, Yekosafaati bwe yakola endagaano etaali ya butukuvu, nnabbi n'amusisinkana n'amugamba nti, “Osaana okuyamba omukozi w'ebibi, n'okwagala abo abakyawa Mukama?” Tewali muntu eyakola kino awatali kukangavvulwa nnyo, nga Asa omunaku bwe yakangavvulwa. Ddala yawangula mu lutalo, n'afuna obuwanguzi.

Kyali kigendererwa kya mateeka, naye yakituukiriza mu ngeri etaali ya mateeka. Yafuna obuwanguzi, era nvumirira okugamba nti, yali yeeyagaza era yeekuluukuutira ekirevu kye mu kwematamu nga, laba! nnabbi n'ajja okumuweereza obubaka bwa Katonda, n'agamba nti: “Kubanga weesiga kabaka wa Busuuli, so teweesiga Mukama Katonda wo, eggye lya kabaka wa Busuuli kyeryava likudduka.

Abayesiyopya n'Abaluubi tebaali ggye ddene, nga balina amagaali n'abeebagala embalaasi abangi nnyo? Naye kubanga weesiga Mukama, yabagabula mu mukono gwo.

Kubanga amaaso ga Mukama gatunula wonna mu nsi yonna, okwoleka amaanyi ge eri abo abalina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali. Okoze kya busirusiru mu kino, kubanga okuva kaakano onoobanga n'entalo” — 2 Ebyomumirembe 16:7-9 —ekintu kyekimu kye yagenda e Busuuli okugezaako okwewala. Yayagala emirembe, so si lutalo, n'aserengeta e Busuuli asobole okumala ennaku ze ezaali zisigadde mu mirembe nga, laba! Ekigambo kya Katonda ne kifuluma nti, “Onoobanga n'entalo.” Yakangavvulwa mu kintu kyekimu kye yeetunda ye ne Katonda we. “Manya nga ekibi kyo kirikuzuula.” Eno ye ngeri ya Katonda ey'okukangavvula abaana be ng'ayita mu bintu byebimu mwe batunda ebirungi bye. “Onoobanga n'entalo.”

Naye twagala okwogera ku ky'enjawulo ku kyokuyigira nnabbi kye aggya mu kintu kino; kubanga agamba nti, “Lwaki wagenda e Busuuli? Lwaki wayonoona eri Katonda? Weerabidde ani gwe yali Katonda wa Isirayiri? Tewamanya nti amaaso ga Mukama gatunula mu nsi yonna?”

Yandikuyambye kaakano, ggwe Asa, nga bwe yakuyamba mu biseera eby'edda. Ajja kuyamba buli muntu yenna alina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali—amwesiga. Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, kino kye kyokuyigira nnabbi ky'aggyayo, si Asa yekka, naye ne ba Asa bonna okuva ku mirembe gye, n'abo abakyaliyo okujja, eri buli musajja na buli mukazi eyeeyita omuweereza wa Katonda; nnabbi awuluguma okuyita mu mirembe gyonna nti “amaaso ga Mukama gatunula wonna mu nsi yonna, okwoleka amaanyi ge eri abo abalina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali.”

Kaakano, omutima guno ogutuukiridde gwe guluwa? “Ah!” ogamba nti, “ekyo kye kigambo ekikulu.” Yee, ekyo kye kigambo ekikulu, era tujja kugezaako okulaga omutima guno bwe guli. Guteekwa okuba omutima ogw'enjawulo ku mitima egya bulijjo; emitima gyonna tegituukiridde eri Katonda, kubanga singa gyali, amaaso ge gandutaddewo okutunula wonna mu nsi okuginoonya. Gyandibadde mingi bwe gyandibadde emitima egya bulijjo, naye kirabika lwatu nti gy'emitima egy'enjawulo ku mitima egya bulijjo; era ekintu ekirala kirabika lwatu mu bigambo bino, nti omutima ogw'engeri eno gwa muwendo nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda.

Agusanyukira; assaamu omuntu omu ow'omutima ogwo ekitiibwa okusinga enkumi n'enkumi ez'emitima egy'engeri endala, egiri mingi nnyo. Ŋŋamba nti, ebyokuyigira bino ebibiri buli muntu alina amagezi ag'obutonde ajja kubikkiriza mangu ago—nti emitima gino si mitima gya bulijjo, era nti gya muwendo nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda.

Kaakano, amakulu g'ekigambo kino “omutima ogutuukiridde,” nga kyogera ku mitima gy'abaana ba Katonda okuyita mu Baibuli yonna, ge gaki? Nga bw'omanyi, njagala okunyweza ebigambo byange mu kamwa k'abajulizi babiri oba basatu, nzija kukuwa ebyawandiikibwa bibiri oba bisatu, tusobole okuzuula amakulu Katonda g'ateeka mu kigambo kino, olwo tujja kukuwa amakulu agasingayo obuwansi, gonna gye gakkiriziganya, kubanga sagala mpaka. Ka tutunuulire Zabbuli 37:37: “Tunuulira omuntu atuukiridde, olabe omugolokofu, kubanga waliwo enkomerero eri omuntu ow'emirembe.” — Zabbuli 37:37 Waliwo abantu ng'abo Katonda b'ayogerako mu lunyiriri luli.

“balyoke balase mu kyama oyo atuukiridde,” — Zabbuli 64:4 abaabeera bulijjo ekigendererwa Setaani ky'ayagala okulasa. Talasa nnyo abantu abalina emitima egitatuukiridde eri Mukama. Abantu abo abatuukiridde b'alasa.

“nga bamulasa mbagirawo awatali kutya.” — Zabbuli 64:4 oboolyawo ng'akyalowooza nti be mikwano gye.

“Kale mubeere abatuukiridde, nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw'ali omutuukiridde.” — Matayo 5:48 Ekyo kitegeeza ekintu. Tujja kugezaako okuzuula kye kitegeeza.

“Yesu n'amugamba nti, 'Bw'oba ng'oyagala okuba omutuukiridde, genda otunde by'olina obiwe abaavu, olibeera n'obugagga mu ggulu; era jjangu ongoberere.'” — Matayo 19:21 Ate era, mu 1 Abakkolinso 2:6— “Naye mu abo abakuze twogera amagezi,” — 1 Abakkolinso 2:6 Ne mu 2 Timoseewo 3:17— “omuntu wa Katonda alyoke abe omutuukiridde, ng'atendekeddwa okukola buli mulimu omulungi.” — 2 Timoseewo 3:17 Waliwo n'ebirala bingi, naye bino bye byokulabirako, era ndowooza nti Abakristaayo bonna bassaawo amakulu agamu mu bigambo bino. Biteekwa okuba ebigambo ebiraga enjawulo ennene wakati w'abantu aboogerwako n'abasajja n'abakazi aba bulijjo. Kaakano, bitegeeza ki? Kale, amakulu agasingayo obuwansi ag'abayivu bonna n'amasomero gonna ge gano, nti bitegeeza obwesimbu n'obumalirivu. Kale, ekyo kye njagala kyokka. Mpa omuntu omwesimbu era omumalirivu mu kwagala kwe, era ekyo kye njagala kyokka; ekyo kirituuka mu bitundu byonna eby'obulamu bwe; kirituuka ku nkomerero z'engalo ze n'ebigere bye, okuyita mu maaso ge, n'okuyita mu lulimi lwe, eri munne ow'omu maka, n'eri ab'omu maka ge, eri edduuka lye, n'eri emirimu gye, n'eri ekibiina kye mu nsi. Ekyo kye ntegeeza obutukuvu! Kale, nga tuddira enkyusa esingayo obuwansi, kitegeeza nti omuntu alina omutima ogutuukiridde mu kwagala, era omumalirivu ddala mu buweereza! Amiina. Kubanga omuntu oyo atuukiridde bw'atyo eri Katonda, Katonda ddala ajja kweraga nga wa maanyi mu ngeri ez'enjawulo!

Kino tekiyinza kutegeeza mutima gwa butonde bwokka; guteekwa okutegeeza omutima omuzze obuggya, kubanga tewali mitima mituukiridde mu butonde. Mu ngeri eno tewali n'omu akola obulungi n'atayonoona, kubanga buli mwana wa Adamu abuze ng'endiga ebuze, akoze ebintu bye yali tasaanidde kukola, n'aleka ebintu bye yali asaanidde okukola nga tabikoze, era ensi yonna efuuse eyazza omusango mu maaso ga Katonda.

Tewali mitima mituukiridde mu butonde. Kale, guteekwa okutegeeza omutima ogwazzibwa obuggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ogutereezeddwa ne Katonda, olwo ne gukuumibwa nga gutuukiridde. Omutima teguyinza kukuumibwa nga gutuukiridde okutuusa nga gumaze okutereezebwa, era ekyo kye kyama ky'okugwa kwa abamu ku mmwe. Mugezaako okubala ebibala nga omuti tennasimbibwa. Munoonya ebibala eby'omutima ogutuukiridde nga temunnaba kufuna gumu. Muyinza okumalibwa amaanyi. Muteekwa okuzzibwa omutima gwammwe obuggya, olwo ne gukuumibwa nga gutuukiridde olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Kale, omutima guno ogutuukiridde gutegeeza ki?

1. Omutima ogutuukiridde mu bwesigwa bwagwo eri Katonda, ogwewaddeyo ddala eri oludda lwa Katonda, awatali kutunuulira bivaamu—omwesigwa. Gino gy'emitima Katonda gy'ayagala. Guno gwe gwali enjawulo wakati wa Dawudi ne Sawulo. Tewaali njawulo nnene mu kitundu ekisinga eky'obulamu bwa Sawulo obw'okungulu bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n'obulamu bwa Dawudi. Oboolyawo nnabbi Samwiri yekka ye yamanya enjawulo, n'abalala batono abaali beetegereza obulungi; naye enjawulo yali nti Dawudi yali mwesigwa eri Katonda, era Katonda kyeyava amuyita, olw'ensonga eno, omusajja eyeeyagalibwa omutima gwe.

Okuva ku kuyitibwa kwa Dawudi okusooka okumuggya mu bisibo by'endiga, okutuusa ku nkomerero, okuggyako omulundi gumu oba ebiri, mu bulamu bwe bwonna, yali mwesigwa eri Katonda; era bw'onoonoonya obulungi ebyafaayo bye, ojja kuzuula nti mu ntalo ze zonna, ne mu bikolwa bye byonna n'amawanga agaali gamwetoolodde, ne n'abakulembeze b'ebintu mu bwakabaka bwe—mu buli kimu, Dawudi yali mwesigwa eri Katonda. Ebyagasa obwakabaka bwa Katonda bye byali ku mutima gwa Dawudi—so si kitiibwa kye ye, oba okuwummula, oba okukulaakulana kwe—so si ttutumu lye oba obugagga bwe, oba okwezimbira ennyumba—ennyumba ya Katonda we ye yali ey'omuwendo eri omutima gwe. Yali mwesigwa; ate Sawulo yali mwesigwa okutuusa awo we kyamugasira ebigendererwa n'ebyamuganyulanga byokka. Ah! Ba Sawulo ng'abo bameka mu nnaku zino. Amateeka ga Katonda bwe gaawakana n'endowooza ze, yanyooma Katonda mu lwatu n'akola nga bwe yayagala. Yawaayo ebyagasa Katonda ku lw'ebibye. Yali atali mwesigwa mu mutima, kyeyava aba mulyi wa lukwe, era teyayinza kuyiga kkubo lya Mukama. Teyabeera mutuukiridde eri Mukama Katonda we, era oluvannyuma, Katonda n'amugoba, ne Samwiri n'amugoba, era omanyi enkomerero ye bwe yali. Kwe kwawukana kwa boobabiri—omwesigwa n'atali mwesigwa.

Omutima ogutuukiridde eri Katonda! Kitegeeza ki? Kitegeeza— 2. Okutuukirira mu buwulize bwagwo. Omusajja oba omukazi alina omutima ogw'engeri eno alekeraawo okulonda mu mateeka ga Katonda, ge banaagondera ne ge batagenda kugondera—balekeraawo okuba n'okwagala kwabwe, wadde nga oluusi bayinza okulwana n'okwagala kwabwe, era ekkubo Katonda ly'ayinza okubayita okukwata liyinza okulabika gye bali ng'ekkubo ery'akabi, era bayinza okulinda katono okumala okumatizibwa ddala; naye bwe bamala okumatizibwa nti kkubo lya Katonda, omwana ow'amazima taasaasaanenga. Tebeebuuza ku mubiri na musaayi, naye beeyongera mu maaso, awatali kutunuulira bivaamu. Buno bwe bwali obuwulize bwa Pawulo. Teyeebuuza ku mubiri na musaayi; yabala ebintu byonna ng'ebisasiro n'okufaafaaganirwa, era yeeyongera okukola bw'atyo okutuusa ku nkomerero—omumalirivu mu buwulize bwe.

Abantu bajja gye tuli nga baagala okumanya kye basaanidde okukola; bawulira nti balina omutima ogw'ekitundu kyokka mu buweereza bwa Katonda; tebalina ssanyu wadde maanyi, ne bagamba nti, “Nsaanidde kukola ki?” era tuddira, nga Katonda bw'atuyamba, akambe akasala, ne tugezaako okuzuula ekizibu. Tubassa wansi w'ekitangaala eky'omuliro ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne tugezaako okubakebera ne tuzuula we bakyamiye. Oboolyawo Mukama atutwala ku kifo ekirumi, ne twoleka ekizibu, naye mu kifo ky'okugondera, beekweka.

Batunula mu maaso, ne balaba nti okugondera ekitangaala kirimu okufiirwa okw'engeri emu—oboolyawo erinnya, obugagga, enkolagana n'ab'omu maka, okuwummula, oba okufiirwa emikwano, okufiirwa ebibaweweeza eby'ekiseera, okufiirwa emirimu emirungi. Okufiirwa kuli emabega, era bakulaba. Bamanyi gye tubatwala, ne badda ennyuma; tebaagala kulaba, ate era tebaagala kweraba nga abatali beesigwa, kyebava bakyusa emitwe gyabwe ne batatunula mu ludda lw'ekitangaala, nga bakiweweeza ne bayimba nti— “Singa ensi yonna ey'obutonde yandibadde yange, Ekyo kyandibadde ekiweebwayo ekitono nnyo,” n'ebirala.

Ogwo si mutima gutuukiridde, wabula mutima gwa kitundu eri Mukama Katonda.

Omutima ogw'ekitundu, oguli mungi nnyo, eky'ennaku, mu nnaku zino, gwagala okuweereza Katonda katono. Gwetegese okugenda olugendo lutono ne Katonda, naye si lwonna; bwe kityo, nga tuddira amakulu agasingayo obuwansi, ogwo si mutima gutuukiridde eri Mukama. Kiyinza okusuubirwa nti Mukama yandeeragidde amaanyi ge ku lw'abantu ng'abo? Olowooza nga wandikoze bw'otyo singa wali Katonda?

Ka tugambe nti wali kabaka, ng'olina omulangira oba omukungu eyakuweerezanga n'obuvumu n'obwemalirivu bungi ng'ate byemuganyula; naye ka tugambe nti embeera yakyuka, ggwe n'oggyibwa ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka n'osindikibwa mu buwaŋŋanguse, erinnya lyo nga lisuulibwa mu ggwanga mwe wafugira nga kabaka mu buswavu n'obuvumazi; ka tugambe nti omukungu ono yakuleka n'agamba nti, “Oh! Nzija kubeera ku ludda lwa kabaka afuga. Nnali neemalidde nnyo eri omusajja ono ng'akyafuga, naye siyinza kusigala nga neemalidde gy'ali kaakano ng'ebimuganyula bikulukuse mu nfuufu; nteekwa okubeera ku ludda oluwangula.”

Wandiroowoozezza otya ku musajja ng'oyo? Era singa wazzibwa mu bwakabaka bwo n'obuyinza, wandeeragidde amaanyi go ku lw'omusajja ng'oyo? Nedda; wandijjukidde, nga Dawudi bwe yakola, omusajja eyakukolimira. Naye singa wali n'omulangira oba omukungu eyakugoberera mu buwaŋŋanguse, eyakuweereza mu kyama, eyagezaako okuwanirira ebikuganyula, eyalwanirira obutuukirivu bwo n'obwenkanya, n'awanirira erinnya lyo n'agezaako okulaga abantu nti wali musajja mulungi era ow'amazima, eyakunywerera ng'eggwanga lyonna likuyita omulyi wa lukwe—singa wakomawo ku ntebe yo ey'obwakabaka, tewandeeragidde amaanyi go ku lw'omusajja oyo? Mazima ddala wandikoze. Mukama agamba nti alyeeraga nga wa maanyi ku lw'abo ab'omutima ogwo gy'ali.

Mmwe bami abali wano mulina omuddu—omusajja omugezi era omukalabakalaba; mumanyi bw'ayinza okubaweereza obulungi, era bw'ayinza okuba ow'omugaso, era bw'andibadde singa yali ow'amazima; naye mulina ensonga okukkiriza nti anaagenda nammwe okutuusa awo we kinaamuganyulira ye yekka; anaabaweereza okutuusa awo we ayinza okwegasa, naye, bw'anaasobola okumumatiza ye ng'akussizza mmwe, muyinza okusigala awo mugalamidde. Wandigambye ki omusajja ng'oyo? Wandigambye nti, “Sirimwolekera maanyi n'akatono.” Bw'atyo Katonda tasuubirwa kweraga nga wa maanyi ku lw'abantu abatali ba mutima gutuukiridde. Omukazi omu yagamba gye ndi nti, “Mbadde nkola kino ne kiri okumala emyaka, naye sirina maanyi; lwaki sirina?” Ne mmuddamu nti, “Kubanga toli wa mazima eri Katonda. Anaagawa buli muntu yenna ali wa mazima gy'ali, era asobola okulaba mu mutima gwo, era amanyi nti toli.” Lwaki taakwolekere maanyi ku lulwo? Kubanga toolekere ye butiribiri ku lulwe. Amangu ddala lw'onoolaga ng'oli mumalirivu, mu kaseera ako lw'anaakwolekera amaanyi ge.

Singa wali mu kifo kya Danyeri, tewandikoze nga bwe yakola. Danyeri yali omu ku basajja ab'omutima ogutuukiridde; yaweereza Katonda we bwe yali mu kugaggawala. Yabikkulanga eddirisa lye buli lunaku.

Awo abalabe be ne basendasenda kabaka okuteeka etteeka nti tewaba muntu asaba omulala yenna wabula kabaka ono okumala ennaku eziwera. “Kaakano,” ne bagamba, “tujja kumukwata.” Naye Danyeri yakola nga bwe yali ayizeeko okukola; yagenda n'asaba nga eddirisa lye libikkuse. Ogamba nti, “Eryo lyali ddiini ery'okweraga, kwali kuyita mpaka. Kyali kyetaagisa ki okulaga bw'atyo; teyandisibye ddirisa n'ayingira mu kisenge eky'omunda? Ekyo kyali nga mmwe abantu ba Salvation Army, bulijjo mwagala okweraga. Lwaki teyayingira mu kisenge eky'omunda n'asaba?” Kubanga yali ayagala okuba omumalirivu ku lwa Katonda we mu kubonaabona, mu maaso g'abalabe be, nga bwe yali mu kugaggawala. Bw'atyo yagenda n'asaba nga eddirisa libikkuse eri Katonda w'Eggulu, era kubanga ye Katonda w'Eggulu, asobola okulabirira ababe. Omutima gwe gwali gutuukiridde eri Mukama Katonda we.

3. Omutima guno ogutuukiridde gutuukiridde mu kwesiga kwagwo:—era, oboolyawo, ekyo kyandisoose okujja, kubanga gwe muzi gwa byonna.

Ai, nga Ibulayimu bwe yali mulungi mu maaso ga Katonda; nga Katonda bwe yamwenyumiririzaamu. Mmanyi ntya nti Ibulayimu yalina omutima ogutuukiridde eri Katonda? Kubanga yamwesiga. Tewali bukakafu bulala—wadde obukakafu obutonotono—bwandibadde bwa mugaso. Nvumirira okugamba nti yali yeetooloddwa obunafu, yalina endowooza enkyamu nnyingi, eri abantu n'eri ensi, naye omutima gwe gwali gutuukiridde eri Katonda. Olowooza nti Katonda yandiremeddwa okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye eri Ibulayimu? Ibulayimu yamwesiga okumbi n'okutuusa ku musaayi gwa Isaaka, era Katonda ne yeeraga nga wa maanyi ku lulwe, n'amuwonya, n'amufuula kitaawe w'abeesigwa; n'amutikkira ekitiibwa eky'olubeerera, erinnya lye kyeryava, okuva mu mulembe okutuuka ku mulembe, libeera empagi ey'amaanyi eri abantu ba Mukama, n'engule ey'ekitiibwa eri Katonda we.
fields.body_text: "Kubanga amaaso ga Mukama gatunula wonna mu nsi yonna, okwoleka amaanyi ge eri abo abalina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali." — 2 Ebyomumirembe 16:9 Ebigambo bino biva mu byafaayo bya Asa, omu ku bakabaka abaatya Katonda era abeewaayo ennyo abaali batudde ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka bwa Yuda. Mu ssuula ey'ekkumi n'ena tubuulirwa nti yatandika obufuzi bwe ng'amaliridde okuzikiriza okusinza ebifaananyi eggwanga lyonna kwe lyali liyingiziddwa omufuzi eyakulembera, n'okuzzaawo okusinza n'okuweereza Katonda wa Isirayiri. Yateekamu amaanyi okukomyawo eggwanga eri obwesigwa n'obuwulize eri Katonda; era obuwanguzi bwe kya kuzzaamu nnyo amaanyi eri buli muntu yenna anaamalirira, yekka era n'omutima ogutuukiridde eri Katonda, okukola kino mu kibiina kyonna, mu mbeera yonna. Yawangula. Katonda yamuwa omukisa mu kufuba kwe okulongoosa obwakabaka bwe munda, era Katonda n'amuwonya abalabe be ab'ebweru, n'amusobozesa olw'amaanyi ge okuwangula kabaka wa Buwesiyopya, eyajja okumulwanyisa n'eggye eddene ennyo, kubanga Kabaka Asa yalina omutima ogutuukiridde eri Katonda. Kabaka ono bwe yajja okumulwanyisa, Asa n'agenda n'akaabira Mukama, ne yeewaayo eri Katonda we, ng'amwesiga okumuwonya; era Katonda teyaswaza muntu n'omu, oba nga ye ku mirembe egya Asa oba oluvannyuma, eyakola bw'atyo. Katonda yagabula abalabe be mu mukono gwe, n'amufuula kabaka eyawangula era eyasanyuka ku bantu abaali bagaggawala era abeeyongera obungi. Naye oluvannyuma, nga wayiseewo emyaka mingi—kubanga Asa yalina omutima ogutuukiridde eri Mukama okumala emyaka mingi egy'obufuzi bwe obuwanvu—oba nga kyali, nga bwe kitera okubaawo, nti obulamu obw'okuwummula n'obugagga ne bireeta mu Asa ebibi eby'okudda ennyuma mu kitundu, tetumanyi; naye nga emyaka gigenda mu maaso, olutalo olulala ne lulangibwa, era ku mulundi guno kabaka wa Isirayiri ye yajja okulwanyisa kabaka wa Yuda. Asa yakola ki? Yagenda, nga bwe yakola olubereberye, n'akaabira Mukama, n'ateeka olutalo lwe mu mikono gye? Nedda, teyakola bw'atyo. Yali aleseeyo okwagala kwe okusooka; yali afuuse, mu kigero, atali mwesigwa eri Mukama Katonda wa Isirayiri. Yeerabira amaanyi ge gye gaali; okutegeera kwe okw'omwoyo kwali kuziyaaziye; yali afiiriddwa okutegeera obusobozi bwa Katonda okumuyamba n'okumuwonya mu mikono gy'abalabe be, bw'atyo n'addira ku nkola ez'ensi. Yaserengeta e Busuuli n'ayooya Benikadadi, kabaka wa Busuuli, n'agamba nti, "Jjangu ompolereze, abalabe bange baveeko, kubanga nnyigirizibwa nnyo." Nga bwe kifaananyi kya bantu abadda ennyuma! Ku mulundi omulala, Yekosafaati bwe yakola endagaano etaali ya butukuvu, nnabbi n'amusisinkana n'amugamba nti, "Osaana okuyamba omukozi w'ebibi, n'okwagala abo abakyawa Mukama?" Tewali muntu eyakola kino awatali kukangavvulwa nnyo, nga Asa omunaku bwe yakangavvulwa. Ddala yawangula mu lutalo, n'afuna obuwanguzi. Kyali kigendererwa kya mateeka, naye yakituukiriza mu ngeri etaali ya mateeka. Yafuna obuwanguzi, era nvumirira okugamba nti, yali yeeyagaza era yeekuluukuutira ekirevu kye mu kwematamu nga, laba! nnabbi n'ajja okumuweereza obubaka bwa Katonda, n'agamba nti: "Kubanga weesiga kabaka wa Busuuli, so teweesiga Mukama Katonda wo, eggye lya kabaka wa Busuuli kyeryava likudduka. Abayesiyopya n'Abaluubi tebaali ggye ddene, nga balina amagaali n'abeebagala embalaasi abangi nnyo? Naye kubanga weesiga Mukama, yabagabula mu mukono gwo. Kubanga amaaso ga Mukama gatunula wonna mu nsi yonna, okwoleka amaanyi ge eri abo abalina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali. Okoze kya busirusiru mu kino, kubanga okuva kaakano onoobanga n'entalo" — 2 Ebyomumirembe 16:7-9 —ekintu kyekimu kye yagenda e Busuuli okugezaako okwewala. Yayagala emirembe, so si lutalo, n'aserengeta e Busuuli asobole okumala ennaku ze ezaali zisigadde mu mirembe nga, laba! Ekigambo kya Katonda ne kifuluma nti, "Onoobanga n'entalo." Yakangavvulwa mu kintu kyekimu kye yeetunda ye ne Katonda we. "Manya nga ekibi kyo kirikuzuula." Eno ye ngeri ya Katonda ey'okukangavvula abaana be ng'ayita mu bintu byebimu mwe batunda ebirungi bye. "Onoobanga n'entalo." Naye twagala okwogera ku ky'enjawulo ku kyokuyigira nnabbi kye aggya mu kintu kino; kubanga agamba nti, "Lwaki wagenda e Busuuli? Lwaki wayonoona eri Katonda? Weerabidde ani gwe yali Katonda wa Isirayiri? Tewamanya nti amaaso ga Mukama gatunula mu nsi yonna?" Yandikuyambye kaakano, ggwe Asa, nga bwe yakuyamba mu biseera eby'edda. Ajja kuyamba buli muntu yenna alina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali—amwesiga. Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, kino kye kyokuyigira nnabbi ky'aggyayo, si Asa yekka, naye ne ba Asa bonna okuva ku mirembe gye, n'abo abakyaliyo okujja, eri buli musajja na buli mukazi eyeeyita omuweereza wa Katonda; nnabbi awuluguma okuyita mu mirembe gyonna nti "amaaso ga Mukama gatunula wonna mu nsi yonna, okwoleka amaanyi ge eri abo abalina omutima ogutuukiridde gy'ali." Kaakano, omutima guno ogutuukiridde gwe guluwa? "Ah!" ogamba nti, "ekyo kye kigambo ekikulu." Yee, ekyo kye kigambo ekikulu, era tujja kugezaako okulaga omutima guno bwe guli. Guteekwa okuba omutima ogw'enjawulo ku mitima egya bulijjo; emitima gyonna tegituukiridde eri Katonda, kubanga singa gyali, amaaso ge gandutaddewo okutunula wonna mu nsi okuginoonya. Gyandibadde mingi bwe gyandibadde emitima egya bulijjo, naye kirabika lwatu nti gy'emitima egy'enjawulo ku mitima egya bulijjo; era ekintu ekirala kirabika lwatu mu bigambo bino, nti omutima ogw'engeri eno gwa muwendo nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda. Agusanyukira; assaamu omuntu omu ow'omutima ogwo ekitiibwa okusinga enkumi n'enkumi ez'emitima egy'engeri endala, egiri mingi nnyo. Ŋŋamba nti, ebyokuyigira bino ebibiri buli muntu alina amagezi ag'obutonde ajja kubikkiriza mangu ago—nti emitima gino si mitima gya bulijjo, era nti gya muwendo nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda. Kaakano, amakulu g'ekigambo kino "omutima ogutuukiridde," nga kyogera ku mitima gy'abaana ba Katonda okuyita mu Baibuli yonna, ge gaki? Nga bw'omanyi, njagala okunyweza ebigambo byange mu kamwa k'abajulizi babiri oba basatu, nzija kukuwa ebyawandiikibwa bibiri oba bisatu, tusobole okuzuula amakulu Katonda g'ateeka mu kigambo kino, olwo tujja kukuwa amakulu agasingayo obuwansi, gonna gye gakkiriziganya, kubanga sagala mpaka. Ka tutunuulire Zabbuli 37:37: "Tunuulira omuntu atuukiridde, olabe omugolokofu, kubanga waliwo enkomerero eri omuntu ow'emirembe." — Zabbuli 37:37 Waliwo abantu ng'abo Katonda b'ayogerako mu lunyiriri luli. "balyoke balase mu kyama oyo atuukiridde," — Zabbuli 64:4 abaabeera bulijjo ekigendererwa Setaani ky'ayagala okulasa. Talasa nnyo abantu abalina emitima egitatuukiridde eri Mukama. Abantu abo abatuukiridde b'alasa. "nga bamulasa mbagirawo awatali kutya." — Zabbuli 64:4 oboolyawo ng'akyalowooza nti be mikwano gye. "Kale mubeere abatuukiridde, nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw'ali omutuukiridde." — Matayo 5:48 Ekyo kitegeeza ekintu. Tujja kugezaako okuzuula kye kitegeeza. "Yesu n'amugamba nti, 'Bw'oba ng'oyagala okuba omutuukiridde, genda otunde by'olina obiwe abaavu, olibeera n'obugagga mu ggulu; era jjangu ongoberere.'" — Matayo 19:21 Ate era, mu 1 Abakkolinso 2:6— "Naye mu abo abakuze twogera amagezi," — 1 Abakkolinso 2:6 Ne mu 2 Timoseewo 3:17— "omuntu wa Katonda alyoke abe omutuukiridde, ng'atendekeddwa okukola buli mulimu omulungi." — 2 Timoseewo 3:17 Waliwo n'ebirala bingi, naye bino bye byokulabirako, era ndowooza nti Abakristaayo bonna bassaawo amakulu agamu mu bigambo bino. Biteekwa okuba ebigambo ebiraga enjawulo ennene wakati w'abantu aboogerwako n'abasajja n'abakazi aba bulijjo. Kaakano, bitegeeza ki? Kale, amakulu agasingayo obuwansi ag'abayivu bonna n'amasomero gonna ge gano, nti bitegeeza obwesimbu n'obumalirivu. Kale, ekyo kye njagala kyokka. Mpa omuntu omwesimbu era omumalirivu mu kwagala kwe, era ekyo kye njagala kyokka; ekyo kirituuka mu bitundu byonna eby'obulamu bwe; kirituuka ku nkomerero z'engalo ze n'ebigere bye, okuyita mu maaso ge, n'okuyita mu lulimi lwe, eri munne ow'omu maka, n'eri ab'omu maka ge, eri edduuka lye, n'eri emirimu gye, n'eri ekibiina kye mu nsi.
