fields.title: Ebyogerwa ku Butukuvu mu Exeter Hall (Ekyogerwa Ekisooka)
fields.body_html:
Ndowooza kiteekwa okuba nga kya lwatu eri buli omu ali wano nti kino kye kibuuzo ekisinga obukulu ekiyinza okujjuza omutwe gw’omuntu — nga bwe tuyinza okufaanana Katonda ennyo, nga bwe tuyinza okusembera kumpi ne Katonda ku nsi nga tweteekateeka okufuuka nga bwe tulifaanana ye mu bujjuvu, ne tubeera, mu ngeri, mu mutima gwe ddala emirembe n’emirembe mu ggulu. Buli muntu alina ekigero kyonna eky’Omwoyo wa Katonda ateekwa okulaba nti kino kye kibuuzo ekisinga obukulu kye tuyinza okussaako ebirowoozo byaffe; era ekyama ekisinga ebyama byonna gye ndi, kwe kuba nti omuntu yenna, alina ekigero kyonna eky’Omwoyo wa Katonda, ayinza atya obutalaba mukisa guno ogw’obutukuvu n’agamba nti, “Weewaawo, ne bwe kirabika ng’ekinene ennyo okutuukibwako ku nsi, kirungi nnyo era kya mukisa nnyo. Nandyagadde okukituukako.” Ekyo, gye ndi, kiteekwa okuba endowooza ya buli muntu alina Omwoyo wa Katonda — nti asaanidde okuyaayaanira n’okulumwa ennyonta olw’ekyo, era n’awulira nti talikkuta okutuusa lw’aliraba ng’azuukuse mu kifaananyi ekirungi eky’Omulokozi we. Naye, zaawe! tetukisanga bwe kityo. Mu bintu bingi nnyo, ekintu ekisooka ddala Abakristaayo abeeyita bwe batyo kye bakola kwe kuziyiza n’okugaana enjigiriza eno ey’obutukuvu ng’ekintu ekisinga obukyafu ku nsi.

Nawulira omusajja ng’agamba, ennaku ntono ezaayita — omukulembeze mu kibiina ekimu eky’eddiini — nti omuntu yenna okwogera ku kuba omutukuvu kiraga nti tamanyi kintu kyonna ku bwe yekka, era nga tamanyi kintu kyonna ku Yesu Kristo.

Nagamba nti, “Ayi Katonda wange! kituuse ku kintu bwe kiba nti obutukuvu ne Yesu Kristo bya njawukana ddala nga eggulu n’ensi. Nnali ndowooza nti ye kye kifo eky’omu makkati n’ensulo y’obutukuvu. Nnali ndowooza nti mu ye mwokka mwe tuyinza okufuna obutukuvu bwonna, era nga ku bw’ye obutukuvu bwe buyinza okukolebwa mu ffe.” Naye omusajja ono omunaku yalowooza nti endowooza eno teriimu nsa.

Katonda yeyogerere yekka! Okuva lwe nawulira endowooza eyo mbadde nkaaba nga nva mu buziba bw’emmeeme yange nti, “Mukama, weeyogerere; kola n’amaanyi ku mitima gy’abantu bo obazuukuse. Ggyawo ekibikka ku maaso gaabwe, obalage ekigendererwa kyo mu Kristo Yesu ekibakwatako kye kiri. Tobaleka kubuzaabuzibwa ne basubwa ekiruubirirwa; tobaleka, naye Mukama, kibikkulire mu mitima gyabwe.” Tewali kkubo ddala eddala mu ekiyinza okubikkulirwa, era, bw’onoomukkiriza, anaakibikkulira mu mutima gwo.

Kyandowoozeddwa nti nnyinza okwogerako akabonero oba bubiri ku ekyo omwami wange kye yayogera ku bunafu, kubanga mpisibwako buli kaseera n’abantu abafuula obunafu ebibi. Bakinyiikirira nti ebyetaagisa eby’etteeka lya Adamu tebyakendezebwa n’akatono; nti tetuli wansi w’etteeka ery’enjiri ery’okwagala, oba etteeka lya Kristo, nga Omutume bw’akiteeka, wabula nga tukyali wansi w’etteeka lya Adamu, era nga obutatuukirira n’obunafu buno, omwami wange bye yayogerako, bibi. Neewuunya nti abantu ng’abo tebalowooza ku kifo ekimu, ekiteekwa okusaanyaawo endowooza eyo emirembe gyonna, Omutume w’agamba nti: “N’olwekyo nnaasanyukira nnyo okwenyumiririza mu bunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gabeere ku nze.”

Singa obunafu buno bwali bibi, twandibadde n’ekintu eky’entabiro eritagambika ery’omutume wa Yesu Kristo okwenyumiririza mu bibi bye! Olaba, obunafu bwe bwali bwokka obwo obw’okwonooneka kw’omwoyo n’omubiri obwali busoboka okuwangulwa n’okufugibwa ekisa, olw’ekitiibwa kya Kristo n’olw’okukulaakulanya obwakabaka bwe.

“N’olwekyo nnaasanyukira nnyo okwenyumiririza mu bunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gabeere ku nze” — nti, olw’obunafu buno bwennyini, amaanyi ga Kristo ganaabeera ku nze bwe gatyo okunnyimusa okusukka obwo, ne banfuula nga sibwetaagira, nga mbufuga, kale nga, mu bunafu buno bwennyini, nnaagulumiza amaanyi ge n’ekisa kye okusinga singa nnali muntu atuukiridde mu mwoyo ne mu mubiri. Mu kifo ekirala agamba nti, “Ne nkuumibwe obutagulumizibwa okusukka ekigero olw’obungi bw’okubikkulirwa, nnaweebwa eriggwa mu mubiri, omubaka wa Setaani, okumpuubaala.” Abantu abamu balowooza nti kino kyali kibi; naye mazima, ebigambo, “omubaka wa Setaani,” biraga nti eriggwa lino teryali kikolwa oba mpisa ya Pawulo, wabula kukemebwa oba kubonaabona okw’ebweru, okwaleetebwa Setaani. Ate era, obukakafu bwa Katonda, “Ekisa kyange kikumala,” bwandiziyizza endowooza ey’ekibi. Pawulo yasaba Mukama emirundi esatu okuggibwako eriggwa lino; mazima singa lyali kibi, Mukama yandibadde n’obwegombe okuliggyawo ng’omuweereza we bwe yali! Eriggwa lino, awatali kubuusabuusa, lyali kugezesebwa okw’omubiri — nga ebigambo, “mu mubiri,” bwe biraga — kubonaabona oba nnaku, ng’ayita mu kugumira okwo amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke gagulumizibwe mu bunafu bwa Pawulo — kimu ku bintu ebyo bye yali asobola okugumira “ku bwa Kristo eyamuwa amaanyi.”

Naye laba, kuno kwali kukangavvula Katonda kwe yakkiriza okuziyiza Pawulo okugwa mu kibi; ekintu ekyawukana ddala ku kibi kyennyini. “Katonda takema muntu na kibi.” Mukama yaweereza kino Pawulo si lwa kumufuula muwombeefu, kubanga yali amaze okwetoowaza, wabula lwa kumukuuma nga muwombeefu. Ne ku ffe ffenna tatuweereza kintu? Tetwetaaga kugezesebwa n’okubonaabona mu mubiri tulyoke tusigale nga tuli bawombeefu? Naye kino kikakasa nti, olw’okuba twetaaga ebintu bino okutukuuma nga tuli bawombeefu, kale amalala gabeera mu ffe era gatufuga? Kikakasa ekyawukana ddala.

Ayi, singa abantu, mu kunoonyereza kwabwe ku mukisa guno ogw’obutukuvu, bandikuumye ekintu kino kimu mu birowoozo byabwe, nti kwe kulokolebwa okuva mu kibi! — ekibi mu kikolwa, mu kigendererwa, mu birowoozo!

Nnina ebbaluwa ennungi, gye nafuna ebbanga ttono eryayita okuva ku muwala omuto, eyampandiikira nga wakayita akaseera katono oluvannyuma lw’okuweereza kwange okwasooka mu West End. Yanzimba nti yali muddu asibiddwa, ndowooza, okumala emyaka ena oba etaano, ow’ekibi ekimu ekyali kimwetooloola, era ebbaluwa ye eyasooka yali kwogera kwennyini kw’obuweereize. Yali afubye n’ameggana n’asaba, n’agezaako okuwangula ekibi ekyali kimufuga.

Oluusi n’oluusi yafunanga obuwanguzi, oluvannyuma n’addamu okugwa, era n’agamba nti, “Kintu kikuusakuusa nnyo, ekikwatagana n’ebirowoozo byange n’okulowooza kwange, nga n’olwekyo sirowooza nti nnyinza kulokolebwa n’akatono.” Naddamu ebbaluwa, ne ngezaako okugumya okukkiriza kwe n’essuubi lye mu Yesu Kristo. Namulaga engeri obutakkiriza buno bwe bwali obw’ekivve, era nti, singa yamwesiga okuyingira n’okufuga mu mutima gwe, yali asobola okutukuza n’okulongoosa ebirowoozo n’okulowooza kwennyini. Yakola akakulaakulana katono, n’ampandiikira ebbaluwa endala. Nnaddamu okumuwandiikira, ne mmugumya okweyongera okwesiga. Yagamba nti teyasobola kutuuka okulowooza nti yali asobola okulongoosa ebirowoozo bye. Yali atuuse okukkiriza nti yali asobola okumulokola obutabissa mu nkola, naye teyasobola kukkiriza nti yali asobola okubirongoosa.

Nnaddamu okumuwandiikira omulundi omulala, ne ngezaako, Mukama ng’anyamba, okumulaga engeri Yesu, ng’ayita mu kuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, gye yali asobola okulongoosa ebirowoozo byennyini eby’emitima gyaffe, era, Katonda yeebazibwe, yakola ekigere ekirala. Okuva olwo mfunye ebbaluwa bbiri okuva gy’ali. Yagamba mu eyasooka nti, “Nsanyuka nga nkankana, olw’okutya nti kiyinza okuba kya kiseera buseera, naye mmwesizza okulongoosa ensulo, era nteekwa okugamba nti YAKIKOZE, era, mu kifo ky’okulowooza ebirowoozo bino, nnina ebirowoozo ebitukuvu, era Setaani bw’aleeta ekintu kyonna mu mutwe gwange, kimbeera kya muzizo nnyo nga siyinza kukubuulira nnaku n’entiisa gye kinzijuza.” Nnaddamu okumuwandiikira, nga mmugumya, ne nfuna ebbaluwa endala, mwe yagamba nti, “Kya mazima nti alongoosezza ebirowoozo eby’omutima gwange, era kaakano ntegeera nti ebirowoozo byange bimusanyusa, era anzigye mu kibi kino ekibadde ekizibu n’okubonyaabonya obulamu bwange emyaka gino gyonna egiyise.”

Kaakano, kye njagala okubagamba, kiri nti ekyo ky’asobola okukolera omuntu omu, asobola okukikolera omulala. Bwe mba nga nkyamye wano, nvaayo ku nsonga yonna. Mba nzibye ddala mu kigendererwa n’ekiruubirirwa n’etteeka ery’ekiseera eky’Enjiri, singa Katonda tayagala abantu be kuba balongoofu. Si kwebala nga balongoofu ng’ate si balongoofu. Nedda, nedda! Tugambibwa, emirundi n’emirundi, nti Katonda ayagala abantu be okuba abalongoofu, era nti OBULONGOOFU MU MITIMA GYABWE BWE NDOWOOZA EY’OMU MAKKATI DDALA N’ENKOMERERO N’EKIGENDERERWA EKY’ENJIRI YA YESU KRISTO; bwe kitaba bwe kityo, nvaayo ku nsonga yonna — mba ndimbiddwa ddala.

Okukakasa kino, nnonze ebyawandiikibwa bibiri oba bisatu ebirabika ng’ebibikuŋŋaanya byonna wamu; ebyawandiikibwa ebifunza, ka njogere bwe ntyo. Nnaasooka okuddira, ng’ekyokulabirako, ekyo omwami wange ky’abadde agezaako okunyweza — “Okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kutukuzibwa kwammwe.” Wabula waliwo amakulu, era amakulu ag’amaanyi, mu okutukuzibwa mwe kuteekwa okuba okwagala kw’omuntu. Kuteekwa okuba okwagala kwange, nange, era bwe kutaba kwagala kwange, okwagala kwa Katonda tekuyinza kutuukirira mu nze. Nteekwa okwagala okutukuzibwa, nga Katonda bw’ayagala nti ntukuzibwe. Waliwo enkubiriza nnyingi, era nnyingi n’okusingawo, mu Baibuli ez’okwetukuza wammwe okusinga endagaano za Katonda ez’okubatukuza.

Ekyawandiikibwa ekiddako Yakobo 4:8: “Musembere kumpi ne Katonda, naye anaasembera kumpi nammwe. Munaaze emikono gyammwe, mmwe aboonoonyi; mutukuze emitima gyammwe, mmwe ab’emyoyo ebiri.” Kino kyali eri abaddayo ennyuma, eri abantu abaali beeyita nga bakkiriza, naye abaali baddeyo wansi w’obufuzi bw’okwegomba n’okwegulumiza kwabwe okw’omubiri. Waliwo ebyawandiikibwa bibiri oba bisatu ebirala gye kirabika nga tufuna ensonga yonna ng’efunziddwa, gamba, ng’ekyokulabirako, Tito 2:14: “...eyeewaayo ku lwaffe okutununula okuva mu bujeemu bwonna, n’okwetukuliza abantu ab’envuma ye ye, abanyiikira mu bikolwa ebirungi.” — Kwe kutulongoosa. Ate 1 Timoseewo 1:5 alaga ekigendererwa kya Katonda n’ekiruubirirwa kye mu ngeri yonna ey’okununula: “Ekiruubirirwa eky’ekiragiro kyaffe kwe kwagala okuva mu mutima omulongoofu n’omwoyo omulungi n’okukkiriza okutaliimu bukuusa” — nga alongooseddwa era nga akuumibwa mulongoofu, kubanga singa yali alongoosebbwa n’addamu okwonooneka, teyandibadde mwoyo mulungi wabula mubi. Ate era, mu 1 Yokaana 3:3: “Na buli muntu alina essuubi lino mu ye yeetukuza nga ye bw’ali omutukuvu.” Kaakano, njogera nti, bino bye byawandiikibwa ebifunza, era waliwo n’ebirala bingi eby’amakulu gebimu, okulaga nti enkomerero n’ekigendererwa kyonna eky’okununula kye kino — nti anaatuzza mu bulongoofu; nti anaatuzza mu butuukirivu; nti anaalongoosa emyoyo gyammwe okuva mu bikolwa ebifu okuweereza Katonda omulamu — si kulongoosa kwokka okuva ku byayita, wabula okubakuuma nga mulongoosebbwa okuweereza KATONDA OMULAMU; nti kinaakolebwa okuyita mu kuteeka omusaayi ku mwoyo, oluvannyuma ne kikuumibwa amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’atukuuma mu mbeera ey’obulongoofu n’obuwulize eri obutuukirivu.

Kaakano, njogera nti, kino bwe kitaba ndowooza ey’omu makkati ey’Obukristaayo, siritegeera. Katonda bw’atasobola kunkolera kino — Yesu Kristo bw’atasobola kunkolera kino, kale kirungi ki kyennyini kye nfuna olw’okujja kwe?

Waliwo ebingi nnyo mu bbaluwa zino ebyolekezebwa Omukristaayo kinnoomu okuba kino, n’ekyo, n’ekirala, n’okukola kino, n’ekyo, n’ekirala, okusinga ebyogera ku ekyo Katonda ky’anaamukolera oluvannyuma lwa byonna!

Buno si Bukristaayo bwa kungulu bwokka — kuno si kutuula wansi n’okwewuunyisa mu nneewulira n’okulowooza ku Kristo ali mu ggulu, mu bbaluwa zino; kimuleeta wansi, mu ngeri zonna, MU MITIMA GYAFFE N’OBULAMU BWAFFE WANO, era y’emu ku nkubiriza ez’olubeerera, ba kino, era kola kino n’ekirala.

Ebbaluwa zino ziraga enkyukakyuka ey’amazima, ey’enkola, egenda okutuukirira MU FFE, era kino kye kintu kyokka ekituufu okufiira nakyo. Bwe kitatuukirira mu ggwe, nkugamba, tolisobola kufa mirembe. Onooyagala okulongoosebbwa, nga omwami wange omwagalwa bwe yakubuulira, nga tonnayingira mu maaso g’Omusuubuza wa Bami. Onooyagala okuwulira obutuukirivu obulungi obw’empisa n’obutuukirivu nga busaasaana ku butonde bwo bwonna, obunaakusobozesa okwolekera amaaso ga Katonda n’ogamba nti, “Weewaawo, nkwagala, nkumanyi, naawe ommanyi, era onjagala, era tuli omu. Njagala ebintu by’oyagala, era nneegomba ebintu by’oyagala. Tuli ba mwoyo gumu, ‘abeegasse mu mwoyo gumu ne Mukama.’” Onooyagala ekyo, era tewali kisingako wansi ekituufu okufiira nakyo. Kale lwaki tokiba nakyo? Onookiba nakyo? Lwaki totekamu Katonda okukikolera mu ffe? Onookigezaako? Abantu babeera bagamba nti, “Bakyegomba, era baagala singa bakifuna.” Onookkiriza Katonda okukikola? Onooggyawo obuziba bw’obutakkiriza obuli emmanga w’obuzibu bwo bwonna? Abantu ddala tebakkiriza nti Katonda asobola okubakolera kino, era ekyo kye kiri emmanga w’obuzibu bwabwe. Naye asobola okukikola, era asuubiza okukikola. Onoosinza n’ogamba nti, “Kibe gye ndi ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kiri”?

“YAZAALIBWA — OMULOKOZI.”

Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Ebweru: Ebweru w’ennyumba y’abagenyi, yagaanibwa n’okunyoomebwa. Yasuulibwa ebweru: Yasuulibwa ebweru ku lwange, Omulokozi wange, Kabaka, Yasuulibwa ebweru okuleeta ono eyabula munda.

Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Omuntu: Omuntu ow’ennaku, eyakubibwa, eyayuzibwa embooko: Olw’embooko, ai Mukama, emmeeme yange ewonyezebbwa, Olw’embooko, embooko zo, okusonyiyibwa kwange kwakakasibwa.

Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Omwana gw’Endiga: Omwana gw’Endiga gwa Katonda gwayiwa omusaayi ne gwetikka Ebibi byange: Ebibi byange bye byatta Ssaddaaka, Ebibi byange Omwana gw’Endiga y’agiggyawo.

Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa Okulokola: Okulokola ekiro, mu ttuntu, mu makya. Okukuuma: Okukuuma okuva mu kibi, mu kubuusabuusa, mu kutya; Okukuuma, kubanga laba! Omukuumi wuuno.

Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Kabaka: Kabaka! gulumiza ejjembe lye ery’ekitiibwa, Era muyimbe: Muyimbe, mmwe eggulu!

Yamenya entaana ye, Era yimba, ai nsi! Mulamu okulokola!

Namulaga engeri obutakkiriza buno bwe bwali obw’ekivve, era nti, singa yamwesiga okuyingira n’okufuga mu mutima gwe, yali asobola okutukuza n’okulongoosa ebirowoozo n’okulowooza kwennyini. Yakola akakulaakulana katono, n’ampandiikira ebbaluwa endala. Nnaddamu okumuwandiikira, ne mmugumya okweyongera okwesiga. Yagamba nti teyasobola kutuuka okulowooza nti yali asobola okulongoosa ebirowoozo bye. Yali atuuse okukkiriza nti yali asobola okumulokola obutabissa mu nkola, naye teyasobola kukkiriza nti yali asobola okubirongoosa. Nnaddamu okumuwandiikira omulundi omulala, ne ngezaako, Mukama ng’anyamba, okumulaga engeri Yesu, ng’ayita mu kuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, gye yali asobola okulongoosa ebirowoozo byennyini eby’emitima gyaffe, era, Katonda yeebazibwe, yakola ekigere ekirala. Okuva olwo mfunye ebbaluwa bbiri okuva gy’ali. Yagamba mu eyasooka nti, “Nsanyuka nga nkankana, olw’okutya nti kiyinza okuba kya kiseera buseera, naye mmwesizza okulongoosa ensulo, era nteekwa okugamba nti YAKIKOZE, era, mu kifo ky’okulowooza ebirowoozo bino, nnina ebirowoozo ebitukuvu, era Setaani bw’aleeta ekintu kyonna mu mutwe gwange, kimbeera kya muzizo nnyo nga siyinza kukubuulira nnaku n’entiisa gye kinzijuza.” Nnaddamu okumuwandiikira, nga mmugumya, ne nfuna ebbaluwa endala, mwe yagamba nti, “Kya mazima nti alongoosezza ebirowoozo eby’omutima gwange, era kaakano ntegeera nti ebirowoozo byange bimusanyusa, era anzigye mu kibi kino ekibadde ekizibu n’okubonyaabonya obulamu bwange emyaka gino gyonna egiyise.” Kaakano, kye njagala okubagamba, kiri nti ekyo ky’asobola okukolera omuntu omu, asobola okukikolera omulala. Bwe mba nga nkyamye wano, nvaayo ku nsonga yonna. Mba nzibye ddala mu kigendererwa n’ekiruubirirwa n’etteeka ery’ekiseera eky’Enjiri, singa Katonda tayagala abantu be kuba balongoofu. Si kwebala nga balongoofu ng’ate si balongoofu. Nedda, nedda! Tugambibwa, emirundi n’emirundi, nti Katonda ayagala abantu be okuba abalongoofu, era nti OBULONGOOFU MU MITIMA GYABWE BWE NDOWOOZA EY’OMU MAKKATI DDALA N’ENKOMERERO N’EKIGENDERERWA EKY’ENJIRI YA YESU KRISTO; bwe kitaba bwe kityo, nvaayo ku nsonga yonna — mba ndimbiddwa ddala. Okukakasa kino, nnonze ebyawandiikibwa bibiri oba bisatu ebirabika ng’ebibikuŋŋaanya byonna wamu; ebyawandiikibwa ebifunza, ka njogere bwe ntyo. Nnaasooka okuddira, ng’ekyokulabirako, ekyo omwami wange ky’abadde agezaako okunyweza — “Okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kutukuzibwa kwammwe.” Wabula waliwo amakulu, era amakulu ag’amaanyi, mu okutukuzibwa mwe kuteekwa okuba okwagala kw’omuntu. Kuteekwa okuba okwagala kwange, nange, era bwe kutaba kwagala kwange, okwagala kwa Katonda tekuyinza kutuukirira mu nze. Nteekwa okwagala okutukuzibwa, nga Katonda bw’ayagala nti ntukuzibwe. Waliwo enkubiriza nnyingi, era nnyingi n’okusingawo, mu Baibuli ez’okwetukuza wammwe okusinga endagaano za Katonda ez’okubatukuza. Ekyawandiikibwa ekiddako Yakobo 4:8: “Musembere kumpi ne Katonda, naye anaasembera kumpi nammwe. Munaaze emikono gyammwe, mmwe aboonoonyi; mutukuze emitima gyammwe, mmwe ab’emyoyo ebiri.” Kino kyali eri abaddayo ennyuma, eri abantu abaali beeyita nga bakkiriza, naye abaali baddeyo wansi w’obufuzi bw’okwegomba n’okwegulumiza kwabwe okw’omubiri. Waliwo ebyawandiikibwa bibiri oba bisatu ebirala gye kirabika nga tufuna ensonga yonna ng’efunziddwa, gamba, ng’ekyokulabirako, Tito 2:14: “...eyeewaayo ku lwaffe okutununula okuva mu bujeemu bwonna, n’okwetukuliza abantu ab’envuma ye ye, abanyiikira mu bikolwa ebirungi.” — Kwe kutulongoosa. Ate 1 Timoseewo 1:5 alaga ekigendererwa kya Katonda n’ekiruubirirwa kye mu ngeri yonna ey’okununula: “Ekiruubirirwa eky’ekiragiro kyaffe kwe kwagala okuva mu mutima omulongoofu n’omwoyo omulungi n’okukkiriza okutaliimu bukuusa” — nga alongooseddwa era nga akuumibwa mulongoofu, kubanga singa yali alongoosebbwa n’addamu okwonooneka, teyandibadde mwoyo mulungi wabula mubi. Ate era, mu 1 Yokaana 3:3: “Na buli muntu alina essuubi lino mu ye yeetukuza nga ye bw’ali omutukuvu.” Kaakano, njogera nti, bino bye byawandiikibwa ebifunza, era waliwo n’ebirala bingi eby’amakulu gebimu, okulaga nti enkomerero n’ekigendererwa kyonna eky’okununula kye kino — nti anaatuzza mu bulongoofu; nti anaatuzza mu butuukirivu; nti anaalongoosa emyoyo gyammwe okuva mu bikolwa ebifu okuweereza Katonda omulamu — si kulongoosa kwokka okuva ku byayita, wabula okubakuuma nga mulongoosebbwa okuweereza KATONDA OMULAMU; nti kinaakolebwa okuyita mu kuteeka omusaayi ku mwoyo, oluvannyuma ne kikuumibwa amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’atukuuma mu mbeera ey’obulongoofu n’obuwulize eri obutuukirivu. Kaakano, njogera nti, kino bwe kitaba ndowooza ey’omu makkati ey’Obukristaayo, siritegeera. Katonda bw’atasobola kunkolera kino — Yesu Kristo bw’atasobola kunkolera kino, kale kirungi ki kyennyini kye nfuna olw’okujja kwe? Waliwo ebingi nnyo mu bbaluwa zino ebyolekezebwa Omukristaayo kinnoomu okuba kino, n’ekyo, n’ekirala, n’okukola kino, n’ekyo, n’ekirala, okusinga ebyogera ku ekyo Katonda ky’anaamukolera oluvannyuma lwa byonna! Buno si Bukristaayo bwa kungulu bwokka — kuno si kutuula wansi n’okwewuunyisa mu nneewulira n’okulowooza ku Kristo ali mu ggulu, mu bbaluwa zino; kimuleeta wansi, mu ngeri zonna, MU MITIMA GYAFFE N’OBULAMU BWAFFE WANO, era y’emu ku nkubiriza ez’olubeerera, ba kino, era kola kino n’ekirala. Ebbaluwa zino ziraga enkyukakyuka ey’amazima, ey’enkola, egenda okutuukirira MU FFE, era kino kye kintu kyokka ekituufu okufiira nakyo. Bwe kitatuukirira mu ggwe, nkugamba, tolisobola kufa mirembe. Onooyagala okulongoosebbwa, nga omwami wange omwagalwa bwe yakubuulira, nga tonnayingira mu maaso g’Omusuubuza wa Bami. Onooyagala okuwulira obutuukirivu obulungi obw’empisa n’obutuukirivu nga busaasaana ku butonde bwo bwonna, obunaakusobozesa okwolekera amaaso ga Katonda n’ogamba nti, “Weewaawo, nkwagala, nkumanyi, naawe ommanyi, era onjagala, era tuli omu. Njagala ebintu by’oyagala, era nneegomba ebintu by’oyagala. Tuli ba mwoyo gumu, ‘abeegasse mu mwoyo gumu ne Mukama.’” Onooyagala ekyo, era tewali kisingako wansi ekituufu okufiira nakyo. Kale lwaki tokiba nakyo? Onookiba nakyo? Lwaki totekamu Katonda okukikolera mu ffe? Onookigezaako? Abantu babeera bagamba nti, “Bakyegomba, era baagala singa bakifuna.” Onookkiriza Katonda okukikola? Onooggyawo obuziba bw’obutakkiriza obuli emmanga w’obuzibu bwo bwonna? Abantu ddala tebakkiriza nti Katonda asobola okubakolera kino, era ekyo kye kiri emmanga w’obuzibu bwabwe. Naye asobola okukikola, era asuubiza okukikola. Onoosinza n’ogamba nti, “Kibe gye ndi ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kiri”? “YAZAALIBWA — OMULOKOZI.” Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Ebweru: Ebweru w’ennyumba y’abagenyi, yagaanibwa n’okunyoomebwa. Yasuulibwa ebweru: Yasuulibwa ebweru ku lwange, Omulokozi wange, Kabaka, Yasuulibwa ebweru okuleeta ono eyabula munda. Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Omuntu: Omuntu ow’ennaku, eyakubibwa, eyayuzibwa embooko: Olw’embooko, ai Mukama, emmeeme yange ewonyezebbwa, Olw’embooko, embooko zo, okusonyiyibwa kwange kwakakasibwa. Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Omwana gw’Endiga: Omwana gw’Endiga gwa Katonda gwayiwa omusaayi ne gwetikka Ebibi byange: Ebibi byange bye byatta Ssaddaaka, Ebibi byange Omwana gw’Endiga y’agiggyawo. Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa Okulokola: Okulokola ekiro, mu ttuntu, mu makya. Okukuuma: Okukuuma okuva mu kibi, mu kubuusabuusa, mu kutya; Okukuuma, kubanga laba! Omukuumi wuuno. Yesu Omulokozi yazaalibwa, Kabaka: Kabaka! gulumiza ejjembe lye ery’ekitiibwa, Era muyimbe: Muyimbe, mmwe eggulu! Yamenya entaana ye, Era yimba, ai nsi! Mulamu okulokola!

fields.title: Okwogera okw'Okubiri
fields.body_html:
Kale, abooluganda, mbeegayirira olw'okusaasira kwa Katonda, muwaayo emibiri gyammwe okuba ssaddaaka ennamu, entukuvu, esanyusa Katonda, kwe kusinza kwammwe okw'omwoyo. Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno: naye mukyusibwe olw'okuzza obuggya amagezi gammwe, mulyoke mukakase Katonda ky'ayagala, ekirungi, ekisanyusa, era ekituukiridde. — Abaruumi 12:1-2 Nnadde nfumiitiriza ku kigambo ekiri mu kyawandiikibwa, “mulyoke”—”mulyoke mukakase Katonda ky'ayagala, ekirungi, ekisanyusa, era ekituukiridde.” Okukulaakulana kuno mu bulamu obw'Ekikatonda, awamu n'okulala kwonna, okutuuka ku nkomerero, okutuusa lwe tutuuka mu kitiibwa, kulina ebisaanyizo byakwo. Ekisaanyizo eky'okuva mu mbeera ey'omuntu ow'ensi atazuukuse n'okutuuka ku mbeera ey'omwonoonyi akkiriza nti mwonoonyi, kwe kukkiriza ekitangaala. Katonda azuukusa era amulisiza obukumi n'obukumi, ate enkumi n'enkumi bagaana ekitangaala—amangwago ne bakiggyawo—ne bazibiriza amaaso gaabwe—ne bagaana ekitangaala. Bano baddayo mu kizikiza ekingi n'okusingawo, era beeyongera okwonoona n'obunyiikivu obusinga bwe baali baakola edda; naye abo abakkiriza ekitangaala batuuka mu mbeera ey'emyoyo egizuukuse egimulisiddwa.

Ekisaanyizo ekiddako eky'okukulaakulana okuva mu mbeera y'omwonoonyi alwanirira, ayagala okuva ku bibi bye n'okugoberera Kristo, kwe kukkiriza, okukkiririza mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, alyoke afune okusonyiyibwa ebibi. Era ku buli kukulaakulana okugenda mu maaso, singa omukkiriza ayagala okuyisa emisingi egisooka, singa ayagala okukula wadde akatono, waliwo ekisaanyizo ekiri mu kukulaakulana okwo! Okugeza, singa, oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka, Omwoyo Omutukuvu amubikkulira ekintu ekitakwatagana—ky'ataalabanga edda—ekisaanyizo eky'okukulaakulana ekigere ekirala kwe kwegaana ekintu ekyo!—okukkiriza ekitangaala n'okukigondera; era bw'akyekweka n'atakikkiriza wadde okukigondera, taakulaakulane nate okutuusa lw'anaakikola. Waliwo Abakristaayo enkumi n'enkumi, mu kifo ky'okukulaakulana, be baddayo ennyuma okuva lwe baakyuka, kubanga baagaana okutuukiriza ekisaanyizo, “MULYOKE” bakakase okwagala kwa Katonda okulungi, okusanyusa, era okutuukiridde.

Waaliwo ekisaanyizo. Bandikakasizza okwagala kwa Katonda singa tewaali kisaanyizo; naye waaliwo ekisaanyizo kye baagaana okutuukiriza; kale we bakwatira, we baabeeranga—oba, ekisingako, baddayo ennyuma.

Kale, kaakano, wano waliwo ekisaanyizo ku kukulaakulana kuno okukulu era okw'ekitiibwa okuva mu mbeera ey'okuweebwa obutuukirivu, gye, wadde ng'omukkiriza aweebwa amaanyi ku kibi, ekibi kiryoke kireme okumufuga, naye oluusi, olw'emirimu gyakyo egy'omunda, agwa wansi w'amaanyi gaakyo—okukulaakulana okuva mu mbeera eno ey'okwonoona n'okwenenya okutuuka ku mutindo ogwo omukkiriza gy'abeerera mu Kristo n'ataayonoona, n'ayagala Katonda n'omutima gwe gwonna, n'emmeeme ye yonna, n'amagezi ge gonna, n'amaanyi ge gonna—ng'agatta ne Kristo bw'atyo nti, ng'atambulira mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, atuukiriza etteeka ery'okwagala mwe yateekebwa—okukulaakulana, njogera, okuva mu mbeera eyo ey'okugulumba n'okukka, okuyingira n'okufuluma, okugwa n'okugolokoka, okutuuka ku mutindo guno ogwa waggulu, nakwo kulina ebisaanyizo byakwo.

Mwandyambuseeko eyo leero singa si bisaanyizo; abasinga obungi ku mmwe mwandyambuseeko awamu, ng'Abayisirayeeri bwe bandiyingidde mu Kanani, singa tewaali kisaanyizo. Sirabangako muntu musirusiru nga tayagala kubeera mu nsi ennungi; mazima bayagala okubeeramu, era bandiyingidde ne bafuna omubisi gw'enjuki n'amata, naye waliwo ebisaanyizo! Kale nno, wano mukirabira ddala mu bweru, era mukiraba mu byawandiikibwa ebirala bingi mu ngeri y'emu ey'olwatu.

Tewali kintu Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'assaako essira erisinga nga bw'assaako ku kuteeka ebisaanyizo. Kale bye biruwa? “Kale, abooluganda, mbeegayirira olw'okusaasira kwa Katonda, muwaayo emibiri gyammwe okuba ssaddaaka ennamu”—omuntu omulamu—mmwe, mwenna; si kyo—si kintu ekiri mu mmwe.

Ekigambo ekyo eky'oluvannyuma Omwoyo Omutukuvu takozesa bw'ayogera n'Abakristaayo, naye bulijjo mmwe, byammwe, emibiri gyammwe, emyoyo gyammwe, amagezi gammwe, omuntu yenna—MMWE, “ssaddaaka ennamu, entukuvu, esanyusa Katonda, kwe kusinza kwammwe okw'omwoyo.” Era si bwe kiri? Kisukkiridde? Kisinga ku ekyo kye yateesa bwe yabagula? Kisinga ku kye yasasula? Kwe “kusinza kwammwe okw'omwoyo.”

Kale nno, kaakano, ekisaanyizo kijja: “Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno, naye mukyusibwe olw'okuzza obuggya amagezi gammwe, mulyoke...”

Woowe! singa mwandisobodde okukyusibwa okudda gy'ali n'okwefaananyiriza ba mulembe guno mu kiseera kye kimu, obuzibu bwonna bwandiweddewo. Mmanyi abantu bangi abandikyusibbwa mangwago; naye, okulema okwefaananyiriza ba mulembe guno—nga bayimirira ne beenyinyimba olw'ekyo! Tebasobola kukifuna ku muwendo ogwo.

Nga Finney omwagalwa bwe yali agamba, “Owooluganda wange, bw'oba oyagala okulaba Katonda, tojja kumusanga waggulu eyo, mu kitiibwa kyonna eky'ekibiina n'okuwaanawaana kw'omuliro; oteekwa okukka wansi omunoonye.” Bwe kiri ekyo—”Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno.”

Tewali kintu kinnuma okusingawo, oluvannyuma lw'okubeera mu nkuŋŋaana ez'okuyamba emyoyo, gye ngezaako okwogera mu ngeri entuufu era enzijuvu okulaba nga buli muntu ategeera kye ntegeeza, bwe ŋŋenda ku mmeeza ey'ekijjulo oba eky'akawungeezi, abantu ne bataba na kye bategedde na katono, oba, bwe baba nga bategeeye, tebajja kukikkiriza.

Woowe! kino kye kyama—tebaagala kuva ku malala gaabwe n'okwegulumiza kwabwe. Naye Katonda talyeraga mu myoyo egiri bwe gityo, wadde nga bakaaba ne basaba okutuusa lwe bafuuka magumba, ne bagenda nga bakungubaga ennaku zaabwe zonna. Tebaatuukirize kisaanyizo—”Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno”; tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe wadde okutuuka ku mbaga y'ekijjulo.

Bangi be mmanyi tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe mu ngeri gye baamba enkuufiira zaabwe. Tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe okutuuka ku kuleka okukyalira n'okusembeza abantu abatatya Katonda, ab'ensi, abateriimu, n'aba wamusenge. Tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe okutuuka ku kuleka entegeka zaabwe ez'omu maka okwonoonebwa—nedda, ne bwe kiba nti obulokozi bw'abaana baabwe, n'abaweereza baabwe, ne mikwano gyabwe kwe kusinziira. Ekyetaagisa ddala kwe kusanyusibwa kwabwe kwennyini, olwo ku ludda lwa Katonda n'ofuna kyonna ky'osobola okufuna. “Twetaaga kino, era twetaaga kiri; olwo, singa Mukama Yesu Kristo anajja ku nkomerero n'atukuza byonna, tunaamwebaza nnyo; naye tetusobola kuleka bintu bino.”

Woowe! mikwano gyange, mbagamba, kino tekiyinza kubaawo. Katonda ng'annyamba, nnaabagamba, nteekwa okubagamba, kubanga kikakibwa mu mwoyo gwange olw'ebyo bye ndaba era bye mpulira buli lunaku. Abantu bajja mu nkuŋŋaana zino, ne basinda ne bakaaba ne bajja gye tuli okuyambibwa, ne tumalako obwongo bwaffe obunafu n'emibiri gyaffe nga tubagamba n'okubawa amagezi, nga tubagamba kye baba bakola, ate bwe kituuka awasembayo, tuzuula nti, “Woowe! nedda; temulimbibwalimbibwa: tetugenda kuwaayo bintu bino. Tetuyinza kufuna Mukama bw'anaaba tajja mu yeekaalu zaffe n'abitwala nga bw'abisanga. Tetuyinza kuleka bintu bino.”

Mujjukira ekyawandiikibwa ekyasomebwa ku kuggulawo kw'olukuŋŋaana—Yokaana 17:14: “...era ensi yabakyawa kubanga si ba nsi.” Kirimu amakulu! era waliwo ebyawandiikibwa ebirala kikumi ebiyigiriza amazima ge gamu. Kale, kitegeeza ki? Mukama atuyambe okukiraba!

Tekitegeeza nti tetusaana kuba ng'ensi endala?—nti tetusaana kuluŋŋamizibwa ebigambo eby'amagezi bye bimu, oba okukola ng'emisingi gy'ensi bwe giri?—nti tetusaana kussa essira lye limu ku bintu eby'ensi obuntu, ng'abantu ab'ensi bwe bakola? Mwali mwelowoozangako ebigambo ebyo eby'amaanyi ebiri mu lugero lw'omusizi? Makko 4:19: “...naye okweraliikirira kw'ensi n'obulimba bw'obugagga n'okwegomba ebintu ebirala biyingira ne bizisa ekigambo, ne kitabala bibala”—si bintu bya muzizo, si bintu bya buwemu, si bintu bya nsonyi, naye okwegomba ebintu ebirala.

Mu kyawandiikibwa ekirala, Abafiripi 3:19: “...abalowooza ebintu eby'oku nsi.” Bassa essira erisingawo ku bintu eby'ensi n'ebintu ebirala okusinga bwe bakola eri ebintu eby'obwakabaka bwe. Mu butuufu bassa ebintu bino mu maaso, wadde nga bayimba ku bwakabaka bwe era nga beeyatula okumussa mu maaso: bassa ebintu eby'ensi mu maaso, kyekiva, tebaagala bintu byabwe eby'ensi kwonoonebwa olw'ebintu bye; ne mulowooza nti akubibwa? Mulowooza nti alimbibwa? Mulowooza nga kisoboka nti Katonda Omukulu ow'omu ggulu, alina obukadde n'obukadde bwa bamalayika ne bamalayika abakulu okumusinza n'okumuweereza, ajja kufuka ekitiibwa kye ku bantu ng'abo, ne yeeraga gye bali, n'abakozesa?

Si kirabika! “Nnaabanga ow'olubereberye mu kwagala kwammwe,” bw'agamba.

Mmwe abakazi abali wano, singa mumanya nti temuli ba lubereberye era ab'obumu mu kwagala kwa babbammwe, mwandigambye ki? Nammwe abaami, mwandibadde n'omukazi singa mumanyi nti si mmwe mwokka mu kwagala kwe, naye nga kwawuliddwamu wakati wammwe n'omulala?

“Si kirabika!” mwandigambye; “Sijja kuyiwa kwagala kwange, n'obudde bwange, n'ebirabo byange, ne buli kye nnina, ku muntu omutima gwe gwe gwawuliddwamu n'omulala. Bw'anaaba ayagala omutima gwe okwawulibwamu, kale agende eri oyo omulala.”

Kaakano mumanyi nti Katonda wa buggya, era amanyi abamuduulira, era amanyi abo abatajja kuwaayo kwefaananyiriza kuno okw'ensi balyoke batambule naye nga bambadde engoye enjeru. Amanyi, era, abo abatafaayo ku ky'omuntu yenna ky'abalowoozaako, oba abantu kye boogera ku bo; abo abeetegefu okubalibwa ng'abasirusiru n'abalalu balyoke batambule naye era batumbule ebirungi eby'obwakabaka bwe, era abatwala emibiri gyabwe ng'ebikozesebwa bye n'amaka gaabwe nga yeekaalu ze; abo abakkiriza ng'essaawa zaabwe ez'ekyenkya, oba ez'ekijjulo, oba ez'akatono ak'omu ttuntu, oba essaawa zonna endala ziyinza okwonoonebwa, era, mu butuufu, buli kimu ne kifuulibwa ekya kabiri eri ebirungi eby'obwakabaka bwe.

Tuteekwa okuteeka buli kimu mu buweereza bwe—abaana baffe, emirimu gyaffe, amaka gaffe, na buli kimu. Bwe nkitegeera bulungi, buno bwe butefaananyiriza nsi.

Nga sinnamaliriza, ka njogere ekigambo okuyamba abo abaagala okutuuka ku mukisa guno. Tewali kkubo ddala lirala. Tekigasa kwetooloola bunyiriri. TEMWEFAANANYIRIZANGA, NAYE MUKYUSIBWE. Bino byombi bikontana lwatu. Bwe mulonda okwefaananyiriza, olwo temuyinza kukyusibwa; bwe mutaakkirize kukyusibwa, olwo muteekwa okwefaananyiriza. Kaakano, munaaleka okwefaananyiriza ensi? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, mulyoke, buli omu ku mmwe, mukyusibwe ku makya gano—mwambuke mu nsi. Mwenna muyinza okulokolebwa leero, ne mufuula ekka lyammwe mu Kristo, ne mufuna amaanyi gonna n'ekitiibwa ebijjira abo abamulina; muyinza okukulaakulana okuva mu mbeera ey'ennaku ey'omuntu omunafu agulumba n'akka, ayingira n'afuluma, ow'obunaku, okutuuka ku kifo eky'ekitiibwa eky'omuntu omulokole—omukazi omulokole—omutukuvu wa Katonda awangula!

OKUKKIRIZA Okukkiriza kwange kutunula gy'oli— Okukkiriza kwange, okutono ennyo, okuluubirira; kuyimusa amaaso gaakwo agasumbye okulaba era kaakano kusaba omukisa. Ekirabo kyo eky'ekyewuunyo kukiraba wala; okwagala kwo okutuukiridde kusaba okugabana, era tekutya, era tekuyinza kutya.

Okukkiriza kwange kukukwatako— Okukkiriza kwange, okunafu ennyo, okuggwaamu amaanyi; kuyimusa emikono gyakwo egikankana, nga kukankana, naye nga kuli n'obwangu. Obwakabaka kaakano kubuggya lwa maanyi, era kulinda okutuusa Ggwe, oyo ekisembayo kwe kwesiga, lw'onookassaako akabonero n'otukuza.

Okukkiriza kwange kukunywerera ku Ggwe, Okukkiriza kwange, nga kukyali kutono, naye nga kukakafu, ennanga yaakwo enywerera ku Ggwe wekka, oyo obwaliwo bwo bunkuuma nga ntukuvu. Era Ggwe bulijjo, okulaba n'okuwulira, ekiro, emisana, oli kumpi nnyo— oli kumpi nnyo nange.
fields.body_text: Kale, abooluganda, mbeegayirira olw'okusaasira kwa Katonda, muwaayo emibiri gyammwe okuba ssaddaaka ennamu, entukuvu, esanyusa Katonda, kwe kusinza kwammwe okw'omwoyo. Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno: naye mukyusibwe olw'okuzza obuggya amagezi gammwe, mulyoke mukakase Katonda ky'ayagala, ekirungi, ekisanyusa, era ekituukiridde. — Abaruumi 12:1-2 Nnadde nfumiitiriza ku kigambo ekiri mu kyawandiikibwa, "mulyoke"—"mulyoke mukakase Katonda ky'ayagala, ekirungi, ekisanyusa, era ekituukiridde." Okukulaakulana kuno mu bulamu obw'Ekikatonda, awamu n'okulala kwonna, okutuuka ku nkomerero, okutuusa lwe tutuuka mu kitiibwa, kulina ebisaanyizo byakwo. Ekisaanyizo eky'okuva mu mbeera ey'omuntu ow'ensi atazuukuse n'okutuuka ku mbeera ey'omwonoonyi akkiriza nti mwonoonyi, kwe kukkiriza ekitangaala. Katonda azuukusa era amulisiza obukumi n'obukumi, ate enkumi n'enkumi bagaana ekitangaala—amangwago ne bakiggyawo—ne bazibiriza amaaso gaabwe—ne bagaana ekitangaala. Bano baddayo mu kizikiza ekingi n'okusingawo, era beeyongera okwonoona n'obunyiikivu obusinga bwe baali baakola edda; naye abo abakkiriza ekitangaala batuuka mu mbeera ey'emyoyo egizuukuse egimulisiddwa. Ekisaanyizo ekiddako eky'okukulaakulana okuva mu mbeera y'omwonoonyi alwanirira, ayagala okuva ku bibi bye n'okugoberera Kristo, kwe kukkiriza, okukkiririza mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, alyoke afune okusonyiyibwa ebibi. Era ku buli kukulaakulana okugenda mu maaso, singa omukkiriza ayagala okuyisa emisingi egisooka, singa ayagala okukula wadde akatono, waliwo ekisaanyizo ekiri mu kukulaakulana okwo! Okugeza, singa, oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka, Omwoyo Omutukuvu amubikkulira ekintu ekitakwatagana—ky'ataalabanga edda—ekisaanyizo eky'okukulaakulana ekigere ekirala kwe kwegaana ekintu ekyo!—okukkiriza ekitangaala n'okukigondera; era bw'akyekweka n'atakikkiriza wadde okukigondera, taakulaakulane nate okutuusa lw'anaakikola. Waliwo Abakristaayo enkumi n'enkumi, mu kifo ky'okukulaakulana, be baddayo ennyuma okuva lwe baakyuka, kubanga baagaana okutuukiriza ekisaanyizo, "MULYOKE" bakakase okwagala kwa Katonda okulungi, okusanyusa, era okutuukiridde. Waaliwo ekisaanyizo. Bandikakasizza okwagala kwa Katonda singa tewaali kisaanyizo; naye waaliwo ekisaanyizo kye baagaana okutuukiriza; kale we bakwatira, we baabeeranga—oba, ekisingako, baddayo ennyuma. Kale, kaakano, wano waliwo ekisaanyizo ku kukulaakulana kuno okukulu era okw'ekitiibwa okuva mu mbeera ey'okuweebwa obutuukirivu, gye, wadde ng'omukkiriza aweebwa amaanyi ku kibi, ekibi kiryoke kireme okumufuga, naye oluusi, olw'emirimu gyakyo egy'omunda, agwa wansi w'amaanyi gaakyo—okukulaakulana okuva mu mbeera eno ey'okwonoona n'okwenenya okutuuka ku mutindo ogwo omukkiriza gy'abeerera mu Kristo n'ataayonoona, n'ayagala Katonda n'omutima gwe gwonna, n'emmeeme ye yonna, n'amagezi ge gonna, n'amaanyi ge gonna—ng'agatta ne Kristo bw'atyo nti, ng'atambulira mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, atuukiriza etteeka ery'okwagala mwe yateekebwa—okukulaakulana, njogera, okuva mu mbeera eyo ey'okugulumba n'okukka, okuyingira n'okufuluma, okugwa n'okugolokoka, okutuuka ku mutindo guno ogwa waggulu, nakwo kulina ebisaanyizo byakwo. Mwandyambuseeko eyo leero singa si bisaanyizo; abasinga obungi ku mmwe mwandyambuseeko awamu, ng'Abayisirayeeri bwe bandiyingidde mu Kanani, singa tewaali kisaanyizo. Sirabangako muntu musirusiru nga tayagala kubeera mu nsi ennungi; mazima bayagala okubeeramu, era bandiyingidde ne bafuna omubisi gw'enjuki n'amata, naye waliwo ebisaanyizo! Kale nno, wano mukirabira ddala mu bweru, era mukiraba mu byawandiikibwa ebirala bingi mu ngeri y'emu ey'olwatu. Tewali kintu Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'assaako essira erisinga nga bw'assaako ku kuteeka ebisaanyizo. Kale bye biruwa? "Kale, abooluganda, mbeegayirira olw'okusaasira kwa Katonda, muwaayo emibiri gyammwe okuba ssaddaaka ennamu"—omuntu omulamu—mmwe, mwenna; si kyo—si kintu ekiri mu mmwe. Ekigambo ekyo eky'oluvannyuma Omwoyo Omutukuvu takozesa bw'ayogera n'Abakristaayo, naye bulijjo mmwe, byammwe, emibiri gyammwe, emyoyo gyammwe, amagezi gammwe, omuntu yenna—MMWE, "ssaddaaka ennamu, entukuvu, esanyusa Katonda, kwe kusinza kwammwe okw'omwoyo." Era si bwe kiri? Kisukkiridde? Kisinga ku ekyo kye yateesa bwe yabagula? Kisinga ku kye yasasula? Kwe "kusinza kwammwe okw'omwoyo." Kale nno, kaakano, ekisaanyizo kijja: "Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno, naye mukyusibwe olw'okuzza obuggya amagezi gammwe, mulyoke..." Woowe! singa mwandisobodde okukyusibwa okudda gy'ali n'okwefaananyiriza ba mulembe guno mu kiseera kye kimu, obuzibu bwonna bwandiweddewo. Mmanyi abantu bangi abandikyusibbwa mangwago; naye, okulema okwefaananyiriza ba mulembe guno—nga bayimirira ne beenyinyimba olw'ekyo! Tebasobola kukifuna ku muwendo ogwo. Nga Finney omwagalwa bwe yali agamba, "Owooluganda wange, bw'oba oyagala okulaba Katonda, tojja kumusanga waggulu eyo, mu kitiibwa kyonna eky'ekibiina n'okuwaanawaana kw'omuliro; oteekwa okukka wansi omunoonye." Bwe kiri ekyo—"Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno." Tewali kintu kinnuma okusingawo, oluvannyuma lw'okubeera mu nkuŋŋaana ez'okuyamba emyoyo, gye ngezaako okwogera mu ngeri entuufu era enzijuvu okulaba nga buli muntu ategeera kye ntegeeza, bwe ŋŋenda ku mmeeza ey'ekijjulo oba eky'akawungeezi, abantu ne bataba na kye bategedde na katono, oba, bwe baba nga bategeeye, tebajja kukikkiriza. Woowe! kino kye kyama—tebaagala kuva ku malala gaabwe n'okwegulumiza kwabwe. Naye Katonda talyeraga mu myoyo egiri bwe gityo, wadde nga bakaaba ne basaba okutuusa lwe bafuuka magumba, ne bagenda nga bakungubaga ennaku zaabwe zonna. Tebaatuukirize kisaanyizo—"Temwefaananyirizanga ba mulembe guno"; tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe wadde okutuuka ku mbaga y'ekijjulo. Bangi be mmanyi tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe mu ngeri gye baamba enkuufiira zaabwe. Tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe okutuuka ku kuleka okukyalira n'okusembeza abantu abatatya Katonda, ab'ensi, abateriimu, n'aba wamusenge. Tebaagala kuleka kwefaananyiriza kwabwe okutuuka ku kuleka entegeka zaabwe ez'omu maka okwonoonebwa—nedda, ne bwe kiba nti obulokozi bw'abaana baabwe, n'abaweereza baabwe, ne mikwano gyabwe kwe kusinziira. Ekyetaagisa ddala kwe kusanyusibwa kwabwe kwennyini, olwo ku ludda lwa Katonda n'ofuna kyonna ky'osobola okufuna. "Twetaaga kino, era twetaaga kiri; olwo, singa Mukama Yesu Kristo anajja ku nkomerero n'atukuza byonna, tunaamwebaza nnyo; naye tetusobola kuleka bintu bino." Woowe! mikwano gyange, mbagamba, kino tekiyinza kubaawo. Katonda ng'annyamba, nnaabagamba, nteekwa okubagamba, kubanga kikakibwa mu mwoyo gwange olw'ebyo bye ndaba era bye mpulira buli lunaku. Abantu bajja mu nkuŋŋaana zino, ne basinda ne bakaaba ne bajja gye tuli okuyambibwa, ne tumalako obwongo bwaffe obunafu n'emibiri gyaffe nga tubagamba n'okubawa amagezi, nga tubagamba kye baba bakola, ate bwe kituuka awasembayo, tuzuula nti, "Woowe! nedda; temulimbibwalimbibwa: tetugenda kuwaayo bintu bino. Tetuyinza kufuna Mukama bw'anaaba tajja mu yeekaalu zaffe n'abitwala nga bw'abisanga. Tetuyinza kuleka bintu bino." Mujjukira ekyawandiikibwa ekyasomebwa ku kuggulawo kw'olukuŋŋaana—Yokaana 17:14: "...era ensi yabakyawa kubanga si ba nsi." Kirimu amakulu! era waliwo ebyawandiikibwa ebirala kikumi ebiyigiriza amazima ge gamu. Kale, kitegeeza ki? Mukama atuyambe okukiraba! Tekitegeeza nti tetusaana kuba ng'ensi endala?—nti tetusaana kuluŋŋamizibwa ebigambo eby'amagezi bye bimu, oba okukola ng'emisingi gy'ensi bwe giri?—nti tetusaana kussa essira lye limu ku bintu eby'ensi obuntu, ng'abantu ab'ensi bwe bakola? Mwali mwelowoozangako ebigambo ebyo eby'amaanyi ebiri mu lugero lw'omusizi? Makko 4:19: "...naye okweraliikirira kw'ensi n'obulimba bw'obugagga n'okwegomba ebintu ebirala biyingira ne bizisa ekigambo, ne kitabala bibala"—si bintu bya muzizo, si bintu bya buwemu, si bintu bya nsonyi, naye okwegomba ebintu ebirala. Mu kyawandiikibwa ekirala, Abafiripi 3:19: "...abalowooza ebintu eby'oku nsi." Bassa essira erisingawo ku bintu eby'ensi n'ebintu ebirala okusinga bwe bakola eri ebintu eby'obwakabaka bwe. Mu butuufu bassa ebintu bino mu maaso, wadde nga bayimba ku bwakabaka bwe era nga beeyatula okumussa mu maaso: bassa ebintu eby'ensi mu maaso, kyekiva, tebaagala bintu byabwe eby'ensi kwonoonebwa olw'ebintu bye; ne mulowooza nti akubibwa? Mulowooza nti alimbibwa? Mulowooza nga kisoboka nti Katonda Omukulu ow'omu ggulu, alina obukadde n'obukadde bwa bamalayika ne bamalayika abakulu okumusinza n'okumuweereza, ajja kufuka ekitiibwa kye ku bantu ng'abo, ne yeeraga gye bali, n'abakozesa? Si kirabika! "Nnaabanga ow'olubereberye mu kwagala kwammwe," bw'agamba. Mmwe abakazi abali wano, singa mumanya nti temuli ba lubereberye era ab'obumu mu kwagala kwa babbammwe, mwandigambye ki? Nammwe abaami, mwandibadde n'omukazi singa mumanyi nti si mmwe mwokka mu kwagala kwe, naye nga kwawuliddwamu wakati wammwe n'omulala? "Si kirabika!" mwandigambye; "Sijja kuyiwa kwagala kwange, n'obudde bwange, n'ebirabo byange, ne buli kye nnina, ku muntu omutima gwe gwe gwawuliddwamu n'omulala. Bw'anaaba ayagala omutima gwe okwawulibwamu, kale agende eri oyo omulala." Kaakano mumanyi nti Katonda wa buggya, era amanyi abamuduulira, era amanyi abo abatajja kuwaayo kwefaananyiriza kuno okw'ensi balyoke batambule naye nga bambadde engoye enjeru. Amanyi, era, abo abatafaayo ku ky'omuntu yenna ky'abalowoozaako, oba abantu kye boogera ku bo; abo abeetegefu okubalibwa ng'abasirusiru n'abalalu balyoke batambule naye era batumbule ebirungi eby'obwakabaka bwe, era abatwala emibiri gyabwe ng'ebikozesebwa bye n'amaka gaabwe nga yeekaalu ze; abo abakkiriza ng'essaawa zaabwe ez'ekyenkya, oba ez'ekijjulo, oba ez'akatono ak'omu ttuntu, oba essaawa zonna endala ziyinza okwonoonebwa, era, mu butuufu, buli kimu ne kifuulibwa ekya kabiri eri ebirungi eby'obwakabaka bwe. Tuteekwa okuteeka buli kimu mu buweereza bwe—abaana baffe, emirimu gyaffe, amaka gaffe, na buli kimu. Bwe nkitegeera bulungi, buno bwe butefaananyiriza nsi. Nga sinnamaliriza, ka njogere ekigambo okuyamba abo abaagala okutuuka ku mukisa guno. Tewali kkubo ddala lirala. Tekigasa kwetooloola bunyiriri. TEMWEFAANANYIRIZANGA, NAYE MUKYUSIBWE. Bino byombi bikontana lwatu. Bwe mulonda okwefaananyiriza, olwo temuyinza kukyusibwa; bwe mutaakkirize kukyusibwa, olwo muteekwa okwefaananyiriza. Kaakano, munaaleka okwefaananyiriza ensi? fields.title: Okwogera okw'Okusatu
fields.body_html:
Nga waliwo okugenda mu nkuŋŋaana n'okuweebwa omukisa eyo, oluvannyuma ne tugenda ne tubeera bwe tutyo nga bwe twali, okutuusa oluusi ffe, abeenyigira bulijjo mu kugezaako okusembeza abantu okumpi ne Katonda, ne tugenda nga tuweddemu essuubi nnyo, emitima gyaffe nga giri kumpi okumenyeka.

Tuwulira nti abantu badda emabega okuva mu kifo gye tubakulembeddemu, mu kifo ky'okulinnya okutuuka mu kifo Katonda gy'abayita. Bajja nga bajja, era ffe, nga Nnabbi bw'agamba, tuli gye bali ekyuma ekisanyusa ennyo, oba ekitasanyusa ennyo, ng'embeera bw'eri; kale ne bagenda, so tebafuna kintu kyonna. Tebakola kukulaakulana kwonna okweyoleka. Tetubawadde kirabo kyonna eky'omwoyo. Bakwatibwa bukwatibwa mu mpulira zaabwe, era, olw'ekyo, bawangaala mu wiiki eddako nga bwe baali mu eyayita, ne bagondera okukemebwa nga bwe baakola olubereberye.

Oyinza okulowooza akaseera n'akamu ng'osoma Endagaano Empya nti kino kye kika ky'ekintu Katonda kye yayagala mu kutegeka kwe okw'ekisa n'obulokozi? Tewali kigendererwa ekyeyoleka mu buli kisuubizo, okubuulirira, n'ekiragiro? Katonda yeeyoleka nnyo mu bye yeetaaga ne bye asuubiza, ne mu ntegeka gy'akoze; naye kyokka bangi ku bantu ba Mukama beeyongera bulijjo era n'obunyiikivu okuba abatategeerekeka. Badda emabega ne mu maaso, ng'oluggi bwe lukyukira ku bisiba byalwo, so tebafuna kintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama.

Twagala ddala mufune ekintu okuva eri Mukama, era tukakasa nti muyinza era mujja kufuna, bwe munaagondera embeera. Mukama mwetegefu okubawa ekigero ekyo eky'ekisa, amaanyi, n'obulokozi bye mwetaaga. Kaakano bwe mutuuse ku mulyango gw'ensi ennungi, waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekiyinza okubasigaza ebweru, singa mukoze okwewaayo okwetaagisa. Mazima ddala, bwe muba mukwata ku kintu kyonna, temuyinza kuyingira okutuusa lwe munaakiwaayo. Bwe muba munywerera ku kintu ekibuusabuusa, so temuwa Katonda mukisa mu kubuusabuusa kwammwe, temuyinza kuyingira; naye, bwe mulaba kino, ne mukola okwewaayo okwetaagisa, bwe muba mwagala ddala omukisa guno, waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekiyinza okubasigaza obutagusanyukira, era kye kino—obutakkiriza.

Kirigambibwa ku mmwe, mu myaka egijja, nga bwe kyagambibwa ku abamu mu biseera eby'edda, Abaebbulaniya 3:19: “Awo tulaba nga tebaayinza kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza.” Mutuuse ddala ku mulyango, era abamu ku mmwe mwabaddeyo emirundi mingi. Ai! nga mufunye obuyinza obw'ekisa obungi!

Mulabye nga muyita mu lutimbe! Muwulidde omukono gwe! Ebigere byammwe mubiteeka ku mulyango!

Mwali kumpi okuyingira, ne muddayo emabega olw'obutakkiriza. Kiribeera bwe kityo nate ekiro kino? Kikafuuwe! Munaasala okuyingira? Munaagezaako? Munaakkiriza? Munaabuuka ne mugwa ku bwesigwa bwe? Munaabuuka mu mikono gy'Okwagala Okuyinzabyonna, ne mumwesiga awamu n'ebivaamu? Temufaayo ne bwe munaafa, oba ne bwe wanaabaawo ekibaawo ku mmwe ekitali kyabaawo ku muntu mulala yenna mu byafaayo by'ensi; Katonda anaabalabirira. Temufaayo ne bwe Setaani anajja n'abakebera, nga bwe yakola Yobu, n'ababonyaabonya n'amabwa, n'abateeka ku ntuumu y'evvu— munaasinga okusanyuka eyo awamu ne Yesu okusinga mu lubiri nga taliimu ye. Ai! okweraliikirira kuno olw'ebivaamu! Setaani amanyi ebisoboka ebikulu ebiggule eri bangi ku mmwe; amanyi si kyokka kye muyinza okufuna n'okwesanyusaamu mu mmwe mwennyini, naye ne kye muyinza okutuukiriza ku lwa Katonda singa mwandiyingidde ne mufuna omukisa guno; kale abatiisa n'ebivaamu. Amanyi kye muyinza okukola, n'oyo gwe muyinza okukozesebwa okulokola!

Ani amanyi abameka ku baagalwa bano abababeetooloola, be muyinza okukozesebwa okukulembera okutuuka ku mutindo guno ogwa waggulu—ekifo kino eky'ekitiibwa eky'obumanyirivu obw'Ekikristaayo? ne, okuyita mu bo, abalala bameka? ne engeri, mu ngeri eno, omukisa ogw'ekitiibwa gye gwandisaasaanidde? Mujjukire, era, nti buli lwe musembera ne muddayo emabega, obusobozi nti muliyingira ddala buba butono; era gye musingira okusembera ne muddayo emabega, obusobozi nti mulidda okusembera okumpi bwe kityo bwe bukka.

Munakuwaza Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Waliwo abantu abamu abaabadde basembera okumala emyaka mingi, ne kaakano baddayo ddala emabega, era ntya nti tebaliddamu kwambuka. Munaakola mutya?

Etteeka ery'obwakabaka, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, lye lino, Matayo 9:29: “...Kibe gye muli ng'okukkiriza kwammwe bwe kuli,” ne, Makko 11:24: “Kyenva mbagamba nti, buli kye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nga mukifunye, era kinaabeera kyammwe.” Amazima agataggwaawo gakyogedde—“kinaabeera kyammwe.” Kale nno, munaakikola? Muvuddeko ku buli kintu? Mukyewuze ddala? Mulese buli kintu emabega wammwe? Musazeewo okuva leero ekiro okusala enkolagana yonna n'ebyayita, obuteeddamu kutegekera mubiri kukola kye gwegomba, wabula okusiibula ebintu ebiri emabega olw'enkomerero, mubizibeko amaaso gammwe, ne muteeka amaaso gammwe ku mpeera ey'okuyitibwa kwammwe okwa waggulu, ne mweyongerayo buli saawa eddako mu bulamu bwammwe okutuusa lwe muligituukako? Munaakikola? Bwe munaakikola, Katonda anaabawa omukisa guno. Alindirira okukikola; ali wano. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali wano: akulembera bangi ku mmwe; abeegayirira; anyweza kye ŋgamba mu mitima gyammwe; agamba nti, “Mujje, abaagalwa; muyingire mu kisenge eky'embaga;” ayagala okubawa omukisa n'okubajjuza Omwoyo we. Kale nno, munajja? Ai! Mukama abayambe obutadda mabega, wabula okweyongerayo, okweyongerayo, okweyongerayo, nga temufaayo ku bivaamu.
fields.body_text: Nga waliwo okugenda mu nkuŋŋaana n'okuweebwa omukisa eyo, oluvannyuma ne tugenda ne tubeera bwe tutyo nga bwe twali, okutuusa oluusi ffe, abeenyigira bulijjo mu kugezaako okusembeza abantu okumpi ne Katonda, ne tugenda nga tuweddemu essuubi nnyo, emitima gyaffe nga giri kumpi okumenyeka. Tuwulira nti abantu badda emabega okuva mu kifo gye tubakulembeddemu, mu kifo ky'okulinnya okutuuka mu kifo Katonda gy'abayita. Bajja nga bajja, era ffe, nga Nnabbi bw'agamba, tuli gye bali ekyuma ekisanyusa ennyo, oba ekitasanyusa ennyo, ng'embeera bw'eri; kale ne bagenda, so tebafuna kintu kyonna. Tebakola kukulaakulana kwonna okweyoleka. Tetubawadde kirabo kyonna eky'omwoyo. Bakwatibwa bukwatibwa mu mpulira zaabwe, era, olw'ekyo, bawangaala mu wiiki eddako nga bwe baali mu eyayita, ne bagondera okukemebwa nga bwe baakola olubereberye. Oyinza okulowooza akaseera n'akamu ng'osoma Endagaano Empya nti kino kye kika ky'ekintu Katonda kye yayagala mu kutegeka kwe okw'ekisa n'obulokozi? Tewali kigendererwa ekyeyoleka mu buli kisuubizo, okubuulirira, n'ekiragiro? Katonda yeeyoleka nnyo mu bye yeetaaga ne bye asuubiza, ne mu ntegeka gy'akoze; naye kyokka bangi ku bantu ba Mukama beeyongera bulijjo era n'obunyiikivu okuba abatategeerekeka. Badda emabega ne mu maaso, ng'oluggi bwe lukyukira ku bisiba byalwo, so tebafuna kintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama. Twagala ddala mufune ekintu okuva eri Mukama, era tukakasa nti muyinza era mujja kufuna, bwe munaagondera embeera. Mukama mwetegefu okubawa ekigero ekyo eky'ekisa, amaanyi, n'obulokozi bye mwetaaga. Kaakano bwe mutuuse ku mulyango gw'ensi ennungi, waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekiyinza okubasigaza ebweru, singa mukoze okwewaayo okwetaagisa. Mazima ddala, bwe muba mukwata ku kintu kyonna, temuyinza kuyingira okutuusa lwe munaakiwaayo. Bwe muba munywerera ku kintu ekibuusabuusa, so temuwa Katonda mukisa mu kubuusabuusa kwammwe, temuyinza kuyingira; naye, bwe mulaba kino, ne mukola okwewaayo okwetaagisa, bwe muba mwagala ddala omukisa guno, waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekiyinza okubasigaza obutagusanyukira, era kye kino—obutakkiriza. Kirigambibwa ku mmwe, mu myaka egijja, nga bwe kyagambibwa ku abamu mu biseera eby'edda, Abaebbulaniya 3:19: "Awo tulaba nga tebaayinza kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza." Mutuuse ddala ku mulyango, era abamu ku mmwe mwabaddeyo emirundi mingi. Ai! nga mufunye obuyinza obw'ekisa obungi! Mulabye nga muyita mu lutimbe! Muwulidde omukono gwe! Ebigere byammwe mubiteeka ku mulyango! Mwali kumpi okuyingira, ne muddayo emabega olw'obutakkiriza. Kiribeera bwe kityo nate ekiro kino? Kikafuuwe! Munaasala okuyingira? Munaagezaako? Munaakkiriza? Munaabuuka ne mugwa ku bwesigwa bwe? Munaabuuka mu mikono gy'Okwagala Okuyinzabyonna, ne mumwesiga awamu n'ebivaamu? Temufaayo ne bwe munaafa, oba ne bwe wanaabaawo ekibaawo ku mmwe ekitali kyabaawo ku muntu mulala yenna mu byafaayo by'ensi; Katonda anaabalabirira. Temufaayo ne bwe Setaani anajja n'abakebera, nga bwe yakola Yobu, n'ababonyaabonya n'amabwa, n'abateeka ku ntuumu y'evvu— munaasinga okusanyuka eyo awamu ne Yesu okusinga mu lubiri nga taliimu ye. Ai! okweraliikirira kuno olw'ebivaamu! Setaani amanyi ebisoboka ebikulu ebiggule eri bangi ku mmwe; amanyi si kyokka kye muyinza okufuna n'okwesanyusaamu mu mmwe mwennyini, naye ne kye muyinza okutuukiriza ku lwa Katonda singa mwandiyingidde ne mufuna omukisa guno; kale abatiisa n'ebivaamu. Amanyi kye muyinza okukola, n'oyo gwe muyinza okukozesebwa okulokola! Ani amanyi abameka ku baagalwa bano abababeetooloola, be muyinza okukozesebwa okukulembera okutuuka ku mutindo guno ogwa waggulu—ekifo kino eky'ekitiibwa eky'obumanyirivu obw'Ekikristaayo? ne, okuyita mu bo, abalala bameka? ne engeri, mu ngeri eno, omukisa ogw'ekitiibwa gye gwandisaasaanidde? Mujjukire, era, nti buli lwe musembera ne muddayo emabega, obusobozi nti muliyingira ddala buba butono; era gye musingira okusembera ne muddayo emabega, obusobozi nti mulidda okusembera okumpi bwe kityo bwe bukka. Munakuwaza Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Waliwo abantu abamu abaabadde basembera okumala emyaka mingi, ne kaakano baddayo ddala emabega, era ntya nti tebaliddamu kwambuka. Munaakola mutya? Etteeka ery'obwakabaka, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, lye lino, Matayo 9:29: "...Kibe gye muli ng'okukkiriza kwammwe bwe kuli," ne, Makko 11:24: "Kyenva mbagamba nti, buli kye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nga mukifunye, era kinaabeera kyammwe." fields.title: Emboozi Ey'okuna
fields.body_html:
Ndowooza, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nga kaakano nnina ebigambo bitono nnyo eby'okubagamba. Nga bwe kiri, nneenywezezza ku Katonda okuweebwa amaanyi ge ndyogeza ebigambo bino, bagende bakke mu mitima gyammwe ne bavaamu ebibala eby'amangu era eby'olubeerera mu bulamu bwammwe. Nzikiriza nti Mukama tanakwatibwa nnaku na kunakuwala kwokka, naye nzikiriza nti asunguwala, abantu be bwe bakuŋŋaana, ne boogera, ne bayimba, ne basaba, oluvannyuma ne bagenda awatali kibala kirambike kye batuuseeko—awatali kuba nga bamuwaddeko ekintu kyonna, oba okufuna ekintu kyonna okuva gy'ali. Nzikiriza nti awulira ku ffe nga bwe yawulira ku bantu be ab'edda, bwe yayogera mu Malaki 2:13: “...Mubikka ekyoto kya MUKAMA n'amaziga, n'okukaaba n'okusinda, kubanga takyafaayo ku kiweebwayo wadde okukyaniriza n'ekisa okuva mu mukono gwammwe.” Nga wandigambye nti, “Mumanyi kye njagala mukole; mujje mukikole; era, bwe muba mukikola, ndyagula amadirisa ag'omu ggulu ne mbafukira omukisa.”

Omutima gwange gwalumwa olw'ekyo omukyala kye yaŋŋamba ku makya ga leero, nga sinnayingira mu kizimbe kino. Yagamba nti, “Munnange yagamba nti, 'Toyinza kugamba nti ojja kukuŋŋaanya abantu enkumi nnya okukaabira Omwoyo Omutukuvu?' N'agamba nti, 'Yee, bwe ntyo.' 'Kale, kimpa entiisa. Singa waabaawo ekibaawo; singa waabaawo ekikolebwa?'” Singa Katonda yakkiriza ekintu kibaawo; singa Katonda yakkiriza ekintu kikolebwe ekyanditiisizza omuntu. Naye woowe! ekyo kyayoleka ki? Obuziba bw'okubuusabuusa n'obutakkiriza; ate abantu ne beewuunya nti okubuusabuusa kweyongera. Kyewuunyisa nti ababuusabuusa batusekerera n'okutuduulira? Kyewuunyisa nti mu bibiina by'Obujulizi bw'Ekikristaayo abasajja bagolokoka ne bagamba nti enkola y'Ekikristaayo ekaddiye n'eggwaawo? Tekyewuunyisa, ng'ogwo gwe mutima gw'abantu ba Mukama.

Abantu bakuŋŋaana, ne basaba, ne boogera, ne bayimba nti “Eleru okusinga omuzira,” naye tebakikkiriza n'akatono okusinga abakaafiiri bwe bakikkiriza. Basabira Omwoyo Omutukuvu, so nga tebakkiriza nti waliwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Basaba Katonda akole ekintu, so nga tebamumanyanga kukola kintu kyonna, era tebasuubira nti aliddayo kukikola. Ensi efa olw'obutali bwa mazima buno, era ezikirizibwa kyo.

Josephine Butler ayogera, ku Bufaransa, nti “Bufaransa bulindiridde amazima:” era ne Bungereza bwe butyo, era n'ensi yonna erindiridde amazima. Katonda atuyambe okukola abantu ab'amazima. Abamu ku mmwe mukkiriza nti tewali kya kubaawo. Temukkiriza nti Katonda ajja kukola ekintu kyonna—noolwekyo talikola mu bulamu bwammwe. Singa mwabeera e Nazaaleesi, mulowooza nti Yesu Kristo yandibakoledde ekintu kyonna? Singa mwali bakiggala era bakasiru, mwandisigadde bwe mutyo, kubanga teyandisobodde kukola bikolwa bya maanyi mu mmwe, olw'obutakkiriza bwammwe! Ye y'omu kaakano; era bwe muba temumusuubira kukola kintu kyonna, owooluganda, talikola. Naye abamu ku ffe tumusuubira okukola ekintu. Abamu ku ffe tukkiriza nti ajja kukola ekintu, era nti n'ejjinja lino ettono, eryatemebwa okuva mu lusozi awatali mikono, agenderera okuyimusa obwakabaka obunene. Yesu Kristo tajja kunakuwazibwa, n'aleka Setaani okumusekerera mu maaso ennaku zonna, n'agamba nti, “Nkubbye omugabo gwo.” Tujja kukola ekintu, oba tufiire mu kukigezaako.

Ekisembayo, Katonda ayagala ki gye tuli? Ayagala tube era tukole. Ayagala tufaanane Omwana we, ne tukola nga Omwana we bwe yakola; era bwe tutuuka awo, alinyeenyeza ensi ng'ayita mu ffe. Abantu bagamba nti, “Toyinza kufaanana Omwana we.” Kale nnyo, olwo, tojja kufuna kisukka ku ky'okkiriza. Singa ssaalowooza nti Yesu Kristo w'amaanyi agamala okuzikiriza emirimu gya Setaani, n'okututuusa nate ku kifaananyi Katonda kye yasooka okuteekawo, nnandisudde ekintu kyonna emirembe gyonna. Ki! Atuwadde eddiini gye tutayinza kukola? Nti nedda, tajja kutuduulira. Ki? Atuwadde Omulokozi atayinza kulokola? Kale nziggya emikono ku ye. Ki! Yeeyita nti alinkolera kye tayinza? Nedda, nedda. Okubala 23:19 kutugamba nti: “Katonda si muntu, alyoke alimbe, wadde omwana w'omuntu, alyoke akyuse endowooza ye.” era mbagamba nti enteekateeka ye ey'obulokozi erina enjuyi bbiri—yolekera eri Katonda ate n'eri omuntu. Enfaako ku nze nga bw'efaako ku Katonda omukulu. Si nteekateeka ya bulokozi bwokka—wabula nteekateeka ya kuzzaawo.

Bw'aba tayinza kunzizaawo, awenkanya kunsalira musango. Bw'aba tayinza kumponya, n'ankola buggya, n'anzizaawo ku kifaananyi kye yali ayagadde mbeere, tewali kirala ky'aba yeerekedde.

Nsomooza omuntu yenna okulaga okuyita mu Bayibuli nti si kituufu nti agenderera okunzizaawo—obwongo, omutima, emmeeme, omwoyo, omubiri, buli kawenga k'obuntu bwange—okunzizaawo mu bujjuvu, okumpanyisiza ddala mu kifaananyi ky'Omwana we. Singa yasobola okundokola awatali kunzizaawo, olwo yandisobodde okundokola awatali Mulokozi n'akatono. Musoma mutya Bayibuli zammwe? Musoma mutya ebyafaayo by'eby'amagero—ebyafaayo bye yazibula amaaso, n'aggulawo amatu, n'atukuza omugenge, n'azuukiza abafu? Ajja kubawonya bwe mumukkiriza.

Bino bye bigambo ensi bya yeetaaga—ebigambo ebiramu, obujulizi obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, abantu abatambula nga bakiikirira Omwoyo, n'obulamu n'amaanyi bya Yesu Kristo. Muyinza okusaasaanya Bayibuli, nga bwe mukoze, mu nsi yonna. Muyinza okubuulira, n'okuyimba, n'okwogera, n'okukola kye mwagala; naye, bwe mutalaga bantu ebbaluwa ennamu, ne mubalaga enkyukakyuka ey'empisa n'obulamu mu mmwe eyaleetebwa amaanyi n'ekisa kya Katonda—bwe mutabagendako ne mukola emirimu gya Yesu Kristo, muyinza okweyongera okubuulira, ate ensi ne yeeyongera kwonooneka, era n'ekkanisa nayo. Twetaaga obujulizi obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Twagala YESU AKOMEWO NATE MU MUBIRI.

Wali oyakalaba ekiseera ky'ekikolwa mu kifo ekyo—1 Yokaana 4:2: “...Buli mwoyo ayatula nti Yesu Kristo yajja mu mubiri ava eri Katonda,”—si nti yajja, oba yali azze, wabula nti azze kaakano. Woowe! engeri abantu gye bakyawamu Yesu Kristo mu mubiri. Oyinza okuba ow'eddiini ennyo, ow'amateeka ennyo, okutuusa lw'ojja eri Yesu mu mubiri, olwo balikuluma amannyo nga bwe baalulumira Kristo. Tebasobola kuziyiza bantu ba ngeri eyo. Kino kye ensi ky'eyeetaaga—abantu abatukuvu; era tewali kirala kirikola. Twagezezzaako buli kintu ekirala. Mmwe Abakristaayo abava mu bibinja ebirala eby'eggye lya Mukama, mugezezzaako Bayibuli, n'okubuulira, n'okuyimba, n'okusinza, n'amasomero ga Ssande. Nakyalako oluvannyuma mu kitundu ky'eggwanga gye baŋŋambira nti kumpi buli muntu ow'omu kitundu ekyo yali ayise mu masomero gaabwe aga Ssande, ate nga waliyo abasajja eyo abasika omuwala omuto ku madaala g'amayinja ne bamusamba okutuusa lw'afuuka omuddugavu n'okunyiiga. Ekibiina ekinene eky'abantu abeenyigira mu Byogero bya Lancashire baayita mu masomero gammwe aga Ssande.

Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, Katonda ayogera nammwe mu bintu bino, singa mumuwuliriza, era agamba nti ennukuta etta, nti okukomola, n'okubatiza, n'enkola, n'emikolo, n'okugenda mu kkanisa, n'okusoma Bayibuli, byonna si kintu, bwe mutabaamu Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Mwetaaga obujulizi obwa nnamaddala, obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo nate, era Eggye ly'Obulokozi bwe litagenda kubeera ekyo, Katonda alizikize! Nnandisiimye okwogera ku lumbe lw'Eggye singa ssaalikkirizza nti lyandibadde ekyo. Ensi efiirira kino.

Nakwatibwako nnyo, jjo, olw'okuwulira olugero oluva e Paris, olwanjogeddwa omukazi omuto eyaakomawo, ng'aŋŋamba ku mwana wange omwagalwa. Olugero lwali luno: Omukazi yajja, ku makya, n'asaba okulaba omukyala. Ne bagezaako okumugoba, ne babuuza nti, “Omulala tayinza kukola?” “Nedda,” omukazi n'agamba; “Njagala nnyo okulaba omukyala yennyini.” Ne bagamba nti, “Toyinza kumulaba leero—mulwadde nnyo!” “Kale,” n'agamba, “Ndimulaba ddi?” Ne bamuwa ekiseera olunaku olwaddirira olw'oku ssaawa, n'olwo omukazi ono omwavu n'ajja, n'ayogera olugero luno: “Nnawulira, emyaka mukaaga egiyise, nti waliwo omuntu ayinza okuggyamu Setaani. Kaakano, laba, nnina Setaani munda, era ampindula omubi era omunaku, era njagala nnyo aggyibwemu, era mbadde ndduka okumala emyaka gino omukaaga okunoonya omuntu ayinza okumusikamu. Nadda eri bakabona bangi, naye tebaasobola kumusikamu kubanga baalina Setaani munda mu bo; era, laba bwe wabaawo Setaani munda mu nze ne Setaani munda mu bo, twatandika okulwana, ne batasobola kumusikamu.” Nga kino kinnyonnyola bulungi Ebikolwa 19:15: “Naye omwoyo omubi ne guddamu nti, 'Yesu mmumanyi, ne Pawulo mmumanyi, naye mmwe muli baani?'” Mazima ddala, tewali ayinza kugoba Setaani ng'alina Setaani mu ye. Amagezi g'omukazi omukadde omunaku ge gaamubuulira kino.

“Era,” n'ayongerako, “omusajja omulungi yaŋŋamba nti omukyala ono azze wano asobola okumusikamu, era nzize gy'ali akikole, kubanga njagala asikibwemu.” Woowe, yee! Ne ndowooza nti, ekyo kye kintu abantu abanaku kye beetaaga mu nsi yonna. BEETAAGA ABANTU ABASOBOLA OKUGOBA SETAANI—abantu abalina amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu munda mu bo okukikola. Woowe! Onooba omuntu ng'oyo?

“Katonda ali ludda wa?” omuntu yaŋŋamba olunaku olujja, mu nnaku ennyingi—”Katonda ali ludda wa?” Ddala, ali ludda wa!

“Lwaki teyeeraga? Lwaki takola kintu?” Omukyala oyo yatidde nti waabaawo ekintu ekibaawo abantu 4,000 bwe bakuŋŋaana okusabira Omwoyo Omutukuvu! Lwaki nedda? Mugamba nti tekyusa. Enzikiriza yammwe bw'egamba. Mugamba nti y'omu jjo, leero, n'emirembe gyonna.

Mugamba nti obwetaavu bw'ensi bunene bwe butyo. Mugamba nti omutima gwe omunene ogw'okwagala gukubira ab'omu maka g'abantu abagwa, ab'ebibi, abakyama. Mugamba nti atwagala. Bulijjo mwogera ku kwagala kwe. Nsonga ki eleetera obutakola kintu ku lwaffe, n'okukka mu bujjuvu obwenkanaawo obw'amaanyi ag'omwoyo nga bwe yakola ku Pentekooti? Lwaki? Lwa kubanga temwewaayo gy'ali era temuli beetegefu kukikola nga abantu bwe baali mu biseera eby'edda. Temubalidde bintu byonna kufaafaaganirwa na kasasiro. Temusudde buli kintu ku minzaani, era, noolwekyo, tajja kubabatiza na Mwoyo Mutukuvu mu ngeri eno. Bano be bantu ensi b'eyeetaaga—abantu ab'ekirowoozo kimu—Kristo, era oyo eyakomererwa. Ku lwa Kristo, muleke okuwakana.

Nagamba omukyala eyali afunye omukisa guno omuntu bwe yamutuukako n'atandika n'olunyiriri luno n'oluli, n'enkyusa eno n'eri—”Weegendereze toolina kutandika kwewuunya na kulowooza; ojja kufiirwa omukisa gwo”—era yaguufiirwa. Toyinza kukimanya na kutegeera kwa magezi. Woowe! singa ensi yasobodde okukimanya na kutegeera, bandimanyi bingi nnyo. Naye agaana amagezi go gonna ag'ensi. Si na kutegeera, wabula na kukkiriza! Bw'onoomanya Katonda kinaaba na kukkiriza, ng'ofuuka ng'omwana omuto—ng'oyasamya akamwa ko, ng'ogamba nti, “Mukama, fuka munda;” n'olwo okuwakana kwo n'ebizibu byo binaggwaawo, era onoolaba obutukuvu, okutukuzibwa, obulongoofu, okwagala okutuukiridde, nga byaka ku buli lupapula lw'Ekigambo kya Katonda. Nkaaba mu maaso ga Katonda, mpulira nga kumpi okusukka kye nsobola okugumira, ku mpisa eno embi abantu abamu gye balaga ey'okusika omugaati okugguyako mu kamwa k'abaana nga baakatandika okugwegomba. Mukama abakwatirwe ekisa! Bwe mutayingira mmwe bennyini, ku lwa Kristo temuziyiza balala kuyingira.

Omuweereza—omusajja omulungi, eyeewaddeyo—yali agezaako okundaga nti okutukuzibwa kuno kwali kunene nnyo okufunibwa n'okukuumibwa. Nagamba nti, “Ssebo omwagalwa, omanyi otya? Omusajja omulala bw'aba n'okukkiriza okutambula okutuuka eri Yesu Kristo n'agamba nti, 'Laba, kino nkiraba mu Kitabo kyo; wansuubiza kino; kale nno, Mukama, nnina okukkiriza okukitwala:' weegendereze topima mukisa gwe na kukkiriza kwo. Olowooza nti ekkanisa etuuse ku mutindo gwe ogw'omukisa n'obuvunaanyizibwa? Nze sirowooza bwe ntyo. Ekyalina ebigere bingi eby'okutambula. Weegendereze toziyiza muntu yenna.” Etteeka ery'obwakabaka okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero linaaba— “Ng'okukkiriza kwo bwe kuli.” Bw'oba oyagala omukisa guno, teeka wansi okuwakana kwo, teeka ebigere byo ku mpaka zo, tambula otuuke ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka ogusabe, era tta, era komerera, era suula okuva ku ggwe, ekintu ekikolimire ekiguziyiza, n'olwo onoogufuna; era Mukama alikujjuza amaanyi ge n'ekitiibwa kye kaakano, era ekintu kinaabaawo. Mukama akikkirize. Amiina.

Enkomerero.
fields.body_text: Ndowooza, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nga kaakano nnina ebigambo bitono nnyo eby'okubagamba. Nga bwe kiri, nneenywezezza ku Katonda okuweebwa amaanyi ge ndyogeza ebigambo bino, bagende bakke mu mitima gyammwe ne bavaamu ebibala eby'amangu era eby'olubeerera mu bulamu bwammwe. Nzikiriza nti Mukama tanakwatibwa nnaku na kunakuwala kwokka, naye nzikiriza nti asunguwala, abantu be bwe bakuŋŋaana, ne boogera, ne bayimba, ne basaba, oluvannyuma ne bagenda awatali kibala kirambike kye batuuseeko—awatali kuba nga bamuwaddeko ekintu kyonna, oba okufuna ekintu kyonna okuva gy'ali. Nzikiriza nti awulira ku ffe nga bwe yawulira ku bantu be ab'edda, bwe yayogera mu Malaki 2:13: "...Mubikka ekyoto kya MUKAMA n'amaziga, n'okukaaba n'okusinda, kubanga takyafaayo ku kiweebwayo wadde okukyaniriza n'ekisa okuva mu mukono gwammwe." Nga wandigambye nti, "Mumanyi kye njagala mukole; mujje mukikole; era, bwe muba mukikola, ndyagula amadirisa ag'omu ggulu ne mbafukira omukisa." Omutima gwange gwalumwa olw'ekyo omukyala kye yaŋŋamba ku makya ga leero, nga sinnayingira mu kizimbe kino. Yagamba nti, "Munnange yagamba nti, 'Toyinza kugamba nti ojja kukuŋŋaanya abantu enkumi nnya okukaabira Omwoyo Omutukuvu?' N'agamba nti, 'Yee, bwe ntyo.' 'Kale, kimpa entiisa. Singa waabaawo ekibaawo; singa waabaawo ekikolebwa?'" Singa Katonda yakkiriza ekintu kibaawo; singa Katonda yakkiriza ekintu kikolebwe ekyanditiisizza omuntu. Naye woowe! ekyo kyayoleka ki? Obuziba bw'okubuusabuusa n'obutakkiriza; ate abantu ne beewuunya nti okubuusabuusa kweyongera. Kyewuunyisa nti ababuusabuusa batusekerera n'okutuduulira? Kyewuunyisa nti mu bibiina by'Obujulizi bw'Ekikristaayo abasajja bagolokoka ne bagamba nti enkola y'Ekikristaayo ekaddiye n'eggwaawo? Tekyewuunyisa, ng'ogwo gwe mutima gw'abantu ba Mukama. Abantu bakuŋŋaana, ne basaba, ne boogera, ne bayimba nti "Eleru okusinga omuzira," naye tebakikkiriza n'akatono okusinga abakaafiiri bwe bakikkiriza. Basabira Omwoyo Omutukuvu, so nga tebakkiriza nti waliwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Basaba Katonda akole ekintu, so nga tebamumanyanga kukola kintu kyonna, era tebasuubira nti aliddayo kukikola. Ensi efa olw'obutali bwa mazima buno, era ezikirizibwa kyo. Josephine Butler ayogera, ku Bufaransa, nti "Bufaransa bulindiridde amazima:" era ne Bungereza bwe butyo, era n'ensi yonna erindiridde amazima. Katonda atuyambe okukola abantu ab'amazima. Abamu ku mmwe mukkiriza nti tewali kya kubaawo. Temukkiriza nti Katonda ajja kukola ekintu kyonna—noolwekyo talikola mu bulamu bwammwe. Singa mwabeera e Nazaaleesi, mulowooza nti Yesu Kristo yandibakoledde ekintu kyonna? Singa mwali bakiggala era bakasiru, mwandisigadde bwe mutyo, kubanga teyandisobodde kukola bikolwa bya maanyi mu mmwe, olw'obutakkiriza bwammwe! Ye y'omu kaakano; era bwe muba temumusuubira kukola kintu kyonna, owooluganda, talikola. Naye abamu ku ffe tumusuubira okukola ekintu. Abamu ku ffe tukkiriza nti ajja kukola ekintu, era nti n'ejjinja lino ettono, eryatemebwa okuva mu lusozi awatali mikono, agenderera okuyimusa obwakabaka obunene. Yesu Kristo tajja kunakuwazibwa, n'aleka Setaani okumusekerera mu maaso ennaku zonna, n'agamba nti, "Nkubbye omugabo gwo." Tujja kukola ekintu, oba tufiire mu kukigezaako. Ekisembayo, Katonda ayagala ki gye tuli? Ayagala tube era tukole. Ayagala tufaanane Omwana we, ne tukola nga Omwana we bwe yakola; era bwe tutuuka awo, alinyeenyeza ensi ng'ayita mu ffe. Abantu bagamba nti, "Toyinza kufaanana Omwana we." Kale nnyo, olwo, tojja kufuna kisukka ku ky'okkiriza. Singa ssaalowooza nti Yesu Kristo w'amaanyi agamala okuzikiriza emirimu gya Setaani, n'okututuusa nate ku kifaananyi Katonda kye yasooka okuteekawo, nnandisudde ekintu kyonna emirembe gyonna. Ki! Atuwadde eddiini gye tutayinza kukola? Nti nedda, tajja kutuduulira. Ki? Atuwadde Omulokozi atayinza kulokola? Kale nziggya emikono ku ye. Ki! Yeeyita nti alinkolera kye tayinza? Nedda, nedda. Okubala 23:19 kutugamba nti: "Katonda si muntu, alyoke alimbe, wadde omwana w'omuntu, alyoke akyuse endowooza ye." era mbagamba nti enteekateeka ye ey'obulokozi erina enjuyi bbiri—yolekera eri Katonda ate n'eri omuntu. Enfaako ku nze nga bw'efaako ku Katonda omukulu. Si nteekateeka ya bulokozi bwokka—wabula nteekateeka ya kuzzaawo. Bw'aba tayinza kunzizaawo, awenkanya kunsalira musango. Bw'aba tayinza kumponya, n'ankola buggya, n'anzizaawo ku kifaananyi kye yali ayagadde mbeere, tewali kirala ky'aba yeerekedde. Nsomooza omuntu yenna okulaga okuyita mu Bayibuli nti si kituufu nti agenderera okunzizaawo—obwongo, omutima, emmeeme, omwoyo, omubiri, buli kawenga k'obuntu bwange—okunzizaawo mu bujjuvu, okumpanyisiza ddala mu kifaananyi ky'Omwana we. Singa yasobola okundokola awatali kunzizaawo, olwo yandisobodde okundokola awatali Mulokozi n'akatono. Musoma mutya Bayibuli zammwe? Musoma mutya ebyafaayo by'eby'amagero—ebyafaayo bye yazibula amaaso, n'aggulawo amatu, n'atukuza omugenge, n'azuukiza abafu? Ajja kubawonya bwe mumukkiriza. Bino bye bigambo ensi bya yeetaaga—ebigambo ebiramu, obujulizi obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, abantu abatambula nga bakiikirira Omwoyo, n'obulamu n'amaanyi bya Yesu Kristo. Muyinza okusaasaanya Bayibuli, nga bwe mukoze, mu nsi yonna. Muyinza okubuulira, n'okuyimba, n'okwogera, n'okukola kye mwagala; naye, bwe mutalaga bantu ebbaluwa ennamu, ne mubalaga enkyukakyuka ey'empisa n'obulamu mu mmwe eyaleetebwa amaanyi n'ekisa kya Katonda—bwe mutabagendako ne mukola emirimu gya Yesu Kristo, muyinza okweyongera okubuulira, ate ensi ne yeeyongera kwonooneka, era n'ekkanisa nayo. Twetaaga obujulizi obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Twagala YESU AKOMEWO NATE MU MUBIRI. Wali oyakalaba ekiseera ky'ekikolwa mu kifo ekyo—1 Yokaana 4:2: "...Buli mwoyo ayatula nti Yesu Kristo yajja mu mubiri ava eri Katonda,"—si nti yajja, oba yali azze, wabula nti azze kaakano. Woowe! engeri abantu gye bakyawamu Yesu Kristo mu mubiri. Oyinza okuba ow'eddiini ennyo, ow'amateeka ennyo, okutuusa lw'ojja eri Yesu mu mubiri, olwo balikuluma amannyo nga bwe baalulumira Kristo. Tebasobola kuziyiza bantu ba ngeri eyo. Kino kye ensi ky'eyeetaaga—abantu abatukuvu; era tewali kirala kirikola. Twagezezzaako buli kintu ekirala. Mmwe Abakristaayo abava mu bibinja ebirala eby'eggye lya Mukama, mugezezzaako Bayibuli, n'okubuulira, n'okuyimba, n'okusinza, n'amasomero ga Ssande. Nakyalako oluvannyuma mu kitundu ky'eggwanga gye baŋŋambira nti kumpi buli muntu ow'omu kitundu ekyo yali ayise mu masomero gaabwe aga Ssande, ate nga waliyo abasajja eyo abasika omuwala omuto ku madaala g'amayinja ne bamusamba okutuusa lw'afuuka omuddugavu n'okunyiiga. Ekibiina ekinene eky'abantu abeenyigira mu Byogero bya Lancashire baayita mu masomero gammwe aga Ssande. Kaakano, ŋŋamba nti, Katonda ayogera nammwe mu bintu bino, singa mumuwuliriza, era agamba nti ennukuta etta, nti okukomola, n'okubatiza, n'enkola, n'emikolo, n'okugenda mu kkanisa, n'okusoma Bayibuli, byonna si kintu, bwe mutabaamu Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Mwetaaga obujulizi obwa nnamaddala, obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo nate, era Eggye ly'Obulokozi bwe litagenda kubeera ekyo, Katonda alizikize! Nnandisiimye okwogera ku lumbe lw'Eggye singa ssaalikkirizza nti lyandibadde ekyo. Ensi efiirira kino. Nakwatibwako nnyo, jjo, olw'okuwulira olugero oluva e Paris, olwanjogeddwa omukazi omuto eyaakomawo, ng'aŋŋamba ku mwana wange omwagalwa. Olugero lwali luno: Omukazi yajja, ku makya, n'asaba okulaba omukyala. Ne bagezaako okumugoba, ne babuuza nti, "Omulala tayinza kukola?" "Nedda," omukazi n'agamba; "Njagala nnyo okulaba omukyala yennyini." Ne bagamba nti, "Toyinza kumulaba leero—mulwadde nnyo!" "Kale," n'agamba, "Ndimulaba ddi?" Ne bamuwa ekiseera olunaku olwaddirira olw'oku ssaawa, n'olwo omukazi ono omwavu n'ajja, n'ayogera olugero luno: "Nnawulira, emyaka mukaaga egiyise, nti waliwo omuntu ayinza okuggyamu Setaani. Kaakano, laba, nnina Setaani munda, era ampindula omubi era omunaku, era njagala nnyo aggyibwemu, era mbadde ndduka okumala emyaka gino omukaaga okunoonya omuntu ayinza okumusikamu. Nadda eri bakabona bangi, naye tebaasobola kumusikamu kubanga baalina Setaani munda mu bo; era, laba bwe wabaawo Setaani munda mu nze ne Setaani munda mu bo, twatandika okulwana, ne batasobola kumusikamu." Nga kino kinnyonnyola bulungi Ebikolwa 19:15: "Naye omwoyo omubi ne guddamu nti, 'Yesu mmumanyi, ne Pawulo mmumanyi, naye mmwe muli baani?'" Mazima ddala, tewali ayinza kugoba Setaani ng'alina Setaani mu ye. Amagezi g'omukazi omukadde omunaku ge gaamubuulira kino. "Era," n'ayongerako, "omusajja omulungi yaŋŋamba nti omukyala ono azze wano asobola okumusikamu, era nzize gy'ali akikole, kubanga njagala asikibwemu." Woowe, yee! Ne ndowooza nti, ekyo kye kintu abantu abanaku kye beetaaga mu nsi yonna. BEETAAGA ABANTU ABASOBOLA OKUGOBA SETAANI—abantu abalina amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu munda mu bo okukikola. Woowe! Onooba omuntu ng'oyo? "Katonda ali ludda wa?" omuntu yaŋŋamba olunaku olujja, mu nnaku ennyingi—"Katonda ali ludda wa?" Ddala, ali ludda wa! "Lwaki teyeeraga? Lwaki takola kintu?" Omukyala oyo yatidde nti waabaawo ekintu ekibaawo abantu 4,000 bwe bakuŋŋaana okusabira Omwoyo Omutukuvu! Lwaki nedda? Mugamba nti tekyusa. Enzikiriza yammwe bw'egamba. Mugamba nti y'omu jjo, leero, n'emirembe gyonna. Mugamba nti obwetaavu bw'ensi bunene bwe butyo. Mugamba nti omutima gwe omunene ogw'okwagala gukubira ab'omu maka g'abantu abagwa, ab'ebibi, abakyama. Mugamba nti atwagala. Bulijjo mwogera ku kwagala kwe. Nsonga ki eleetera obutakola kintu ku lwaffe, n'okukka mu bujjuvu obwenkanaawo obw'amaanyi ag'omwoyo nga bwe yakola ku Pentekooti? Lwaki? Lwa kubanga temwewaayo gy'ali era temuli beetegefu kukikola nga abantu bwe baali mu biseera eby'edda. Temubalidde bintu byonna kufaafaaganirwa na kasasiro. Temusudde buli kintu ku minzaani, era, noolwekyo, tajja kubabatiza na Mwoyo Mutukuvu mu ngeri eno. Bano be bantu ensi b'eyeetaaga—abantu ab'ekirowoozo kimu—Kristo, era oyo eyakomererwa. Ku lwa Kristo, muleke okuwakana. Nagamba omukyala eyali afunye omukisa guno omuntu bwe yamutuukako n'atandika n'olunyiriri luno n'oluli, n'enkyusa eno n'eri—"Weegendereze toolina kutandika kwewuunya na kulowooza; ojja kufiirwa omukisa gwo"—era yaguufiirwa. Toyinza kukimanya na kutegeera kwa magezi. Woowe! singa ensi yasobodde okukimanya na kutegeera, bandimanyi bingi nnyo. Naye agaana amagezi go gonna ag'ensi. Si na kutegeera, wabula na kukkiriza! Bw'onoomanya Katonda kinaaba na kukkiriza, ng'ofuuka ng'omwana omuto—ng'oyasamya akamwa ko, ng'ogamba nti, "Mukama, fuka munda;" n'olwo okuwakana kwo n'ebizibu byo binaggwaawo, era onoolaba obutukuvu, okutukuzibwa, obulongoofu, okwagala okutuukiridde, nga byaka ku buli lupapula lw'Ekigambo kya Katonda. Nkaaba mu maaso ga Katonda, mpulira nga kumpi okusukka kye nsobola okugumira, ku mpisa eno embi abantu abamu gye balaga ey'okusika omugaati okugguyako mu kamwa k'abaana nga baakatandika okugwegomba. Mukama abakwatirwe ekisa! Bwe mutayingira mmwe bennyini, ku lwa Kristo temuziyiza balala kuyingira.
